verses.textZh: 耶和华的仆人摩西死了以后，耶和华吩咐摩西的侍从，嫩的儿子约书亚，说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的仆人摩西死了以后，耶和华吩咐摩西的侍从，嫩的儿子约书亚，说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的仆人摩西死了以后，耶和华晓谕摩西的帮手，嫩的儿子约书亚，说：
verses.textEnNiv: After the death of Moses the servant of the Lord , the Lord said to Joshua son of Nun, Moses’ aide:
verses.textEnEsv: After the death of Moses the servant of the Lord , the Lord said to Joshua the son of Nun, Moses’ assistant,
verses.textEnNkjv: After the death of Moses the servant of the Lord, it came to pass that the Lord spoke to Joshua the son of Nun, Moses’ assistant, saying:
verses.textEnNlt: After the death of Moses the Lord ’s servant, the Lord spoke to Joshua son of Nun, Moses’ assistant. He said,
verses.textEnNasb: Now it came about after the death of Moses the servant of the Lord, that the Lord spoke to Joshua the son of Nun, Moses’ servant, saying,
verses.textEn: After the death of Moses the servant of the Lord , the Lord said to Joshua son of Nun, Moses’ aide:

verses.textZh: "我的仆人摩西死了；现在你要起来，和全体人民过这约旦河，到我现在要赐给他们以色列人的地去。
verses.textZhCnvs: "我的仆人摩西死了；现在你要起来，和全体人民过这约旦河，到我现在要赐给他们以色列人的地去。
verses.textZhCuv: 「我的仆人摩西死了。现在你要起来，和众百姓过这约旦河，往我所要赐给以色列人的地去。
verses.textEnNiv: "Moses my servant is dead. Now then, you and all these people, get ready to cross the Jordan River into the land I am about to give to them—to the Israelites.
verses.textEnEsv: "Moses my servant is dead. Now therefore arise, go over this Jordan, you and all this people, into the land that I am giving to them, to the people of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Moses My servant is dead. Now therefore, arise, go over this Jordan, you and all this people, to the land which I am giving to them—the children of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: "Moses my servant is dead. Therefore, the time has come for you to lead these people, the Israelites, across the Jordan River into the land I am giving them.
verses.textEnNasb: "Moses My servant is dead; so now arise, cross this Jordan, you and all this people, to the land which I am giving to them, to the sons of Israel.
verses.textEn: "Moses my servant is dead. Now then, you and all these people, get ready to cross the Jordan River into the land I am about to give to them—to the Israelites.

verses.textZh: 你们脚掌踏过的每一处地方，我都照着我应许摩西的赐给你们了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们脚掌踏过的每一处地方，我都照着我应许摩西的赐给你们了。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡你们脚掌所踏之地，我都照着我所应许摩西的话赐给你们了。
verses.textEnNiv: I will give you every place where you set your foot, as I promised Moses.
verses.textEnEsv: Every place that the sole of your foot will tread upon I have given to you, just as I promised to Moses.
verses.textEnNkjv: Every place that the sole of your foot will tread upon I have given you, as I said to Moses.
verses.textEnNlt: I promise you what I promised Moses: ‘Wherever you set foot, you will be on land I have given you—
verses.textEnNasb: Every place on which the sole of your foot steps, I have given it to you, just as I spoke to Moses.
verses.textEn: I will give you every place where you set your foot, as I promised Moses.

verses.textZh: 从旷野和这黎巴嫩，直到大河，就是幼发拉底河，赫人的全地，以至大海日落的地方，就是你们的疆界。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从旷野和这黎巴嫩，直到大河，就是幼发拉底河，赫人的全地，以至大海日落的地方，就是你们的疆界。
verses.textZhCuv: 从旷野和这黎巴嫩，直到幼发拉底大河，赫人的全地，又到大海日落之处，都要作你们的境界。
verses.textEnNiv: Your territory will extend from the desert to Lebanon, and from the great river, the Euphrates—all the Hittite country—to the Mediterranean Sea in the west.
verses.textEnEsv: From the wilderness and this Lebanon as far as the great river, the river Euphrates, all the land of the Hittites to the Great Sea toward the going down of the sun shall be your territory.
verses.textEnNkjv: From the wilderness and this Lebanon as far as the great river, the River Euphrates, all the land of the Hittites, and to the Great Sea toward the going down of the sun, shall be your territory.
verses.textEnNlt: from the Negev wilderness in the south to the Lebanon mountains in the north, from the Euphrates River in the east to the Mediterranean Sea in the west, including all the land of the Hittites.’
verses.textEnNasb: From the wilderness and this Lebanon, even as far as the great river, the river Euphrates, all the land of the Hittites, and as far as the Great Sea toward the setting of the sun will be your territory.
verses.textEn: Your territory will extend from the desert to Lebanon, and from the great river, the Euphrates—all the Hittite country—to the Mediterranean Sea in the west.

verses.textZh: 你一生的日子必没有一人能在你面前立得住；我怎样与摩西同在，也必照样与你同在；我决不离开你，也不离弃你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你一生的日子必没有一人能在你面前立得住；我怎样与摩西同在，也必照样与你同在；我决不离开你，也不离弃你。
verses.textZhCuv: 你平生的日子，必无一人能在你面前站立得住。我怎样与摩西同在，也必照样与你同在；我必不撇下你，也不丢弃你。
verses.textEnNiv: No one will be able to stand against you all the days of your life. As I was with Moses, so I will be with you; I will never leave you nor forsake you.
verses.textEnEsv: No man shall be able to stand before you all the days of your life. Just as I was with Moses, so I will be with you. I will not leave you or forsake you.
verses.textEnNkjv: No man shall beableto stand before you all the days of your life; as I was with Moses, so I will be with you. I will not leave you nor forsake you.
verses.textEnNlt: No one will be able to stand against you as long as you live. For I will be with you as I was with Moses. I will not fail you or abandon you.
verses.textEnNasb: No one will be able to oppose you all the days of your life. Just as I have been with Moses, I will be with you; I will not desert you nor abandon you.
verses.textEn: No one will be able to stand against you all the days of your life. As I was with Moses, so I will be with you; I will never leave you nor forsake you.

verses.textZh: 你要坚强勇敢，因为你必使这人民得着我曾经向他们列祖起誓，要赐给他们的那地作产业。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要坚强勇敢，因为你必使这人民得着我曾经向他们列祖起誓，要赐给他们的那地作产业。
verses.textZhCuv: 你当刚强壮胆！因为你必使这百姓承受那地为业，就是我向他们列祖起誓应许赐给他们的地。
verses.textEnNiv: Be strong and courageous, because you will lead these people to inherit the land I swore to their ancestors to give them.
verses.textEnEsv: Be strong and courageous, for you shall cause this people to inherit the land that I swore to their fathers to give them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Be strong and of good courage, for to this people you shall divide as an inheritance the land which I swore to their fathers to give them.
verses.textEnNlt: "Be strong and courageous, for you are the one who will lead these people to possess all the land I swore to their ancestors I would give them.
verses.textEnNasb: Be strong and courageous, for you shall give this people possession of the land which I swore to their fathers to give them.
verses.textEn: Be strong and courageous, because you will lead these people to inherit the land I swore to their ancestors to give them.

verses.textZh: 你只要坚强，十分勇敢，谨守遵行我仆人摩西吩咐你的一切律法，不可偏离左右，好使你无论到哪里去，都可以亨通。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你只要坚强，十分勇敢，谨守遵行我仆人摩西吩咐你的一切律法，不可偏离左右，好使你无论到哪里去，都可以亨通。
verses.textZhCuv: 只要刚强，大大壮胆，谨守遵行我仆人摩西所吩咐你的一切律法，不可偏离左右，使你无论往哪里去，都可以顺利。
verses.textEnNiv: "Be strong and very courageous. Be careful to obey all the law my servant Moses gave you; do not turn from it to the right or to the left, that you may be successful wherever you go.
verses.textEnEsv: Only be strong and very courageous, being careful to do according to all the law that Moses my servant commanded you. Do not turn from it to the right hand or to the left, that you may have good success wherever you go.
verses.textEnNkjv: Only be strong and very courageous, that you may observe to do according to all the law which Moses My servant commanded you; do not turn from it to the right hand or to the left, that you may prosper wherever you go.
verses.textEnNlt: Be strong and very courageous. Be careful to obey all the instructions Moses gave you. Do not deviate from them, turning either to the right or to the left. Then you will be successful in everything you do.
verses.textEnNasb: Only be strong and very courageous; be careful to do according to all the Law which Moses My servant commanded you; do not turn from it to the right or to the left, so that you may achieve success wherever you go.
verses.textEn: "Be strong and very courageous. Be careful to obey all the law my servant Moses gave you; do not turn from it to the right or to the left, that you may be successful wherever you go.

verses.textZh: 这律法书不可离开你的口，要昼夜默诵，好使你谨守遵行书中所记的一切；这样，你的道路就必顺利，你必一路亨通。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这律法书不可离开你的口，要昼夜默诵，好使你谨守遵行书中所记的一切；这样，你的道路就必顺利，你必一路亨通。
verses.textZhCuv: 这律法书不可离开你的口，总要昼夜思想，好使你谨守遵行这书上所写的一切话。如此，你的道路就可以亨通，凡事顺利。
verses.textEnNiv: Keep this Book of the Law always on your lips; meditate on it day and night, so that you may be careful to do everything written in it. Then you will be prosperous and successful.
verses.textEnEsv: This Book of the Law shall not depart from your mouth, but you shall meditate on it day and night, so that you may be careful to do according to all that is written in it. For then you will make your way prosperous, and then you will have good success.
verses.textEnNkjv: This Book of the Law shall not depart from your mouth, but you shall meditate in it day and night, that you may observe to do according to all that is written in it. For then you will make your way prosperous, and then you will have good success.
verses.textEnNlt: Study this Book of Instruction continually. Meditate on it day and night so you will be sure to obey everything written in it. Only then will you prosper and succeed in all you do.
verses.textEnNasb: This Book of the Law shall not depart from your mouth, but you shall meditate on it day and night, so that you may be careful to do according to all that is written in it; for then you will make your way prosperous, and then you will achieve success.
verses.textEn: Keep this Book of the Law always on your lips; meditate on it day and night, so that you may be careful to do everything written in it. Then you will be prosperous and successful.

verses.textZh: 我不是吩咐过你要坚强勇敢吗？所以，你不要惧怕，也不要惊慌；因为你无论到哪里去，耶和华你的神必与你同在。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我不是吩咐过你要坚强勇敢吗？所以，你不要惧怕，也不要惊慌；因为你无论到哪里去，耶和华你的神必与你同在。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我岂没有吩咐你吗？你当刚强壮胆！不要惧怕，也不要惊惶；因为你无论往哪里去，耶和华－你的神必与你同在。」
verses.textEnNiv: Have I not commanded you? Be strong and courageous. Do not be afraid; do not be discouraged, for the Lord your God will be with you wherever you go."
verses.textEnEsv: Have I not commanded you? Be strong and courageous. Do not be frightened, and do not be dismayed, for the Lord your God is with you wherever you go."
verses.textEnNkjv: Have I not commanded you? Be strong and of good courage; do not be afraid, nor be dismayed, for the Lord your God is with you wherever you go."
verses.textEnNlt: This is my command—be strong and courageous! Do not be afraid or discouraged. For the Lord your God is with you wherever you go."
verses.textEnNasb: Have I not commanded you? Be strong and courageous! Do not be terrified nor dismayed, for the Lord your God is with you wherever you go."
verses.textEn: Have I not commanded you? Be strong and courageous. Do not be afraid; do not be discouraged, for the Lord your God will be with you wherever you go."

verses.textZh: 于是约书亚吩咐人民的官长说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是约书亚吩咐人民的官长说：
verses.textZhCuv: 于是，约书亚吩咐百姓的官长说：
verses.textEnNiv: So Joshua ordered the officers of the people:
verses.textEnEsv: And Joshua commanded the officers of the people,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Joshua commanded the officers of the people, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: Joshua then commanded the officers of Israel,
verses.textEnNasb: Then Joshua commanded the officers of the people, saying,
verses.textEn: So Joshua ordered the officers of the people:

verses.textZh: "你们要走遍营中，吩咐人民说：‘你们要预备粮食，因为三天之内，你们要过这约旦河，进去得耶和华你们的神要赐给你们作产业的地。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: "你们要走遍营中，吩咐人民说：‘你们要预备粮食，因为三天之内，你们要过这约旦河，进去得耶和华你们的神要赐给你们作产业的地。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 「你们要走遍营中，吩咐百姓说：『当预备食物；因为三日之内你们要过这约旦河，进去得耶和华－你们神赐你们为业之地。』」
verses.textEnNiv: "Go through the camp and tell the people, ‘Get your provisions ready. Three days from now you will cross the Jordan here to go in and take possession of the land the Lord your God is giving you for your own.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: "Pass through the midst of the camp and command the people, ‘Prepare your provisions, for within three days you are to pass over this Jordan to go in to take possession of the land that the Lord your God is giving you to possess.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: "Pass through the camp and command the people, saying, ‘Prepare provisions for yourselves, for within three days you will cross over this Jordan, to go in to possess the land which the Lord your God is giving you to possess.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: "Go through the camp and tell the people to get their provisions ready. In three days you will cross the Jordan River and take possession of the land the Lord your God is giving you."
verses.textEnNasb: "Pass through the midst of the camp and command the people, saying, ‘Prepare provisions for yourselves, for within three days you are going to cross this Jordan, to go in to take possession of the land which the Lord your God is giving you, to possess it.’ "
verses.textEn: "Go through the camp and tell the people, ‘Get your provisions ready. Three days from now you will cross the Jordan here to go in and take possession of the land the Lord your God is giving you for your own.’ "

verses.textZh: 约书亚又对流本人、迦得人和玛拿西半个支派的人说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 约书亚又对流本人、迦得人和玛拿西半个支派的人说：
verses.textZhCuv: 约书亚对吕便人、迦得人，和玛拿西半支派的人说：
verses.textEnNiv: But to the Reubenites, the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh, Joshua said,
verses.textEnEsv: And to the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh Joshua said,
verses.textEnNkjv: And to the Reubenites, the Gadites, and half the tribe of Manasseh Joshua spoke, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: Then Joshua called together the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and the half-tribe of Manasseh. He told them,
verses.textEnNasb: But to the Reubenites, to the Gadites, and to the half-tribe of Manasseh, Joshua said,
verses.textEn: But to the Reubenites, the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh, Joshua said,

verses.textZh: "你们要记住耶和华的仆人摩西吩咐你们的话：‘耶和华你们的神赐你们安息，他必把这地赐给你们。’
verses.textZhCnvs: "你们要记住耶和华的仆人摩西吩咐你们的话：‘耶和华你们的神赐你们安息，他必把这地赐给你们。’
verses.textZhCuv: 「你们要追念耶和华的仆人摩西所吩咐你们的话说：『耶和华－你们的神使你们得享平安，也必将这地赐给你们。』
verses.textEnNiv: "Remember the command that Moses the servant of the Lord gave you after he said, ‘The Lord your God will give you rest by giving you this land.’
verses.textEnEsv: "Remember the word that Moses the servant of the Lord commanded you, saying, ‘The Lord your God is providing you a place of rest and will give you this land.’
verses.textEnNkjv: "Remember the word which Moses the servant of the Lord commanded you, saying, ‘The Lord your God is giving you rest and is giving you this land.’
verses.textEnNlt: "Remember what Moses, the servant of the Lord , commanded you: ‘The Lord your God is giving you a place of rest. He has given you this land.’
verses.textEnNasb: "Remember the word which Moses the servant of the Lord commanded you, saying, ‘The Lord your God is giving you rest, and will give you this land.’
verses.textEn: "Remember the command that Moses the servant of the Lord gave you after he said, ‘The Lord your God will give you rest by giving you this land.’

verses.textZh: 你们的妻子、孩子和牲畜，都可以留在约旦河东边、摩西赐给你们的地上；但你们所有英勇的战士，都要拿起武器，在你们的兄弟前面过河去，帮助他们；
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们的妻子、孩子和牲畜，都可以留在约旦河东边、摩西赐给你们的地上；但你们所有英勇的战士，都要拿起武器，在你们的兄弟前面过河去，帮助他们；
verses.textZhCuv: 你们的妻子、孩子，和牲畜都可以留在约旦河东、摩西所给你们的地；但你们中间一切大能的勇士都要带着兵器在你们的弟兄前面过去，帮助他们，
verses.textEnNiv: Your wives, your children and your livestock may stay in the land that Moses gave you east of the Jordan, but all your fighting men, ready for battle, must cross over ahead of your fellow Israelites. You are to help them
verses.textEnEsv: Your wives, your little ones, and your livestock shall remain in the land that Moses gave you beyond the Jordan, but all the men of valor among you shall pass over armed before your brothers and shall help them,
verses.textEnNkjv: Your wives, your little ones, and your livestock shall remain in the land which Moses gave you on this side of the Jordan. But you shall pass before your brethren armed, all your mighty men of valor, and help them,
verses.textEnNlt: Your wives, children, and livestock may remain here in the land Moses assigned to you on the east side of the Jordan River. But your strong warriors, fully armed, must lead the other tribes across the Jordan to help them conquer their territory. Stay with them
verses.textEnNasb: Your wives, your little ones, and your livestock shall remain in the land which Moses gave you beyond the Jordan, but you shall cross ahead of your brothers in battle formation, all your valiant warriors, and shall help them,
verses.textEn: Your wives, your children and your livestock may stay in the land that Moses gave you east of the Jordan, but all your fighting men, ready for battle, must cross over ahead of your fellow Israelites. You are to help them

verses.textZh: 等到耶和华使你们的兄弟可以和你们一样安居，同样得着耶和华你们的神要赐给他们作产业的地，你们才可以回到你们所得的地，以它作你们的产业，就是耶和华的仆人摩西在约旦河东边日出之地赐给你们的地方。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 等到耶和华使你们的兄弟可以和你们一样安居，同样得着耶和华你们的神要赐给他们作产业的地，你们才可以回到你们所得的地，以它作你们的产业，就是耶和华的仆人摩西在约旦河东边日出之地赐给你们的地方。"
verses.textZhCuv: 等到耶和华使你们的弟兄像你们一样得享平安，并且得着耶和华－你们神所赐他们为业之地，那时才可以回你们所得之地，承受为业，就是耶和华的仆人摩西在约旦河东、向日出之地所给你们的。」
verses.textEnNiv: until the Lord gives them rest, as he has done for you, and until they too have taken possession of the land the Lord your God is giving them. After that, you may go back and occupy your own land, which Moses the servant of the Lord gave you east of the Jordan toward the sunrise."
verses.textEnEsv: until the Lord gives rest to your brothers as he has to you, and they also take possession of the land that the Lord your God is giving them. Then you shall return to the land of your possession and shall possess it, the land that Moses the servant of the Lord gave you beyond the Jordan toward the sunrise."
verses.textEnNkjv: until the Lord has given your brethren rest, as He gave you, and they also have taken possession of the land which the Lord your God is giving them. Then you shall return to the land of your possession and enjoy it, which Moses the Lord’s servant gave you on this side of the Jordan toward the sunrise."
verses.textEnNlt: until the Lord gives them rest, as he has given you rest, and until they, too, possess the land the Lord your God is giving them. Only then may you return and settle here on the east side of the Jordan River in the land that Moses, the servant of the Lord , assigned to you."
verses.textEnNasb: until the Lord gives your brothers rest, as He is giving you, and they also possess the land which the Lord your God is giving them. Then you may return to your own land, and take possession of that which Moses the servant of the Lord gave you beyond the Jordan toward the sunrise."
verses.textEn: until the Lord gives them rest, as he has done for you, and until they too have taken possession of the land the Lord your God is giving them. After that, you may go back and occupy your own land, which Moses the servant of the Lord gave you east of the Jordan toward the sunrise."

verses.textZh: 他们回答约书亚，说："你吩咐我们的一切，我们都必遵行；无论你差派我们到哪里去，我们都一定去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们回答约书亚，说："你吩咐我们的一切，我们都必遵行；无论你差派我们到哪里去，我们都一定去。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们回答约书亚说：「你所吩咐我们行的，我们都必行；你所差遣我们去的，我们都必去。
verses.textEnNiv: Then they answered Joshua, "Whatever you have commanded us we will do, and wherever you send us we will go.
verses.textEnEsv: And they answered Joshua, "All that you have commanded us we will do, and wherever you send us we will go.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they answered Joshua, saying, "All that you command us we will do, and wherever you send us we will go.
verses.textEnNlt: They answered Joshua, "We will do whatever you command us, and we will go wherever you send us.
verses.textEnNasb: They answered Joshua, saying, "All that you have commanded us we will do, and wherever you send us we will go.
verses.textEn: Then they answered Joshua, "Whatever you have commanded us we will do, and wherever you send us we will go.

verses.textZh: 我们从前怎样凡事听从摩西，现在也必照样听从你；唯愿耶和华你的神与你同在，像与摩西同在一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们从前怎样凡事听从摩西，现在也必照样听从你；唯愿耶和华你的神与你同在，像与摩西同在一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们从前在一切事上怎样听从摩西，现在也必照样听从你；惟愿耶和华－你的神与你同在，像与摩西同在一样。
verses.textEnNiv: Just as we fully obeyed Moses, so we will obey you. Only may the Lord your God be with you as he was with Moses.
verses.textEnEsv: Just as we obeyed Moses in all things, so we will obey you. Only may the Lord your God be with you, as he was with Moses!
verses.textEnNkjv: Just as we heeded Moses in all things, so we will heed you. Only the Lord your God be with you, as He was with Moses.
verses.textEnNlt: We will obey you just as we obeyed Moses. And may the Lord your God be with you as he was with Moses.
verses.textEnNasb: Just as we obeyed Moses in all things, so we will obey you; only may the Lord your God be with you as He was with Moses.
verses.textEn: Just as we fully obeyed Moses, so we will obey you. Only may the Lord your God be with you as he was with Moses.

verses.textZh: 无论谁违背你的话，不听从你吩咐他的一切命令，那人必要处死。你只管坚强勇敢。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 无论谁违背你的话，不听从你吩咐他的一切命令，那人必要处死。你只管坚强勇敢。"
verses.textZhCuv: 无论什么人违背你的命令，不听从你所吩咐他的一切话，就必治死他。你只要刚强壮胆！」
verses.textEnNiv: Whoever rebels against your word and does not obey it, whatever you may command them, will be put to death. Only be strong and courageous!"
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever rebels against your commandment and disobeys your words, whatever you command him, shall be put to death. Only be strong and courageous."
verses.textEnNkjv: Whoever rebels against your command and does not heed your words, in all that you command him, shall be put to death. Only be strong and of good courage."
verses.textEnNlt: Anyone who rebels against your orders and does not obey your words and everything you command will be put to death. So be strong and courageous!"
verses.textEnNasb: Anyone who rebels against your command and does not obey your words in all that you command him, shall be put to death; only be strong and courageous."
verses.textEn: Whoever rebels against your word and does not obey it, whatever you may command them, will be put to death. Only be strong and courageous!"

verses.textZh: 于是，嫩的儿子约书亚从什亭秘密地差派两个探子，对他们说："你们去窥探那地，尤其是耶利哥。"二人去了，来到一个名叫喇合的妓女家中，就在那里住宿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，嫩的儿子约书亚从什亭秘密地差派两个探子，对他们说："你们去窥探那地，尤其是耶利哥。"二人去了，来到一个名叫喇合的妓女家中，就在那里住宿。
verses.textZhCuv: 当下，嫩的儿子约书亚从什亭暗暗打发两个人作探子，吩咐说：「你们去窥探那地和耶利哥。」于是二人去了，来到一个妓女名叫喇合的家里，就在那里躺卧。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Joshua son of Nun secretly sent two spies from Shittim. "Go, look over the land," he said, "especially Jericho." So they went and entered the house of a prostitute named Rahab and stayed there.
verses.textEnEsv: And Joshua the son of Nun sent two men secretly from Shittim as spies, saying, "Go, view the land, especially Jericho." And they went and came into the house of a prostitute whose name was Rahab and lodged there.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Joshua the son of Nun sent out two men from Acacia Grove to spy secretly, saying, "Go, view the land, especially Jericho." So they went, and came to the house of a harlot named Rahab, and lodged there.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Joshua secretly sent out two spies from the Israelite camp at Acacia Grove. He instructed them, "Scout out the land on the other side of the Jordan River, especially around Jericho." So the two men set out and came to the house of a prostitute named Rahab and stayed there that night.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Joshua the son of Nun sent two men as spies secretly from Shittim, saying, "Go, view the land, especially Jericho." So they went and entered the house of a prostitute whose name was Rahab, and rested there.
verses.textEn: Then Joshua son of Nun secretly sent two spies from Shittim. "Go, look over the land," he said, "especially Jericho." So they went and entered the house of a prostitute named Rahab and stayed there.

verses.textZh: 有人向耶利哥王报告："今夜从以色列人那里有人进来，要窥探这地。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 有人向耶利哥王报告："今夜从以色列人那里有人进来，要窥探这地。"
verses.textZhCuv: 有人告诉耶利哥王说：「今夜有以色列人来到这里窥探此地。」
verses.textEnNiv: The king of Jericho was told, "Look, some of the Israelites have come here tonight to spy out the land."
verses.textEnEsv: And it was told to the king of Jericho, "Behold, men of Israel have come here tonight to search out the land."
verses.textEnNkjv: And it was told the king of Jericho, saying, "Behold, men have come here tonight from the children of Israel to search out the country."
verses.textEnNlt: But someone told the king of Jericho, "Some Israelites have come here tonight to spy out the land."
verses.textEnNasb: But it was told to the king of Jericho, saying, "Behold, men from the sons of Israel have come here tonight to spy out the land."
verses.textEn: The king of Jericho was told, "Look, some of the Israelites have come here tonight to spy out the land."

verses.textZh: 耶利哥王派人到喇合那里，说："把那些来到你这里，进了你家中的人带出来，因为他们来是要窥探全地的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶利哥王派人到喇合那里，说："把那些来到你这里，进了你家中的人带出来，因为他们来是要窥探全地的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶利哥王打发人去见喇合说：「那来到你这里、进了你家的人要交出来，因为他们来窥探全地。」
verses.textEnNiv: So the king of Jericho sent this message to Rahab: "Bring out the men who came to you and entered your house, because they have come to spy out the whole land."
verses.textEnEsv: Then the king of Jericho sent to Rahab, saying, "Bring out the men who have come to you, who entered your house, for they have come to search out all the land."
verses.textEnNkjv: So the king of Jericho sent to Rahab, saying, "Bring out the men who have come to you, who have entered your house, for they have come to search out all the country."
verses.textEnNlt: So the king of Jericho sent orders to Rahab: "Bring out the men who have come into your house, for they have come here to spy out the whole land."
verses.textEnNasb: And the king of Jericho sent word to Rahab, saying, "Bring out the men who have come to you, who have entered your house, for they have come to spy out all the land."
verses.textEn: So the king of Jericho sent this message to Rahab: "Bring out the men who came to you and entered your house, because they have come to spy out the whole land."

verses.textZh: 但那女人已把那两个人藏起来，还这样回答王："不错，那些人到过我这里来，但是，我不知道他们是从哪里来的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但那女人已把那两个人藏起来，还这样回答王："不错，那些人到过我这里来，但是，我不知道他们是从哪里来的。
verses.textZhCuv: 女人将二人隐藏，就回答说：「那人果然到我这里来；他们是哪里来的我却不知道。
verses.textEnNiv: But the woman had taken the two men and hidden them. She said, "Yes, the men came to me, but I did not know where they had come from.
verses.textEnEsv: But the woman had taken the two men and hidden them. And she said, "True, the men came to me, but I did not know where they were from.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the woman took the two men and hid them. So she said, "Yes, the men came to me, but I did not know where they were from.
verses.textEnNlt: Rahab had hidden the two men, but she replied, "Yes, the men were here earlier, but I didn’t know where they were from.
verses.textEnNasb: But the woman had taken the two men and hidden them, and she said, "Yes, the men came to me, but I did not know where they were from.
verses.textEn: But the woman had taken the two men and hidden them. She said, "Yes, the men came to me, but I did not know where they had come from.

verses.textZh: 天黑、城门快要关的时候，那些人出去了；我不知道他们到哪里去。你们快去追赶，必可以追上他们。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 天黑、城门快要关的时候，那些人出去了；我不知道他们到哪里去。你们快去追赶，必可以追上他们。"
verses.textZhCuv: 天黑、要关城门的时候，他们出去了，往哪里去我却不知道。你们快快地去追赶，就必追上。」（
verses.textEnNiv: At dusk, when it was time to close the city gate, they left. I don’t know which way they went. Go after them quickly. You may catch up with them."
verses.textEnEsv: And when the gate was about to be closed at dark, the men went out. I do not know where the men went. Pursue them quickly, for you will overtake them."
verses.textEnNkjv: And it happened as the gate was being shut, when it was dark, that the men went out. Where the men went I do not know; pursue them quickly, for you may overtake them."
verses.textEnNlt: They left the town at dusk, as the gates were about to close. I don’t know where they went. If you hurry, you can probably catch up with them."
verses.textEnNasb: It came about, when it was time to shut the gate at dark, that the men went out; I do not know where the men went. Pursue them quickly, for you will overtake them."
verses.textEn: At dusk, when it was time to close the city gate, they left. I don’t know which way they went. Go after them quickly. You may catch up with them."

verses.textZh: 其实她领他们上了屋顶，把他们藏在堆放在屋顶的麻秸里面。
verses.textZhCnvs: 其实她领他们上了屋顶，把他们藏在堆放在屋顶的麻秸里面。
verses.textZhCuv: 先是女人领二人上了房顶，将他们藏在那里所摆的麻秸中。）
verses.textEnNiv: (But she had taken them up to the roof and hidden them under the stalks of flax she had laid out on the roof.)
verses.textEnEsv: But she had brought them up to the roof and hid them with the stalks of flax that she had laid in order on the roof.
verses.textEnNkjv: (But she had brought them up to the roof and hidden them with the stalks of flax, which she had laid in order on the roof.)
verses.textEnNlt: (Actually, she had taken them up to the roof and hidden them beneath bundles of flax she had laid out.)
verses.textEnNasb: But she had brought them up to the roof and hidden them in the stalks of flax which she had laid in order on the roof.
verses.textEn: (But she had taken them up to the roof and hidden them under the stalks of flax she had laid out on the roof.)

verses.textZh: 那些人就沿着往约旦河的路上追赶他们，直到渡口；追赶的人一出城，城门就关上了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那些人就沿着往约旦河的路上追赶他们，直到渡口；追赶的人一出城，城门就关上了。
verses.textZhCuv: 那些人就往约旦河的渡口追赶他们去了。追赶他们的人一出去，城门就关了。
verses.textEnNiv: So the men set out in pursuit of the spies on the road that leads to the fords of the Jordan, and as soon as the pursuers had gone out, the gate was shut.
verses.textEnEsv: So the men pursued after them on the way to the Jordan as far as the fords. And the gate was shut as soon as the pursuers had gone out.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the men pursued them by the road to the Jordan, to the fords. And as soon as those who pursued them had gone out, they shut the gate.
verses.textEnNlt: So the king’s men went looking for the spies along the road leading to the shallow crossings of the Jordan River. And as soon as the king’s men had left, the gate of Jericho was shut.
verses.textEnNasb: So the men pursued them on the road to the Jordan, to the crossing places; and as soon as those who were pursuing them had gone out, they shut the gate.
verses.textEn: So the men set out in pursuit of the spies on the road that leads to the fords of the Jordan, and as soon as the pursuers had gone out, the gate was shut.

verses.textZh: 两个探子还没有躺下睡觉，那女人就上屋顶到他们那里去，
verses.textZhCnvs: 两个探子还没有躺下睡觉，那女人就上屋顶到他们那里去，
verses.textZhCuv: 二人还没有躺卧，女人就上房顶，到他们那里，
verses.textEnNiv: Before the spies lay down for the night, she went up on the roof
verses.textEnEsv: Before the men lay down, she came up to them on the roof
verses.textEnNkjv: Now before they lay down, she came up to them on the roof,
verses.textEnNlt: Before the spies went to sleep that night, Rahab went up on the roof to talk with them.
verses.textEnNasb: Now before the spies lay down, she came up to them on the roof,
verses.textEn: Before the spies lay down for the night, she went up on the roof

verses.textZh: 对他们二人说："我知道耶和华已经把这地赐给你们了，你们使我们十分害怕，这地所有的居民都在你们面前胆战心惊。
verses.textZhCnvs: 对他们二人说："我知道耶和华已经把这地赐给你们了，你们使我们十分害怕，这地所有的居民都在你们面前胆战心惊。
verses.textZhCuv: 对他们说：「我知道耶和华已经把这地赐给你们，并且因你们的缘故我们都惊慌了。这地的一切居民在你们面前心都消化了；
verses.textEnNiv: and said to them, "I know that the Lord has given you this land and that a great fear of you has fallen on us, so that all who live in this country are melting in fear because of you.
verses.textEnEsv: and said to the men, "I know that the Lord has given you the land, and that the fear of you has fallen upon us, and that all the inhabitants of the land melt away before you.
verses.textEnNkjv: and said to the men: "I know that the Lord has given you the land, that the terror of you has fallen on us, and that all the inhabitants of the land are fainthearted because of you.
verses.textEnNlt: "I know the Lord has given you this land," she told them. "We are all afraid of you. Everyone in the land is living in terror.
verses.textEnNasb: and said to the men, "I know that the Lord has given you the land, and that the terror of you has fallen on us, and that all the inhabitants of the land have despaired because of you.
verses.textEn: and said to them, "I know that the Lord has given you this land and that a great fear of you has fallen on us, so that all who live in this country are melting in fear because of you.

verses.textZh: 因为我们听见你们从埃及出来的时候，耶和华怎样使红海的水在你们面前干了，以及你们怎样对待约旦河东亚摩利人的两个王西宏和噩，把他们完全消灭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为我们听见你们从埃及出来的时候，耶和华怎样使红海的水在你们面前干了，以及你们怎样对待约旦河东亚摩利人的两个王西宏和噩，把他们完全消灭。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为我们听见你们出埃及的时候，耶和华怎样在你们前面使红海的水干了，并且你们怎样待约旦河东的两个亚摩利王西宏和噩，将他们尽行毁灭。
verses.textEnNiv: We have heard how the Lord dried up the water of the Red Sea for you when you came out of Egypt, and what you did to Sihon and Og, the two kings of the Amorites east of the Jordan, whom you completely destroyed.
verses.textEnEsv: For we have heard how the Lord dried up the water of the Red Sea before you when you came out of Egypt, and what you did to the two kings of the Amorites who were beyond the Jordan, to Sihon and Og, whom you devoted to destruction.
verses.textEnNkjv: For we have heard how the Lord dried up the water of the Red Sea for you when you came out of Egypt, and what you did to the two kings of the Amorites who were on the other side of the Jordan, Sihon and Og, whom you utterly destroyed.
verses.textEnNlt: For we have heard how the Lord made a dry path for you through the Red Sea when you left Egypt. And we know what you did to Sihon and Og, the two Amorite kings east of the Jordan River, whose people you completely destroyed.
verses.textEnNasb: For we have heard how the Lord dried up the water of the Red Sea before you when you came out of Egypt, and what you did to the two kings of the Amorites who were beyond the Jordan, to Sihon and Og, whom you utterly destroyed.
verses.textEn: We have heard how the Lord dried up the water of the Red Sea for you when you came out of Egypt, and what you did to Sihon and Og, the two kings of the Amorites east of the Jordan, whom you completely destroyed.

verses.textZh: 我们听见了，就都心里惊怕；没有一人再有勇气在你们面前站立；因为耶和华你们的神是天上、也是地上的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们听见了，就都心里惊怕；没有一人再有勇气在你们面前站立；因为耶和华你们的神是天上、也是地上的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们一听见这些事，心就消化了。因你们的缘故，并无一人有胆气。耶和华－你们的神本是上天下地的神。
verses.textEnNiv: When we heard of it, our hearts melted in fear and everyone’s courage failed because of you, for the Lord your God is God in heaven above and on the earth below.
verses.textEnEsv: And as soon as we heard it, our hearts melted, and there was no spirit left in any man because of you, for the Lord your God, he is God in the heavens above and on the earth beneath.
verses.textEnNkjv: And as soon as we heard thesethings, our hearts melted; neither did there remain any more courage in anyone because of you, for the Lord your God, He is God in heaven above and on earth beneath.
verses.textEnNlt: No wonder our hearts have melted in fear! No one has the courage to fight after hearing such things. For the Lord your God is the supreme God of the heavens above and the earth below.
verses.textEnNasb: When we heard these reports, our hearts melted and no courage remained in anyone any longer because of you; for the Lord your God, He is God in heaven above and on earth below.
verses.textEn: When we heard of it, our hearts melted in fear and everyone’s courage failed because of you, for the Lord your God is God in heaven above and on the earth below.

verses.textZh: 现在求你们指着耶和华向我起誓：我既然恩待了你们，你们也要恩待我的父家，并且给我一个确实的凭据，
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在求你们指着耶和华向我起誓：我既然恩待了你们，你们也要恩待我的父家，并且给我一个确实的凭据，
verses.textZhCuv: 现在我既是恩待你们，求你们指着耶和华向我起誓，也要恩待我父家，并给我一个实在的证据，
verses.textEnNiv: "Now then, please swear to me by the Lord that you will show kindness to my family, because I have shown kindness to you. Give me a sure sign
verses.textEnEsv: Now then, please swear to me by the Lord that, as I have dealt kindly with you, you also will deal kindly with my father’s house, and give me a sure sign
verses.textEnNkjv: Now therefore, I beg you, swear to me by the Lord, since I have shown you kindness, that you also will show kindness to my father’s house, and give me a true token,
verses.textEnNlt: "Now swear to me by the Lord that you will be kind to me and my family since I have helped you. Give me some guarantee that
verses.textEnNasb: Now then, please swear to me by the Lord, since I have dealt kindly with you, that you also will deal kindly with my father’s household, and give me a pledge of truth,
verses.textEn: "Now then, please swear to me by the Lord that you will show kindness to my family, because I have shown kindness to you. Give me a sure sign

verses.textZh: 放过我的父母、兄弟姊妹和他们所有的一切，救我们的命不致死亡。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 放过我的父母、兄弟姊妹和他们所有的一切，救我们的命不致死亡。"
verses.textZhCuv: 要救活我的父母、弟兄、姊妹，和一切属他们的，拯救我们性命不死。」
verses.textEnNiv: that you will spare the lives of my father and mother, my brothers and sisters, and all who belong to them—and that you will save us from death."
verses.textEnEsv: that you will save alive my father and mother, my brothers and sisters, and all who belong to them, and deliver our lives from death."
verses.textEnNkjv: and spare my father, my mother, my brothers, my sisters, and all that they have, and deliver our lives from death."
verses.textEnNlt: when Jericho is conquered, you will let me live, along with my father and mother, my brothers and sisters, and all their families."
verses.textEnNasb: and spare my father and my mother, and my brothers and my sisters, and all who belong to them, and save our lives from death."
verses.textEn: that you will spare the lives of my father and mother, my brothers and sisters, and all who belong to them—and that you will save us from death."

verses.textZh: 两个探子就对她说："如果你不泄漏我们这次行动，我们愿以性命作你们的保证；耶和华把这地赐给我们的时候，我们必定以慈爱和诚实待你们。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 两个探子就对她说："如果你不泄漏我们这次行动，我们愿以性命作你们的保证；耶和华把这地赐给我们的时候，我们必定以慈爱和诚实待你们。"
verses.textZhCuv: 二人对她说：「你若不泄漏我们这件事，我们情愿替你们死。耶和华将这地赐给我们的时候，我们必以慈爱诚实待你。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Our lives for your lives!" the men assured her. "If you don’t tell what we are doing, we will treat you kindly and faithfully when the Lord gives us the land."
verses.textEnEsv: And the men said to her, "Our life for yours even to death! If you do not tell this business of ours, then when the Lord gives us the land we will deal kindly and faithfully with you."
verses.textEnNkjv: So the men answered her, "Our lives for yours, if none of you tell this business of ours. And it shall be, when the Lord has given us the land, that we will deal kindly and truly with you."
verses.textEnNlt: "We offer our own lives as a guarantee for your safety," the men agreed. "If you don’t betray us, we will keep our promise and be kind to you when the Lord gives us the land."
verses.textEnNasb: So the men said to her, "Our life for yours if you do not tell this business of ours; and it shall come about when the Lord gives us the land that we will deal kindly and faithfully with you."
verses.textEn: "Our lives for your lives!" the men assured her. "If you don’t tell what we are doing, we will treat you kindly and faithfully when the Lord gives us the land."

verses.textZh: 于是，那女人用绳子把二人从窗户缒下去，因为她的房屋是在城墙上，她就住在城墙上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，那女人用绳子把二人从窗户缒下去，因为她的房屋是在城墙上，她就住在城墙上。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是女人用绳子将二人从窗户里缒下去；因她的房子是在城墙边上，她也住在城墙上。
verses.textEnNiv: So she let them down by a rope through the window, for the house she lived in was part of the city wall.
verses.textEnEsv: Then she let them down by a rope through the window, for her house was built into the city wall, so that she lived in the wall.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then she let them down by a rope through the window, for her house was on the city wall; she dwelt on the wall.
verses.textEnNlt: Then, since Rahab’s house was built into the town wall, she let them down by a rope through the window.
verses.textEnNasb: Then she let them down by a rope through the window, for her house was on the city wall, so that she was living on the wall.
verses.textEn: So she let them down by a rope through the window, for the house she lived in was part of the city wall.

verses.textZh: 她对他们二人说："你们要到山上去，免得追赶的人遇上你们；你们要在那里躲藏三天，等追赶的人回城，然后你们才可以走你们的路。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 她对他们二人说："你们要到山上去，免得追赶的人遇上你们；你们要在那里躲藏三天，等追赶的人回城，然后你们才可以走你们的路。"
verses.textZhCuv: 她对他们说：「你们且往山上去，恐怕追赶的人碰见你们；要在那里隐藏三天，等追赶的人回来，然后才可以走你们的路。」
verses.textEnNiv: She said to them, "Go to the hills so the pursuers will not find you. Hide yourselves there three days until they return, and then go on your way."
verses.textEnEsv: And she said to them, "Go into the hills, or the pursuers will encounter you, and hide there three days until the pursuers have returned. Then afterward you may go your way."
verses.textEnNkjv: And she said to them, "Get to the mountain, lest the pursuers meet you. Hide there three days, until the pursuers have returned. Afterward you may go your way."
verses.textEnNlt: "Escape to the hill country," she told them. "Hide there for three days from the men searching for you. Then, when they have returned, you can go on your way."
verses.textEnNasb: And she said to them, "Go to the hill country, so that the pursuers will not encounter you, and hide yourselves there for three days until the pursuers return. Then afterward you may go on your way."
verses.textEn: She said to them, "Go to the hills so the pursuers will not find you. Hide yourselves there three days until they return, and then go on your way."

verses.textZh: 他们二人对她说："如果你不遵照我们的话行，你叫我们起的誓就与我们无关了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们二人对她说："如果你不遵照我们的话行，你叫我们起的誓就与我们无关了。
verses.textZhCuv: 二人对她说：「你要这样行。不然，你叫我们所起的誓就与我们无干了。
verses.textEnNiv: Now the men had said to her, "This oath you made us swear will not be binding on us
verses.textEnEsv: The men said to her, "We will be guiltless with respect to this oath of yours that you have made us swear.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the men said to her: "We willbe blameless of this oath of yours which you have made us swear,
verses.textEnNlt: Before they left, the men told her, "We will be bound by the oath we have taken only if you follow these instructions.
verses.textEnNasb: And the men said to her, "We shall be exempt from this oath to you which you have made us swear,
verses.textEn: Now the men had said to her, "This oath you made us swear will not be binding on us

verses.textZh: 你要留意，我们再到这地方的时候，你要把这条朱红色线系在你缒我们下去的窗户上；你也要把你的父母、兄弟和你父的全家，都聚集在你的屋里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要留意，我们再到这地方的时候，你要把这条朱红色线系在你缒我们下去的窗户上；你也要把你的父母、兄弟和你父的全家，都聚集在你的屋里。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们来到这地的时候，你要把这条朱红线绳系在缒我们下去的窗户上，并要使你的父母、弟兄，和你父的全家都聚集在你家中。
verses.textEnNiv: unless, when we enter the land, you have tied this scarlet cord in the window through which you let us down, and unless you have brought your father and mother, your brothers and all your family into your house.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, when we come into the land, you shall tie this scarlet cord in the window through which you let us down, and you shall gather into your house your father and mother, your brothers, and all your father’s household.
verses.textEnNkjv: unless, when we come into the land, you bind this line of scarlet cord in the window through which you let us down, and unless you bring your father, your mother, your brothers, and all your father’s household to your own home.
verses.textEnNlt: When we come into the land, you must leave this scarlet rope hanging from the window through which you let us down. And all your family members—your father, mother, brothers, and all your relatives—must be here inside the house.
verses.textEnNasb: unless, when we come into the land, you tie this cord of scarlet thread in the window through which you let us down, and gather into your house your father, your mother, your brothers, and all your father’s household.
verses.textEn: unless, when we enter the land, you have tied this scarlet cord in the window through which you let us down, and unless you have brought your father and mother, your brothers and all your family into your house.

verses.textZh: 任何人走出你家门，到外面去的，他的血就必归到他自己的头上，与我们无关；任何人同你在屋里的，如果有人下手加害他，他的血就归到我们头上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 任何人走出你家门，到外面去的，他的血就必归到他自己的头上，与我们无关；任何人同你在屋里的，如果有人下手加害他，他的血就归到我们头上。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡出了你家门往街上去的，他的罪 必归到自己的头上，与我们无干了。凡在你家里的，若有人下手害他，流他血的罪就归到我们的头上。
verses.textEnNiv: If any of them go outside your house into the street, their blood will be on their own heads; we will not be responsible. As for those who are in the house with you, their blood will be on our head if a hand is laid on them.
verses.textEnEsv: Then if anyone goes out of the doors of your house into the street, his blood shall be on his own head, and we shall be guiltless. But if a hand is laid on anyone who is with you in the house, his blood shall be on our head.
verses.textEnNkjv: So it shall be that whoever goes outside the doors of your house into the street, his blood shallbe on his own head, and we willbe guiltless. And whoever is with you in the house, his blood shallbe on our head if a hand is laid on him.
verses.textEnNlt: If they go out into the street and are killed, it will not be our fault. But if anyone lays a hand on people inside this house, we will accept the responsibility for their death.
verses.textEnNasb: And it shall come about that anyone who goes out of the doors of your house outside will have his blood on his own head, and we will be innocent; but anyone who is with you in the house, his blood will be on our head if a hand is laid on him.
verses.textEn: If any of them go outside your house into the street, their blood will be on their own heads; we will not be responsible. As for those who are in the house with you, their blood will be on our head if a hand is laid on them.

verses.textZh: 如果你泄漏了我们这次的行动，那么，你叫我们起的誓就与我们无关了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果你泄漏了我们这次的行动，那么，你叫我们起的誓就与我们无关了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你若泄漏我们这件事，你叫我们所起的誓就与我们无干了。」
verses.textEnNiv: But if you tell what we are doing, we will be released from the oath you made us swear."
verses.textEnEsv: But if you tell this business of ours, then we shall be guiltless with respect to your oath that you have made us swear."
verses.textEnNkjv: And if you tell this business of ours, then we will be free from your oath which you made us swear."
verses.textEnNlt: If you betray us, however, we are not bound by this oath in any way."
verses.textEnNasb: But if you tell this business of ours, then we shall be exempt from the oath which you have made us swear."
verses.textEn: But if you tell what we are doing, we will be released from the oath you made us swear."

verses.textZh: 那女人回答："照你们的话，就这样吧。"于是打发他们二人走了。他们走了以后，她就把朱红色线系在窗户上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那女人回答："照你们的话，就这样吧。"于是打发他们二人走了。他们走了以后，她就把朱红色线系在窗户上。
verses.textZhCuv: 女人说：「照你们的话行吧！」于是打发他们去了，又把朱红线绳系在窗户上。
verses.textEnNiv: "Agreed," she replied. "Let it be as you say." So she sent them away, and they departed. And she tied the scarlet cord in the window.
verses.textEnEsv: And she said, "According to your words, so be it." Then she sent them away, and they departed. And she tied the scarlet cord in the window.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then she said, "According to your words, so be it." And she sent them away, and they departed. And she bound the scarlet cord in the window.
verses.textEnNlt: "I accept your terms," she replied. And she sent them on their way, leaving the scarlet rope hanging from the window.
verses.textEnNasb: She then said, "According to your words, so be it." So she sent them away, and they departed; and she tied the scarlet cord in the window.
verses.textEn: "Agreed," she replied. "Let it be as you say." So she sent them away, and they departed. And she tied the scarlet cord in the window.

verses.textZh: 二人离去，上到山上，在那里住了三天，等追赶的人回城去了；追赶的人一路搜寻他们，却找不着。
verses.textZhCnvs: 二人离去，上到山上，在那里住了三天，等追赶的人回城去了；追赶的人一路搜寻他们，却找不着。
verses.textZhCuv: 二人到山上，在那里住了三天，等着追赶的人回去了。追赶的人一路找他们，却找不着。
verses.textEnNiv: When they left, they went into the hills and stayed there three days, until the pursuers had searched all along the road and returned without finding them.
verses.textEnEsv: They departed and went into the hills and remained there three days until the pursuers returned, and the pursuers searched all along the way and found nothing.
verses.textEnNkjv: They departed and went to the mountain, and stayed there three days until the pursuers returned. The pursuers sought them all along the way, but did not find them.
verses.textEnNlt: The spies went up into the hill country and stayed there three days. The men who were chasing them searched everywhere along the road, but they finally returned without success.
verses.textEnNasb: So they departed and came to the hill country, and remained there for three days, until the pursuers returned. Now the pursuers had searched for them all along the road, but had not found them.
verses.textEn: When they left, they went into the hills and stayed there three days, until the pursuers had searched all along the road and returned without finding them.

verses.textZh: 二人于是下山回去，过了约旦河，回到嫩的儿子约书亚那里，把他们遭遇的一切事向他报告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 二人于是下山回去，过了约旦河，回到嫩的儿子约书亚那里，把他们遭遇的一切事向他报告。
verses.textZhCuv: 二人就下山回来，过了河，到嫩的儿子约书亚那里，向他述说所遭遇的一切事；
verses.textEnNiv: Then the two men started back. They went down out of the hills, forded the river and came to Joshua son of Nun and told him everything that had happened to them.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the two men returned. They came down from the hills and passed over and came to Joshua the son of Nun, and they told him all that had happened to them.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the two men returned, descended from the mountain, and crossed over; and they came to Joshua the son of Nun, and told him all that had befallen them.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the two spies came down from the hill country, crossed the Jordan River, and reported to Joshua all that had happened to them.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the two men returned and came down from the hill country, and they crossed over and came to Joshua the son of Nun. Then they reported to him all that had happened to them.
verses.textEn: Then the two men started back. They went down out of the hills, forded the river and came to Joshua son of Nun and told him everything that had happened to them.

verses.textZh: 他们又对约书亚说："耶和华真的把那地全交在我们手里了；那地所有的居民都在我们面前胆战心惊。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们又对约书亚说："耶和华真的把那地全交在我们手里了；那地所有的居民都在我们面前胆战心惊。"
verses.textZhCuv: 又对约书亚说：「耶和华果然将那全地交在我们手中；那地的一切居民在我们面前心都消化了。」
verses.textEnNiv: They said to Joshua, "The Lord has surely given the whole land into our hands; all the people are melting in fear because of us."
verses.textEnEsv: And they said to Joshua, "Truly the Lord has given all the land into our hands. And also, all the inhabitants of the land melt away because of us."
verses.textEnNkjv: And they said to Joshua, "Truly the Lord has delivered all the land into our hands, for indeed all the inhabitants of the country are fainthearted because of us."
verses.textEnNlt: "The Lord has given us the whole land," they said, "for all the people in the land are terrified of us."
verses.textEnNasb: And they said to Joshua, "The Lord has indeed handed over to us all the land; furthermore, all the inhabitants of the land have despaired because of us."
verses.textEn: They said to Joshua, "The Lord has surely given the whole land into our hands; all the people are melting in fear because of us."

verses.textZh: 约书亚清早起来，和全体以色列人从什亭出发，来到约旦河，在那里住宿，等候过河。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约书亚清早起来，和全体以色列人从什亭出发，来到约旦河，在那里住宿，等候过河。
verses.textZhCuv: 约书亚清早起来，和以色列众人都离开什亭，来到约旦河，就住在那里，等候过河。
verses.textEnNiv: Early in the morning Joshua and all the Israelites set out from Shittim and went to the Jordan, where they camped before crossing over.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Joshua rose early in the morning and they set out from Shittim. And they came to the Jordan, he and all the people of Israel, and lodged there before they passed over.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Joshua rose early in the morning; and they set out from Acacia Grove and came to the Jordan, he and all the children of Israel, and lodged there before they crossed over.
verses.textEnNlt: Early the next morning Joshua and all the Israelites left Acacia Grove and arrived at the banks of the Jordan River, where they camped before crossing.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Joshua got up early in the morning; and he and all the sons of Israel set out from Shittim and came to the Jordan, and they spent the night there before they crossed.
verses.textEn: Early in the morning Joshua and all the Israelites set out from Shittim and went to the Jordan, where they camped before crossing over.

verses.textZh: 过了三天，官长走遍营中，
verses.textZhCnvs: 过了三天，官长走遍营中，
verses.textZhCuv: 过了三天，官长走遍营中，
verses.textEnNiv: After three days the officers went throughout the camp,
verses.textEnEsv: At the end of three days the officers went through the camp
verses.textEnNkjv: So it was, after three days, that the officers went through the camp;
verses.textEnNlt: Three days later the Israelite officers went through the camp,
verses.textEnNasb: Then at the end of three days the officers went through the midst of the camp;
verses.textEn: After three days the officers went throughout the camp,

verses.textZh: 吩咐人民说："你们看见耶和华你们的神的约柜，又看见抬约柜的利未支派的祭司的时候，就要从你们所住的地方出发，跟在约柜后面走。
verses.textZhCnvs: 吩咐人民说："你们看见耶和华你们的神的约柜，又看见抬约柜的利未支派的祭司的时候，就要从你们所住的地方出发，跟在约柜后面走。
verses.textZhCuv: 吩咐百姓说：「你们看见耶和华－你们神的约柜，又见祭司利未人抬着，就要离开所住的地方，跟着约柜去。
verses.textEnNiv: giving orders to the people: "When you see the ark of the covenant of the Lord your God, and the Levitical priests carrying it, you are to move out from your positions and follow it.
verses.textEnEsv: and commanded the people, "As soon as you see the ark of the covenant of the Lord your God being carried by the Levitical priests, then you shall set out from your place and follow it.
verses.textEnNkjv: and they commanded the people, saying, "When you see the ark of the covenant of the Lord your God, and the priests, the Levites, bearing it, then you shall set out from your place and go after it.
verses.textEnNlt: giving these instructions to the people: "When you see the Levitical priests carrying the Ark of the Covenant of the Lord your God, move out from your positions and follow them.
verses.textEnNasb: and they commanded the people, saying, "When you see the ark of the covenant of the Lord your God with the Levitical priests carrying it, then you shall set out from your place and go after it.
verses.textEn: giving orders to the people: "When you see the ark of the covenant of the Lord your God, and the Levitical priests carrying it, you are to move out from your positions and follow it.

verses.textZh: 只是你们和约柜之间应有一段距离，相隔约一公里，不可走近约柜，好使你们知道你们应走的路，因为这条路你们以前没有走过。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 只是你们和约柜之间应有一段距离，相隔约一公里，不可走近约柜，好使你们知道你们应走的路，因为这条路你们以前没有走过。"
verses.textZhCuv: 只是你们和约柜相离要量二千肘，不可与约柜相近，使你们知道所当走的路，因为这条路你们向来没有走过。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then you will know which way to go, since you have never been this way before. But keep a distance of about two thousand cubits between you and the ark; do not go near it."
verses.textEnEsv: Yet there shall be a distance between you and it, about 2,000 cubits in length. Do not come near it, in order that you may know the way you shall go, for you have not passed this way before."
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet there shall be a space between you and it, about two thousand cubits by measure. Do not come near it, that you may know the way by which you must go, for you have not passed this way before."
verses.textEnNlt: Since you have never traveled this way before, they will guide you. Stay about half a mile behind them, keeping a clear distance between you and the Ark. Make sure you don’t come any closer."
verses.textEnNasb: However, there shall be a distance between you and it of about two thousand cubits by measurement. Do not come near it, so that you may know the way by which you shall go, for you have not passed this way before."
verses.textEn: Then you will know which way to go, since you have never been this way before. But keep a distance of about two thousand cubits between you and the ark; do not go near it."

verses.textZh: 约书亚对人民说："你们要自洁，因为明天耶和华要在你们中间行奇事。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 约书亚对人民说："你们要自洁，因为明天耶和华要在你们中间行奇事。"
verses.textZhCuv: 约书亚吩咐百姓说：「你们要自洁，因为明天耶和华必在你们中间行奇事。」
verses.textEnNiv: Joshua told the people, "Consecrate yourselves, for tomorrow the Lord will do amazing things among you."
verses.textEnEsv: Then Joshua said to the people, "Consecrate yourselves, for tomorrow the Lord will do wonders among you."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Joshua said to the people, "Sanctify yourselves, for tomorrow the Lord will do wonders among you."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Joshua told the people, "Purify yourselves, for tomorrow the Lord will do great wonders among you."
verses.textEnNasb: Then Joshua said to the people, "Consecrate yourselves, for tomorrow the Lord will do miracles among you."
verses.textEn: Joshua told the people, "Consecrate yourselves, for tomorrow the Lord will do amazing things among you."

verses.textZh: 约书亚又吩咐祭司说："你们要抬起约柜，在人民前面过河去。"于是他们抬起约柜，走在人民的前面。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约书亚又吩咐祭司说："你们要抬起约柜，在人民前面过河去。"于是他们抬起约柜，走在人民的前面。
verses.textZhCuv: 约书亚又吩咐祭司说：「你们抬起约柜，在百姓前头过去。」于是他们抬起约柜，在百姓前头走。
verses.textEnNiv: Joshua said to the priests, "Take up the ark of the covenant and pass on ahead of the people." So they took it up and went ahead of them.
verses.textEnEsv: And Joshua said to the priests, "Take up the ark of the covenant and pass on before the people." So they took up the ark of the covenant and went before the people.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Joshua spoke to the priests, saying, "Take up the ark of the covenant and cross over before the people." So they took up the ark of the covenant and went before the people.
verses.textEnNlt: In the morning Joshua said to the priests, "Lift up the Ark of the Covenant and lead the people across the river." And so they started out and went ahead of the people.
verses.textEnNasb: And Joshua spoke to the priests, saying, "Take up the ark of the covenant and cross over ahead of the people." So they took up the ark of the covenant and went ahead of the people.
verses.textEn: Joshua said to the priests, "Take up the ark of the covenant and pass on ahead of the people." So they took it up and went ahead of them.

verses.textZh: 耶和华对约书亚说："今天起，我要使你在以色列众人眼中成为尊大，这样他们就知道我怎样与摩西同在，也必照样与你同在。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对约书亚说："今天起，我要使你在以色列众人眼中成为尊大，这样他们就知道我怎样与摩西同在，也必照样与你同在。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对约书亚说：「从今日起，我必使你在以色列众人眼前尊大，使他们知道我怎样与摩西同在，也必照样与你同在。
verses.textEnNiv: And the Lord said to Joshua, "Today I will begin to exalt you in the eyes of all Israel, so they may know that I am with you as I was with Moses.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord said to Joshua, "Today I will begin to exalt you in the sight of all Israel, that they may know that, as I was with Moses, so I will be with you.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord said to Joshua, "This day I will begin to exalt you in the sight of all Israel, that they may know that, as I was with Moses, so I will be with you.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord told Joshua, "Today I will begin to make you a great leader in the eyes of all the Israelites. They will know that I am with you, just as I was with Moses.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the Lord said to Joshua, "This day I will begin to exalt you in the sight of all Israel, so that they will know that just as I have been with Moses, I will be with you.
verses.textEn: And the Lord said to Joshua, "Today I will begin to exalt you in the eyes of all Israel, so they may know that I am with you as I was with Moses.

verses.textZh: 你要吩咐抬着约柜的祭司说：‘你们到了约旦河水边的时候，要站在约旦河中。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要吩咐抬着约柜的祭司说：‘你们到了约旦河水边的时候，要站在约旦河中。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 你要吩咐抬约柜的祭司说：『你们到了约旦河的水边上，就要在约旦河水里站住。』」
verses.textEnNiv: Tell the priests who carry the ark of the covenant: ‘When you reach the edge of the Jordan’s waters, go and stand in the river.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: And as for you, command the priests who bear the ark of the covenant, ‘When you come to the brink of the waters of the Jordan, you shall stand still in the Jordan.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall command the priests who bear the ark of the covenant, saying, ‘When you have come to the edge of the water of the Jordan, you shall stand in the Jordan.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: Give this command to the priests who carry the Ark of the Covenant: ‘When you reach the banks of the Jordan River, take a few steps into the river and stop there.’"

verses.textEnNkjv: And Joshua said, "By this you shall know that the living God is among you, and that He will without fail drive out from before you the Canaanites and the Hittites and the Hivites and the Perizzites and the Girgashites and the Amorites and the Jebusites:

verses.textEn: This is how you will know that the living God is among you and that he will certainly drive out before you the Canaanites, Hittites, Hivites, Perizzites, Girgashites, Amorites and Jebusites.

verses.textEnNiv: And as soon as the priests who carry the ark of the Lord —the Lord of all the earth—set foot in the Jordan, its waters flowing downstream will be cut off and stand up in a heap."
verses.textEnEsv: And when the soles of the feet of the priests bearing the ark of the Lord , the Lord of all the earth, shall rest in the waters of the Jordan, the waters of the Jordan shall be cut off from flowing, and the waters coming down from above shall stand in one heap."
verses.textEnNkjv: And it shall come to pass, as soon as the soles of the feet of the priests who bear the ark of the Lord, the Lord of all the earth, shall rest in the waters of the Jordan, that the waters of the Jordan shall be cut off, the waters that come down from upstream, and they shall stand as a heap."
verses.textEnNlt: The priests will carry the Ark of the Lord , the Lord of all the earth. As soon as their feet touch the water, the flow of water will be cut off upstream, and the river will stand up like a wall."
verses.textEnNasb: And it will come about when the soles of the feet of the priests who carry the ark of the Lord, the Lord of all the earth, rest in the waters of the Jordan, the waters of the Jordan will be cut off, that is, the waters which are flowing down from above; and they will stand in one heap."
verses.textEn: And as soon as the priests who carry the ark of the Lord —the Lord of all the earth—set foot in the Jordan, its waters flowing downstream will be cut off and stand up in a heap."

verses.textZh: 水就停住了，那从上游流下来的水立起成垒，在很远的地方，就是在撒拉但旁边的亚当城那里停住；那往下流入亚拉巴海，就是盐海的水完全被截断；于是人民就在耶利哥的对面过了河。
verses.textZhCnvs: 水就停住了，那从上游流下来的水立起成垒，在很远的地方，就是在撒拉但旁边的亚当城那里停住；那往下流入亚拉巴海，就是盐海的水完全被截断；于是人民就在耶利哥的对面过了河。
verses.textZhCuv: 那从上往下流的水便在极远之地、撒拉但旁的亚当城那里停住，立起成垒；那往亚拉巴的海，就是盐海，下流的水全然断绝。于是百姓在耶利哥的对面过去了。

It piled up in a heap a great distance away, at a town called Adam in the vicinity of Zarethan, while the water flowing down to the Sea of the Arabah (that is, the Dead Sea) was completely cut off. So the people crossed over opposite Jericho.
verses.textEnEsv: the waters coming down from above stood and rose up in a heap very far away, at Adam, the city that is beside Zarethan, and those flowing down toward the Sea of the Arabah, the Salt Sea, were completely cut off. And the people passed over opposite Jericho.
verses.textEnNkjv: that the waters which came down from upstream stood still, and rose in a heap very far away at Adam, the city that is beside Zaretan. So the waters that went down into the Sea of the Arabah, the Salt Sea, failed, and were cut off; and the people crossed over opposite Jericho.
verses.textEnNlt: the water above that point began backing up a great distance away at a town called Adam, which is near Zarethan. And the water below that point flowed on to the Dead Sea until the riverbed was dry. Then all the people crossed over near the town of Jericho.

And they carried them over with them to the place where they lodged and laid them down there.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the children of Israel did so, just as Joshua commanded, and took up twelve stones from the midst of the Jordan, as the Lord had spoken to Joshua, according to the number of the tribes of the children of Israel, and carried them over with them to the place where they lodged, and laid them down there.
verses.textEnNlt: So the men did as Joshua had commanded them. They took twelve stones from the middle of the Jordan River, one for each tribe, just as the Lord had told Joshua. They carried them to the place where they camped for the night and constructed the memorial there.
verses.textEnNasb: So the sons of Israel did exactly as Joshua commanded, and took up twelve stones from the middle of the Jordan, just as the Lord spoke to Joshua, according to the number of the tribes of the sons of Israel; and they carried them over with them to the encampment and put them down there.
verses.textEn: So the Israelites did as Joshua commanded them. They took twelve stones from the middle of the Jordan, according to the number of the tribes of the Israelites, as the Lord had told Joshua; and they carried them over with them to their camp, where they put them down.

verses.textZh: 约书亚又在约旦河中间，在抬约柜的祭司的脚所站的地方，竖立十二块石头；那些石头到今日还在那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约书亚又在约旦河中间，在抬约柜的祭司的脚所站的地方，竖立十二块石头；那些石头到今日还在那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 约书亚另把十二块石头立在约旦河中，在抬约柜的祭司脚站立的地方；直到今日，那石头还在那里。
verses.textEnNiv: Joshua set up the twelve stones that had been in the middle of the Jordan at the spot where the priests who carried the ark of the covenant had stood. And they are there to this day.
verses.textEnEsv: And Joshua set up twelve stones in the midst of the Jordan, in the place where the feet of the priests bearing the ark of the covenant had stood; and they are there to this day.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Joshua set up twelve stones in the midst of the Jordan, in the place where the feet of the priests who bore the ark of the covenant stood; and they are there to this day.
verses.textEnNlt: Joshua also set up another pile of twelve stones in the middle of the Jordan, at the place where the priests who carried the Ark of the Covenant were standing. And they are there to this day.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Joshua set up twelve stones in the middle of the Jordan at the place where the feet of the priests who carried the ark of the covenant were standing, and they are there to this day.
verses.textEn: Joshua set up the twelve stones that had been in the middle of the Jordan at the spot where the priests who carried the ark of the covenant had stood. And they are there to this day.

verses.textZh: 抬约柜的祭司站在约旦河中间，直到耶和华吩咐约书亚告诉人民的一切事，就是照着摩西吩咐约书亚的一切事，都办完了，人民就急忙过去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 抬约柜的祭司站在约旦河中间，直到耶和华吩咐约书亚告诉人民的一切事，就是照着摩西吩咐约书亚的一切事，都办完了，人民就急忙过去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 抬约柜的祭司站在约旦河中，等到耶和华晓谕约书亚吩咐百姓的事办完了，是照摩西所吩咐约书亚的一切话。于是百姓急速过去了。
verses.textEnNiv: Now the priests who carried the ark remained standing in the middle of the Jordan until everything the Lord had commanded Joshua was done by the people, just as Moses had directed Joshua. The people hurried over,
verses.textEnEsv: For the priests bearing the ark stood in the midst of the Jordan until everything was finished that the Lord commanded Joshua to tell the people, according to all that Moses had commanded Joshua. The people passed over in haste.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the priests who bore the ark stood in the midst of the Jordan until everything was finished that the Lord had commanded Joshua to speak to the people, according to all that Moses had commanded Joshua; and the people hurried and crossed over.
verses.textEnNlt: The priests who were carrying the Ark stood in the middle of the river until all of the Lord ’s commands that Moses had given to Joshua were carried out. Meanwhile, the people hurried across the riverbed.
verses.textEnNasb: For the priests who carried the ark were standing in the middle of the Jordan until everything was completed that the Lord had commanded Joshua to speak to the people, according to all that Moses had commanded Joshua. And the people hurried and crossed;
verses.textEn: Now the priests who carried the ark remained standing in the middle of the Jordan until everything the Lord had commanded Joshua was done by the people, just as Moses had directed Joshua. The people hurried over,

verses.textZh: 全体人民都过了河以后，耶和华的约柜和祭司才在人民的面前过去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 全体人民都过了河以后，耶和华的约柜和祭司才在人民的面前过去。
verses.textZhCuv: 众百姓尽都过了河，耶和华的约柜和祭司就在百姓面前过去。
verses.textEnNiv: and as soon as all of them had crossed, the ark of the Lord and the priests came to the other side while the people watched.
verses.textEnEsv: And when all the people had finished passing over, the ark of the Lord and the priests passed over before the people.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then it came to pass, when all the people had completely crossed over, that the ark of the Lord and the priests crossed over in the presence of the people.
verses.textEnNlt: And when everyone was safely on the other side, the priests crossed over with the Ark of the Lord as the people watched.
verses.textEnNasb: and when all the people had finished crossing, then the ark of the Lord and the priests crossed in front of the people.
verses.textEn: and as soon as all of them had crossed, the ark of the Lord and the priests came to the other side while the people watched.

verses.textZh: 流本人、迦得人和玛拿西半个支派的人，都照着摩西吩咐他们的，拿起武器，在以色列人前面过河去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 流本人、迦得人和玛拿西半个支派的人，都照着摩西吩咐他们的，拿起武器，在以色列人前面过河去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 吕便人、迦得人、玛拿西半支派的人都照摩西所吩咐他们的，带着兵器在以色列人前头过去。
verses.textEnNiv: The men of Reuben, Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh crossed over, ready for battle, in front of the Israelites, as Moses had directed them.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Reuben and the sons of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh passed over armed before the people of Israel, as Moses had told them.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the men of Reuben, the men of Gad, and half the tribe of Manasseh crossed over armed before the children of Israel, as Moses had spoken to them.
verses.textEnNlt: The armed warriors from the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and the half-tribe of Manasseh led the Israelites across the Jordan, just as Moses had directed.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Reuben, the sons of Gad, and the half-tribe of Manasseh crossed over in battle formation before the sons of Israel, just as Moses had spoken to them;
verses.textEn: The men of Reuben, Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh crossed over, ready for battle, in front of the Israelites, as Moses had directed them.

verses.textZh: 他们约有四万人，都装备好，预备打仗，在耶和华面前走过去，来到耶利哥的平原，等候作战。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们约有四万人，都装备好，预备打仗，在耶和华面前走过去，来到耶利哥的平原，等候作战。
verses.textZhCuv: 约有四万人都准备打仗，在耶和华面前过去，到耶利哥的平原，等候上阵。
verses.textEnNiv: About forty thousand armed for battle crossed over before the Lord to the plains of Jericho for war.
verses.textEnEsv: About 40,000 ready for war passed over before the Lord for battle, to the plains of Jericho.
verses.textEnNkjv: About forty thousand prepared for war crossed over before the Lord for battle, to the plains of Jericho.
verses.textEnNlt: These armed men—about 40,000 strong—were ready for battle, and the Lord was with them as they crossed over to the plains of Jericho.
verses.textEnNasb: about forty thousand equipped for war, crossed for battle before the Lord to the desert plains of Jericho.
verses.textEn: About forty thousand armed for battle crossed over before the Lord to the plains of Jericho for war.

verses.textZh: 那一天耶和华使约书亚在以色列众人眼中成为尊大；在他一生的日子，人民敬畏他，好象敬畏摩西一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那一天耶和华使约书亚在以色列众人眼中成为尊大；在他一生的日子，人民敬畏他，好象敬畏摩西一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 当那日，耶和华使约书亚在以色列众人眼前尊大。在他平生的日子，百姓敬畏他，像从前敬畏摩西一样。
verses.textEnNiv: That day the Lord exalted Joshua in the sight of all Israel; and they stood in awe of him all the days of his life, just as they had stood in awe of Moses.
verses.textEnEsv: On that day the Lord exalted Joshua in the sight of all Israel, and they stood in awe of him just as they had stood in awe of Moses, all the days of his life.
verses.textEnNkjv: On that day the Lord exalted Joshua in the sight of all Israel; and they feared him, as they had feared Moses, all the days of his life.
verses.textEnNlt: That day the Lord made Joshua a great leader in the eyes of all the Israelites, and for the rest of his life they revered him as much as they had revered Moses.
verses.textEnNasb: On that day the Lord exalted Joshua in the sight of all Israel, so that they revered him, just as they had revered Moses all the days of his life.
verses.textEn: That day the Lord exalted Joshua in the sight of all Israel; and they stood in awe of him all the days of his life, just as they had stood in awe of Moses.

verses.textZh: 耶和华吩咐约书亚说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华吩咐约书亚说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华晓谕约书亚说：
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord said to Joshua,
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord said to Joshua,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord spoke to Joshua, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord had said to Joshua,
verses.textEnNasb: Now the Lord said to Joshua,
verses.textEn: Then the Lord said to Joshua,

verses.textZh: "吩咐抬约柜的祭司从约旦河上来。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "吩咐抬约柜的祭司从约旦河上来。"
verses.textZhCuv: 「你吩咐抬法柜的祭司从约旦河里上来。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Command the priests carrying the ark of the covenant law to come up out of the Jordan."
verses.textEnEsv: "Command the priests bearing the ark of the testimony to come up out of the Jordan."
verses.textEnNkjv: "Command the priests who bear the ark of the Testimony to come up from the Jordan."
verses.textEnNlt: "Command the priests carrying the Ark of the Covenant to come up out of the riverbed."
verses.textEnNasb: "Command the priests who carry the ark of the testimony that they come up from the Jordan."
verses.textEn: "Command the priests carrying the ark of the covenant law to come up out of the Jordan."

verses.textZh: 于是约书亚吩咐祭司说："你们从约旦河上来。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是约书亚吩咐祭司说："你们从约旦河上来。"
verses.textZhCuv: 约书亚就吩咐祭司说：「你们从约旦河里上来。」
verses.textEnNiv: So Joshua commanded the priests, "Come up out of the Jordan."
verses.textEnEsv: So Joshua commanded the priests, "Come up out of the Jordan."
verses.textEnNkjv: Joshua therefore commanded the priests, saying, "Come up from the Jordan."
verses.textEnNlt: So Joshua gave the command.
verses.textEnNasb: So Joshua commanded the priests, saying, "Come up from the Jordan."
verses.textEn: So Joshua commanded the priests, "Come up out of the Jordan."

verses.textZh: 抬耶和华约柜的祭司从约旦河中间上来的时候，祭司的脚掌一提起来踏在干地上，约旦河的水就流回原处，像以前一样涨过两岸。
verses.textZhCnvs: 抬耶和华约柜的祭司从约旦河中间上来的时候，祭司的脚掌一提起来踏在干地上，约旦河的水就流回原处，像以前一样涨过两岸。
verses.textZhCuv: 抬耶和华约柜的祭司从约旦河里上来，脚掌刚落旱地，约旦河的水就流到原处，仍旧涨过两岸。
verses.textEnNiv: And the priests came up out of the river carrying the ark of the covenant of the Lord . No sooner had they set their feet on the dry ground than the waters of the Jordan returned to their place and ran at flood stage as before.
verses.textEnEsv: And when the priests bearing the ark of the covenant of the Lord came up from the midst of the Jordan, and the soles of the priests’ feet were lifted up on dry ground, the waters of the Jordan returned to their place and overflowed all its banks, as before.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it came to pass, when the priests who bore the ark of the covenant of the Lord had come from the midst of the Jordan, and the soles of the priests’ feet touched the dry land, that the waters of the Jordan returned to their place and overflowed all its banks as before.
verses.textEnNlt: As soon as the priests carrying the Ark of the Lord ’s Covenant came up out of the riverbed and their feet were on high ground, the water of the Jordan returned and overflowed its banks as before.
verses.textEnNasb: It came about when the priests who carried the ark of the covenant of the Lord had come up from the middle of the Jordan, and the soles of the priests’ feet were lifted up to the dry ground, that the waters of the Jordan returned to their place, and went over all its banks as before.
verses.textEn: And the priests came up out of the river carrying the ark of the covenant of the Lord . No sooner had they set their feet on the dry ground than the waters of the Jordan returned to their place and ran at flood stage as before.

verses.textZh: 正月初十，人民从约旦河上来以后，就在吉甲，在耶利哥的东边安营。
verses.textZhCnvs: 正月初十，人民从约旦河上来以后，就在吉甲，在耶利哥的东边安营。
verses.textZhCuv: 正月初十日，百姓从约旦河里上来，就在吉甲，在耶利哥的东边安营。
verses.textEnNiv: On the tenth day of the first month the people went up from the Jordan and camped at Gilgal on the eastern border of Jericho.
verses.textEnEsv: The people came up out of the Jordan on the tenth day of the first month, and they encamped at Gilgal on the east border of Jericho.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the people came up from the Jordan on the tenth day of the first month, and they camped in Gilgal on the east border of Jericho.
verses.textEnNlt: The people crossed the Jordan on the tenth day of the first month. Then they camped at Gilgal, just east of Jericho.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the people came up from the Jordan on the tenth of the first month and camped at Gilgal, on the eastern edge of Jericho.
verses.textEn: On the tenth day of the first month the people went up from the Jordan and camped at Gilgal on the eastern border of Jericho.

verses.textZh: 约书亚把他们从约旦河取来的那十二块石头，竖立在吉甲。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约书亚把他们从约旦河取来的那十二块石头，竖立在吉甲。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们从约旦河中取来的那十二块石头，约书亚就立在吉甲，
verses.textEnNiv: And Joshua set up at Gilgal the twelve stones they had taken out of the Jordan.
verses.textEnEsv: And those twelve stones, which they took out of the Jordan, Joshua set up at Gilgal.
verses.textEnNkjv: And those twelve stones which they took out of the Jordan, Joshua set up in Gilgal.
verses.textEnNlt: It was there at Gilgal that Joshua piled up the twelve stones taken from the Jordan River.
verses.textEnNasb: As for those twelve stones which they had taken from the Jordan, Joshua set them up at Gilgal.
verses.textEn: And Joshua set up at Gilgal the twelve stones they had taken out of the Jordan.

verses.textZh: 约书亚对以色列人说："如果日后你们的子孙问他们的父亲说：‘这些石头是甚么意思？’
verses.textZhCnvs: 约书亚对以色列人说："如果日后你们的子孙问他们的父亲说：‘这些石头是甚么意思？’
verses.textZhCuv: 对以色列人说：「日后你们的子孙问他们的父亲说：『这些石头是什么意思？』
verses.textEnNiv: He said to the Israelites, "In the future when your descendants ask their parents, ‘What do these stones mean?’
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to the people of Israel, "When your children ask their fathers in times to come, ‘What do these stones mean?’
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he spoke to the children of Israel, saying: "When your children ask their fathers in time to come, saying, ‘What are these stones?’
verses.textEnNlt: Then Joshua said to the Israelites, "In the future your children will ask, ‘What do these stones mean?’
verses.textEnNasb: And he said to the sons of Israel, "When your children ask their fathers in time to come, saying, ‘What are these stones?’
verses.textEn: He said to the Israelites, "In the future when your descendants ask their parents, ‘What do these stones mean?’

verses.textZh: 那时，你们就要告诉你们的子孙，说：‘以色列人曾经在干地上走过了这约旦河。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，你们就要告诉你们的子孙，说：‘以色列人曾经在干地上走过了这约旦河。’
verses.textZhCuv: 你们就告诉他们说：『以色列人曾走干地过这约旦河；
verses.textEnNiv: tell them, ‘Israel crossed the Jordan on dry ground.’
verses.textEnEsv: then you shall let your children know, ‘Israel passed over this Jordan on dry ground.’
verses.textEnNkjv: then you shall let your children know, saying, ‘Israel crossed over this Jordan on dry land’;
verses.textEnNlt: Then you can tell them, ‘This is where the Israelites crossed the Jordan on dry ground.’
verses.textEnNasb: then you shall inform your children, saying, ‘Israel crossed this Jordan on dry ground.’
verses.textEn: tell them, ‘Israel crossed the Jordan on dry ground.’

verses.textZh: 因为耶和华你们的神在你们面前使约旦河的水干了，直到你们都过了河，好象耶和华你们的神从前对红海所行的，在我们面前使红海干了，直到我们都过了河一样；
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为耶和华你们的神在你们面前使约旦河的水干了，直到你们都过了河，好象耶和华你们的神从前对红海所行的，在我们面前使红海干了，直到我们都过了河一样；
verses.textZhCuv: 因为耶和华－你们的神在你们前面使约旦河的水干了，等着你们过来，就如耶和华－你们的神从前在我们前面使红海干了，等着我们过来一样，
verses.textEnNiv: For the Lord your God dried up the Jordan before you until you had crossed over. The Lord your God did to the Jordan what he had done to the Red Sea when he dried it up before us until we had crossed over.
