verses.textEnEsv: For the Lord your God dried up the waters of the Jordan for you until you passed over, as the Lord your God did to the Red Sea, which he dried up for us until we passed over,
verses.textEnNkjv: for the Lord your God dried up the waters of the Jordan before you until you had crossed over, as the Lord your God did to the Red Sea, which He dried up before us until we had crossed over,
verses.textEnNlt: For the Lord your God dried up the river right before your eyes, and he kept it dry until you were all across, just as he did at the Red Sea when he dried it up until we had all crossed over.
verses.textEnNasb: For the Lord your God dried up the waters of the Jordan before you until you had crossed, just as the Lord your God had done to the Red Sea, which He dried up before us until we had crossed;
verses.textEn: For the Lord your God dried up the Jordan before you until you had crossed over. The Lord your God did to the Jordan what he had done to the Red Sea when he dried it up before us until we had crossed over.

verses.textZh: 好使地上万民都认识耶和华的手，是有能力的手，也要使你们永远敬畏耶和华你们的神。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 好使地上万民都认识耶和华的手，是有能力的手，也要使你们永远敬畏耶和华你们的神。"
verses.textZhCuv: 要使地上万民都知道，耶和华的手大有能力，也要使你们永远敬畏耶和华－你们的神。』」
verses.textEnNiv: He did this so that all the peoples of the earth might know that the hand of the Lord is powerful and so that you might always fear the Lord your God."
verses.textEnEsv: so that all the peoples of the earth may know that the hand of the Lord is mighty, that you may fear the Lord your God forever."
verses.textEnNkjv: that all the peoples of the earth may know the hand of the Lord, that it is mighty, that you may fear the Lord your God forever."
verses.textEnNlt: He did this so all the nations of the earth might know that the Lord ’s hand is powerful, and so you might fear the Lord your God forever."
verses.textEnNasb: so that all the peoples of the earth may know that the hand of the Lord is mighty, so that you may fear the Lord your God forever."
verses.textEn: He did this so that all the peoples of the earth might know that the hand of the Lord is powerful and so that you might always fear the Lord your God."

verses.textZh: 在约旦河西，亚摩利人的众王和靠近海边迦南人的众王，听见耶和华怎样使约旦河的水在以色列人面前干了，直到他们都过河去，他们都心里惊怕，因以色列人的缘故，勇气全失。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在约旦河西，亚摩利人的众王和靠近海边迦南人的众王，听见耶和华怎样使约旦河的水在以色列人面前干了，直到他们都过河去，他们都心里惊怕，因以色列人的缘故，勇气全失。
verses.textZhCuv: 约旦河西亚摩利人的诸王和靠海迦南人的诸王，听见耶和华在以色列人前面使约旦河的水干了，等到我们过去，他们的心因以色列人的缘故就消化了，不再有胆气。
verses.textEnNiv: Now when all the Amorite kings west of the Jordan and all the Canaanite kings along the coast heard how the Lord had dried up the Jordan before the Israelites until they had crossed over, their hearts melted in fear and they no longer had the courage to face the Israelites.
verses.textEnEsv: As soon as all the kings of the Amorites who were beyond the Jordan to the west, and all the kings of the Canaanites who were by the sea, heard that the Lord had dried up the waters of the Jordan for the people of Israel until they had crossed over, their hearts melted and there was no longer any spirit in them because of the people of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: So it was, when all the kings of the Amorites who were on the west side of the Jordan, and all the kings of the Canaanites who were by the sea, heard that the Lord had dried up the waters of the Jordan from before the children of Israel until we had crossed over, that their heart melted; and there was no spirit in them any longer because of the children of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: When all the Amorite kings west of the Jordan and all the Canaanite kings who lived along the Mediterranean coast heard how the Lord had dried up the Jordan River so the people of Israel could cross, they lost heart and were paralyzed with fear because of them.
verses.textEnNasb: Now it came about when all the kings of the Amorites who were beyond the Jordan to the west, and all the kings of the Canaanites who were by the sea, heard how the Lord had dried up the waters of the Jordan before the sons of Israel until they had crossed, that their hearts melted, and there was no spirit in them any longer because of the sons of Israel.
verses.textEn: Now when all the Amorite kings west of the Jordan and all the Canaanite kings along the coast heard how the Lord had dried up the Jordan before the Israelites until they had crossed over, their hearts melted in fear and they no longer had the courage to face the Israelites.

verses.textZh: 那时，耶和华对约书亚说："你要制造火石刀，第二次给以色列人行割礼。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，耶和华对约书亚说："你要制造火石刀，第二次给以色列人行割礼。"
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，耶和华吩咐约书亚说：「你制造火石刀，第二次给以色列人行割礼。」
verses.textEnNiv: At that time the Lord said to Joshua, "Make flint knives and circumcise the Israelites again."
verses.textEnEsv: At that time the Lord said to Joshua, "Make flint knives and circumcise the sons of Israel a second time."
verses.textEnNkjv: At that time the Lord said to Joshua, "Make flint knives for yourself, and circumcise the sons of Israel again the second time."
verses.textEnNlt: At that time the Lord told Joshua, "Make flint knives and circumcise this second generation of Israelites. "
verses.textEnNasb: At that time the Lord said to Joshua, "Make for yourself flint knives and circumcise again the sons of Israel the second time."
verses.textEn: At that time the Lord said to Joshua, "Make flint knives and circumcise the Israelites again."

verses.textZh: 约书亚就制造了火石刀，在包皮山那里给以色列人行了割礼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约书亚就制造了火石刀，在包皮山那里给以色列人行了割礼。
verses.textZhCuv: 约书亚就制造了火石刀，在「除皮山」那里给以色列人行割礼。
verses.textEnNiv: So Joshua made flint knives and circumcised the Israelites at Gibeath Haaraloth.
verses.textEnEsv: So Joshua made flint knives and circumcised the sons of Israel at Gibeath-haaraloth.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Joshua made flint knives for himself, and circumcised the sons of Israel at the hill of the foreskins.
verses.textEnNlt: So Joshua made flint knives and circumcised the entire male population of Israel at Gibeath-haaraloth.
verses.textEnNasb: So Joshua made himself flint knives and circumcised the sons of Israel at Gibeath-haaraloth.
verses.textEn: So Joshua made flint knives and circumcised the Israelites at Gibeath Haaraloth.

verses.textZh: 约书亚给以色列人行割礼的原因是这样：所有从埃及出来的人民，就是所有能作战的男丁，出埃及以后，都死在旷野的路上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约书亚给以色列人行割礼的原因是这样：所有从埃及出来的人民，就是所有能作战的男丁，出埃及以后，都死在旷野的路上。
verses.textZhCuv: 约书亚行割礼的缘故，是因为从埃及出来的众民，就是一切能打仗的男丁，出了埃及以后，都死在旷野的路上。
verses.textEnNiv: Now this is why he did so: All those who came out of Egypt—all the men of military age—died in the wilderness on the way after leaving Egypt.
verses.textEnEsv: And this is the reason why Joshua circumcised them: all the males of the people who came out of Egypt, all the men of war, had died in the wilderness on the way after they had come out of Egypt.
verses.textEnNkjv: And this is the reason why Joshua circumcised them: All the people who came out of Egypt whowere males, all the men of war, had died in the wilderness on the way, after they had come out of Egypt.
verses.textEnNlt: Joshua had to circumcise them because all the men who were old enough to fight in battle when they left Egypt had died in the wilderness.
verses.textEnNasb: This is the reason why Joshua circumcised them: all the people who came out of Egypt who were males, all the men of war, died in the wilderness along the way after they came out of Egypt.
verses.textEn: Now this is why he did so: All those who came out of Egypt—all the men of military age—died in the wilderness on the way after leaving Egypt.

verses.textZh: 因为所有从埃及出来的人民都受过割礼；唯有从埃及出来以后，所有在旷野的路上出生的人民，都没有受过割礼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为所有从埃及出来的人民都受过割礼；唯有从埃及出来以后，所有在旷野的路上出生的人民，都没有受过割礼。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为出来的众民都受过割礼；惟独出埃及以后、在旷野的路上所生的众民都没有受过割礼。
verses.textEnNiv: All the people that came out had been circumcised, but all the people born in the wilderness during the journey from Egypt had not.
verses.textEnEsv: Though all the people who came out had been circumcised, yet all the people who were born on the way in the wilderness after they had come out of Egypt had not been circumcised.
verses.textEnNkjv: For all the people who came out had been circumcised, but all the people born in the wilderness, on the way as they came out of Egypt, had not been circumcised.
verses.textEnNlt: Those who left Egypt had all been circumcised, but none of those born after the Exodus, during the years in the wilderness, had been circumcised.
verses.textEnNasb: For all the people who came out were circumcised, but all the people who were born in the wilderness along the way as they came out of Egypt had not been circumcised.
verses.textEn: All the people that came out had been circumcised, but all the people born in the wilderness during the journey from Egypt had not.

verses.textZh: 以色列人在旷野走了四十年，直到全国的人，就是从埃及出来能作战的男丁，都灭尽了，因为他们不听耶和华的话；耶和华曾经向他们起誓，必不容许他们看见耶和华向他们列祖起誓要赐给我们的地，就是流奶与蜜的地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人在旷野走了四十年，直到全国的人，就是从埃及出来能作战的男丁，都灭尽了，因为他们不听耶和华的话；耶和华曾经向他们起誓，必不容许他们看见耶和华向他们列祖起誓要赐给我们的地，就是流奶与蜜的地。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人在旷野走了四十年，等到国民，就是出埃及的兵丁，都消灭了，因为他们没有听从耶和华的话。耶和华曾向他们起誓，必不容他们看见耶和华向他们列祖起誓、应许赐给我们的地，就是流奶与蜜之地。
verses.textEnNiv: The Israelites had moved about in the wilderness forty years until all the men who were of military age when they left Egypt had died, since they had not obeyed the Lord . For the Lord had sworn to them that they would not see the land he had solemnly promised their ancestors to give us, a land flowing with milk and honey.
verses.textEnEsv: For the people of Israel walked forty years in the wilderness, until all the nation, the men of war who came out of Egypt, perished, because they did not obey the voice of the Lord ; the Lord swore to them that he would not let them see the land that the Lord had sworn to their fathers to give to us, a land flowing with milk and honey.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the children of Israel walked forty years in the wilderness, till all the people whowere men of war, who came out of Egypt, were consumed, because they did not obey the voice of the Lord—to whom the Lord swore that He would not show them the land which the Lord had sworn to their fathers that He would give us, "a land flowing with milk and honey."
verses.textEnNlt: The Israelites had traveled in the wilderness for forty years until all the men who were old enough to fight in battle when they left Egypt had died. For they had disobeyed the Lord , and the Lord vowed he would not let them enter the land he had sworn to give us—a land flowing with milk and honey.
verses.textEnNasb: For the sons of Israel walked forty years in the wilderness, until all the nation, that is, the men of war who came out of Egypt, perished because they did not listen to the voice of the Lord, to whom the Lord had sworn that He would not let them see the land which the Lord had sworn to their fathers to give us, a land flowing with milk and honey.
verses.textEn: The Israelites had moved about in the wilderness forty years until all the men who were of military age when they left Egypt had died, since they had not obeyed the Lord . For the Lord had sworn to them that they would not see the land he had solemnly promised their ancestors to give us, a land flowing with milk and honey.

verses.textZh: 他们的子孙，就是耶和华兴起来代替他们的，约书亚给他们行了割礼；这些人是未受割礼的人，因为他们在路上没有受过割礼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们的子孙，就是耶和华兴起来代替他们的，约书亚给他们行了割礼；这些人是未受割礼的人，因为他们在路上没有受过割礼。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们的子孙，就是耶和华所兴起来接续他们的，都没有受过割礼；因为在路上没有给他们行割礼，约书亚这才给他们行了。
verses.textEnNiv: So he raised up their sons in their place, and these were the ones Joshua circumcised. They were still uncircumcised because they had not been circumcised on the way.
verses.textEnEsv: So it was their children, whom he raised up in their place, that Joshua circumcised. For they were uncircumcised, because they had not been circumcised on the way.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Joshua circumcised their sons whom He raised up in their place; for they were uncircumcised, because they had not been circumcised on the way.
verses.textEnNlt: So Joshua circumcised their sons—those who had grown up to take their fathers’ places—for they had not been circumcised on the way to the Promised Land.
verses.textEnNasb: So their children whom He raised up in their place, Joshua circumcised; for they were uncircumcised, because they had not circumcised them along the way.
verses.textEn: So he raised up their sons in their place, and these were the ones Joshua circumcised. They were still uncircumcised because they had not been circumcised on the way.

verses.textZh: 全国的人受了割礼之后，都住在营中自己的地方，直到痊愈。
verses.textZhCnvs: 全国的人受了割礼之后，都住在营中自己的地方，直到痊愈。
verses.textZhCuv: 国民都受完了割礼，就住在营中自己的地方，等到痊愈了。
verses.textEnNiv: And after the whole nation had been circumcised, they remained where they were in camp until they were healed.
verses.textEnEsv: When the circumcising of the whole nation was finished, they remained in their places in the camp until they were healed.
verses.textEnNkjv: So it was, when they had finished circumcising all the people, that they stayed in their places in the camp till they were healed.
verses.textEnNlt: After all the males had been circumcised, they rested in the camp until they were healed.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when they had finished circumcising all the nation, they remained in their places in the camp until they recovered.
verses.textEn: And after the whole nation had been circumcised, they remained where they were in camp until they were healed.

verses.textZh: 耶和华对约书亚说："我今日把埃及的耻辱从你们身上辊去了。"因此，那地方名叫吉甲 ，直到今日。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对约书亚说："我今日把埃及的耻辱从你们身上辊去了。"因此，那地方名叫吉甲 ，直到今日。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对约书亚说：「我今日将埃及的羞辱从你们身上滚去了。」因此，那地方名叫吉甲 ，直到今日。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord said to Joshua, "Today I have rolled away the reproach of Egypt from you." So the place has been called Gilgal to this day.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord said to Joshua, "Today I have rolled away the reproach of Egypt from you." And so the name of that place is called Gilgal to this day.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord said to Joshua, "This day I have rolled away the reproach of Egypt from you." Therefore the name of the place is called Gilgal to this day.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to Joshua, "Today I have rolled away the shame of your slavery in Egypt." So that place has been called Gilgal to this day.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord said to Joshua, "Today I have rolled away the shame of Egypt from you." So the name of that place is called Gilgal to this day.
verses.textEn: Then the Lord said to Joshua, "Today I have rolled away the reproach of Egypt from you." So the place has been called Gilgal to this day.

verses.textZh: 以色列人在吉甲安营；正月十四日晚上，他们在耶利哥的平原守逾越节。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人在吉甲安营；正月十四日晚上，他们在耶利哥的平原守逾越节。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人在吉甲安营。正月十四日晚上，在耶利哥的平原守逾越节。
verses.textEnNiv: On the evening of the fourteenth day of the month, while camped at Gilgal on the plains of Jericho, the Israelites celebrated the Passover.
verses.textEnEsv: While the people of Israel were encamped at Gilgal, they kept the Passover on the fourteenth day of the month in the evening on the plains of Jericho.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the children of Israel camped in Gilgal, and kept the Passover on the fourteenth day of the month at twilight on the plains of Jericho.
verses.textEnNlt: While the Israelites were camped at Gilgal on the plains of Jericho, they celebrated Passover on the evening of the fourteenth day of the first month.
verses.textEnNasb: While the sons of Israel camped at Gilgal they celebrated the Passover on the evening of the fourteenth day of the month on the desert plains of Jericho.
verses.textEn: On the evening of the fourteenth day of the month, while camped at Gilgal on the plains of Jericho, the Israelites celebrated the Passover.

verses.textZh: 逾越节后次日，他们吃了那地的出产；就在那一天，吃了无酵饼和烘的谷物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 逾越节后次日，他们吃了那地的出产；就在那一天，吃了无酵饼和烘的谷物。
verses.textZhCuv: 逾越节的次日，他们就吃了那地的出产；正当那日吃无酵饼和烘的谷。
verses.textEnNiv: The day after the Passover, that very day, they ate some of the produce of the land: unleavened bread and roasted grain.
verses.textEnEsv: And the day after the Passover, on that very day, they ate of the produce of the land, unleavened cakes and parched grain.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they ate of the produce of the land on the day after the Passover, unleavened bread and parched grain, on the very same day.
verses.textEnNlt: The very next day they began to eat unleavened bread and roasted grain harvested from the land.
verses.textEnNasb: Then on the day after the Passover, on that very day, they ate some of the produce of the land, unleavened cakes and roasted grain.
verses.textEn: The day after the Passover, that very day, they ate some of the produce of the land: unleavened bread and roasted grain.

verses.textZh: 他们吃了那地的出产之后，第二天吗哪就停止降下；以色列人不再有吗哪了；那一年他们却吃迦南地的出产。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们吃了那地的出产之后，第二天吗哪就停止降下；以色列人不再有吗哪了；那一年他们却吃迦南地的出产。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们吃了那地的出产，第二日吗哪就止住了，以色列人也不再有吗哪了。那一年，他们却吃迦南地的出产。
verses.textEnNiv: The manna stopped the day after they ate this food from the land; there was no longer any manna for the Israelites, but that year they ate the produce of Canaan.
verses.textEnEsv: And the manna ceased the day after they ate of the produce of the land. And there was no longer manna for the people of Israel, but they ate of the fruit of the land of Canaan that year.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the manna ceased on the day after they had eaten the produce of the land; and the children of Israel no longer had manna, but they ate the food of the land of Canaan that year.
verses.textEnNlt: No manna appeared on the day they first ate from the crops of the land, and it was never seen again. So from that time on the Israelites ate from the crops of Canaan.
verses.textEnNasb: And the manna ceased on the day after they had eaten some of the produce of the land, so that the sons of Israel no longer had manna, but they ate some of the yield of the land of Canaan during that year.
verses.textEn: The manna stopped the day after they ate this food from the land; there was no longer any manna for the Israelites, but that year they ate the produce of Canaan.

verses.textZh: 约书亚走近耶利哥的时候，抬头观看，看见一个人站在他对面，手里拿着拔出来的刀。约书亚走到他那里，对他说："你是我们的人，还是我们的仇敌呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 约书亚走近耶利哥的时候，抬头观看，看见一个人站在他对面，手里拿着拔出来的刀。约书亚走到他那里，对他说："你是我们的人，还是我们的仇敌呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 约书亚靠近耶利哥的时候，举目观看，不料，有一个人手里有拔出来的刀，对面站立。约书亚到他那里，问他说：「你是帮助我们呢，是帮助我们敌人呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: Now when Joshua was near Jericho, he looked up and saw a man standing in front of him with a drawn sword in his hand. Joshua went up to him and asked, "Are you for us or for our enemies?"
verses.textEnEsv: When Joshua was by Jericho, he lifted up his eyes and looked, and behold, a man was standing before him with his drawn sword in his hand. And Joshua went to him and said to him, "Are you for us, or for our adversaries?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And it came to pass, when Joshua was by Jericho, that he lifted his eyes and looked, and behold, a Man stood opposite him with His sword drawn in His hand. And Joshua went to Him and said to Him, "Are You for us or for our adversaries?"
verses.textEnNlt: When Joshua was near the town of Jericho, he looked up and saw a man standing in front of him with sword in hand. Joshua went up to him and demanded, "Are you friend or foe?"
verses.textEnNasb: Now it came about when Joshua was by Jericho, he raised his eyes and looked, and behold, a man was standing opposite him with his sword drawn in his hand, and Joshua went to him and said to him, "Are you for us or for our enemies?"
verses.textEn: Now when Joshua was near Jericho, he looked up and saw a man standing in front of him with a drawn sword in his hand. Joshua went up to him and asked, "Are you for us or for our enemies?"

verses.textZh: 那人回答："不是的；我现在来是作耶和华军队的元帅。"约书亚就脸伏在地，向他下拜，对他说："我主有甚么事要吩咐仆人呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那人回答："不是的；我现在来是作耶和华军队的元帅。"约书亚就脸伏在地，向他下拜，对他说："我主有甚么事要吩咐仆人呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 他回答说：「不是的，我来是要作耶和华军队的元帅。」约书亚就俯伏在地下拜，说：「我主有什么话吩咐仆人。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Neither," he replied, "but as commander of the army of the Lord I have now come." Then Joshua fell facedown to the ground in reverence, and asked him, "What message does my Lord have for his servant?"
verses.textEnEsv: And he said, "No; but I am the commander of the army of the Lord . Now I have come." And Joshua fell on his face to the earth and worshiped and said to him, "What does my lord say to his servant?"
verses.textEnNkjv: So He said, "No, but as Commander of the army of the Lord I have now come." And Joshua fell on his face to the earth and worshiped, and said to Him, "What does my Lord say to His servant?"
verses.textEnNlt: "Neither one," he replied. "I am the commander of the Lord ’s army." At this, Joshua fell with his face to the ground in reverence. "I am at your command," Joshua said. "What do you want your servant to do?"
verses.textEnNasb: He said, "No; rather I have come now as captain of the army of the Lord." And Joshua fell on his face to the ground, and bowed down, and said to him, "What has my lord to say to his servant?"
verses.textEn: "Neither," he replied, "but as commander of the army of the Lord I have now come." Then Joshua fell facedown to the ground in reverence, and asked him, "What message does my Lord have for his servant?"

verses.textZh: 耶和华军队的元帅对约书亚说："把你脚上的鞋脱下来，因为你站的地方是圣地。"约书亚就照着行了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华军队的元帅对约书亚说："把你脚上的鞋脱下来，因为你站的地方是圣地。"约书亚就照着行了。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华军队的元帅对约书亚说：「把你脚上的鞋脱下来，因为你所站的地方是圣的。」约书亚就照着行了。
verses.textEnNiv: The commander of the Lord ’s army replied, "Take off your sandals, for the place where you are standing is holy." And Joshua did so.
verses.textEnEsv: And the commander of the Lord ’s army said to Joshua, "Take off your sandals from your feet, for the place where you are standing is holy." And Joshua did so.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Commander of the Lord’s army said to Joshua, "Take your sandal off your foot, for the place where you stand is holy." And Joshua did so.
verses.textEnNlt: The commander of the Lord ’s army replied, "Take off your sandals, for the place where you are standing is holy." And Joshua did as he was told.
verses.textEnNasb: And the captain of the Lord’s army said to Joshua, "Remove your sandals from your feet, for the place where you are standing is holy." And Joshua did so.
verses.textEn: The commander of the Lord ’s army replied, "Take off your sandals, for the place where you are standing is holy." And Joshua did so.

verses.textZh: 耶利哥的城门因以色列人的缘故，就紧紧地关闭，没有人出入。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶利哥的城门因以色列人的缘故，就紧紧地关闭，没有人出入。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶利哥的城门因以色列人就关得严紧，无人出入。
verses.textEnNiv: Now the gates of Jericho were securely barred because of the Israelites. No one went out and no one came in.
verses.textEnEsv: Now Jericho was shut up inside and outside because of the people of Israel. None went out, and none came in.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Jericho was securely shut up because of the children of Israel; none went out, and none came in.
verses.textEnNlt: Now the gates of Jericho were tightly shut because the people were afraid of the Israelites. No one was allowed to go out or in.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Jericho was tightly shut because of the sons of Israel; no one went out and no one came in.
verses.textEn: Now the gates of Jericho were securely barred because of the Israelites. No one went out and no one came in.

verses.textZh: 耶和华对约书亚说："看，我已经把耶利哥和耶利哥的王，以及英勇的战士，都交在你的手中了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对约书亚说："看，我已经把耶利哥和耶利哥的王，以及英勇的战士，都交在你的手中了。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华晓谕约书亚说：「看哪，我已经把耶利哥和耶利哥的王，并大能的勇士，都交在你手中。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord said to Joshua, "See, I have delivered Jericho into your hands, along with its king and its fighting men.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord said to Joshua, "See, I have given Jericho into your hand, with its king and mighty men of valor.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord said to Joshua: "See! I have given Jericho into your hand, its king, and the mighty men of valor.
verses.textEnNlt: But the Lord said to Joshua, "I have given you Jericho, its king, and all its strong warriors.
verses.textEnNasb: But the Lord said to Joshua, "See, I have handed Jericho over to you, with its king and the valiant warriors.
verses.textEn: Then the Lord said to Joshua, "See, I have delivered Jericho into your hands, along with its king and its fighting men.

verses.textZh: 你们所有能作战的男丁要围绕这城，一天围绕一次，六天都要这样行；
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们所有能作战的男丁要围绕这城，一天围绕一次，六天都要这样行；
verses.textZhCuv: 你们的一切兵丁要围绕这城，一日围绕一次，六日都要这样行。
verses.textEnNiv: March around the city once with all the armed men. Do this for six days.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall march around the city, all the men of war going around the city once. Thus shall you do for six days.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall march around the city, all you men of war; you shall go all around the city once. This you shall do six days.
verses.textEnNlt: You and your fighting men should march around the town once a day for six days.
verses.textEnNasb: And you shall march around the city, all the men of war circling the city once. You shall do so for six days.
verses.textEn: March around the city once with all the armed men. Do this for six days.

verses.textZh: 并派七个祭司拿着七个羊角，走在约柜的前面；到第七天，你们要绕城七次，祭司也要吹角。
verses.textZhCnvs: 并派七个祭司拿着七个羊角，走在约柜的前面；到第七天，你们要绕城七次，祭司也要吹角。
verses.textZhCuv: 七个祭司要拿七个羊角走在约柜前。到第七日，你们要绕城七次，祭司也要吹角。
verses.textEnNiv: Have seven priests carry trumpets of rams’ horns in front of the ark. On the seventh day, march around the city seven times, with the priests blowing the trumpets.
verses.textEnEsv: Seven priests shall bear seven trumpets of rams’ horns before the ark. On the seventh day you shall march around the city seven times, and the priests shall blow the trumpets.
verses.textEnNkjv: And seven priests shall bear seven trumpets of rams’ horns before the ark. But the seventh day you shall march around the city seven times, and the priests shall blow the trumpets.
verses.textEnNlt: Seven priests will walk ahead of the Ark, each carrying a ram’s horn. On the seventh day you are to march around the town seven times, with the priests blowing the horns.
verses.textEnNasb: Also seven priests shall carry seven trumpets of rams’ horns in front of the ark; then on the seventh day you shall march around the city seven times, and the priests shall blow the trumpets.
verses.textEn: Have seven priests carry trumpets of rams’ horns in front of the ark. On the seventh day, march around the city seven times, with the priests blowing the trumpets.

verses.textZh: 当羊角吹起长号，你们听见角声的时候，全体人民要大声呼喊，那时城墙就必塌陷；你们各人要向前直冲。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 当羊角吹起长号，你们听见角声的时候，全体人民要大声呼喊，那时城墙就必塌陷；你们各人要向前直冲。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们吹的角声拖长，你们听见角声，众百姓要大声呼喊，城墙就必塌陷，各人都要往前直上。」
verses.textEnNiv: When you hear them sound a long blast on the trumpets, have the whole army give a loud shout; then the wall of the city will collapse and the army will go up, everyone straight in."
verses.textEnEsv: And when they make a long blast with the ram’s horn, when you hear the sound of the trumpet, then all the people shall shout with a great shout, and the wall of the city will fall down flat, and the people shall go up, everyone straight before him."
verses.textEnNkjv: It shall come to pass, when they make a long blast with the ram’s horn, and when you hear the sound of the trumpet, that all the people shall shout with a great shout; then the wall of the city will fall down flat. And the people shall go up every man straight before him."
verses.textEnNlt: When you hear the priests give one long blast on the rams’ horns, have all the people shout as loud as they can. Then the walls of the town will collapse, and the people can charge straight into the town."
verses.textEnNasb: It shall be that when they make a long blast with the ram’s horn, and when you hear the sound of the trumpet, all the people shall shout with a great shout; and the wall of the city will fall down flat, and the people shall go up, everyone straight ahead."
verses.textEn: When you hear them sound a long blast on the trumpets, have the whole army give a loud shout; then the wall of the city will collapse and the army will go up, everyone straight in."

verses.textZh: 于是嫩的儿子约书亚把祭司召了来，对他们说："你们要抬起约柜；并派七个祭司拿着七个羊角，走在耶和华约柜的前面。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是嫩的儿子约书亚把祭司召了来，对他们说："你们要抬起约柜；并派七个祭司拿着七个羊角，走在耶和华约柜的前面。"
verses.textZhCuv: 嫩的儿子约书亚召了祭司来，吩咐他们说：「你们抬起约柜来，要有七个祭司拿七个羊角走在耶和华的约柜前」；
verses.textEnNiv: So Joshua son of Nun called the priests and said to them, "Take up the ark of the covenant of the Lord and have seven priests carry trumpets in front of it."
verses.textEnEsv: So Joshua the son of Nun called the priests and said to them, "Take up the ark of the covenant and let seven priests bear seven trumpets of rams’ horns before the ark of the Lord ."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Joshua the son of Nun called the priests and said to them, "Take up the ark of the covenant, and let seven priests bear seven trumpets of rams’ horns before the ark of the Lord."
verses.textEnNlt: So Joshua called together the priests and said, "Take up the Ark of the Lord ’s Covenant, and assign seven priests to walk in front of it, each carrying a ram’s horn."
verses.textEnNasb: So Joshua the son of Nun called the priests and said to them, "Take up the ark of the covenant, and have seven priests carry seven trumpets of rams’ horns in front of the ark of the Lord."
verses.textEn: So Joshua son of Nun called the priests and said to them, "Take up the ark of the covenant of the Lord and have seven priests carry trumpets in front of it."

verses.textZh: 他又对人民说："你们前去绕城吧，拿武器的人要走在耶和华约柜的前面。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又对人民说："你们前去绕城吧，拿武器的人要走在耶和华约柜的前面。"
verses.textZhCuv: 又对百姓说：「你们前去绕城，带兵器的要走在耶和华的约柜前。」
verses.textEnNiv: And he ordered the army, "Advance! March around the city, with an armed guard going ahead of the ark of the Lord ."
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to the people, "Go forward. March around the city and let the armed men pass on before the ark of the Lord ."
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said to the people, "Proceed, and march around the city, and let him who is armed advance before the ark of the Lord."
verses.textEnNlt: Then he gave orders to the people: "March around the town, and the armed men will lead the way in front of the Ark of the Lord ."
verses.textEnNasb: Then he said to the people, "Go forward and march around the city, and the armed men shall go on ahead of the ark of the Lord."
verses.textEn: And he ordered the army, "Advance! March around the city, with an armed guard going ahead of the ark of the Lord ."

verses.textZh: 约书亚吩咐人民以后，七个祭司拿着七个羊角，走在耶和华的前面，并且吹角，耶和华的约柜在他们后面跟着走。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约书亚吩咐人民以后，七个祭司拿着七个羊角，走在耶和华的前面，并且吹角，耶和华的约柜在他们后面跟着走。
verses.textZhCuv: 约书亚对百姓说完了话，七个祭司拿七个羊角走在耶和华面前吹角；耶和华的约柜在他们后面跟随。
verses.textEnNiv: When Joshua had spoken to the people, the seven priests carrying the seven trumpets before the Lord went forward, blowing their trumpets, and the ark of the Lord ’s covenant followed them.
verses.textEnEsv: And just as Joshua had commanded the people, the seven priests bearing the seven trumpets of rams’ horns before the Lord went forward, blowing the trumpets, with the ark of the covenant of the Lord following them.
verses.textEnNkjv: So it was, when Joshua had spoken to the people, that the seven priests bearing the seven trumpets of rams’ horns before the Lord advanced and blew the trumpets, and the ark of the covenant of the Lord followed them.
verses.textEnNlt: After Joshua spoke to the people, the seven priests with the rams’ horns started marching in the presence of the Lord , blowing the horns as they marched. And the Ark of the Lord ’s Covenant followed behind them.
verses.textEnNasb: And it was so, that when Joshua had spoken to the people, the seven priests carrying the seven trumpets of rams’ horns before the Lord went forward and blew the trumpets; and the ark of the covenant of the Lord followed them.
verses.textEn: When Joshua had spoken to the people, the seven priests carrying the seven trumpets before the Lord went forward, blowing their trumpets, and the ark of the Lord ’s covenant followed them.

verses.textZh: 拿武器的人走在吹角的祭司前面，在约柜后面也有防卫的队伍跟着走，祭司一面走，一面吹角。
verses.textZhCnvs: 拿武器的人走在吹角的祭司前面，在约柜后面也有防卫的队伍跟着走，祭司一面走，一面吹角。
verses.textZhCuv: 带兵器的走在吹角的祭司前面，后队随着约柜行。祭司一面走一面吹。
verses.textEnNiv: The armed guard marched ahead of the priests who blew the trumpets, and the rear guard followed the ark. All this time the trumpets were sounding.
verses.textEnEsv: The armed men were walking before the priests who were blowing the trumpets, and the rear guard was walking after the ark, while the trumpets blew continually.
verses.textEnNkjv: The armed men went before the priests who blew the trumpets, and the rear guard came after the ark, while thepriests continued blowing the trumpets.
verses.textEnNlt: Some of the armed men marched in front of the priests with the horns and some behind the Ark, with the priests continually blowing the horns.
verses.textEnNasb: And the armed men went ahead of the priests who blew the trumpets, and the rear guard came after the ark, while they continued to blow the trumpets.
verses.textEn: The armed guard marched ahead of the priests who blew the trumpets, and the rear guard followed the ark. All this time the trumpets were sounding.

verses.textZh: 约书亚吩咐人民说："你们不可呼喊，不可让人听见你们的声音，连一句话也不可出口，等到我吩咐你们‘呼喊’的那天，你们才可以呼喊。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 约书亚吩咐人民说："你们不可呼喊，不可让人听见你们的声音，连一句话也不可出口，等到我吩咐你们‘呼喊’的那天，你们才可以呼喊。"
verses.textZhCuv: 约书亚吩咐百姓说：「你们不可呼喊，不可出声，连一句话也不可出你们的口，等到我吩咐你们呼喊的日子，那时才可以呼喊。」
verses.textEnNiv: But Joshua had commanded the army, "Do not give a war cry, do not raise your voices, do not say a word until the day I tell you to shout. Then shout!"
verses.textEnEsv: But Joshua commanded the people, "You shall not shout or make your voice heard, neither shall any word go out of your mouth, until the day I tell you to shout. Then you shall shout."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Joshua had commanded the people, saying, "You shall not shout or make any noise with your voice, nor shall a word proceed out of your mouth, until the day I say to you, ‘Shout!’ Then you shall shout."
verses.textEnNlt: "Do not shout; do not even talk," Joshua commanded. "Not a single word from any of you until I tell you to shout. Then shout!"
verses.textEnNasb: But Joshua commanded the people, saying, "You shall not shout nor let your voice be heard, nor let a word proceed from your mouth, until the day I tell you, ‘Shout!’ Then you shall shout!"
verses.textEn: But Joshua had commanded the army, "Do not give a war cry, do not raise your voices, do not say a word until the day I tell you to shout. Then shout!"

verses.textZh: 这样，耶和华的约柜绕城而行，围绕了一次，众人就回到营中，在营里住宿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，耶和华的约柜绕城而行，围绕了一次，众人就回到营中，在营里住宿。
verses.textZhCuv: 这样，他使耶和华的约柜绕城，把城绕了一次；众人回到营里，就在营里住宿。
verses.textEnNiv: So he had the ark of the Lord carried around the city, circling it once. Then the army returned to camp and spent the night there.
verses.textEnEsv: So he caused the ark of the Lord to circle the city, going about it once. And they came into the camp and spent the night in the camp.
verses.textEnNkjv: So he had the ark of the Lord circle the city, going around it once. Then they came into the camp and lodged in the camp.
verses.textEnNlt: So the Ark of the Lord was carried around the town once that day, and then everyone returned to spend the night in the camp.
verses.textEnNasb: So he had the ark of the Lord taken around the city, circling it once; then they came into the camp and spent the night in the camp.
verses.textEn: So he had the ark of the Lord carried around the city, circling it once. Then the army returned to camp and spent the night there.

verses.textZh: 约书亚清早起来，祭司又抬起耶和华的约柜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约书亚清早起来，祭司又抬起耶和华的约柜。
verses.textZhCuv: 约书亚清早起来，祭司又抬起耶和华的约柜。
verses.textEnNiv: Joshua got up early the next morning and the priests took up the ark of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Then Joshua rose early in the morning, and the priests took up the ark of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: And Joshua rose early in the morning, and the priests took up the ark of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Joshua got up early the next morning, and the priests again carried the Ark of the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Now Joshua got up early in the morning, and the priests took up the ark of the Lord.
verses.textEn: Joshua got up early the next morning and the priests took up the ark of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 拿着七个羊角的七位祭司，走在耶和华的约柜前面；一面走，一面吹角；拿武器的人走在他们前面，在耶和华的约柜后面也有防卫的队伍跟着走；祭司一面走，一面吹角。
verses.textZhCnvs: 拿着七个羊角的七位祭司，走在耶和华的约柜前面；一面走，一面吹角；拿武器的人走在他们前面，在耶和华的约柜后面也有防卫的队伍跟着走；祭司一面走，一面吹角。
verses.textZhCuv: 七个祭司拿七个羊角在耶和华的约柜前，时常行走吹角；带兵器的在他们前面走，后队随着耶和华的约柜行。祭司一面走一面吹。
verses.textEnNiv: The seven priests carrying the seven trumpets went forward, marching before the ark of the Lord and blowing the trumpets. The armed men went ahead of them and the rear guard followed the ark of the Lord , while the trumpets kept sounding.
verses.textEnEsv: And the seven priests bearing the seven trumpets of rams’ horns before the ark of the Lord walked on, and they blew the trumpets continually. And the armed men were walking before them, and the rear guard was walking after the ark of the Lord , while the trumpets blew continually.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then seven priests bearing seven trumpets of rams’ horns before the ark of the Lord went on continually and blew with the trumpets. And the armed men went before them. But the rear guard came after the ark of the Lord, while thepriests continued blowing the trumpets.
verses.textEnNlt: The seven priests with the rams’ horns marched in front of the Ark of the Lord , blowing their horns. Again the armed men marched both in front of the priests with the horns and behind the Ark of the Lord . All this time the priests were blowing their horns.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the seven priests carrying the seven trumpets of rams’ horns in front of the ark of the Lord went on continually, and blew the trumpets; and the armed men went ahead of them, and the rear guard came after the ark of the Lord, while they continued to blow the trumpets.
verses.textEn: The seven priests carrying the seven trumpets went forward, marching before the ark of the Lord and blowing the trumpets. The armed men went ahead of them and the rear guard followed the ark of the Lord , while the trumpets kept sounding.

verses.textZh: 第二日，众人又绕城一次，然后回到营里去；六日他们都是这样行。
verses.textZhCnvs: 第二日，众人又绕城一次，然后回到营里去；六日他们都是这样行。
verses.textZhCuv: 第二日，众人把城绕了一次，就回营里去。六日都是这样行。
verses.textEnNiv: So on the second day they marched around the city once and returned to the camp. They did this for six days.
verses.textEnEsv: And the second day they marched around the city once, and returned into the camp. So they did for six days.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the second day they marched around the city once and returned to the camp. So they did six days.
verses.textEnNlt: On the second day they again marched around the town once and returned to the camp. They followed this pattern for six days.
verses.textEnNasb: So the second day they marched around the city once and returned to the camp; they did the same for six days.
verses.textEn: So on the second day they marched around the city once and returned to the camp. They did this for six days.

verses.textZh: 到了第七日，清早黎明的时候，他们起来，以同样的方式绕城七次；只有这一日，他们绕城七次。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到了第七日，清早黎明的时候，他们起来，以同样的方式绕城七次；只有这一日，他们绕城七次。
verses.textZhCuv: 第七日清早，黎明的时候，他们起来，照样绕城七次；惟独这日把城绕了七次。
verses.textEnNiv: On the seventh day, they got up at daybreak and marched around the city seven times in the same manner, except that on that day they circled the city seven times.
verses.textEnEsv: On the seventh day they rose early, at the dawn of day, and marched around the city in the same manner seven times. It was only on that day that they marched around the city seven times.
verses.textEnNkjv: But it came to pass on the seventh day that they rose early, about the dawning of the day, and marched around the city seven times in the same manner. On that day only they marched around the city seven times.
verses.textEnNlt: On the seventh day the Israelites got up at dawn and marched around the town as they had done before. But this time they went around the town seven times.
verses.textEnNasb: Then on the seventh day they got up early at the dawning of the day and marched around the city in the same way seven times; only on that day did they march around the city seven times.
verses.textEn: On the seventh day, they got up at daybreak and marched around the city seven times in the same manner, except that on that day they circled the city seven times.

verses.textZh: 到了第七次，祭司吹角的时候，约书亚就对人民说："你们呼喊吧，因为耶和华已经把这城赐给你们了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到了第七次，祭司吹角的时候，约书亚就对人民说："你们呼喊吧，因为耶和华已经把这城赐给你们了。
verses.textZhCuv: 到了第七次，祭司吹角的时候，约书亚吩咐百姓说：「呼喊吧，因为耶和华已经把城交给你们了！
verses.textEnNiv: The seventh time around, when the priests sounded the trumpet blast, Joshua commanded the army, "Shout! For the Lord has given you the city!
verses.textEnEsv: And at the seventh time, when the priests had blown the trumpets, Joshua said to the people, "Shout, for the Lord has given you the city.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the seventh time it happened, when the priests blew the trumpets, that Joshua said to the people: "Shout, for the Lord has given you the city!
verses.textEnNlt: The seventh time around, as the priests sounded the long blast on their horns, Joshua commanded the people, "Shout! For the Lord has given you the town!
verses.textEnNasb: And at the seventh time, when the priests blew the trumpets, Joshua said to the people, "Shout! For the Lord has given you the city.
verses.textEn: The seventh time around, when the priests sounded the trumpet blast, Joshua commanded the army, "Shout! For the Lord has given you the city!

verses.textZh: 这城要完全毁灭，城和城中的一切都归耶和华；只有妓女喇合，和所有与她在家中的都可以存活，因为她收藏了我们派去的使者。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这城要完全毁灭，城和城中的一切都归耶和华；只有妓女喇合，和所有与她在家中的都可以存活，因为她收藏了我们派去的使者。
verses.textZhCuv: 这城和其中所有的都要在耶和华面前毁灭；只有妓女喇合与她家中所有的可以存活，因为她隐藏了我们所打发的使者。
verses.textEnNiv: The city and all that is in it are to be devoted to the Lord . Only Rahab the prostitute and all who are with her in her house shall be spared, because she hid the spies we sent.
verses.textEnEsv: And the city and all that is within it shall be devoted to the Lord for destruction. Only Rahab the prostitute and all who are with her in her house shall live, because she hid the messengers whom we sent.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the city shall be doomed by the Lord to destruction, it and all who are in it. Only Rahab the harlot shall live, she and all who are with her in the house, because she hid the messengers that we sent.
verses.textEnNlt: Jericho and everything in it must be completely destroyed as an offering to the Lord . Only Rahab the prostitute and the others in her house will be spared, for she protected our spies.
verses.textEnNasb: But the city shall be designated for destruction, it and everything that is in it belongs to the Lord; only Rahab the prostitute and all who are with her in the house shall live, because she hid the messengers whom we sent.
verses.textEn: The city and all that is in it are to be devoted to the Lord . Only Rahab the prostitute and all who are with her in her house shall be spared, because she hid the spies we sent.

verses.textZh: 不过你们要谨慎，不可取那当毁灭的物，恐怕你们贪心，取了那当毁灭的物，就使以色列营成为当毁灭的，使以色列营遭遇灾祸。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不过你们要谨慎，不可取那当毁灭的物，恐怕你们贪心，取了那当毁灭的物，就使以色列营成为当毁灭的，使以色列营遭遇灾祸。
verses.textZhCuv: 至于你们，务要谨慎，不可取那当灭的物，恐怕你们取了那当灭的物就连累以色列的全营，使全营受咒诅。
verses.textEnNiv: But keep away from the devoted things, so that you will not bring about your own destruction by taking any of them. Otherwise you will make the camp of Israel liable to destruction and bring trouble on it.
verses.textEnEsv: But you, keep yourselves from the things devoted to destruction, lest when you have devoted them you take any of the devoted things and make the camp of Israel a thing for destruction and bring trouble upon it.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you, by all means abstain from the accursed things, lest you become accursed when you take of the accursed things, and make the camp of Israel a curse, and trouble it.
verses.textEnNlt: "Do not take any of the things set apart for destruction, or you yourselves will be completely destroyed, and you will bring trouble on the camp of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: But as for you, only keep yourselves from the things designated for destruction, so that you do not covet them and take some of the designated things, and turn the camp of Israel into something designated for destruction and bring disaster on it.
verses.textEn: But keep away from the devoted things, so that you will not bring about your own destruction by taking any of them. Otherwise you will make the camp of Israel liable to destruction and bring trouble on it.

verses.textZh: 可是，所有的金银和铜铁的器皿，都要归耶和华为圣，存入耶和华的库房中。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 可是，所有的金银和铜铁的器皿，都要归耶和华为圣，存入耶和华的库房中。"
verses.textZhCuv: 惟有金子、银子，和铜铁的器皿都要归耶和华为圣，必入耶和华的库中。」
verses.textEnNiv: All the silver and gold and the articles of bronze and iron are sacred to the Lord and must go into his treasury."
verses.textEnEsv: But all silver and gold, and every vessel of bronze and iron, are holy to the Lord ; they shall go into the treasury of the Lord ."
verses.textEnNkjv: But all the silver and gold, and vessels of bronze and iron, are consecrated to the Lord; they shall come into the treasury of the Lord."
verses.textEnNlt: Everything made from silver, gold, bronze, or iron is sacred to the Lord and must be brought into his treasury."
verses.textEnNasb: But all the silver and gold, and articles of bronze and iron are holy to the Lord; they shall go into the treasury of the Lord."
verses.textEn: All the silver and gold and the articles of bronze and iron are sacred to the Lord and must go into his treasury."

verses.textZh: 于是人民呼喊，祭司也吹角。人民听见角声的时候，就大声呼喊，城墙就塌陷了；于是，人民冲入城中，人人向前，把城攻取。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是人民呼喊，祭司也吹角。人民听见角声的时候，就大声呼喊，城墙就塌陷了；于是，人民冲入城中，人人向前，把城攻取。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是百姓呼喊，祭司也吹角。百姓听见角声，便大声呼喊，城墙就塌陷，百姓便上去进城，各人往前直上，将城夺取；
verses.textEnNiv: When the trumpets sounded, the army shouted, and at the sound of the trumpet, when the men gave a loud shout, the wall collapsed; so everyone charged straight in, and they took the city.
verses.textEnEsv: So the people shouted, and the trumpets were blown. As soon as the people heard the sound of the trumpet, the people shouted a great shout, and the wall fell down flat, so that the people went up into the city, every man straight before him, and they captured the city.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the people shouted when thepriests blew the trumpets. And it happened when the people heard the sound of the trumpet, and the people shouted with a great shout, that the wall fell down flat. Then the people went up into the city, every man straight before him, and they took the city.
verses.textEnNlt: When the people heard the sound of the rams’ horns, they shouted as loud as they could. Suddenly, the walls of Jericho collapsed, and the Israelites charged straight into the town and captured it.
verses.textEnNasb: So the people shouted, and the priests blew the trumpets; and when the people heard the sound of the trumpet, the people shouted with a great shout, and the wall fell down flat, so that the people went up into the city, everyone straight ahead, and they took the city.
verses.textEn: When the trumpets sounded, the army shouted, and at the sound of the trumpet, when the men gave a loud shout, the wall collapsed; so everyone charged straight in, and they took the city.

verses.textZh: 他们把城中的一切，无论男女老幼、牛羊和驴，都用刀杀尽。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们把城中的一切，无论男女老幼、牛羊和驴，都用刀杀尽。
verses.textZhCuv: 又将城中所有的，不拘男女老少，牛羊和驴，都用刀杀尽。
verses.textEnNiv: They devoted the city to the Lord and destroyed with the sword every living thing in it—men and women, young and old, cattle, sheep and donkeys.
verses.textEnEsv: Then they devoted all in the city to destruction, both men and women, young and old, oxen, sheep, and donkeys, with the edge of the sword.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they utterly destroyed all that was in the city, both man and woman, young and old, ox and sheep and donkey, with the edge of the sword.
verses.textEnNlt: They completely destroyed everything in it with their swords—men and women, young and old, cattle, sheep, goats, and donkeys.
verses.textEnNasb: They utterly destroyed everything in the city, both man and woman, young and old, and ox, sheep, and donkey, with the edge of the sword.
verses.textEn: They devoted the city to the Lord and destroyed with the sword every living thing in it—men and women, young and old, cattle, sheep and donkeys.

verses.textZh: 约书亚对窥探那地的两个人说："你们进那妓女的家里去，照着你们向她所起的誓，把那女人和她所有的一切，都从家里带出来。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 约书亚对窥探那地的两个人说："你们进那妓女的家里去，照着你们向她所起的誓，把那女人和她所有的一切，都从家里带出来。"
verses.textZhCuv: 约书亚吩咐窥探地的两个人说：「你们进那妓女的家，照着你们向她所起的誓，将那女人和她所有的都从那里带出来。」
verses.textEnNiv: Joshua said to the two men who had spied out the land, "Go into the prostitute’s house and bring her out and all who belong to her, in accordance with your oath to her."
verses.textEnEsv: But to the two men who had spied out the land, Joshua said, "Go into the prostitute’s house and bring out from there the woman and all who belong to her, as you swore to her."
verses.textEnNkjv: But Joshua had said to the two men who had spied out the country, "Go into the harlot’s house, and from there bring out the woman and all that she has, as you swore to her."
verses.textEnNlt: Meanwhile, Joshua said to the two spies, "Keep your promise. Go to the prostitute’s house and bring her out, along with all her family."
verses.textEnNasb: And Joshua said to the two men who had spied out the land, "Go into the prostitute’s house and bring the woman and all she has out of there, just as you have sworn to her."
verses.textEn: Joshua said to the two men who had spied out the land, "Go into the prostitute’s house and bring her out and all who belong to her, in accordance with your oath to her."

verses.textZh: 那两个年轻密探就进去，把喇合和她的父母、兄弟、她所有的一切，以及她所有的亲属，都领出来，安置在以色列的营外。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那两个年轻密探就进去，把喇合和她的父母、兄弟、她所有的一切，以及她所有的亲属，都领出来，安置在以色列的营外。
verses.textZhCuv: 当探子的两个少年人就进去，将喇合与她的父母、弟兄，和她所有的，并她一切的亲眷，都带出来，安置在以色列的营外。
verses.textEnNiv: So the young men who had done the spying went in and brought out Rahab, her father and mother, her brothers and sisters and all who belonged to her. They brought out her entire family and put them in a place outside the camp of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: So the young men who had been spies went in and brought out Rahab and her father and mother and brothers and all who belonged to her. And they brought all her relatives and put them outside the camp of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the young men who had been spies went in and brought out Rahab, her father, her mother, her brothers, and all that she had. So they brought out all her relatives and left them outside the camp of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: The men who had been spies went in and brought out Rahab, her father, mother, brothers, and all the other relatives who were with her. They moved her whole family to a safe place near the camp of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: So the young men who were spies went in and brought out Rahab, her father, her mother, her brothers, and all she had; they also brought out all her relatives, and placed them outside the camp of Israel.
verses.textEn: So the young men who had done the spying went in and brought out Rahab, her father and mother, her brothers and sisters and all who belonged to her. They brought out her entire family and put them in a place outside the camp of Israel.

verses.textZh: 众人把城和城中的一切都用火烧了；只有金银和铜铁的器皿都放入耶和华圣所的库房里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 众人把城和城中的一切都用火烧了；只有金银和铜铁的器皿都放入耶和华圣所的库房里。
verses.textZhCuv: 众人就用火将城和其中所有的焚烧了；惟有金子、银子，和铜铁的器皿都放在耶和华殿的库中。
verses.textEnNiv: Then they burned the whole city and everything in it, but they put the silver and gold and the articles of bronze and iron into the treasury of the Lord ’s house.
verses.textEnEsv: And they burned the city with fire, and everything in it. Only the silver and gold, and the vessels of bronze and of iron, they put into the treasury of the house of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: But they burned the city and all that was in it with fire. Only the silver and gold, and the vessels of bronze and iron, they put into the treasury of the house of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Israelites burned the town and everything in it. Only the things made from silver, gold, bronze, or iron were kept for the treasury of the Lord ’s house.
verses.textEnNasb: Then they burned the city with fire, and all that was in it. Only the silver and gold, and the articles of bronze and iron, they put into the treasury of the house of the Lord.
verses.textEn: Then they burned the whole city and everything in it, but they put the silver and gold and the articles of bronze and iron into the treasury of the Lord ’s house.

verses.textZh: 约书亚却放过妓女喇合和她的父家，以及她所有的一切；她住在以色列中，直到今日，因为她收藏了约书亚派去窥探耶利哥的使者。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约书亚却放过妓女喇合和她的父家，以及她所有的一切；她住在以色列中，直到今日，因为她收藏了约书亚派去窥探耶利哥的使者。
verses.textZhCuv: 约书亚却把妓女喇合与她父家，并她所有的，都救活了；因为她隐藏了约书亚所打发窥探耶利哥的使者，她就住在以色列中，直到今日。
verses.textEnNiv: But Joshua spared Rahab the prostitute, with her family and all who belonged to her, because she hid the men Joshua had sent as spies to Jericho—and she lives among the Israelites to this day.
verses.textEnEsv: But Rahab the prostitute and her father’s household and all who belonged to her, Joshua saved alive. And she has lived in Israel to this day, because she hid the messengers whom Joshua sent to spy out Jericho.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Joshua spared Rahab the harlot, her father’s household, and all that she had. So she dwells in Israel to this day, because she hid the messengers whom Joshua sent to spy out Jericho.
verses.textEnNlt: So Joshua spared Rahab the prostitute and her relatives who were with her in the house, because she had hidden the spies Joshua sent to Jericho. And she lives among the Israelites to this day.
verses.textEnNasb: However, Rahab the prostitute and her father’s household and all she had, Joshua spared; and she has lived in the midst of Israel to this day, because she hid the messengers whom Joshua sent to spy out Jericho.
verses.textEn: But Joshua spared Rahab the prostitute, with her family and all who belonged to her, because she hid the men Joshua had sent as spies to Jericho—and she lives among the Israelites to this day.

verses.textZh: 那时，约书亚要人民起誓，说："起来重建这耶利哥城的，那人在耶和华面前是可咒可诅的；他立地基的时候必丧长子；他安城门的时候必失幼子。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，约书亚要人民起誓，说："起来重建这耶利哥城的，那人在耶和华面前是可咒可诅的；他立地基的时候必丧长子；他安城门的时候必失幼子。"
verses.textZhCuv: 当时，约书亚叫众人起誓说：「有兴起重修这耶利哥城的人，当在耶和华面前受咒诅。 他立根基的时候，必丧长子， 安门的时候，必丧幼子。」
verses.textEnNiv: At that time Joshua pronounced this solemn oath: "Cursed before the Lord is the one who undertakes to rebuild this city, Jericho: "At the cost of his firstborn son he will lay its foundations; at the cost of his youngest he will set up its gates."
verses.textEnEsv: Joshua laid an oath on them at that time, saying, "Cursed before the Lord be the man who rises up and rebuilds this city, Jericho. "At the cost of his firstborn shall he lay its foundation, and at the cost of his youngest son shall he set up its gates."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Joshua charged them at that time, saying, "Cursed be the man before the Lord who rises up and builds this city Jericho; he shall lay its foundation with his firstborn, and with his youngest he shall set up its gates."
verses.textEnNlt: At that time Joshua invoked this curse: "May the curse of the Lord fall on anyone who tries to rebuild the town of Jericho. At the cost of his firstborn son, he will lay its foundation. At the cost of his youngest son, he will set up its gates."
verses.textEnNasb: Then Joshua made them take an oath at that time, saying, "Cursed before the Lord is the man who rises up and builds this city Jericho; with the loss of his firstborn he will lay its foundation, and with the loss of his youngest son he will set up its gates."
verses.textEn: At that time Joshua pronounced this solemn oath: "Cursed before the Lord is the one who undertakes to rebuild this city, Jericho: "At the cost of his firstborn son he will lay its foundations; at the cost of his youngest he will set up its gates."

verses.textZh: 耶和华与约书亚同在；约书亚的名声传遍全地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华与约书亚同在；约书亚的名声传遍全地。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华与约书亚同在，约书亚的声名传扬遍地。
verses.textEnNiv: So the Lord was with Joshua, and his fame spread throughout the land.
verses.textEnEsv: So the Lord was with Joshua, and his fame was in all the land.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the Lord was with Joshua, and his fame spread throughout all the country.
verses.textEnNlt: So the Lord was with Joshua, and his reputation spread throughout the land.
verses.textEnNasb: So the Lord was with Joshua, and his fame was in all the land.
verses.textEn: So the Lord was with Joshua, and his fame spread throughout the land.

verses.textZh: 以色列人在那当毁灭的物上犯了不忠实的罪；因为犹大支派中，谢拉的曾孙、撒底的孙子、迦米的儿子亚干，取了当毁灭的物，耶和华就向以色列人发怒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人在那当毁灭的物上犯了不忠实的罪；因为犹大支派中，谢拉的曾孙、撒底的孙子、迦米的儿子亚干，取了当毁灭的物，耶和华就向以色列人发怒。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人在当灭的物上犯了罪；因为犹大支派中，谢拉的曾孙，撒底的孙子，迦米的儿子亚干取了当灭的物；耶和华的怒气就向以色列人发作。
verses.textEnNiv: But the Israelites were unfaithful in regard to the devoted things ; Achan son of Karmi, the son of Zimri, the son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, took some of them. So the Lord ’s anger burned against Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: But the people of Israel broke faith in regard to the devoted things, for Achan the son of Carmi, son of Zabdi, son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, took some of the devoted things. And the anger of the Lord burned against the people of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the children of Israel committed a trespass regarding the accursed things, for Achan the son of Carmi, the son of Zabdi, the son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, took of the accursed things; so the anger of the Lord burned against the children of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: But Israel violated the instructions about the things set apart for the Lord . A man named Achan had stolen some of these dedicated things, so the Lord was very angry with the Israelites. Achan was the son of Carmi, a descendant of Zimri son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah.
verses.textEnNasb: But the sons of Israel acted unfaithfully regarding the things designated for destruction, for Achan, the son of Carmi, the son of Zabdi, the son of Zerah, from the tribe of Judah, took some of the designated things; therefore the anger of the Lord burned against the sons of Israel.
verses.textEn: But the Israelites were unfaithful in regard to the devoted things ; Achan son of Karmi, the son of Zimri, the son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, took some of them. So the Lord ’s anger burned against Israel.

verses.textZh: 那时，约书亚从耶利哥派人到伯特利东边，靠近伯．亚文的艾城去，吩咐他们说："你们上去窥探那地。"那些人就上去，窥探艾城。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，约书亚从耶利哥派人到伯特利东边，靠近伯．亚文的艾城去，吩咐他们说："你们上去窥探那地。"那些人就上去，窥探艾城。
verses.textZhCuv: 当下，约书亚从耶利哥打发人往伯特利东边、靠近伯‧亚文的艾城去，吩咐他们说：「你们上去窥探那地。」他们就上去窥探艾城。
verses.textEnNiv: Now Joshua sent men from Jericho to Ai, which is near Beth Aven to the east of Bethel, and told them, "Go up and spy out the region." So the men went up and spied out Ai.
verses.textEnEsv: Joshua sent men from Jericho to Ai, which is near Beth-aven, east of Bethel, and said to them, "Go up and spy out the land." And the men went up and spied out Ai.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Joshua sent men from Jericho to Ai, which is beside Beth Aven, on the east side of Bethel, and spoke to them, saying, "Go up and spy out the country." So the men went up and spied out Ai.
verses.textEnNlt: Joshua sent some of his men from Jericho to spy out the town of Ai, east of Bethel, near Beth-aven.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Joshua sent men from Jericho to Ai, which is near Beth-aven, east of Bethel, and said to them, " Go up and spy out the land." So the men went up and spied out Ai.
verses.textEn: Now Joshua sent men from Jericho to Ai, which is near Beth Aven to the east of Bethel, and told them, "Go up and spy out the region." So the men went up and spied out Ai.

verses.textZh: 他们回来，对约书亚说："不需要全体人民都上去；只要大约二三千人就可以上去攻打艾城了；不必劳动全体人民都上那里去，因为那里的人很少。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们回来，对约书亚说："不需要全体人民都上去；只要大约二三千人就可以上去攻打艾城了；不必劳动全体人民都上那里去，因为那里的人很少。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们回到约书亚那里，对他说：「众民不必都上去，只要二三千人上去就能攻取艾城；不必劳累众民都去，因为那里的人少。」
verses.textEnNiv: When they returned to Joshua, they said, "Not all the army will have to go up against Ai. Send two or three thousand men to take it and do not weary the whole army, for only a few people live there."
verses.textEnEsv: And they returned to Joshua and said to him, "Do not have all the people go up, but let about two or three thousand men go up and attack Ai. Do not make the whole people toil up there, for they are few."
verses.textEnNkjv: And they returned to Joshua and said to him, "Do not let all the people go up, but let about two or three thousand men go up and attack Ai. Do not weary all the people there, for thepeopleofAiare few."
verses.textEnNlt: When they returned, they told Joshua, "There’s no need for all of us to go up there; it won’t take more than two or three thousand men to attack Ai. Since there are so few of them, don’t make all our people struggle to go up there."
verses.textEnNasb: Then they returned to Joshua and said to him, "Do not have all the people go up; have only about two or three thousand men go up and attack Ai; do not trouble all the people there, for they are few."
verses.textEn: When they returned to Joshua, they said, "Not all the army will have to go up against Ai. Send two or three thousand men to take it and do not weary the whole army, for only a few people live there."

verses.textZh: 于是人民中约有三千人上那里去，但他们竟在艾城的人面前逃跑了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是人民中约有三千人上那里去，但他们竟在艾城的人面前逃跑了。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是民中约有三千人上那里去，竟在艾城人面前逃跑了。
verses.textEnNiv: So about three thousand went up; but they were routed by the men of Ai,
verses.textEnEsv: So about three thousand men went up there from the people. And they fled before the men of Ai,
verses.textEnNkjv: So about three thousand men went up there from the people, but they fled before the men of Ai.
verses.textEnNlt: So approximately 3,000 warriors were sent, but they were soundly defeated. The men of Ai
verses.textEnNasb: So about three thousand men from the people went up there, but they fled from the men of Ai.
verses.textEn: So about three thousand went up; but they were routed by the men of Ai,

verses.textZh: 艾城的人击杀了他们约三十六人；从城门前追赶他们，一直追到示巴琳；在山坡上把他们击溃；人民的心就极其惊怕。
verses.textZhCnvs: 艾城的人击杀了他们约三十六人；从城门前追赶他们，一直追到示巴琳；在山坡上把他们击溃；人民的心就极其惊怕。
verses.textZhCuv: 艾城的人击杀了他们三十六人，从城门前追赶他们，直到示巴琳，在下坡杀败他们；众民的心就消化如水。
verses.textEnNiv: who killed about thirty-six of them. They chased the Israelites from the city gate as far as the stone quarries and struck them down on the slopes. At this the hearts of the people melted in fear and became like water.
verses.textEnEsv: and the men of Ai killed about thirty-six of their men and chased them before the gate as far as Shebarim and struck them at the descent. And the hearts of the people melted and became as water.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the men of Ai struck down about thirty-six men, for they chased them from before the gate as far as Shebarim, and struck them down on the descent; therefore the hearts of the people melted and became like water.
verses.textEnNlt: chased the Israelites from the town gate as far as the quarries, and they killed about thirty-six who were retreating down the slope. The Israelites were paralyzed with fear at this turn of events, and their courage melted away.
verses.textEnNasb: And the men of Ai struck and killed about thirty-six of their men, and pursued them from the gate as far as Shebarim and struck them on the mountainside; and the hearts of the people melted and became like water.
verses.textEn: who killed about thirty-six of them. They chased the Israelites from the city gate as far as the stone quarries and struck them down on the slopes. At this the hearts of the people melted in fear and became like water.

verses.textZh: 约书亚就撕裂自己的衣服，和以色列人的长老，在耶和华的约柜前，一同俯伏在地，直到晚上，也把尘土撒在头上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约书亚就撕裂自己的衣服，和以色列人的长老，在耶和华的约柜前，一同俯伏在地，直到晚上，也把尘土撒在头上。
verses.textZhCuv: 约书亚便撕裂衣服；他和以色列的长老把灰撒在头上，在耶和华的约柜前俯伏在地，直到晚上。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Joshua tore his clothes and fell facedown to the ground before the ark of the Lord , remaining there till evening. The elders of Israel did the same, and sprinkled dust on their heads.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Joshua tore his clothes and fell to the earth on his face before the ark of the Lord until the evening, he and the elders of Israel. And they put dust on their heads.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Joshua tore his clothes, and fell to the earth on his face before the ark of the Lord until evening, he and the elders of Israel; and they put dust on their heads.
verses.textEnNlt: Joshua and the elders of Israel tore their clothing in dismay, threw dust on their heads, and bowed face down to the ground before the Ark of the Lord until evening.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Joshua tore his clothes and fell to the ground on his face before the ark of the Lord until the evening, both he and the elders of Israel; and they put dust on their heads.
verses.textEn: Then Joshua tore his clothes and fell facedown to the ground before the ark of the Lord , remaining there till evening. The elders of Israel did the same, and sprinkled dust on their heads.

verses.textZh: 约书亚说："唉！主耶和华啊，你为甚么领这人民过约旦河，为要把我们交在亚摩利人的手中，使我们灭亡呢？我们宁愿住在约旦河那边倒好。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约书亚说："唉！主耶和华啊，你为甚么领这人民过约旦河，为要把我们交在亚摩利人的手中，使我们灭亡呢？我们宁愿住在约旦河那边倒好。
verses.textZhCuv: 约书亚说：「哀哉！主耶和华啊，你为什么竟领这百姓过约旦河，将我们交在亚摩利人的手中，使我们灭亡呢？我们不如住在约旦河那边倒好。
verses.textEnNiv: And Joshua said, "Alas, Sovereign Lord , why did you ever bring this people across the Jordan to deliver us into the hands of the Amorites to destroy us? If only we had been content to stay on the other side of the Jordan!
verses.textEnEsv: And Joshua said, "Alas, O Lord God , why have you brought this people over the Jordan at all, to give us into the hands of the Amorites, to destroy us? Would that we had been content to dwell beyond the Jordan!
verses.textEnNkjv: And Joshua said, "Alas, Lord God, why have You brought this people over the Jordan at all—to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites, to destroy us? Oh, that we had been content, and dwelt on the other side of the Jordan!
verses.textEnNlt: Then Joshua cried out, "Oh, Sovereign Lord , why did you bring us across the Jordan River if you are going to let the Amorites kill us? If only we had been content to stay on the other side!
verses.textEnNasb: And Joshua said, "Oh, Lord God! Why did You ever bring this people across the Jordan, only to hand us over to the Amorites, to eliminate us? If only we had been willing to live beyond the Jordan!
verses.textEn: And Joshua said, "Alas, Sovereign Lord , why did you ever bring this people across the Jordan to deliver us into the hands of the Amorites to destroy us? If only we had been content to stay on the other side of the Jordan!

verses.textZh: 主啊！以色列人既然在仇敌面前转身逃跑，我还有甚么可说的呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 主啊！以色列人既然在仇敌面前转身逃跑，我还有甚么可说的呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 主啊，以色列人既在仇敌面前转背逃跑，我还有什么可说的呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Pardon your servant, Lord. What can I say, now that Israel has been routed by its enemies?
verses.textEnEsv: O Lord, what can I say, when Israel has turned their backs before their enemies!
verses.textEnNkjv: O Lord, what shall I say when Israel turns its back before its enemies?
verses.textEnNlt: Lord, what can I say now that Israel has fled from its enemies?
verses.textEnNasb: O Lord, what can I say since Israel has turned their back before their enemies?
verses.textEn: Pardon your servant, Lord. What can I say, now that Israel has been routed by its enemies?

verses.textZh: 迦南人和这地所有的居民听见了，就必围困我们，把我们的名字从这世上剪除，那时你为你的大名要怎样行呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 迦南人和这地所有的居民听见了，就必围困我们，把我们的名字从这世上剪除，那时你为你的大名要怎样行呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 迦南人和这地一切的居民听见了就必围困我们，将我们的名从地上除灭。那时你为你的大名要怎样行呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: The Canaanites and the other people of the country will hear about this and they will surround us and wipe out our name from the earth. What then will you do for your own great name?"
verses.textEnEsv: For the Canaanites and all the inhabitants of the land will hear of it and will surround us and cut off our name from the earth. And what will you do for your great name?"
verses.textEnNkjv: For the Canaanites and all the inhabitants of the land will hear it, and surround us, and cut off our name from the earth. Then what will You do for Your great name?"
verses.textEnNlt: For when the Canaanites and all the other people living in the land hear about it, they will surround us and wipe our name off the face of the earth. And then what will happen to the honor of your great name?"
verses.textEnNasb: For the Canaanites and all the inhabitants of the land will hear about it, and they will surround us and eliminate our name from the earth. And what will You do for Your great name?"
verses.textEn: The Canaanites and the other people of the country will hear about this and they will surround us and wipe out our name from the earth. What then will you do for your own great name?"

verses.textZh: 耶和华对约书亚说："你起来，为甚么这样脸伏在地呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对约书亚说："你起来，为甚么这样脸伏在地呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华吩咐约书亚说：「起来！你为何这样俯伏在地呢？
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to Joshua, "Stand up! What are you doing down on your face?
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord said to Joshua, "Get up! Why have you fallen on your face?
verses.textEnNkjv: So the Lord said to Joshua: "Get up! Why do you lie thus on your face?
verses.textEnNlt: But the Lord said to Joshua, "Get up! Why are you lying on your face like this?
verses.textEnNasb: So the Lord said to Joshua, "Stand up! Why is it that you have fallen on your face?
verses.textEn: The Lord said to Joshua, "Stand up! What are you doing down on your face?

verses.textZh: 以色列人犯了罪，违背了我吩咐他们的约定，因为他们取了那当毁灭的物，他们偷窃，并且说谎，又把那当毁灭的物放在自己的物件中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人犯了罪，违背了我吩咐他们的约定，因为他们取了那当毁灭的物，他们偷窃，并且说谎，又把那当毁灭的物放在自己的物件中。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人犯了罪，违背了我所吩咐他们的约，取了当灭的物；又偷窃，又行诡诈，又把那当灭的放在他们的家具里。
verses.textEnNiv: Israel has sinned; they have violated my covenant, which I commanded them to keep. They have taken some of the devoted things; they have stolen, they have lied, they have put them with their own possessions.
verses.textEnEsv: Israel has sinned; they have transgressed my covenant that I commanded them; they have taken some of the devoted things; they have stolen and lied and put them among their own belongings.
verses.textEnNkjv: Israel has sinned, and they have also transgressed My covenant which I commanded them. For they have even taken some of the accursed things, and have both stolen and deceived; and they have also put it among their own stuff.
verses.textEnNlt: Israel has sinned and broken my covenant! They have stolen some of the things that I commanded must be set apart for me. And they have not only stolen them but have lied about it and hidden the things among their own belongings.
verses.textEnNasb: Israel has sinned, and they have also violated My covenant which I commanded them. And they have even taken some of the things designated for destruction, and have both stolen and kept it a secret. Furthermore, they have also put them among their own things.
verses.textEn: Israel has sinned; they have violated my covenant, which I commanded them to keep. They have taken some of the devoted things; they have stolen, they have lied, they have put them with their own possessions.

verses.textZh: 所以，以色列人在他们的仇敌面前站立不住，在他们的仇敌面前转身逃跑，因为他们成了当毁灭的。如果你们不把那当毁灭的物从你们中间除掉，我就必不再与你们同在了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，以色列人在他们的仇敌面前站立不住，在他们的仇敌面前转身逃跑，因为他们成了当毁灭的。如果你们不把那当毁灭的物从你们中间除掉，我就必不再与你们同在了。
verses.textZhCuv: 因此，以色列人在仇敌面前站立不住。他们在仇敌面前转背逃跑，是因成了被咒诅的；你们若不把当灭的物从你们中间除掉，我就不再与你们同在了。
verses.textEnNiv: That is why the Israelites cannot stand against their enemies; they turn their backs and run because they have been made liable to destruction. I will not be with you anymore unless you destroy whatever among you is devoted to destruction.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore the people of Israel cannot stand before their enemies. They turn their backs before their enemies, because they have become devoted for destruction. I will be with you no more, unless you destroy the devoted things from among you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore the children of Israel could not stand before their enemies, but turned their backs before their enemies, because they have become doomed to destruction. Neither will I be with you anymore, unless you destroy the accursed from among you.
verses.textEnNlt: That is why the Israelites are running from their enemies in defeat. For now Israel itself has been set apart for destruction. I will not remain with you any longer unless you destroy the things among you that were set apart for destruction.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore the sons of Israel cannot stand against their enemies; they turn their backs before their enemies, because they have become designated for destruction. I will not be with you anymore unless you eliminate from your midst the things designated for destruction.
verses.textEn: That is why the Israelites cannot stand against their enemies; they turn their backs and run because they have been made liable to destruction. I will not be with you anymore unless you destroy whatever among you is devoted to destruction.

verses.textZh: 你起来，要人民自洁，对他们说：‘你们要自洁，预备明天；因为耶和华以色列的神这样说：以色列啊！你们中间有那当毁灭的物；除非你们把那当毁灭的物从你们中间除去，你们在仇敌的面前就不能站立得住。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你起来，要人民自洁，对他们说：‘你们要自洁，预备明天；因为耶和华以色列的神这样说：以色列啊！你们中间有那当毁灭的物；除非你们把那当毁灭的物从你们中间除去，你们在仇敌的面前就不能站立得住。
verses.textZhCuv: 你起来，叫百姓自洁，对他们说：『你们要自洁，预备明天，因为耶和华－以色列的神这样说：以色列啊，你们中间有当灭的物，你们若不除掉，在仇敌面前必站立不住！』
verses.textEnNiv: "Go, consecrate the people. Tell them, ‘Consecrate yourselves in preparation for tomorrow; for this is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: There are devoted things among you, Israel. You cannot stand against your enemies until you remove them.
verses.textEnEsv: Get up! Consecrate the people and say, ‘Consecrate yourselves for tomorrow; for thus says the Lord , God of Israel, "There are devoted things in your midst, O Israel. You cannot stand before your enemies until you take away the devoted things from among you."
verses.textEnNkjv: Get up, sanctify the people, and say, ‘Sanctify yourselves for tomorrow, because thus says the Lord God of Israel: "Thereis an accursed thing in your midst, O Israel; you cannot stand before your enemies until you take away the accursed thing from among you."
verses.textEnNlt: "Get up! Command the people to purify themselves in preparation for tomorrow. For this is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: Hidden among you, O Israel, are things set apart for the Lord . You will never defeat your enemies until you remove these things from among you.
verses.textEnNasb: Stand up! Consecrate the people and say, ‘Consecrate yourselves for tomorrow, because the Lord, the God of Israel, has said this: "There are things designated for destruction in your midst, Israel. You cannot stand against your enemies until you have removed the designated things from your midst."
verses.textEn: "Go, consecrate the people. Tell them, ‘Consecrate yourselves in preparation for tomorrow; for this is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: There are devoted things among you, Israel. You cannot stand against your enemies until you remove them.

verses.textZh: 到了早晨，你们要按着支派前来，耶和华抽签抽中的支派，要按着宗族前来；耶和华抽签抽中的宗族，要按着家庭前来；耶和华抽签抽中的家庭，男丁要一个一个前来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到了早晨，你们要按着支派前来，耶和华抽签抽中的支派，要按着宗族前来；耶和华抽签抽中的宗族，要按着家庭前来；耶和华抽签抽中的家庭，男丁要一个一个前来。
verses.textZhCuv: 到了早晨，你们要按着支派近前来；耶和华所取的支派，要按着宗族近前来；耶和华所取的宗族，要按着家室近前来；耶和华所取的家室，要按着人丁，一个一个地近前来。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘In the morning, present yourselves tribe by tribe. The tribe the Lord chooses shall come forward clan by clan; the clan the Lord chooses shall come forward family by family; and the family the Lord chooses shall come forward man by man.
verses.textEnEsv: In the morning therefore you shall be brought near by your tribes. And the tribe that the Lord takes by lot shall come near by clans. And the clan that the Lord takes shall come near by households. And the household that the Lord takes shall come near man by man.
verses.textEnNkjv: In the morning therefore you shall be brought according to your tribes. And it shall be that the tribe which the Lord takes shall come according to families; and the family which the Lord takes shall come by households; and the household which the Lord takes shall come man by man.
verses.textEnNlt: "In the morning you must present yourselves by tribes, and the Lord will point out the tribe to which the guilty man belongs. That tribe must come forward with its clans, and the Lord will point out the guilty clan. That clan will then come forward, and the Lord will point out the guilty family. Finally, each member of the guilty family must come forward one by one.
verses.textEnNasb: So in the morning you shall come forward by your tribes. And it shall be that the tribe which the Lord selects by lot shall come forward by families, and the family which the Lord selects shall come forward by households, and the household which the Lord selects shall come forward man by man.
verses.textEn: " ‘In the morning, present yourselves tribe by tribe. The tribe the Lord chooses shall come forward clan by clan; the clan the Lord chooses shall come forward family by family; and the family the Lord chooses shall come forward man by man.

verses.textZh: 如果那藏有当毁灭的物的人被抽签抽中了，他和他所有的一切都要用火焚烧；因为他违背了耶和华的约，又因为他在以色列中作了愚昧的事。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果那藏有当毁灭的物的人被抽签抽中了，他和他所有的一切都要用火焚烧；因为他违背了耶和华的约，又因为他在以色列中作了愚昧的事。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 被取的人有当灭的物在他那里，他和他所有的必被火焚烧；因他违背了耶和华的约，又因他在以色列中行了愚妄的事。」
verses.textEnNiv: Whoever is caught with the devoted things shall be destroyed by fire, along with all that belongs to him. He has violated the covenant of the Lord and has done an outrageous thing in Israel!’ "
verses.textEnEsv: And he who is taken with the devoted things shall be burned with fire, he and all that he has, because he has transgressed the covenant of the Lord , and because he has done an outrageous thing in Israel.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then it shall be that he who is taken with the accursed thing shall be burned with fire, he and all that he has, because he has transgressed the covenant of the Lord, and because he has done a disgraceful thing in Israel.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: The one who has stolen what was set apart for destruction will himself be burned with fire, along with everything he has, for he has broken the covenant of the Lord and has done a horrible thing in Israel."
verses.textEnNasb: And it shall be that the one who is selected with the things designated for destruction shall be burned with fire, he and all that belongs to him, because he has violated the covenant of the Lord, and because he has committed a disgraceful thing in Israel.’ "
verses.textEn: Whoever is caught with the devoted things shall be destroyed by fire, along with all that belongs to him. He has violated the covenant of the Lord and has done an outrageous thing in Israel!’ "

verses.textZh: 约书亚清早起来，要以色列人按着支派前来；结果，犹大支派被抽签抽中了；
verses.textZhCnvs: 约书亚清早起来，要以色列人按着支派前来；结果，犹大支派被抽签抽中了；
verses.textZhCuv: 于是，约书亚清早起来，使以色列人按着支派近前来，取出来的是犹大支派；
verses.textEnNiv: Early the next morning Joshua had Israel come forward by tribes, and Judah was chosen.
verses.textEnEsv: So Joshua rose early in the morning and brought Israel near tribe by tribe, and the tribe of Judah was taken.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Joshua rose early in the morning and brought Israel by their tribes, and the tribe of Judah was taken.
verses.textEnNlt: Early the next morning Joshua brought the tribes of Israel before the Lord , and the tribe of Judah was singled out.
verses.textEnNasb: So Joshua got up early in the morning and brought Israel forward by tribes, and the tribe of Judah was selected.
verses.textEn: Early the next morning Joshua had Israel come forward by tribes, and Judah was chosen.

verses.textZh: 他要犹大宗族前来，结果，谢拉的家族被抽签抽中了；他要谢拉家族的男丁一个一个前来，结果，撒底被抽签抽中了；
verses.textZhCnvs: 他要犹大宗族前来，结果，谢拉的家族被抽签抽中了；他要谢拉家族的男丁一个一个前来，结果，撒底被抽签抽中了；
verses.textZhCuv: 使犹大支派 近前来，就取了谢拉的宗族；使谢拉的宗族，按着家室人丁，一个一个地近前来，取出来的是撒底；
