verses.textEnNiv: The clans of Judah came forward, and the Zerahites were chosen. He had the clan of the Zerahites come forward by families, and Zimri was chosen.
verses.textEnEsv: And he brought near the clans of Judah, and the clan of the Zerahites was taken. And he brought near the clan of the Zerahites man by man, and Zabdi was taken.
verses.textEnNkjv: He brought the clan of Judah, and he took the family of the Zarhites; and he brought the family of the Zarhites man by man, and Zabdi was taken.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the clans of Judah came forward, and the clan of Zerah was singled out. Then the families of Zerah came forward, and the family of Zimri was singled out.
verses.textEnNasb: So he brought the family of Judah forward, and he selected the family of the Zerahites; then he brought the family of the Zerahites forward man by man, and Zabdi was selected.
verses.textEn: The clans of Judah came forward, and the Zerahites were chosen. He had the clan of the Zerahites come forward by families, and Zimri was chosen.

verses.textZh: 他要撒底家中的男丁一个一个前来，结果，亚干被抽签抽中了，亚干是迦米的儿子、撒底的孙子、谢拉的曾孙，是属于犹大支派的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他要撒底家中的男丁一个一个前来，结果，亚干被抽签抽中了，亚干是迦米的儿子、撒底的孙子、谢拉的曾孙，是属于犹大支派的。
verses.textZhCuv: 使撒底的家室，按着人丁，一个一个地近前来，就取出犹大支派的人谢拉的曾孙，撒底的孙子，迦米的儿子亚干。
verses.textEnNiv: Joshua had his family come forward man by man, and Achan son of Karmi, the son of Zimri, the son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, was chosen.
verses.textEnEsv: And he brought near his household man by man, and Achan the son of Carmi, son of Zabdi, son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, was taken.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he brought his household man by man, and Achan the son of Carmi, the son of Zabdi, the son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, was taken.
verses.textEnNlt: Every member of Zimri’s family was brought forward person by person, and Achan was singled out.
verses.textEnNasb: And he brought his household forward man by man; and Achan, son of Carmi, son of Zabdi, son of Zerah, from the tribe of Judah, was selected.
verses.textEn: Joshua had his family come forward man by man, and Achan son of Karmi, the son of Zimri, the son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, was chosen.

verses.textZh: 约书亚对亚干说："我儿，我劝你把荣耀归给耶和华以色列的神，向他认罪，告诉我你作了甚么事，不可向我隐瞒。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 约书亚对亚干说："我儿，我劝你把荣耀归给耶和华以色列的神，向他认罪，告诉我你作了甚么事，不可向我隐瞒。"
verses.textZhCuv: 约书亚对亚干说：「我儿，我劝你将荣耀归给耶和华－以色列的神，在他面前认罪，将你所做的事告诉我，不要向我隐瞒。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Joshua said to Achan, "My son, give glory to the Lord , the God of Israel, and honor him. Tell me what you have done; do not hide it from me."
verses.textEnEsv: Then Joshua said to Achan, "My son, give glory to the Lord God of Israel and give praise to him. And tell me now what you have done; do not hide it from me."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Joshua said to Achan, "My son, I beg you, give glory to the Lord God of Israel, and make confession to Him, and tell me now what you have done; do not hide it from me."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Joshua said to Achan, "My son, give glory to the Lord , the God of Israel, by telling the truth. Make your confession and tell me what you have done. Don’t hide it from me."
verses.textEnNasb: Then Joshua said to Achan, "My son, I implore you, give glory to the Lord, the God of Israel, and give praise to Him; and tell me now what you have done. Do not hide it from me."
verses.textEn: Then Joshua said to Achan, "My son, give glory to the Lord , the God of Israel, and honor him. Tell me what you have done; do not hide it from me."

verses.textZh: 亚干回答约书亚，说："我实在得罪了耶和华以色列的神；我作过的事是这样的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚干回答约书亚，说："我实在得罪了耶和华以色列的神；我作过的事是这样的。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚干回答约书亚说：「我实在得罪了耶和华－以色列的神。我所做的事如此如此：
verses.textEnNiv: Achan replied, "It is true! I have sinned against the Lord , the God of Israel. This is what I have done:
verses.textEnEsv: And Achan answered Joshua, "Truly I have sinned against the Lord God of Israel, and this is what I did:
verses.textEnNkjv: And Achan answered Joshua and said, "Indeed I have sinned against the Lord God of Israel, and this is what I have done:
verses.textEnNlt: Achan replied, "It is true! I have sinned against the Lord , the God of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: So Achan answered Joshua and said, "Truly, I have sinned against the Lord, the God of Israel, and this is what I did:
verses.textEn: Achan replied, "It is true! I have sinned against the Lord , the God of Israel. This is what I have done:

verses.textZh: 我在战利品中，看见了一件美丽的示拿衣服、二千二百八十克银子，和一条重五百七十克的金条；我因贪爱这些物件，就把它们拿去了；现在埋藏在我帐棚的地里，银子在底下。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我在战利品中，看见了一件美丽的示拿衣服、二千二百八十克银子，和一条重五百七十克的金条；我因贪爱这些物件，就把它们拿去了；现在埋藏在我帐棚的地里，银子在底下。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我在所夺的财物中看见一件美好的示拿衣服，二百舍客勒银子，一条金子重五十舍客勒，我就贪爱这些物件，便拿去了。现今藏在我帐棚内的地里，银子在衣服底下。」
verses.textEnNiv: When I saw in the plunder a beautiful robe from Babylonia, two hundred shekels of silver and a bar of gold weighing fifty shekels, I coveted them and took them. They are hidden in the ground inside my tent, with the silver underneath."
verses.textEnEsv: when I saw among the spoil a beautiful cloak from Shinar, and 200 shekels of silver, and a bar of gold weighing 50 shekels, then I coveted them and took them. And see, they are hidden in the earth inside my tent, with the silver underneath."
verses.textEnNkjv: When I saw among the spoils a beautiful Babylonian garment, two hundred shekels of silver, and a wedge of gold weighing fifty shekels, I coveted them and took them. And there they are, hidden in the earth in the midst of my tent, with the silver under it."
verses.textEnNlt: Among the plunder I saw a beautiful robe from Babylon, 200 silver coins, and a bar of gold weighing more than a pound. I wanted them so much that I took them. They are hidden in the ground beneath my tent, with the silver buried deeper than the rest."
verses.textEnNasb: when I saw among the spoils a beautiful robe from Shinar, two hundred shekels of silver, and a bar of gold fifty shekels in weight, then I wanted them and took them; and behold, they are hidden in the ground inside my tent, with the silver underneath."
verses.textEn: When I saw in the plunder a beautiful robe from Babylonia, two hundred shekels of silver and a bar of gold weighing fifty shekels, I coveted them and took them. They are hidden in the ground inside my tent, with the silver underneath."

verses.textZh: 约书亚就派人跑到亚干的帐棚里，果然见到东西埋藏在那里，银子在底下。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约书亚就派人跑到亚干的帐棚里，果然见到东西埋藏在那里，银子在底下。
verses.textZhCuv: 约书亚就打发人跑到亚干的帐棚里。那件衣服果然藏在他帐棚内，银子在底下。
verses.textEnNiv: So Joshua sent messengers, and they ran to the tent, and there it was, hidden in his tent, with the silver underneath.
verses.textEnEsv: So Joshua sent messengers, and they ran to the tent; and behold, it was hidden in his tent with the silver underneath.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Joshua sent messengers, and they ran to the tent; and there it was, hidden in his tent, with the silver under it.
verses.textEnNlt: So Joshua sent some men to make a search. They ran to the tent and found the stolen goods hidden there, just as Achan had said, with the silver buried beneath the rest.
verses.textEnNasb: So Joshua sent messengers, and they ran to the tent; and behold, it was hidden in his tent with the silver underneath it.
verses.textEn: So Joshua sent messengers, and they ran to the tent, and there it was, hidden in his tent, with the silver underneath.

verses.textZh: 他们就把东西从帐棚中拿出来，带到约书亚和以色列人那里，摆在耶和华面前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们就把东西从帐棚中拿出来，带到约书亚和以色列人那里，摆在耶和华面前。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们就从帐棚里取出来，拿到约书亚和以色列众人那里，放在耶和华面前。
verses.textEnNiv: They took the things from the tent, brought them to Joshua and all the Israelites and spread them out before the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: And they took them out of the tent and brought them to Joshua and to all the people of Israel. And they laid them down before the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: And they took them from the midst of the tent, brought them to Joshua and to all the children of Israel, and laid them out before the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: They took the things from the tent and brought them to Joshua and all the Israelites. Then they laid them on the ground in the presence of the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: So they took them from inside the tent and brought them to Joshua and to all the sons of Israel; and they laid them out before the Lord.
verses.textEn: They took the things from the tent, brought them to Joshua and all the Israelites and spread them out before the Lord .

verses.textZh: 约书亚和全体以色列人一起把谢拉的曾孙亚干和那银子、那件衣服、那金条，以及亚干的儿女、牛、驴、羊、帐棚和他所有的一切，都带上亚割谷去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约书亚和全体以色列人一起把谢拉的曾孙亚干和那银子、那件衣服、那金条，以及亚干的儿女、牛、驴、羊、帐棚和他所有的一切，都带上亚割谷去。
verses.textZhCuv: 约书亚和以色列众人把谢拉的曾孙亚干和那银子、那件衣服、那条金子，并亚干的儿女、牛、驴、羊、帐棚，以及他所有的，都带到亚割谷去。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Joshua, together with all Israel, took Achan son of Zerah, the silver, the robe, the gold bar, his sons and daughters, his cattle, donkeys and sheep, his tent and all that he had, to the Valley of Achor.
verses.textEnEsv: And Joshua and all Israel with him took Achan the son of Zerah, and the silver and the cloak and the bar of gold, and his sons and daughters and his oxen and donkeys and sheep and his tent and all that he had. And they brought them up to the Valley of Achor.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Joshua, and all Israel with him, took Achan the son of Zerah, the silver, the garment, the wedge of gold, his sons, his daughters, his oxen, his donkeys, his sheep, his tent, and all that he had, and they brought them to the Valley of Achor.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Joshua and all the Israelites took Achan, the silver, the robe, the bar of gold, his sons, daughters, cattle, donkeys, sheep, goats, tent, and everything he had, and they brought them to the valley of Achor.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Joshua, and all Israel with him, took Achan the son of Zerah, the silver, the robe, the bar of gold, his sons, his daughters, his oxen, his donkeys, his sheep, his tent, and all that belonged to him; and they brought them up to the Valley of Achor.
verses.textEn: Then Joshua, together with all Israel, took Achan son of Zerah, the silver, the robe, the gold bar, his sons and daughters, his cattle, donkeys and sheep, his tent and all that he had, to the Valley of Achor.

verses.textZh: 约书亚说："你为甚么给我们招惹灾祸呢？今天耶和华必使你遭受灾祸。"于是全体以色列人用石头把他打死。他们用石头打死他们以后，就把一切用火烧了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约书亚说："你为甚么给我们招惹灾祸呢？今天耶和华必使你遭受灾祸。"于是全体以色列人用石头把他打死。他们用石头打死他们以后，就把一切用火烧了。
verses.textZhCuv: 约书亚说：「你为什么连累我们呢？今日耶和华必叫你受连累。」于是以色列众人用石头打死他，将石头扔在其上，又用火焚烧他所有的 。
verses.textEnNiv: Joshua said, "Why have you brought this trouble on us? The Lord will bring trouble on you today." Then all Israel stoned him, and after they had stoned the rest, they burned them.
verses.textEnEsv: And Joshua said, "Why did you bring trouble on us? The Lord brings trouble on you today." And all Israel stoned him with stones. They burned them with fire and stoned them with stones.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Joshua said, "Why have you troubled us? The Lord will trouble you this day." So all Israel stoned him with stones; and they burned them with fire after they had stoned them with stones.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Joshua said to Achan, "Why have you brought trouble on us? The Lord will now bring trouble on you." And all the Israelites stoned Achan and his family and burned their bodies.
verses.textEnNasb: And Joshua said, "Why have you brought disaster on us? The Lord will bring disaster on you this day." And all Israel stoned them with stones; and they burned them with fire after they had stoned them with stones.
verses.textEn: Joshua said, "Why have you brought this trouble on us? The Lord will bring trouble on you today." Then all Israel stoned him, and after they had stoned the rest, they burned them.

verses.textZh: 众人又在亚干身上堆起了一大堆石头，这堆石头一直存到今日；于是耶和华就回心转意，不发烈怒。因此那地方名叫亚割谷，直到今日。
verses.textZhCnvs: 众人又在亚干身上堆起了一大堆石头，这堆石头一直存到今日；于是耶和华就回心转意，不发烈怒。因此那地方名叫亚割谷，直到今日。
verses.textZhCuv: 众人在亚干身上堆成一大堆石头，直存到今日。于是耶和华转意，不发他的烈怒。因此那地方名叫亚割谷 ，直到今日。
verses.textEnNiv: Over Achan they heaped up a large pile of rocks, which remains to this day. Then the Lord turned from his fierce anger. Therefore that place has been called the Valley of Achor ever since.
verses.textEnEsv: And they raised over him a great heap of stones that remains to this day. Then the Lord turned from his burning anger. Therefore, to this day the name of that place is called the Valley of Achor.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they raised over him a great heap of stones, still there to this day. So the Lord turned from the fierceness of His anger. Therefore the name of that place has been called the Valley of Achor to this day.
verses.textEnNlt: They piled a great heap of stones over Achan, which remains to this day. That is why the place has been called the Valley of Trouble ever since. So the Lord was no longer angry.
verses.textEnNasb: Then they erected over him a large heap of stones that stands to this day, and the Lord turned from the fierceness of His anger. Therefore the name of that place has been called the Valley of Achor to this day.
verses.textEn: Over Achan they heaped up a large pile of rocks, which remains to this day. Then the Lord turned from his fierce anger. Therefore that place has been called the Valley of Achor ever since.

verses.textZh: 耶和华对约书亚说："你不要惧怕，也不要惊慌，你只管带领所有能作战的人，起来上艾城去；你看，我已经把艾城的王和他的人民、城市、土地都交在你手里了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对约书亚说："你不要惧怕，也不要惊慌，你只管带领所有能作战的人，起来上艾城去；你看，我已经把艾城的王和他的人民、城市、土地都交在你手里了。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对约书亚说：「不要惧怕，也不要惊惶。你起来，率领一切兵丁上艾城去，我已经把艾城的王和他的民、他的城，并他的地，都交在你手里。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord said to Joshua, "Do not be afraid; do not be discouraged. Take the whole army with you, and go up and attack Ai. For I have delivered into your hands the king of Ai, his people, his city and his land.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord said to Joshua, "Do not fear and do not be dismayed. Take all the fighting men with you, and arise, go up to Ai. See, I have given into your hand the king of Ai, and his people, his city, and his land.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the Lord said to Joshua: "Do not be afraid, nor be dismayed; take all the people of war with you, and arise, go up to Ai. See, I have given into your hand the king of Ai, his people, his city, and his land.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to Joshua, "Do not be afraid or discouraged. Take all your fighting men and attack Ai, for I have given you the king of Ai, his people, his town, and his land.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the Lord said to Joshua, "Do not fear or be dismayed. Take all the people of war with you. Arise, go up to Ai; see, I have handed over to you the king of Ai, his people, his city, and his land.
verses.textEn: Then the Lord said to Joshua, "Do not be afraid; do not be discouraged. Take the whole army with you, and go up and attack Ai. For I have delivered into your hands the king of Ai, his people, his city and his land.

verses.textZh: 你怎样对待耶利哥和耶利哥的王，也要照样对待艾城和艾城的王；只是城中的战利品和牲畜，你们可以据为己有；你要在城后面设下攻城的伏兵。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你怎样对待耶利哥和耶利哥的王，也要照样对待艾城和艾城的王；只是城中的战利品和牲畜，你们可以据为己有；你要在城后面设下攻城的伏兵。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你怎样待耶利哥和耶利哥的王，也当照样待艾城和艾城的王。只是城内所夺的财物和牲畜，你们可以取为自己的掠物。你要在城后设下伏兵。」
verses.textEnNiv: You shall do to Ai and its king as you did to Jericho and its king, except that you may carry off their plunder and livestock for yourselves. Set an ambush behind the city."
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall do to Ai and its king as you did to Jericho and its king. Only its spoil and its livestock you shall take as plunder for yourselves. Lay an ambush against the city, behind it."
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall do to Ai and its king as you did to Jericho and its king. Only its spoil and its cattle you shall take as booty for yourselves. Lay an ambush for the city behind it."
verses.textEnNlt: You will destroy them as you destroyed Jericho and its king. But this time you may keep the plunder and the livestock for yourselves. Set an ambush behind the town."
verses.textEnNasb: You shall do to Ai and its king just as you did to Jericho and its king; you shall take only its spoils and its cattle as plunder for yourselves. Set an ambush for the city behind it."
verses.textEn: You shall do to Ai and its king as you did to Jericho and its king, except that you may carry off their plunder and livestock for yourselves. Set an ambush behind the city."

verses.textZh: 于是，约书亚和所有能作战的人都起来上艾城去；约书亚选了三万英勇的战士，趁夜派他们出去，
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，约书亚和所有能作战的人都起来上艾城去；约书亚选了三万英勇的战士，趁夜派他们出去，
verses.textZhCuv: 于是，约书亚和一切兵丁都起来，要上艾城去。约书亚选了三万大能的勇士，夜间打发他们前往，
verses.textEnNiv: So Joshua and the whole army moved out to attack Ai. He chose thirty thousand of his best fighting men and sent them out at night
verses.textEnEsv: So Joshua and all the fighting men arose to go up to Ai. And Joshua chose 30,000 mighty men of valor and sent them out by night.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Joshua arose, and all the people of war, to go up against Ai; and Joshua chose thirty thousand mighty men of valor and sent them away by night.
verses.textEnNlt: So Joshua and all the fighting men set out to attack Ai. Joshua chose 30,000 of his best warriors and sent them out at night
verses.textEnNasb: So Joshua rose up with all the people of war to go up to Ai; and Joshua chose thirty thousand men, valiant warriors, and sent them out at night.
verses.textEn: So Joshua and the whole army moved out to attack Ai. He chose thirty thousand of his best fighting men and sent them out at night

verses.textZh: 吩咐他们说："你们注意，要在城后面埋伏攻城；不可离城太远，人人都要作好准备。
verses.textZhCnvs: 吩咐他们说："你们注意，要在城后面埋伏攻城；不可离城太远，人人都要作好准备。
verses.textZhCuv: 吩咐他们说：「你们要在城后埋伏，不可离城太远，都要各自准备。
verses.textEnNiv: with these orders: "Listen carefully. You are to set an ambush behind the city. Don’t go very far from it. All of you be on the alert.
verses.textEnEsv: And he commanded them, "Behold, you shall lie in ambush against the city, behind it. Do not go very far from the city, but all of you remain ready.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he commanded them, saying: "Behold, you shall lie in ambush against the city, behind the city. Do not go very far from the city, but all of you be ready.
verses.textEnNlt: with these orders: "Hide in ambush close behind the town and be ready for action.
verses.textEnNasb: He commanded them, saying, "See, you are going to ambush the city from behind it. Do not go very far from the city, but all of you be ready.
verses.textEn: with these orders: "Listen carefully. You are to set an ambush behind the city. Don’t go very far from it. All of you be on the alert.

verses.textZh: 我和所有与我一起的人，要向城推进。城里的人像前一次出来攻击我们的时候，我们就在他们面前逃跑；
verses.textZhCnvs: 我和所有与我一起的人，要向城推进。城里的人像前一次出来攻击我们的时候，我们就在他们面前逃跑；
verses.textZhCuv: 我与我所带领的众民要向城前往。城里的人像初次出来攻击我们的时候，我们就在他们面前逃跑，
verses.textEnNiv: I and all those with me will advance on the city, and when the men come out against us, as they did before, we will flee from them.
verses.textEnEsv: And I and all the people who are with me will approach the city. And when they come out against us just as before, we shall flee before them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I and all the people who are with me will approach the city; and it will come about, when they come out against us as at the first, that we shall flee before them.
verses.textEnNlt: When our main army attacks, the men of Ai will come out to fight as they did before, and we will run away from them.
verses.textEnNasb: Then I and all the people who are with me will approach the city. And when they come out to meet us as they did the first time, we will flee before them.
verses.textEn: I and all those with me will advance on the city, and when the men come out against us, as they did before, we will flee from them.

verses.textZh: 他们必定出来追赶我们，我们就把他们引出城来，因为他们必定说：‘这些人像前一次一样在我们面前逃跑了。’所以我们要在他们面前逃跑。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们必定出来追赶我们，我们就把他们引出城来，因为他们必定说：‘这些人像前一次一样在我们面前逃跑了。’所以我们要在他们面前逃跑。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们必出来追赶我们，直到我们引诱他们离开城；因为他们必说：『这些人像初次在我们面前逃跑。』所以我们要在他们面前逃跑，
verses.textEnNiv: They will pursue us until we have lured them away from the city, for they will say, ‘They are running away from us as they did before.’ So when we flee from them,
verses.textEnEsv: And they will come out after us, until we have drawn them away from the city. For they will say, ‘They are fleeing from us, just as before.’ So we will flee before them.
verses.textEnNkjv: For they will come out after us till we have drawn them from the city, for they will say, ‘Theyare fleeing before us as at the first.’ Therefore we will flee before them.
verses.textEnNlt: We will let them chase us until we have drawn them away from the town. For they will say, ‘The Israelites are running away from us as they did before.’ Then, while we are running from them,
verses.textEnNasb: They will come out after us until we have lured them away from the city, for they will say, ‘They are fleeing before us just as they did the first time.’ So we will flee before them.
verses.textEn: They will pursue us until we have lured them away from the city, for they will say, ‘They are running away from us as they did before.’ So when we flee from them,

verses.textZh: 那时你们就要从埋伏的地方起来，占领那城，因为耶和华你们的神必把城交在你们的手里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时你们就要从埋伏的地方起来，占领那城，因为耶和华你们的神必把城交在你们的手里。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们就从埋伏的地方起来，夺取那城，因为耶和华－你们的神必把城交在你们手里。
verses.textEnNiv: you are to rise up from ambush and take the city. The Lord your God will give it into your hand.
verses.textEnEsv: Then you shall rise up from the ambush and seize the city, for the Lord your God will give it into your hand.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then you shall rise from the ambush and seize the city, for the Lord your God will deliver it into your hand.
verses.textEnNlt: you will jump up from your ambush and take possession of the town, for the Lord your God will give it to you.
verses.textEnNasb: Then you shall rise from your ambush and take possession of the city, for the Lord your God will hand it over to you.
verses.textEn: you are to rise up from ambush and take the city. The Lord your God will give it into your hand.

verses.textZh: 你们占领了城以后，就要放火烧城；要照着耶和华的话行事；你们要谨慎，我已经吩咐你们了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们占领了城以后，就要放火烧城；要照着耶和华的话行事；你们要谨慎，我已经吩咐你们了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你们夺了城以后，就放火烧城，要照耶和华的话行。这是我吩咐你们的。」
verses.textEnNiv: When you have taken the city, set it on fire. Do what the Lord has commanded. See to it; you have my orders."
verses.textEnEsv: And as soon as you have taken the city, you shall set the city on fire. You shall do according to the word of the Lord . See, I have commanded you."
verses.textEnNkjv: And it will be, when you have taken the city, that you shall set the city on fire. According to the commandment of the Lord you shall do. See, I have commanded you."
verses.textEnNlt: Set the town on fire, as the Lord has commanded. You have your orders."
verses.textEnNasb: Then it will be when you have seized the city, that you shall set the city on fire. You shall do it in accordance with the word of the Lord. See, I have commanded you."
verses.textEn: When you have taken the city, set it on fire. Do what the Lord has commanded. See to it; you have my orders."

verses.textZh: 约书亚差派他们去了，他们就上到埋伏的地方去，住在伯特利和艾城的中间，就是在艾城的西边。那一夜，约书亚却在人民中间住宿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约书亚差派他们去了，他们就上到埋伏的地方去，住在伯特利和艾城的中间，就是在艾城的西边。那一夜，约书亚却在人民中间住宿。
verses.textZhCuv: 约书亚打发他们前往，他们就上埋伏的地方去，住在伯特利和艾城的中间，就是在艾城的西边。这夜约书亚却在民中住宿。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Joshua sent them off, and they went to the place of ambush and lay in wait between Bethel and Ai, to the west of Ai—but Joshua spent that night with the people.
verses.textEnEsv: So Joshua sent them out. And they went to the place of ambush and lay between Bethel and Ai, to the west of Ai, but Joshua spent that night among the people.
verses.textEnNkjv: Joshua therefore sent them out; and they went to lie in ambush, and stayed between Bethel and Ai, on the west side of Ai; but Joshua lodged that night among the people.
verses.textEnNlt: So they left and went to the place of ambush between Bethel and the west side of Ai. But Joshua remained among the people in the camp that night.
verses.textEnNasb: So Joshua sent them away, and they went to the place of ambush and remained between Bethel and Ai, on the west side of Ai; but Joshua spent that night among the people.
verses.textEn: Then Joshua sent them off, and they went to the place of ambush and lay in wait between Bethel and Ai, to the west of Ai—but Joshua spent that night with the people.

verses.textZh: 约书亚清早起来，召集人民上艾城去，他和以色列的长老走在人民的前面。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约书亚清早起来，召集人民上艾城去，他和以色列的长老走在人民的前面。
verses.textZhCuv: 约书亚清早起来，点齐百姓，他和以色列的长老在百姓前面上艾城去。
verses.textEnNiv: Early the next morning Joshua mustered his army, and he and the leaders of Israel marched before them to Ai.
verses.textEnEsv: Joshua arose early in the morning and mustered the people and went up, he and the elders of Israel, before the people to Ai.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Joshua rose up early in the morning and mustered the people, and went up, he and the elders of Israel, before the people to Ai.
verses.textEnNlt: Early the next morning Joshua roused his men and started toward Ai, accompanied by the elders of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Joshua got up early in the morning and mustered the people, and he went up with the elders of Israel before the people to Ai.
verses.textEn: Early the next morning Joshua mustered his army, and he and the leaders of Israel marched before them to Ai.

verses.textZh: 所有与他在一起的战士都上去，迫近艾城，在城的北面安营；在约书亚和艾城中间有一个山谷，
verses.textZhCnvs: 所有与他在一起的战士都上去，迫近艾城，在城的北面安营；在约书亚和艾城中间有一个山谷，
verses.textZhCuv: 众民，就是他所带领的兵丁，都上去，向前直往，来到城前，在艾城北边安营。在约书亚和艾城中间有一山谷。
verses.textEnNiv: The entire force that was with him marched up and approached the city and arrived in front of it. They set up camp north of Ai, with the valley between them and the city.
verses.textEnEsv: And all the fighting men who were with him went up and drew near before the city and encamped on the north side of Ai, with a ravine between them and Ai.
verses.textEnNkjv: And all the people of war who were with him went up and drew near; and they came before the city and camped on the north side of Ai. Now a valley lay between them and Ai.
verses.textEnNlt: All the fighting men who were with Joshua marched in front of the town and camped on the north side of Ai, with a valley between them and the town.
verses.textEnNasb: Then all the people of war who were with him went up and approached, and arrived in front of the city; and they camped on the north side of Ai. And there was a valley between him and Ai.
verses.textEn: The entire force that was with him marched up and approached the city and arrived in front of it. They set up camp north of Ai, with the valley between them and the city.

verses.textZh: 约书亚挑了大约五千人，要他们埋伏在伯特利和艾城中间，就是艾城的西面。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约书亚挑了大约五千人，要他们埋伏在伯特利和艾城中间，就是艾城的西面。
verses.textZhCuv: 他挑了约有五千人，使他们埋伏在伯特利和艾城的中间，就是在艾城的西边，
verses.textEnNiv: Joshua had taken about five thousand men and set them in ambush between Bethel and Ai, to the west of the city.
verses.textEnEsv: He took about 5,000 men and set them in ambush between Bethel and Ai, to the west of the city.
verses.textEnNkjv: So he took about five thousand men and set them in ambush between Bethel and Ai, on the west side of the city.
verses.textEnNlt: That night Joshua sent about 5,000 men to lie in ambush between Bethel and Ai, on the west side of the town.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he took about five thousand men and set them in ambush between Bethel and Ai, on the west side of the city.
verses.textEn: Joshua had taken about five thousand men and set them in ambush between Bethel and Ai, to the west of the city.

verses.textZh: 于是他们把众民，就是在城北的全军和在城西的伏兵都布置好了。那一夜，约书亚走进了山谷之中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是他们把众民，就是在城北的全军和在城西的伏兵都布置好了。那一夜，约书亚走进了山谷之中。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是安置了百姓，就是城北的全军和城西的伏兵。这夜约书亚进入山谷之中。
verses.textEnNiv: So the soldiers took up their positions—with the main camp to the north of the city and the ambush to the west of it. That night Joshua went into the valley.
verses.textEnEsv: So they stationed the forces, the main encampment that was north of the city and its rear guard west of the city. But Joshua spent that night in the valley.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when they had set the people, all the army that was on the north of the city, and its rear guard on the west of the city, Joshua went that night into the midst of the valley.
verses.textEnNlt: So they stationed the main army north of the town and the ambush west of the town. Joshua himself spent that night in the valley.
verses.textEnNasb: So they stationed the people, all the army that was on the north side of the city, and its rear guard on the west side of the city, and Joshua spent that night in the midst of the valley.
verses.textEn: So the soldiers took up their positions—with the main camp to the north of the city and the ambush to the west of it. That night Joshua went into the valley.

verses.textZh: 艾城的王看见了这情形，就和艾城的人急忙在清早起来，按着亚拉巴前面所约定之处出到亚拉巴，要与以色列人交战；王却不知道在城后面有伏兵要攻击他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 艾城的王看见了这情形，就和艾城的人急忙在清早起来，按着亚拉巴前面所约定之处出到亚拉巴，要与以色列人交战；王却不知道在城后面有伏兵要攻击他。
verses.textZhCuv: 艾城的王看见这景况，就和全城的人，清早急忙起来，按所定的时候，出到亚拉巴前，要与以色列人交战；王却不知道在城后有伏兵。
verses.textEnNiv: When the king of Ai saw this, he and all the men of the city hurried out early in the morning to meet Israel in battle at a certain place overlooking the Arabah. But he did not know that an ambush had been set against him behind the city.
verses.textEnEsv: And as soon as the king of Ai saw this, he and all his people, the men of the city, hurried and went out early to the appointed place toward the Arabah to meet Israel in battle. But he did not know that there was an ambush against him behind the city.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it happened, when the king of Ai saw it, that the men of the city hurried and rose early and went out against Israel to battle, he and all his people, at an appointed place before the plain. But he did not know that therewas an ambush against him behind the city.
verses.textEnNlt: When the king of Ai saw the Israelites across the valley, he and all his army hurried out early in the morning and attacked the Israelites at a place overlooking the Jordan Valley. But he didn’t realize there was an ambush behind the town.
verses.textEnNasb: And it came about, when the king of Ai saw them, that the men of the city hurried and got up early, and went out to meet Israel in battle, he and all his people at the appointed place before the desert plain. But he did not know that there was an ambush against him behind the city.
verses.textEn: When the king of Ai saw this, he and all the men of the city hurried out early in the morning to meet Israel in battle at a certain place overlooking the Arabah. But he did not know that an ambush had been set against him behind the city.

verses.textZh: 约书亚和以色列人在他们面前装败，沿着通往旷野的路逃跑。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约书亚和以色列人在他们面前装败，沿着通往旷野的路逃跑。
verses.textZhCuv: 约书亚和以色列众人在他们面前装败，往那通旷野的路逃跑。
verses.textEnNiv: Joshua and all Israel let themselves be driven back before them, and they fled toward the wilderness.
verses.textEnEsv: And Joshua and all Israel pretended to be beaten before them and fled in the direction of the wilderness.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Joshua and all Israel made as if they were beaten before them, and fled by the way of the wilderness.
verses.textEnNlt: Joshua and the Israelite army fled toward the wilderness as though they were badly beaten.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Joshua and all Israel pretended to be defeated before them, and fled by the way of the wilderness.
verses.textEn: Joshua and all Israel let themselves be driven back before them, and they fled toward the wilderness.

verses.textZh: 城里的众民都被召集，去追赶他们；艾城的人追赶约书亚的时候，就都被诱离城。
verses.textZhCnvs: 城里的众民都被召集，去追赶他们；艾城的人追赶约书亚的时候，就都被诱离城。
verses.textZhCuv: 城内的众民都被招聚，追赶他们；艾城人追赶的时候，就被引诱离开城。
verses.textEnNiv: All the men of Ai were called to pursue them, and they pursued Joshua and were lured away from the city.
verses.textEnEsv: So all the people who were in the city were called together to pursue them, and as they pursued Joshua they were drawn away from the city.
verses.textEnNkjv: So all the people who were in Ai were called together to pursue them. And they pursued Joshua and were drawn away from the city.
verses.textEnNlt: Then all the men in the town were called out to chase after them. In this way, they were lured away from the town.
verses.textEnNasb: And all the people who were in the city were called together to pursue them, and they pursued Joshua and were lured away from the city.
verses.textEn: All the men of Ai were called to pursue them, and they pursued Joshua and were lured away from the city.

verses.textZh: 艾城和伯特利城没有留下一个人不出来追赶以色列人；他们撇下了敞开的城门，去追赶以色列人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 艾城和伯特利城没有留下一个人不出来追赶以色列人；他们撇下了敞开的城门，去追赶以色列人。
verses.textZhCuv: 艾城和伯特利城没有一人不出来追赶以色列人的，撇了敞开的城门，去追赶以色列人。
verses.textEnNiv: Not a man remained in Ai or Bethel who did not go after Israel. They left the city open and went in pursuit of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: Not a man was left in Ai or Bethel who did not go out after Israel. They left the city open and pursued Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: There was not a man left in Ai or Bethel who did not go out after Israel. So they left the city open and pursued Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: There was not a man left in Ai or Bethel who did not chase after the Israelites, and the town was left wide open.
verses.textEnNasb: So not a man was left in Ai or Bethel, but they had all gone out after Israel, and they left the city unguarded and pursued Israel.
verses.textEn: Not a man remained in Ai or Bethel who did not go after Israel. They left the city open and went in pursuit of Israel.

verses.textZh: 耶和华对约书亚说："你向着艾城伸出你手中的短枪，因为我要把城交在你手里。"约书亚就向着艾城伸出他手里的短枪。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对约书亚说："你向着艾城伸出你手中的短枪，因为我要把城交在你手里。"约书亚就向着艾城伸出他手里的短枪。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华吩咐约书亚说：「你向艾城伸出手里的短枪，因为我要将城交在你手里。」约书亚就向城伸出手里的短枪。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord said to Joshua, "Hold out toward Ai the javelin that is in your hand, for into your hand I will deliver the city." So Joshua held out toward the city the javelin that was in his hand.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the Lord said to Joshua, "Stretch out the javelin that is in your hand toward Ai, for I will give it into your hand." And Joshua stretched out the javelin that was in his hand toward the city.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord said to Joshua, "Stretch out the spear that is in your hand toward Ai, for I will give it into your hand." And Joshua stretched out the spear that was in his hand toward the city.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to Joshua, "Point the spear in your hand toward Ai, for I will hand the town over to you." Joshua did as he was commanded.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord said to Joshua, "Reach out with the sword that is in your hand toward Ai, for I will hand it over to you." So Joshua reached out with the sword that was in his hand toward the city.
verses.textEn: Then the Lord said to Joshua, "Hold out toward Ai the javelin that is in your hand, for into your hand I will deliver the city." So Joshua held out toward the city the javelin that was in his hand.

verses.textZh: 他一伸手，伏兵就从埋伏的地方急忙起来，冲进城去，把城夺取，并连忙放火烧城。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他一伸手，伏兵就从埋伏的地方急忙起来，冲进城去，把城夺取，并连忙放火烧城。
verses.textZhCuv: 他一伸手，伏兵就从埋伏的地方急忙起来，夺了城，跑进城去，放火焚烧。
verses.textEnNiv: As soon as he did this, the men in the ambush rose quickly from their position and rushed forward. They entered the city and captured it and quickly set it on fire.
verses.textEnEsv: And the men in the ambush rose quickly out of their place, and as soon as he had stretched out his hand, they ran and entered the city and captured it. And they hurried to set the city on fire.
verses.textEnNkjv: So thosein ambush arose quickly out of their place; they ran as soon as he had stretched out his hand, and they entered the city and took it, and hurried to set the city on fire.
verses.textEnNlt: As soon as Joshua gave this signal, all the men in ambush jumped up from their position and poured into the town. They quickly captured it and set it on fire.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the men in ambush rose quickly from their place, and when he had reached out with his hand, they ran and entered the city and captured it, and they quickly set the city on fire.
verses.textEn: As soon as he did this, the men in the ambush rose quickly from their position and rushed forward. They entered the city and captured it and quickly set it on fire.

verses.textZh: 艾城的人转身观看，看见城里浓烟冲天，就全身乏力，不能逃跑；往旷野逃跑的以色列人就转过来攻击追赶他们的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 艾城的人转身观看，看见城里浓烟冲天，就全身乏力，不能逃跑；往旷野逃跑的以色列人就转过来攻击追赶他们的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 艾城的人回头一看，不料，城中烟气冲天，他们就无力向左向右逃跑。那往旷野逃跑的百姓便转身攻击追赶他们的人。
verses.textEnNiv: The men of Ai looked back and saw the smoke of the city rising up into the sky, but they had no chance to escape in any direction; the Israelites who had been fleeing toward the wilderness had turned back against their pursuers.
verses.textEnEsv: So when the men of Ai looked back, behold, the smoke of the city went up to heaven, and they had no power to flee this way or that, for the people who fled to the wilderness turned back against the pursuers.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when the men of Ai looked behind them, they saw, and behold, the smoke of the city ascended to heaven. So they had no power to flee this way or that way, and the people who had fled to the wilderness turned back on the pursuers.
verses.textEnNlt: When the men of Ai looked behind them, smoke from the town was filling the sky, and they had nowhere to go. For the Israelites who had fled in the direction of the wilderness now turned on their pursuers.
verses.textEnNasb: When the men of Ai turned back and looked, behold, the smoke of the city ascended to the sky, and they had no place to flee this way or that, for the people who had been fleeing to the wilderness turned against the pursuers.
verses.textEn: The men of Ai looked back and saw the smoke of the city rising up into the sky, but they had no chance to escape in any direction; the Israelites who had been fleeing toward the wilderness had turned back against their pursuers.

verses.textZh: 约书亚和以色列人看见伏兵已经夺取了城，又看见城中浓烟上升，就转回，击杀艾城的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约书亚和以色列人看见伏兵已经夺取了城，又看见城中浓烟上升，就转回，击杀艾城的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 约书亚和以色列众人见伏兵已经夺了城，城中烟气飞腾，就转身回去，击杀艾城的人。
verses.textEnNiv: For when Joshua and all Israel saw that the ambush had taken the city and that smoke was going up from it, they turned around and attacked the men of Ai.
verses.textEnEsv: And when Joshua and all Israel saw that the ambush had captured the city, and that the smoke of the city went up, then they turned back and struck down the men of Ai.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when Joshua and all Israel saw that the ambush had taken the city and that the smoke of the city ascended, they turned back and struck down the men of Ai.
verses.textEnNlt: When Joshua and all the other Israelites saw that the ambush had succeeded and that smoke was rising from the town, they turned and attacked the men of Ai.
verses.textEnNasb: When Joshua and all Israel saw that the men in ambush had captured the city and that the smoke of the city ascended, they turned back and killed the men of Ai.
verses.textEn: For when Joshua and all Israel saw that the ambush had taken the city and that smoke was going up from it, they turned around and attacked the men of Ai.

verses.textZh: 伏兵也出城攻击艾城的人；艾城的人就被困在以色列人中间，前后受敌；于是以色列人把他们击杀，没有留下一个，也没有一个逃脱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 伏兵也出城攻击艾城的人；艾城的人就被困在以色列人中间，前后受敌；于是以色列人把他们击杀，没有留下一个，也没有一个逃脱。
verses.textZhCuv: 伏兵也出城迎击艾城人，艾城人就困在以色列人中间，前后都是以色列人。于是以色列人击杀他们，没有留下一个，也没有一个逃脱的，
verses.textEnNiv: Those in the ambush also came out of the city against them, so that they were caught in the middle, with Israelites on both sides. Israel cut them down, leaving them neither survivors nor fugitives.
verses.textEnEsv: And the others came out from the city against them, so they were in the midst of Israel, some on this side, and some on that side. And Israel struck them down, until there was left none that survived or escaped.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the others came out of the city against them; so they were caught in the midst of Israel, some on this side and some on that side. And they struck them down, so that they let none of them remain or escape.
verses.textEnNlt: Meanwhile, the Israelites who were inside the town came out and attacked the enemy from the rear. So the men of Ai were caught in the middle, with Israelite fighters on both sides. Israel attacked them, and not a single person survived or escaped.
verses.textEnNasb: The others came out from the city to confront them, so that they were trapped in the midst of Israel, some on this side and some on that side; and they killed them until there was not one left who escaped or survived.
verses.textEn: Those in the ambush also came out of the city against them, so that they were caught in the middle, with Israelites on both sides. Israel cut them down, leaving them neither survivors nor fugitives.

verses.textZh: 他们活捉了艾城的王，把他解到约书亚那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们活捉了艾城的王，把他解到约书亚那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 生擒了艾城的王，将他解到约书亚那里。
verses.textEnNiv: But they took the king of Ai alive and brought him to Joshua.
verses.textEnEsv: But the king of Ai they took alive, and brought him near to Joshua.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the king of Ai they took alive, and brought him to Joshua.
verses.textEnNlt: Only the king of Ai was taken alive and brought to Joshua.
verses.textEnNasb: But they captured the king of Ai alive and brought him to Joshua.
verses.textEn: But they took the king of Ai alive and brought him to Joshua.

verses.textZh: 以色列人在田间、在旷野，杀尽了所有追赶他们的艾城的居民，艾城的人全部倒在刀下，直到完全消灭；接着，以色列众人回到艾城，用刀击杀了城中的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人在田间、在旷野，杀尽了所有追赶他们的艾城的居民，艾城的人全部倒在刀下，直到完全消灭；接着，以色列众人回到艾城，用刀击杀了城中的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人在田间和旷野杀尽所追赶一切艾城的居民。艾城人倒在刀下，直到灭尽；以色列众人就回到艾城，用刀杀了城中的人。
verses.textEnNiv: When Israel had finished killing all the men of Ai in the fields and in the wilderness where they had chased them, and when every one of them had been put to the sword, all the Israelites returned to Ai and killed those who were in it.
verses.textEnEsv: When Israel had finished killing all the inhabitants of Ai in the open wilderness where they pursued them, and all of them to the very last had fallen by the edge of the sword, all Israel returned to Ai and struck it down with the edge of the sword.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it came to pass when Israel had made an end of slaying all the inhabitants of Ai in the field, in the wilderness where they pursued them, and when they all had fallen by the edge of the sword until they were consumed, that all the Israelites returned to Ai and struck it with the edge of the sword.
verses.textEnNlt: When the Israelite army finished chasing and killing all the men of Ai in the open fields, they went back and finished off everyone inside.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when Israel had finished killing all the inhabitants of Ai in the field in the wilderness where they pursued them, and all of them had fallen by the edge of the sword until they were destroyed, then all Israel returned to Ai and struck it with the edge of the sword.
verses.textEn: When Israel had finished killing all the men of Ai in the fields and in the wilderness where they had chased them, and when every one of them had been put to the sword, all the Israelites returned to Ai and killed those who were in it.

verses.textZh: 那一天被杀的人，连男带女，共有一万二千人，就是艾城所有的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那一天被杀的人，连男带女，共有一万二千人，就是艾城所有的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 当日杀毙的人，连男带女共有一万二千，就是艾城所有的人。
verses.textEnNiv: Twelve thousand men and women fell that day—all the people of Ai.
verses.textEnEsv: And all who fell that day, both men and women, were 12,000, all the people of Ai.
verses.textEnNkjv: So it was that all who fell that day, both men and women, were twelve thousand—all the people of Ai.
verses.textEnNlt: So the entire population of Ai, including men and women, was wiped out that day—12,000 in all.
verses.textEnNasb: So all who fell that day, both men and women, were twelve thousand—all the people of Ai.
verses.textEn: Twelve thousand men and women fell that day—all the people of Ai.

verses.textZh: 约书亚没有收回伸出短枪的手，直到把艾城的居民都消灭为止。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约书亚没有收回伸出短枪的手，直到把艾城的居民都消灭为止。
verses.textZhCuv: 约书亚没有收回手里所伸出来的短枪，直到把艾城的一切居民尽行杀灭。
verses.textEnNiv: For Joshua did not draw back the hand that held out his javelin until he had destroyed all who lived in Ai.
verses.textEnEsv: But Joshua did not draw back his hand with which he stretched out the javelin until he had devoted all the inhabitants of Ai to destruction.
verses.textEnNkjv: For Joshua did not draw back his hand, with which he stretched out the spear, until he had utterly destroyed all the inhabitants of Ai.
verses.textEnNlt: For Joshua kept holding out his spear until everyone who had lived in Ai was completely destroyed.
verses.textEnNasb: For Joshua did not withdraw his hand with which he reached out with the sword until he had utterly destroyed all the inhabitants of Ai.
verses.textEn: For Joshua did not draw back the hand that held out his javelin until he had destroyed all who lived in Ai.

verses.textZh: 只有那城里的牲畜和战利品，以色列人照着耶和华吩咐约书亚的话，都据为己有。
verses.textZhCnvs: 只有那城里的牲畜和战利品，以色列人照着耶和华吩咐约书亚的话，都据为己有。
verses.textZhCuv: 惟独城中的牲畜和财物，以色列人都取为自己的掠物，是照耶和华所吩咐约书亚的话。
verses.textEnNiv: But Israel did carry off for themselves the livestock and plunder of this city, as the Lord had instructed Joshua.
verses.textEnEsv: Only the livestock and the spoil of that city Israel took as their plunder, according to the word of the Lord that he commanded Joshua.
verses.textEnNkjv: Only the livestock and the spoil of that city Israel took as booty for themselves, according to the word of the Lord which He had commanded Joshua.
verses.textEnNlt: Only the livestock and the treasures of the town were not destroyed, for the Israelites kept these as plunder for themselves, as the Lord had commanded Joshua.
verses.textEnNasb: Israel took only the cattle and the spoils of that city as plunder for themselves, in accordance with the word of the Lord which He had commanded Joshua.
verses.textEn: But Israel did carry off for themselves the livestock and plunder of this city, as the Lord had instructed Joshua.

verses.textZh: 约书亚烧了艾城，使城永远成为废堆，一片荒凉，直到今日。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约书亚烧了艾城，使城永远成为废堆，一片荒凉，直到今日。
verses.textZhCuv: 约书亚将艾城焚烧，使城永为高堆、荒场，直到今日；
verses.textEnNiv: So Joshua burned Ai and made it a permanent heap of ruins, a desolate place to this day.
verses.textEnEsv: So Joshua burned Ai and made it forever a heap of ruins, as it is to this day.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Joshua burned Ai and made it a heap forever, a desolation to this day.
verses.textEnNlt: So Joshua burned the town of Ai, and it became a permanent mound of ruins, desolate to this very day.
verses.textEnNasb: So Joshua burned Ai and made it a refuse heap forever, a desolation until this day.
verses.textEn: So Joshua burned Ai and made it a permanent heap of ruins, a desolate place to this day.

verses.textZh: 他又把艾城的王悬在树上，直到黄昏的时候；日落的时候，约书亚吩咐人把尸体从树上拿下来，丢在城门口那里，又在尸体上堆起了一大堆石头，这堆石头一直存到今日。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又把艾城的王悬在树上，直到黄昏的时候；日落的时候，约书亚吩咐人把尸体从树上拿下来，丢在城门口那里，又在尸体上堆起了一大堆石头，这堆石头一直存到今日。
verses.textZhCuv: 又将艾城王挂在树上，直到晚上。日落的时候，约书亚吩咐人把尸首从树上取下来，丢在城门口，在尸首上堆成一大堆石头，直存到今日。
verses.textEnNiv: He impaled the body of the king of Ai on a pole and left it there until evening. At sunset, Joshua ordered them to take the body from the pole and throw it down at the entrance of the city gate. And they raised a large pile of rocks over it, which remains to this day.
verses.textEnEsv: And he hanged the king of Ai on a tree until evening. And at sunset Joshua commanded, and they took his body down from the tree and threw it at the entrance of the gate of the city and raised over it a great heap of stones, which stands there to this day.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the king of Ai he hanged on a tree until evening. And as soon as the sun was down, Joshua commanded that they should take his corpse down from the tree, cast it at the entrance of the gate of the city, and raise over it a great heap of stones thatremains to this day.
verses.textEnNlt: Joshua impaled the king of Ai on a sharpened pole and left him there until evening. At sunset the Israelites took down the body, as Joshua commanded, and threw it in front of the town gate. They piled a great heap of stones over him that can still be seen today.
verses.textEnNasb: And he hanged the king of Ai on a tree until evening; but at sunset Joshua gave the command and they took his body down from the tree and threw it at the entrance of the city gate, and erected over it a large heap of stones that stands to this day.
verses.textEn: He impaled the body of the king of Ai on a pole and left it there until evening. At sunset, Joshua ordered them to take the body from the pole and throw it down at the entrance of the city gate. And they raised a large pile of rocks over it, which remains to this day.

verses.textZh: 那时，约书亚在以巴路山上，为耶和华以色列的神筑了一座祭坛，
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，约书亚在以巴路山上，为耶和华以色列的神筑了一座祭坛，
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，约书亚在以巴路山上为耶和华－以色列的神筑一座坛，
verses.textEnNiv: Then Joshua built on Mount Ebal an altar to the Lord , the God of Israel,
verses.textEnEsv: At that time Joshua built an altar to the Lord , the God of Israel, on Mount Ebal,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Joshua built an altar to the Lord God of Israel in Mount Ebal,
verses.textEnNlt: Then Joshua built an altar to the Lord , the God of Israel, on Mount Ebal.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Joshua built an altar to the Lord, the God of Israel, on Mount Ebal,
verses.textEn: Then Joshua built on Mount Ebal an altar to the Lord , the God of Israel,

verses.textZh: 是照着耶和华的仆人摩西吩咐以色列人的，照着摩西律法书上所写的，用未经过铁器打凿的整块石块筑成的一座祭坛；在这祭坛之上，众人向耶和华献燔祭，也献平安祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 是照着耶和华的仆人摩西吩咐以色列人的，照着摩西律法书上所写的，用未经过铁器打凿的整块石块筑成的一座祭坛；在这祭坛之上，众人向耶和华献燔祭，也献平安祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 是用没有动过铁器的整石头筑的，照着耶和华仆人摩西所吩咐以色列人的话，正如摩西律法书上所写的。众人在这坛上给耶和华奉献燔祭和平安祭。
verses.textEnNiv: as Moses the servant of the Lord had commanded the Israelites. He built it according to what is written in the Book of the Law of Moses—an altar of uncut stones, on which no iron tool had been used. On it they offered to the Lord burnt offerings and sacrificed fellowship offerings.
verses.textEnEsv: just as Moses the servant of the Lord had commanded the people of Israel, as it is written in the Book of the Law of Moses, "an altar of uncut stones, upon which no man has wielded an iron tool." And they offered on it burnt offerings to the Lord and sacrificed peace offerings.
verses.textEnNkjv: as Moses the servant of the Lord had commanded the children of Israel, as it is written in the Book of the Law of Moses: "an altar of whole stones over which no man has wielded an iron tool." And they offered on it burnt offerings to the Lord, and sacrificed peace offerings.
verses.textEnNlt: He followed the commands that Moses the Lord ’s servant had written in the Book of Instruction: "Make me an altar from stones that are uncut and have not been shaped with iron tools." Then on the altar they presented burnt offerings and peace offerings to the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: just as Moses the servant of the Lord had commanded the sons of Israel, as it is written in the Book of the Law of Moses, an altar of uncut stones on which no one had wielded an iron tool; and they offered burnt offerings on it to the Lord, and sacrificed peace offerings.
verses.textEn: as Moses the servant of the Lord had commanded the Israelites. He built it according to what is written in the Book of the Law of Moses—an altar of uncut stones, on which no iron tool had been used. On it they offered to the Lord burnt offerings and sacrificed fellowship offerings.

verses.textZh: 约书亚在那里，当着以色列人面前，把摩西所写的摩西律法抄写在石头上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约书亚在那里，当着以色列人面前，把摩西所写的摩西律法抄写在石头上。
verses.textZhCuv: 约书亚在那里，当着以色列人面前，将摩西所写的律法抄写在石头上。
verses.textEnNiv: There, in the presence of the Israelites, Joshua wrote on stones a copy of the law of Moses.
verses.textEnEsv: And there, in the presence of the people of Israel, he wrote on the stones a copy of the law of Moses, which he had written.
verses.textEnNkjv: And there, in the presence of the children of Israel, he wrote on the stones a copy of the law of Moses, which he had written.
verses.textEnNlt: And as the Israelites watched, Joshua copied onto the stones of the altar the instructions Moses had given them.
verses.textEnNasb: And he wrote there on the stones a copy of the Law of Moses, which he had written, in the presence of the sons of Israel.
verses.textEn: There, in the presence of the Israelites, Joshua wrote on stones a copy of the law of Moses.

verses.textZh: 全体以色列人和他们的长老、官长，以及审判官，都站在约柜的两旁，在抬耶和华约柜的利未支派的祭司前面；无论是寄居的，或是本地人，一半对着基利心山，一半对着以巴路山；正如耶和华的仆人摩西以前所吩咐的，好为以色列民祝福。
verses.textZhCnvs: 全体以色列人和他们的长老、官长，以及审判官，都站在约柜的两旁，在抬耶和华约柜的利未支派的祭司前面；无论是寄居的，或是本地人，一半对着基利心山，一半对着以巴路山；正如耶和华的仆人摩西以前所吩咐的，好为以色列民祝福。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列众人，无论是本地人、是寄居的，和长老、官长，并审判官，都站在约柜两旁，在抬耶和华约柜的祭司利未人面前，一半对着基利心山，一半对着以巴路山，为以色列民祝福，正如耶和华仆人摩西先前所吩咐的。
verses.textEnNiv: All the Israelites, with their elders, officials and judges, were standing on both sides of the ark of the covenant of the Lord , facing the Levitical priests who carried it. Both the foreigners living among them and the native-born were there. Half of the people stood in front of Mount Gerizim and half of them in front of Mount Ebal, as Moses the servant of the Lord had formerly commanded when he gave instructions to bless the people of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: And all Israel, sojourner as well as native born, with their elders and officers and their judges, stood on opposite sides of the ark before the Levitical priests who carried the ark of the covenant of the Lord , half of them in front of Mount Gerizim and half of them in front of Mount Ebal, just as Moses the servant of the Lord had commanded at the first, to bless the people of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then all Israel, with their elders and officers and judges, stood on either side of the ark before the priests, the Levites, who bore the ark of the covenant of the Lord, the stranger as well as he who was born among them. Half of them were in front of Mount Gerizim and half of them in front of Mount Ebal, as Moses the servant of the Lord had commanded before, that they should bless the people of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: Then all the Israelites—foreigners and native-born alike—along with the elders, officers, and judges, were divided into two groups. One group stood in front of Mount Gerizim, the other in front of Mount Ebal. Each group faced the other, and between them stood the Levitical priests carrying the Ark of the Lord ’s Covenant. This was all done according to the commands that Moses, the servant of the Lord , had previously given for blessing the people of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: And all Israel with their elders, officers, and their judges were standing on both sides of the ark before the Levitical priests who carried the ark of the covenant of the Lord, the stranger as well as the native. Half of them stood in front of Mount Gerizim, and half of them in front of Mount Ebal, just as Moses the servant of the Lord had commanded at first to bless the people of Israel.
verses.textEn: All the Israelites, with their elders, officials and judges, were standing on both sides of the ark of the covenant of the Lord , facing the Levitical priests who carried it. Both the foreigners living among them and the native-born were there. Half of the people stood in front of Mount Gerizim and half of them in front of Mount Ebal, as Moses the servant of the Lord had formerly commanded when he gave instructions to bless the people of Israel.

verses.textZh: 然后，约书亚宣读律法上一切祝福和咒诅的话，全都照着律法书上所写的一切。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然后，约书亚宣读律法上一切祝福和咒诅的话，全都照着律法书上所写的一切。
verses.textZhCuv: 随后，约书亚将律法上祝福、咒诅的话，照着律法书上一切所写的，都宣读了一遍。
verses.textEnNiv: Afterward, Joshua read all the words of the law—the blessings and the curses—just as it is written in the Book of the Law.
verses.textEnEsv: And afterward he read all the words of the law, the blessing and the curse, according to all that is written in the Book of the Law.
verses.textEnNkjv: And afterward he read all the words of the law, the blessings and the cursings, according to all that is written in the Book of the Law.
verses.textEnNlt: Joshua then read to them all the blessings and curses Moses had written in the Book of Instruction.
verses.textEnNasb: Then afterward he read all the words of the Law, the blessing and the curse, according to everything that is written in the Book of the Law.
verses.textEn: Afterward, Joshua read all the words of the law—the blessings and the curses—just as it is written in the Book of the Law.

verses.textZh: 摩西吩咐的一切话，约书亚在以色列全体会众和妇女、小孩，以及在他们中间来往的寄居者面前，没有一句不向他们宣读出来的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西吩咐的一切话，约书亚在以色列全体会众和妇女、小孩，以及在他们中间来往的寄居者面前，没有一句不向他们宣读出来的。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西所吩咐的一切话，约书亚在以色列全会众和妇女、孩子，并他们中间寄居的外人面前，没有一句不宣读的。
verses.textEnNiv: There was not a word of all that Moses had commanded that Joshua did not read to the whole assembly of Israel, including the women and children, and the foreigners who lived among them.
verses.textEnEsv: There was not a word of all that Moses commanded that Joshua did not read before all the assembly of Israel, and the women, and the little ones, and the sojourners who lived among them.
verses.textEnNkjv: There was not a word of all that Moses had commanded which Joshua did not read before all the assembly of Israel, with the women, the little ones, and the strangers who were living among them.
verses.textEnNlt: Every word of every command that Moses had ever given was read to the entire assembly of Israel, including the women and children and the foreigners who lived among them.
verses.textEnNasb: There was not a word of all that Moses had commanded which Joshua did not read before all the assembly of Israel with the women, the little ones, and the strangers who were living among them.
verses.textEn: There was not a word of all that Moses had commanded that Joshua did not read to the whole assembly of Israel, including the women and children, and the foreigners who lived among them.

verses.textZh: 在约旦河西，住在山上、高原和对着黎巴嫩山大海沿岸所有的王，就是赫人、亚摩利人、迦南人、比利洗人、希未人、耶布斯人的王，听见了这些事的时候，
verses.textZhCnvs: 在约旦河西，住在山上、高原和对着黎巴嫩山大海沿岸所有的王，就是赫人、亚摩利人、迦南人、比利洗人、希未人、耶布斯人的王，听见了这些事的时候，
verses.textZhCuv: 约旦河西，住山地、高原，并对着黎巴嫩山沿大海一带的诸王，就是赫人、亚摩利人、迦南人、比利洗人、希未人、耶布斯人的诸王，听见这事，
verses.textEnNiv: Now when all the kings west of the Jordan heard about these things—the kings in the hill country, in the western foothills, and along the entire coast of the Mediterranean Sea as far as Lebanon (the kings of the Hittites, Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites)—
verses.textEnEsv: As soon as all the kings who were beyond the Jordan in the hill country and in the lowland all along the coast of the Great Sea toward Lebanon, the Hittites, the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites, heard of this,
verses.textEnNkjv: And it came to pass when all the kings who were on this side of the Jordan, in the hills and in the lowland and in all the coasts of the Great Sea toward Lebanon— the Hittite, the Amorite, the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite—heard aboutit,
verses.textEnNlt: Now all the kings west of the Jordan River heard about what had happened. These were the kings of the Hittites, Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites, who lived in the hill country, in the western foothills, and along the coast of the Mediterranean Sea as far north as the Lebanon mountains.
verses.textEnNasb: Now it came about when all the kings who were beyond the Jordan, in the hill country, the lowland, and on all the coast of the Great Sea toward Lebanon, the Hittite and the Amorite, the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite, heard about it,
verses.textEn: Now when all the kings west of the Jordan heard about these things—the kings in the hill country, in the western foothills, and along the entire coast of the Mediterranean Sea as far as Lebanon (the kings of the Hittites, Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites)—

verses.textZh: 就聚集起来，同心协力地要与约书亚和以色列人交战。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就聚集起来，同心协力地要与约书亚和以色列人交战。
verses.textZhCuv: 就都聚集，同心合意地要与约书亚和以色列人争战。
verses.textEnNiv: they came together to wage war against Joshua and Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: they gathered together as one to fight against Joshua and Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: that they gathered together to fight with Joshua and Israel with one accord.
verses.textEnNlt: These kings combined their armies to fight as one against Joshua and the Israelites.
verses.textEnNasb: that they met together with one purpose, to fight with Joshua and with Israel.
verses.textEn: they came together to wage war against Joshua and Israel.

verses.textZh: 基遍的居民听见了约书亚向耶利哥和艾城所行的事，
verses.textZhCnvs: 基遍的居民听见了约书亚向耶利哥和艾城所行的事，
verses.textZhCuv: 基遍的居民听见约书亚向耶利哥和艾城所行的事，
verses.textEnNiv: However, when the people of Gibeon heard what Joshua had done to Jericho and Ai,
verses.textEnEsv: But when the inhabitants of Gibeon heard what Joshua had done to Jericho and to Ai,
verses.textEnNkjv: But when the inhabitants of Gibeon heard what Joshua had done to Jericho and Ai,
verses.textEnNlt: But when the people of Gibeon heard what Joshua had done to Jericho and Ai,
verses.textEnNasb: The inhabitants of Gibeon also heard what Joshua had done to Jericho and to Ai,
verses.textEn: However, when the people of Gibeon heard what Joshua had done to Jericho and Ai,

verses.textZh: 就施诡计，假冒使者而来，把旧的布袋和破裂又修补过的旧皮酒袋驮在驴上，
verses.textZhCnvs: 就施诡计，假冒使者而来，把旧的布袋和破裂又修补过的旧皮酒袋驮在驴上，
verses.textZhCuv: 就设诡计，假充使者，拿旧口袋和破裂缝补的旧皮酒袋驮在驴上，
verses.textEnNiv: they resorted to a ruse: They went as a delegation whose donkeys were loaded with worn-out sacks and old wineskins, cracked and mended.
verses.textEnEsv: they on their part acted with cunning and went and made ready provisions and took worn-out sacks for their donkeys, and wineskins, worn-out and torn and mended,
verses.textEnNkjv: they worked craftily, and went and pretended to be ambassadors. And they took old sacks on their donkeys, old wineskins torn and mended,
verses.textEnNlt: they resorted to deception to save themselves. They sent ambassadors to Joshua, loading their donkeys with weathered saddlebags and old, patched wineskins.
verses.textEnNasb: but they on their part acted craftily and went and took provisions for a journey, and took worn-out sacks on their donkeys, and wineskins that were worn out, split open, and patched,
verses.textEn: they resorted to a ruse: They went as a delegation whose donkeys were loaded with worn-out sacks and old wineskins, cracked and mended.

verses.textZh: 脚上穿著补过的旧鞋，身穿旧衣服，所带的食物又干又碎。
verses.textZhCnvs: 脚上穿著补过的旧鞋，身穿旧衣服，所带的食物又干又碎。
verses.textZhCuv: 将补过的旧鞋穿在脚上，把旧衣服穿在身上；他们所带的饼都是干的，长了霉了。
verses.textEnNiv: They put worn and patched sandals on their feet and wore old clothes. All the bread of their food supply was dry and moldy.
verses.textEnEsv: with worn-out, patched sandals on their feet, and worn-out clothes. And all their provisions were dry and crumbly.
verses.textEnNkjv: old and patched sandals on their feet, and old garments on themselves; and all the bread of their provision was dry and moldy.
verses.textEnNlt: They put on worn-out, patched sandals and ragged clothes. And the bread they took with them was dry and moldy.
verses.textEnNasb: and worn-out and patched sandals on their feet, and worn-out clothes on themselves; and all the bread of their provision was dry and had become crumbled.
verses.textEn: They put worn and patched sandals on their feet and wore old clothes. All the bread of their food supply was dry and moldy.

verses.textZh: 他们去到吉甲营中约书亚那里，对约书亚和以色列人说："我们是从远地来的，现在求你们和我们立约。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们去到吉甲营中约书亚那里，对约书亚和以色列人说："我们是从远地来的，现在求你们和我们立约。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们到吉甲营中见约书亚，对他和以色列人说：「我们是从远方来的，现在求你与我们立约。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then they went to Joshua in the camp at Gilgal and said to him and the Israelites, "We have come from a distant country; make a treaty with us."
verses.textEnEsv: And they went to Joshua in the camp at Gilgal and said to him and to the men of Israel, "We have come from a distant country, so now make a covenant with us."
verses.textEnNkjv: And they went to Joshua, to the camp at Gilgal, and said to him and to the men of Israel, "We have come from a far country; now therefore, make a covenant with us."
verses.textEnNlt: When they arrived at the camp of Israel at Gilgal, they told Joshua and the men of Israel, "We have come from a distant land to ask you to make a peace treaty with us."
verses.textEnNasb: And they went to Joshua at the camp at Gilgal and said to him and to the men of Israel, "We have come from a far country; now then, make a covenant with us."
verses.textEn: Then they went to Joshua in the camp at Gilgal and said to him and the Israelites, "We have come from a distant country; make a treaty with us."

verses.textZh: 以色列人对这些希未人说："你们也许是这地的居民，若是这样，我们怎样和你们立约呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人对这些希未人说："你们也许是这地的居民，若是这样，我们怎样和你们立约呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人对这些希未人说：「只怕你们是住在我们中间的；若是这样，怎能和你们立约呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: The Israelites said to the Hivites, "But perhaps you live near us, so how can we make a treaty with you?"
verses.textEnEsv: But the men of Israel said to the Hivites, "Perhaps you live among us; then how can we make a covenant with you?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the men of Israel said to the Hivites, "Perhaps you dwell among us; so how can we make a covenant with you?"
verses.textEnNlt: The Israelites replied to these Hivites, "How do we know you don’t live nearby? For if you do, we cannot make a treaty with you."
verses.textEnNasb: But the men of Israel said to the Hivites, "Perhaps you are living within our land; how then are we to make a covenant with you?"
verses.textEn: The Israelites said to the Hivites, "But perhaps you live near us, so how can we make a treaty with you?"

verses.textZh: 他们对约书亚说："我们是你的仆人。"约书亚问他们："你们是甚么人？是从哪里来的？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们对约书亚说："我们是你的仆人。"约书亚问他们："你们是甚么人？是从哪里来的？"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们对约书亚说：「我们是你的仆人。」约书亚问他们说：「你们是什么人？是从哪里来的？」
verses.textEnNiv: "We are your servants," they said to Joshua. But Joshua asked, "Who are you and where do you come from?"
verses.textEnEsv: They said to Joshua, "We are your servants." And Joshua said to them, "Who are you? And where do you come from?"
verses.textEnNkjv: But they said to Joshua, "We are your servants." And Joshua said to them, "Who are you, and where do you come from?"
verses.textEnNlt: They replied, "We are your servants." "But who are you?" Joshua demanded. "Where do you come from?"
verses.textEnNasb: So they said to Joshua, "We are your servants." Then Joshua said to them, "Who are you and where do you come from?"
verses.textEn: "We are your servants," they said to Joshua. But Joshua asked, "Who are you and where do you come from?"

verses.textZh: 他们回答约书亚："你的仆人为了耶和华你神的名从很远的地方而来，因为我们听见了他的名声和他在埃及所行的一切事，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们回答约书亚："你的仆人为了耶和华你神的名从很远的地方而来，因为我们听见了他的名声和他在埃及所行的一切事，
verses.textZhCuv: 他们回答说：「仆人从极远之地而来，是因听见耶和华－你神的名声和他在埃及所行的一切事，
verses.textEnNiv: They answered: "Your servants have come from a very distant country because of the fame of the Lord your God. For we have heard reports of him: all that he did in Egypt,
verses.textEnEsv: They said to him, "From a very distant country your servants have come, because of the name of the Lord your God. For we have heard a report of him, and all that he did in Egypt,
verses.textEnNkjv: So they said to him: "From a very far country your servants have come, because of the name of the Lord your God; for we have heard of His fame, and all that He did in Egypt,
verses.textEnNlt: They answered, "Your servants have come from a very distant country. We have heard of the might of the Lord your God and of all he did in Egypt.
verses.textEnNasb: They said to him, "Your servants have come from a very distant country because of the fame of the Lord your God; for we have heard the report about Him and all that He did in Egypt,
verses.textEn: They answered: "Your servants have come from a very distant country because of the fame of the Lord your God. For we have heard reports of him: all that he did in Egypt,

verses.textZh: 以及他对约旦河东亚摩利人的两个王，就是希实本王西宏和在亚斯他录的巴珊王噩，所行的一切事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以及他对约旦河东亚摩利人的两个王，就是希实本王西宏和在亚斯他录的巴珊王噩，所行的一切事。
verses.textZhCuv: 并他向约旦河东的两个亚摩利王，就是希实本王西宏和在亚斯他录的巴珊王噩一切所行的事。
verses.textEnNiv: and all that he did to the two kings of the Amorites east of the Jordan—Sihon king of Heshbon, and Og king of Bashan, who reigned in Ashtaroth.
verses.textEnEsv: and all that he did to the two kings of the Amorites who were beyond the Jordan, to Sihon the king of Heshbon, and to Og king of Bashan, who lived in Ashtaroth.
verses.textEnNkjv: and all that He did to the two kings of the Amorites who were beyond the Jordan—to Sihon king of Heshbon, and Og king of Bashan, who was at Ashtaroth.
verses.textEnNlt: We have also heard what he did to the two Amorite kings east of the Jordan River—King Sihon of Heshbon and King Og of Bashan (who lived in Ashtaroth).
verses.textEnNasb: and all that He did to the two kings of the Amorites who were beyond the Jordan, to Sihon king of Heshbon and to Og king of Bashan who was in Ashtaroth.
verses.textEn: and all that he did to the two kings of the Amorites east of the Jordan—Sihon king of Heshbon, and Og king of Bashan, who reigned in Ashtaroth.

verses.textZh: 所以我们的长老和我们本国所有的居民对我们说：‘你们手里要带着旅途用的干粮，去迎见以色列人，对他们说：我们是你们的仆人，现在求你们和我们立约。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以我们的长老和我们本国所有的居民对我们说：‘你们手里要带着旅途用的干粮，去迎见以色列人，对他们说：我们是你们的仆人，现在求你们和我们立约。’
verses.textZhCuv: 我们的长老和我们那地的一切居民对我们说：『你们手里要带着路上用的食物去迎接以色列人，对他们说：我们是你们的仆人；现在求你们与我们立约。』
verses.textEnNiv: And our elders and all those living in our country said to us, ‘Take provisions for your journey; go and meet them and say to them, "We are your servants; make a treaty with us." ’
verses.textEnEsv: So our elders and all the inhabitants of our country said to us, ‘Take provisions in your hand for the journey and go to meet them and say to them, "We are your servants. Come now, make a covenant with us."’
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore our elders and all the inhabitants of our country spoke to us, saying, ‘Take provisions with you for the journey, and go to meet them, and say to them, "We are your servants; now therefore, make a covenant with us." ’
verses.textEnNlt: So our elders and all our people instructed us, ‘Take supplies for a long journey. Go meet with the people of Israel and tell them, "We are your servants; please make a treaty with us."’
verses.textEnNasb: So our elders and all the inhabitants of our country spoke to us, saying, ‘Take provisions in your hand for the journey, and go to meet them, and say to them, "We are your servants; now then, make a covenant with us." ’
verses.textEn: And our elders and all those living in our country said to us, ‘Take provisions for your journey; go and meet them and say to them, "We are your servants; make a treaty with us." ’

verses.textZh: 我们出门到你们这里来的时候，从家里带出来作干粮的这饼还是热的；看哪，现在都又干又碎了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们出门到你们这里来的时候，从家里带出来作干粮的这饼还是热的；看哪，现在都又干又碎了。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们出来要往你们这里来的日子，从家里带出来的这饼还是热的；看哪，现在都干了，长了霉了。
verses.textEnNiv: This bread of ours was warm when we packed it at home on the day we left to come to you. But now see how dry and moldy it is.
verses.textEnEsv: Here is our bread. It was still warm when we took it from our houses as our food for the journey on the day we set out to come to you, but now, behold, it is dry and crumbly.
verses.textEnNkjv: This bread of ours we took hot for our provision from our houses on the day we departed to come to you. But now look, it is dry and moldy.
verses.textEnNlt: "This bread was hot from the ovens when we left our homes. But now, as you can see, it is dry and moldy.
verses.textEnNasb: This bread of ours was hot when we took it for our provisions from our houses on the day that we left to come to you; but now behold, it is dry and has become crumbled.
verses.textEn: This bread of ours was warm when we packed it at home on the day we left to come to you. But now see how dry and moldy it is.

verses.textZh: 这些皮酒袋，我们盛酒的时候，还是新的；你看，现在都破裂了。我们这些衣服和鞋因路途遥远，都穿旧了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些皮酒袋，我们盛酒的时候，还是新的；你看，现在都破裂了。我们这些衣服和鞋因路途遥远，都穿旧了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 这皮酒袋，我们盛酒的时候还是新的；看哪，现在已经破裂。我们这衣服和鞋，因为道路甚远，也都穿旧了。」
verses.textEnNiv: And these wineskins that we filled were new, but see how cracked they are. And our clothes and sandals are worn out by the very long journey."
verses.textEnEsv: These wineskins were new when we filled them, and behold, they have burst. And these garments and sandals of ours are worn out from the very long journey."
verses.textEnNkjv: And these wineskins which we filled were new, and see, they are torn; and these our garments and our sandals have become old because of the very long journey."
verses.textEnNlt: These wineskins were new when we filled them, but now they are old and split open. And our clothing and sandals are worn out from our very long journey."
verses.textEnNasb: And these wineskins which we filled were new, and behold, they are split open; and these clothes of ours and our sandals are worn out from the very long journey."
verses.textEn: And these wineskins that we filled were new, but see how cracked they are. And our clothes and sandals are worn out by the very long journey."

verses.textZh: 以色列人取了他们一些食物，却没有求问耶和华的旨意。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人取了他们一些食物，却没有求问耶和华的旨意。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人受了他们些食物，并没有求问耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: The Israelites sampled their provisions but did not inquire of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: So the men took some of their provisions, but did not ask counsel from the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the men of Israel took some of their provisions; but they did not ask counsel of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: So the Israelites examined their food, but they did not consult the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: So the men of Israel took some of their provisions, and did not ask for the counsel of the Lord.
verses.textEn: The Israelites sampled their provisions but did not inquire of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 于是约书亚与他们议和，和他们立约，容他们存活；会众的首领也向他们起了誓。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是约书亚与他们议和，和他们立约，容他们存活；会众的首领也向他们起了誓。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是约书亚与他们讲和，与他们立约，容他们活着；会众的首领也向他们起誓。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Joshua made a treaty of peace with them to let them live, and the leaders of the assembly ratified it by oath.
verses.textEnEsv: And Joshua made peace with them and made a covenant with them, to let them live, and the leaders of the congregation swore to them.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Joshua made peace with them, and made a covenant with them to let them live; and the rulers of the congregation swore to them.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Joshua made a peace treaty with them and guaranteed their safety, and the leaders of the community ratified their agreement with a binding oath.
verses.textEnNasb: And Joshua made peace with them and made a covenant with them, to let them live; and the leaders of the congregation swore an oath to them.
verses.textEn: Then Joshua made a treaty of peace with them to let them live, and the leaders of the assembly ratified it by oath.

verses.textZh: 以色列人和他们立约之后，过了三天，才听见他们是自己的近邻，是住在这地的居民。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人和他们立约之后，过了三天，才听见他们是自己的近邻，是住在这地的居民。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人与他们立约之后，过了三天才听见他们是近邻，住在以色列人中间的。
verses.textEnNiv: Three days after they made the treaty with the Gibeonites, the Israelites heard that they were neighbors, living near them.
verses.textEnEsv: At the end of three days after they had made a covenant with them, they heard that they were their neighbors and that they lived among them.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it happened at the end of three days, after they had made a covenant with them, that they heard that they were their neighbors who dwelt near them.
verses.textEnNlt: Three days after making the treaty, they learned that these people actually lived nearby!
verses.textEnNasb: However, it came about at the end of three days after they had made a covenant with them, that they heard that they were neighbors and that they were living within their land.
verses.textEn: Three days after they made the treaty with the Gibeonites, the Israelites heard that they were neighbors, living near them.

verses.textZh: 于是，以色列人起程，第三日就到了他们的城市；他们的城市就是基遍、基非拉、比录、基列．耶琳。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，以色列人起程，第三日就到了他们的城市；他们的城市就是基遍、基非拉、比录、基列．耶琳。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人起行，第三天到了他们的城邑，就是基遍、基非拉、比录、基列‧耶琳。
verses.textEnNiv: So the Israelites set out and on the third day came to their cities: Gibeon, Kephirah, Beeroth and Kiriath Jearim.
verses.textEnEsv: And the people of Israel set out and reached their cities on the third day. Now their cities were Gibeon, Chephirah, Beeroth, and Kiriath-jearim.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the children of Israel journeyed and came to their cities on the third day. Now their cities were Gibeon, Chephirah, Beeroth, and Kirjath Jearim.
verses.textEnNlt: The Israelites set out at once to investigate and reached their towns in three days. The names of these towns were Gibeon, Kephirah, Beeroth, and Kiriath-jearim.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the sons of Israel set out and came to their cities on the third day. Now their cities were Gibeon, Chephirah, Beeroth, and Kiriath-jearim.
verses.textEn: So the Israelites set out and on the third day came to their cities: Gibeon, Kephirah, Beeroth and Kiriath Jearim.

verses.textZh: 以色列人没有击杀他们，因为会众的首领曾经指着耶和华以色列的神向他们起了誓，全体会众就都向首领发怨言。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人没有击杀他们，因为会众的首领曾经指着耶和华以色列的神向他们起了誓，全体会众就都向首领发怨言。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为会众的首领已经指着耶和华－以色列的神向他们起誓，所以以色列人不击杀他们；全会众就向首领发怨言。
verses.textEnNiv: But the Israelites did not attack them, because the leaders of the assembly had sworn an oath to them by the Lord , the God of Israel. The whole assembly grumbled against the leaders,
verses.textEnEsv: But the people of Israel did not attack them, because the leaders of the congregation had sworn to them by the Lord , the God of Israel. Then all the congregation murmured against the leaders.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the children of Israel did not attack them, because the rulers of the congregation had sworn to them by the Lord God of Israel. And all the congregation complained against the rulers.
verses.textEnNlt: But the Israelites did not attack the towns, for the Israelite leaders had made a vow to them in the name of the Lord , the God of Israel. The people of Israel grumbled against their leaders because of the treaty.
verses.textEnNasb: But the sons of Israel did not attack them because the leaders of the congregation had sworn to them by the Lord, the God of Israel. And the whole congregation grumbled against the leaders.
verses.textEn: But the Israelites did not attack them, because the leaders of the assembly had sworn an oath to them by the Lord , the God of Israel. The whole assembly grumbled against the leaders,

verses.textZh: 众首领对全体会众说："我们曾经指着耶和华以色列的神向他们起了誓，现在我们不能伤害他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 众首领对全体会众说："我们曾经指着耶和华以色列的神向他们起了誓，现在我们不能伤害他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 众首领对全会众说：「我们已经指着耶和华－以色列的神向他们起誓，现在我们不能害他们。
verses.textEnNiv: but all the leaders answered, "We have given them our oath by the Lord , the God of Israel, and we cannot touch them now.
verses.textEnEsv: But all the leaders said to all the congregation, "We have sworn to them by the Lord , the God of Israel, and now we may not touch them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then all the rulers said to all the congregation, "We have sworn to them by the Lord God of Israel; now therefore, we may not touch them.
verses.textEnNlt: But the leaders replied, "Since we have sworn an oath in the presence of the Lord , the God of Israel, we cannot touch them.
verses.textEnNasb: But all the leaders said to the whole congregation, "We have sworn to them by the Lord, the God of Israel, and now we cannot touch them.
verses.textEn: but all the leaders answered, "We have given them our oath by the Lord , the God of Israel, and we cannot touch them now.

verses.textZh: 我们要这样待他们，就是容他们存活，免得神的忿怒因我们向他们所起的誓，临到我们身上。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们要这样待他们，就是容他们存活，免得神的忿怒因我们向他们所起的誓，临到我们身上。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我们要如此待他们，容他们活着，免得有忿怒因我们所起的誓临到我们身上。」
verses.textEnNiv: This is what we will do to them: We will let them live, so that God’s wrath will not fall on us for breaking the oath we swore to them."
verses.textEnEsv: This we will do to them: let them live, lest wrath be upon us, because of the oath that we swore to them."
verses.textEnNkjv: This we will do to them: We will let them live, lest wrath be upon us because of the oath which we swore to them."
