verses.textEnNlt: This is what we must do. We must let them live, for divine anger would come upon us if we broke our oath.
verses.textEnNasb: This we will do to them, even let them live, so that wrath will not be on us because of the oath which we swore to them."
verses.textEn: This is what we will do to them: We will let them live, so that God’s wrath will not fall on us for breaking the oath we swore to them."

verses.textZh: 众首领又对会众说："要让他们存活。"于是他们就给全体会众作了劈柴打水的人，这是按照众首领对他们的吩咐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 众首领又对会众说："要让他们存活。"于是他们就给全体会众作了劈柴打水的人，这是按照众首领对他们的吩咐。
verses.textZhCuv: 首领又对会众说：「要容他们活着。」于是他们为全会众作了劈柴挑水的人，正如首领对他们所说的话。
verses.textEnNiv: They continued, "Let them live, but let them be woodcutters and water carriers in the service of the whole assembly." So the leaders’ promise to them was kept.
verses.textEnEsv: And the leaders said to them, "Let them live." So they became cutters of wood and drawers of water for all the congregation, just as the leaders had said of them.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the rulers said to them, "Let them live, but let them be woodcutters and water carriers for all the congregation, as the rulers had promised them."
verses.textEnNlt: Let them live." So they made them woodcutters and water carriers for the entire community, as the Israelite leaders directed.
verses.textEnNasb: So the leaders said to them, "Let them live." And they became gatherers of firewood and labor to draw water for the whole congregation, just as the leaders had spoken to them.
verses.textEn: They continued, "Let them live, but let them be woodcutters and water carriers in the service of the whole assembly." So the leaders’ promise to them was kept.

verses.textZh: 约书亚把他们召了来，质问他们："你们为甚么欺骗我们说：‘我们离你们很远’，其实你们却是住在这地的？
verses.textZhCnvs: 约书亚把他们召了来，质问他们："你们为甚么欺骗我们说：‘我们离你们很远’，其实你们却是住在这地的？
verses.textZhCuv: 约书亚召了他们来，对他们说：「为什么欺哄我们说『我们离你们甚远』呢？其实你们是住在我们中间。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Joshua summoned the Gibeonites and said, "Why did you deceive us by saying, ‘We live a long way from you,’ while actually you live near us?
verses.textEnEsv: Joshua summoned them, and he said to them, "Why did you deceive us, saying, ‘We are very far from you,’ when you dwell among us?
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Joshua called for them, and he spoke to them, saying, "Why have you deceived us, saying, ‘We are very far from you,’ when you dwell near us?
verses.textEnNlt: Joshua called together the Gibeonites and said, "Why did you lie to us? Why did you say that you live in a distant land when you live right here among us?
verses.textEnNasb: Then Joshua called for them and spoke to them, saying, "Why have you deceived us, saying, ‘We are very far from you,’ when you are living within our land?
verses.textEn: Then Joshua summoned the Gibeonites and said, "Why did you deceive us by saying, ‘We live a long way from you,’ while actually you live near us?

verses.textZh: 现在你们要受到咒诅，你们中间必不断有人作奴仆，为我神的圣所作劈柴打水的人。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在你们要受到咒诅，你们中间必不断有人作奴仆，为我神的圣所作劈柴打水的人。"
verses.textZhCuv: 现在你们是被咒诅的！你们中间的人必断不了作奴仆，为我神的殿作劈柴挑水的人。」
verses.textEnNiv: You are now under a curse: You will never be released from service as woodcutters and water carriers for the house of my God."
verses.textEnEsv: Now therefore you are cursed, and some of you shall never be anything but servants, cutters of wood and drawers of water for the house of my God."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now therefore, you are cursed, and none of you shall be freed from being slaves—woodcutters and water carriers for the house of my God."
verses.textEnNlt: May you be cursed! From now on you will always be servants who cut wood and carry water for the house of my God."
verses.textEnNasb: Now therefore, you are cursed, and you will never cease to be slaves, both gatherers of firewood and labor to draw water for the house of my God."
verses.textEn: You are now under a curse: You will never be released from service as woodcutters and water carriers for the house of my God."

verses.textZh: 他们回答约书亚，说："因为你的仆人确实地听见，耶和华你的神曾经吩咐他的仆人摩西，要把这整片土地赐给你们，并且要在你们面前把这地上所有的居民都消灭，因此，我们因你们的缘故，很怕丧命，才行了这事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们回答约书亚，说："因为你的仆人确实地听见，耶和华你的神曾经吩咐他的仆人摩西，要把这整片土地赐给你们，并且要在你们面前把这地上所有的居民都消灭，因此，我们因你们的缘故，很怕丧命，才行了这事。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们回答约书亚说：「因为有人实在告诉你的仆人，耶和华－你的神曾吩咐他的仆人摩西，把这全地赐给你们，并在你们面前灭绝这地的一切居民，所以我们为你们的缘故甚怕丧命，就行了这事。
verses.textEnNiv: They answered Joshua, "Your servants were clearly told how the Lord your God had commanded his servant Moses to give you the whole land and to wipe out all its inhabitants from before you. So we feared for our lives because of you, and that is why we did this.
verses.textEnEsv: They answered Joshua, "Because it was told to your servants for a certainty that the Lord your God had commanded his servant Moses to give you all the land and to destroy all the inhabitants of the land from before you—so we feared greatly for our lives because of you and did this thing.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they answered Joshua and said, "Because your servants were clearly told that the Lord your God commanded His servant Moses to give you all the land, and to destroy all the inhabitants of the land from before you; therefore we were very much afraid for our lives because of you, and have done this thing.
verses.textEnNlt: They replied, "We did it because we—your servants—were clearly told that the Lord your God commanded his servant Moses to give you this entire land and to destroy all the people living in it. So we feared greatly for our lives because of you. That is why we have done this.
verses.textEnNasb: So they answered Joshua and said, "Since your servants were fully informed that the Lord your God had commanded His servant Moses to give you all the land, and to destroy all the inhabitants of the land before you, we feared greatly for our lives because of you, and did this thing.
verses.textEn: They answered Joshua, "Your servants were clearly told how the Lord your God had commanded his servant Moses to give you the whole land and to wipe out all its inhabitants from before you. So we feared for our lives because of you, and that is why we did this.

verses.textZh: 现在，你看，我们都在你的手里，你看怎样处置我们算为好、算为对，就怎样行吧。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在，你看，我们都在你的手里，你看怎样处置我们算为好、算为对，就怎样行吧。"
verses.textZhCuv: 现在我们在你手中，你以怎样待我们为善为正，就怎样做吧！」
verses.textEnNiv: We are now in your hands. Do to us whatever seems good and right to you."
verses.textEnEsv: And now, behold, we are in your hand. Whatever seems good and right in your sight to do to us, do it."
verses.textEnNkjv: And now, here we are, in your hands; do with us as it seems good and right to do to us."
verses.textEnNlt: Now we are at your mercy—do to us whatever you think is right."
verses.textEnNasb: And now behold, we are in your hands; do to us as it seems good and right in your sight to do."
verses.textEn: We are now in your hands. Do to us whatever seems good and right to you."

verses.textZh: 约书亚就这样处置他们，救了他们脱离以色列人的手，以色列人就没有杀他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约书亚就这样处置他们，救了他们脱离以色列人的手，以色列人就没有杀他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是约书亚这样待他们，救他们脱离以色列人的手，以色列人就没有杀他们。
verses.textEnNiv: So Joshua saved them from the Israelites, and they did not kill them.
verses.textEnEsv: So he did this to them and delivered them out of the hand of the people of Israel, and they did not kill them.
verses.textEnNkjv: So he did to them, and delivered them out of the hand of the children of Israel, so that they did not kill them.
verses.textEnNlt: So Joshua did not allow the people of Israel to kill them.
verses.textEnNasb: This he did to them, and saved them from the hands of the sons of Israel, and they did not kill them.
verses.textEn: So Joshua saved them from the Israelites, and they did not kill them.

verses.textZh: 在那一天，约书亚指派他们在耶和华选择的地方，为会众和耶和华的祭坛作劈柴打水的人，直到今日。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在那一天，约书亚指派他们在耶和华选择的地方，为会众和耶和华的祭坛作劈柴打水的人，直到今日。
verses.textZhCuv: 当日约书亚使他们在耶和华所要选择的地方，为会众和耶和华的坛作劈柴挑水的人，直到今日。
verses.textEnNiv: That day he made the Gibeonites woodcutters and water carriers for the assembly, to provide for the needs of the altar of the Lord at the place the Lord would choose. And that is what they are to this day.
verses.textEnEsv: But Joshua made them that day cutters of wood and drawers of water for the congregation and for the altar of the Lord , to this day, in the place that he should choose.
verses.textEnNkjv: And that day Joshua made them woodcutters and water carriers for the congregation and for the altar of the Lord, in the place which He would choose, even to this day.
verses.textEnNlt: But that day he made the Gibeonites the woodcutters and water carriers for the community of Israel and for the altar of the Lord —wherever the Lord would choose to build it. And that is what they do to this day.
verses.textEnNasb: But on that day Joshua made them gatherers of firewood and labor to draw water for the congregation and for the altar of the Lord, to this day, in the place which He would choose.
verses.textEn: That day he made the Gibeonites woodcutters and water carriers for the assembly, to provide for the needs of the altar of the Lord at the place the Lord would choose. And that is what they are to this day.

verses.textZh: 耶路撒冷王亚多尼．洗德听见约书亚占领了艾城，把城完全毁灭，约书亚怎样对待耶利哥和耶利哥的王，也照样对待艾城和艾城的王；又听见基遍的居民已经与以色列人议和，并可以住在这地，
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶路撒冷王亚多尼．洗德听见约书亚占领了艾城，把城完全毁灭，约书亚怎样对待耶利哥和耶利哥的王，也照样对待艾城和艾城的王；又听见基遍的居民已经与以色列人议和，并可以住在这地，
verses.textZhCuv: 耶路撒冷王亚多尼‧洗德听见约书亚夺了艾城，尽行毁灭，怎样待耶利哥和耶利哥的王，也照样待艾城和艾城的王，又听见基遍的居民与以色列人立了和约，住在他们中间，
verses.textEnNiv: Now Adoni-Zedek king of Jerusalem heard that Joshua had taken Ai and totally destroyed it, doing to Ai and its king as he had done to Jericho and its king, and that the people of Gibeon had made a treaty of peace with Israel and had become their allies.
verses.textEnEsv: As soon as Adoni-zedek, king of Jerusalem, heard how Joshua had captured Ai and had devoted it to destruction, doing to Ai and its king as he had done to Jericho and its king, and how the inhabitants of Gibeon had made peace with Israel and were among them,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it came to pass when Adoni-Zedek king of Jerusalem heard how Joshua had taken Ai and had utterly destroyed it— as he had done to Jericho and its king, so he had done to Ai and its king—and how the inhabitants of Gibeon had made peace with Israel and were among them,
verses.textEnNlt: Adoni-zedek, king of Jerusalem, heard that Joshua had captured and completely destroyed Ai and killed its king, just as he had destroyed the town of Jericho and killed its king. He also learned that the Gibeonites had made peace with Israel and were now their allies.
verses.textEnNasb: Now it came about when Adoni-zedek king of Jerusalem heard that Joshua had captured Ai, and had utterly destroyed it (just as he had done to Jericho and its king, so he had done to Ai and its king), and that the inhabitants of Gibeon had made peace with Israel and were within their land,
verses.textEn: Now Adoni-Zedek king of Jerusalem heard that Joshua had taken Ai and totally destroyed it, doing to Ai and its king as he had done to Jericho and its king, and that the people of Gibeon had made a treaty of peace with Israel and had become their allies.

verses.textZh: 他们就非常惧怕。因为基遍是大城，好象一座王城；又因为基遍比艾城大，城里所有的人都是勇士。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们就非常惧怕。因为基遍是大城，好象一座王城；又因为基遍比艾城大，城里所有的人都是勇士。
verses.textZhCuv: 就甚惧怕；因为基遍是一座大城，如都城一般，比艾城更大，并且城内的人都是勇士。
verses.textEnNiv: He and his people were very much alarmed at this, because Gibeon was an important city, like one of the royal cities; it was larger than Ai, and all its men were good fighters.
verses.textEnEsv: he feared greatly, because Gibeon was a great city, like one of the royal cities, and because it was greater than Ai, and all its men were warriors.
verses.textEnNkjv: that they feared greatly, because Gibeon was a great city, like one of the royal cities, and because it was greater than Ai, and all its men were mighty.
verses.textEnNlt: He and his people became very afraid when they heard all this because Gibeon was a large town—as large as the royal cities and larger than Ai. And the Gibeonite men were strong warriors.
verses.textEnNasb: that he feared greatly because Gibeon was a great city, like one of the royal cities, and because it was greater than Ai, and all its men were mighty.
verses.textEn: He and his people were very much alarmed at this, because Gibeon was an important city, like one of the royal cities; it was larger than Ai, and all its men were good fighters.

verses.textZh: 因此，耶路撒冷王亚多尼．洗德派人到希伯仑王何咸、耶末王毘兰、拉吉王雅非亚和伊矶伦王底璧那里去，对他们说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，耶路撒冷王亚多尼．洗德派人到希伯仑王何咸、耶末王毘兰、拉吉王雅非亚和伊矶伦王底璧那里去，对他们说：
verses.textZhCuv: 所以耶路撒冷王亚多尼‧洗德打发人去见希伯仑王何咸、耶末王毗兰、拉吉王雅非亚，和伊矶伦王底璧，说：
verses.textEnNiv: So Adoni-Zedek king of Jerusalem appealed to Hoham king of Hebron, Piram king of Jarmuth, Japhia king of Lachish and Debir king of Eglon.
verses.textEnEsv: So Adoni-zedek king of Jerusalem sent to Hoham king of Hebron, to Piram king of Jarmuth, to Japhia king of Lachish, and to Debir king of Eglon, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore Adoni-Zedek king of Jerusalem sent to Hoham king of Hebron, Piram king of Jarmuth, Japhia king of Lachish, and Debir king of Eglon, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: So King Adoni-zedek of Jerusalem sent messengers to several other kings: Hoham of Hebron, Piram of Jarmuth, Japhia of Lachish, and Debir of Eglon.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore Adoni-zedek king of Jerusalem sent word to Hoham king of Hebron, to Piram king of Jarmuth, to Japhia king of Lachish, and to Debir king of Eglon, saying,
verses.textEn: So Adoni-Zedek king of Jerusalem appealed to Hoham king of Hebron, Piram king of Jarmuth, Japhia king of Lachish and Debir king of Eglon.

verses.textZh: "求你们上我这里来帮助我，我们好攻打基遍，因为基遍已经与约书亚和以色列人议和了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "求你们上我这里来帮助我，我们好攻打基遍，因为基遍已经与约书亚和以色列人议和了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 「求你们上来帮助我，我们好攻打基遍，因为他们与约书亚和以色列人立了和约。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Come up and help me attack Gibeon," he said, "because it has made peace with Joshua and the Israelites."
verses.textEnEsv: "Come up to me and help me, and let us strike Gibeon. For it has made peace with Joshua and with the people of Israel."
verses.textEnNkjv: "Come up to me and help me, that we may attack Gibeon, for it has made peace with Joshua and with the children of Israel."
verses.textEnNlt: "Come and help me destroy Gibeon," he urged them, "for they have made peace with Joshua and the people of Israel."
verses.textEnNasb: "Come up to me and help me, and let’s attack Gibeon, for it has made peace with Joshua and with the sons of Israel."
verses.textEn: "Come up and help me attack Gibeon," he said, "because it has made peace with Joshua and the Israelites."

verses.textZh: 于是亚摩利人的那五个王，就是耶路撒冷王、希伯仑王、耶末王、拉吉王和伊矶伦王，联合起来，带着他们所有的军队上去，在基遍的对面安营，攻打基遍。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是亚摩利人的那五个王，就是耶路撒冷王、希伯仑王、耶末王、拉吉王和伊矶伦王，联合起来，带着他们所有的军队上去，在基遍的对面安营，攻打基遍。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是五个亚摩利王，就是耶路撒冷王、希伯仑王、耶末王、拉吉王、伊矶伦王，大家聚集，率领他们的众军上去，对着基遍安营，攻打基遍。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the five kings of the Amorites—the kings of Jerusalem, Hebron, Jarmuth, Lachish and Eglon—joined forces. They moved up with all their troops and took up positions against Gibeon and attacked it.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the five kings of the Amorites, the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, and the king of Eglon, gathered their forces and went up with all their armies and encamped against Gibeon and made war against it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore the five kings of the Amorites, the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, and the king of Eglon, gathered together and went up, they and all their armies, and camped before Gibeon and made war against it.
verses.textEnNlt: So these five Amorite kings combined their armies for a united attack. They moved all their troops into place and attacked Gibeon.
verses.textEnNasb: So the five kings of the Amorites, the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, and the king of Eglon, gathered together and went up, they with all their armies, and camped by Gibeon and fought against it.
verses.textEn: Then the five kings of the Amorites—the kings of Jerusalem, Hebron, Jarmuth, Lachish and Eglon—joined forces. They moved up with all their troops and took up positions against Gibeon and attacked it.

verses.textZh: 基遍人就派人到吉甲营中约书亚那里去，说："不可丢弃你的仆人，求你快快上我们这里来拯救我们、帮助我们；因为住在山地的亚摩利人所有的王都集合起来攻击我们。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 基遍人就派人到吉甲营中约书亚那里去，说："不可丢弃你的仆人，求你快快上我们这里来拯救我们、帮助我们；因为住在山地的亚摩利人所有的王都集合起来攻击我们。"
verses.textZhCuv: 基遍人就打发人往吉甲的营中去见约书亚，说：「你不要袖手不顾你的仆人，求你速速上来拯救我们，帮助我们，因为住山地亚摩利人的诸王都聚集攻击我们。」
verses.textEnNiv: The Gibeonites then sent word to Joshua in the camp at Gilgal: "Do not abandon your servants. Come up to us quickly and save us! Help us, because all the Amorite kings from the hill country have joined forces against us."
verses.textEnEsv: And the men of Gibeon sent to Joshua at the camp in Gilgal, saying, "Do not relax your hand from your servants. Come up to us quickly and save us and help us, for all the kings of the Amorites who dwell in the hill country are gathered against us."
verses.textEnNkjv: And the men of Gibeon sent to Joshua at the camp at Gilgal, saying, "Do not forsake your servants; come up to us quickly, save us and help us, for all the kings of the Amorites who dwell in the mountains have gathered together against us."
verses.textEnNlt: The men of Gibeon quickly sent messengers to Joshua at his camp in Gilgal. "Don’t abandon your servants now!" they pleaded. "Come at once! Save us! Help us! For all the Amorite kings who live in the hill country have joined forces to attack us."
verses.textEnNasb: Then the men of Gibeon sent word to Joshua at the camp at Gilgal, saying, "Do not abandon your servants; come up to us quickly and save us and help us, for all the kings of the Amorites that live in the hill country have assembled against us."
verses.textEn: The Gibeonites then sent word to Joshua in the camp at Gilgal: "Do not abandon your servants. Come up to us quickly and save us! Help us, because all the Amorite kings from the hill country have joined forces against us."

verses.textZh: 于是约书亚和所有能作战的人，以及所有英勇的战士，都一起从吉甲上去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是约书亚和所有能作战的人，以及所有英勇的战士，都一起从吉甲上去。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是约书亚和他一切兵丁，并大能的勇士，都从吉甲上去。
verses.textEnNiv: So Joshua marched up from Gilgal with his entire army, including all the best fighting men.
verses.textEnEsv: So Joshua went up from Gilgal, he and all the people of war with him, and all the mighty men of valor.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Joshua ascended from Gilgal, he and all the people of war with him, and all the mighty men of valor.
verses.textEnNlt: So Joshua and his entire army, including his best warriors, left Gilgal and set out for Gibeon.
verses.textEnNasb: So Joshua went up from Gilgal, he and all the people of war with him, and all the valiant warriors.
verses.textEn: So Joshua marched up from Gilgal with his entire army, including all the best fighting men.

verses.textZh: 耶和华对约书亚说："你不要怕他们，因为我已经把他们交在你手里了；他们必没有一人能在你面前站立得住。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对约书亚说："你不要怕他们，因为我已经把他们交在你手里了；他们必没有一人能在你面前站立得住。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对约书亚说：「不要怕他们；因为我已将他们交在你手里，他们无一人能在你面前站立得住。」
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to Joshua, "Do not be afraid of them; I have given them into your hand. Not one of them will be able to withstand you."
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord said to Joshua, "Do not fear them, for I have given them into your hands. Not a man of them shall stand before you."
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord said to Joshua, "Do not fear them, for I have delivered them into your hand; not a man of them shall stand before you."
verses.textEnNlt: "Do not be afraid of them," the Lord said to Joshua, "for I have given you victory over them. Not a single one of them will be able to stand up to you."
verses.textEnNasb: And the Lord said to Joshua, "Do not fear them, for I have handed them over to you; not one of them will stand against you."
verses.textEn: The Lord said to Joshua, "Do not be afraid of them; I have given them into your hand. Not one of them will be able to withstand you."

verses.textZh: 于是约书亚乘夜从吉甲上去，突然来到他们那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是约书亚乘夜从吉甲上去，突然来到他们那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 约书亚就终夜从吉甲上去，猛然临到他们那里。
verses.textEnNiv: After an all-night march from Gilgal, Joshua took them by surprise.
verses.textEnEsv: So Joshua came upon them suddenly, having marched up all night from Gilgal.
verses.textEnNkjv: Joshua therefore came upon them suddenly, having marched all night from Gilgal.
verses.textEnNlt: Joshua traveled all night from Gilgal and took the Amorite armies by surprise.
verses.textEnNasb: So Joshua came upon them suddenly by marching all night from Gilgal.
verses.textEn: After an all-night march from Gilgal, Joshua took them by surprise.

verses.textZh: 耶和华使他们在以色列人面前溃乱，约书亚在基遍大大地击杀他们，沿着伯．和仑的上坡路追赶他们，击打他们，直到亚西加和玛基大。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华使他们在以色列人面前溃乱，约书亚在基遍大大地击杀他们，沿着伯．和仑的上坡路追赶他们，击打他们，直到亚西加和玛基大。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华使他们在以色列人面前溃乱。约书亚在基遍大大地杀败他们，追赶他们，在伯‧和仑的上坡路击杀他们，直到亚西加和玛基大。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord threw them into confusion before Israel, so Joshua and the Israelites defeated them completely at Gibeon. Israel pursued them along the road going up to Beth Horon and cut them down all the way to Azekah and Makkedah.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord threw them into a panic before Israel, who struck them with a great blow at Gibeon and chased them by the way of the ascent of Beth-horon and struck them as far as Azekah and Makkedah.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the Lord routed them before Israel, killed them with a great slaughter at Gibeon, chased them along the road that goes to Beth Horon, and struck them down as far as Azekah and Makkedah.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord threw them into a panic, and the Israelites slaughtered great numbers of them at Gibeon. Then the Israelites chased the enemy along the road to Beth-horon, killing them all along the way to Azekah and Makkedah.
verses.textEnNasb: And the Lord brought them into confusion before Israel, and He struck them down in a great defeat at Gibeon, and pursued them by the way of the ascent to Beth-horon and struck them as far as Azekah and Makkedah.
verses.textEn: The Lord threw them into confusion before Israel, so Joshua and the Israelites defeated them completely at Gibeon. Israel pursued them along the road going up to Beth Horon and cut them down all the way to Azekah and Makkedah.

verses.textZh: 他们从以色列人面前逃跑，正在下伯．和仑斜坡的时候，耶和华从天上降大冰雹在他们身上，一直到亚西加，打死他们；被冰雹打死的，比以色列人用刀杀死的还多。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们从以色列人面前逃跑，正在下伯．和仑斜坡的时候，耶和华从天上降大冰雹在他们身上，一直到亚西加，打死他们；被冰雹打死的，比以色列人用刀杀死的还多。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们在以色列人面前逃跑，正在伯‧和仑下坡的时候，耶和华从天上降大冰雹 在他们身上，直降到亚西加，打死他们。被冰雹打死的，比以色列人用刀杀死的还多。
verses.textEnNiv: As they fled before Israel on the road down from Beth Horon to Azekah, the Lord hurled large hailstones down on them, and more of them died from the hail than were killed by the swords of the Israelites.
verses.textEnEsv: And as they fled before Israel, while they were going down the ascent of Beth-horon, the Lord threw down large stones from heaven on them as far as Azekah, and they died. There were more who died because of the hailstones than the sons of Israel killed with the sword.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it happened, as they fled before Israel and were on the descent of Beth Horon, that the Lord cast down large hailstones from heaven on them as far as Azekah, and they died. Therewere more who died from the hailstones than the children of Israel killed with the sword.
verses.textEnNlt: As the Amorites retreated down the road from Beth-horon, the Lord destroyed them with a terrible hailstorm from heaven that continued until they reached Azekah. The hail killed more of the enemy than the Israelites killed with the sword.
verses.textEnNasb: And as they fled from Israel, while they were at the descent of Beth-horon, the Lord hurled large stones from heaven on them as far as Azekah, and they died; there were more who died from the hailstones than those whom the sons of Israel killed with the sword.
verses.textEn: As they fled before Israel on the road down from Beth Horon to Azekah, the Lord hurled large hailstones down on them, and more of them died from the hail than were killed by the swords of the Israelites.

verses.textZh: 那时，就是耶和华把亚摩利人交给以色列人的时候，约书亚在以色列人面前对耶和华说： "太阳啊，停在基遍； 月亮啊，停在亚雅仑谷。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，就是耶和华把亚摩利人交给以色列人的时候，约书亚在以色列人面前对耶和华说： "太阳啊，停在基遍； 月亮啊，停在亚雅仑谷。"
verses.textZhCuv: 当耶和华将亚摩利人交付以色列人的日子，约书亚就祷告耶和华，在以色列人眼前说： 日头啊，你要停在基遍； 月亮啊，你要止在亚雅仑谷。
verses.textEnNiv: On the day the Lord gave the Amorites over to Israel, Joshua said to the Lord in the presence of Israel: "Sun, stand still over Gibeon, and you, moon, over the Valley of Aijalon."
verses.textEnEsv: At that time Joshua spoke to the Lord in the day when the Lord gave the Amorites over to the sons of Israel, and he said in the sight of Israel, "Sun, stand still at Gibeon, and moon, in the Valley of Aijalon."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Joshua spoke to the Lord in the day when the Lord delivered up the Amorites before the children of Israel, and he said in the sight of Israel: "Sun, stand still over Gibeon; And Moon, in the Valley of Aijalon."
verses.textEnNlt: On the day the Lord gave the Israelites victory over the Amorites, Joshua prayed to the Lord in front of all the people of Israel. He said, "Let the sun stand still over Gibeon, and the moon over the valley of Aijalon."
verses.textEnNasb: Then Joshua spoke to the Lord on the day when the Lord turned the Amorites over to the sons of Israel, and he said in the sight of Israel, "Sun, stand still at Gibeon, And moon, at the Valley of Aijalon!"
verses.textEn: On the day the Lord gave the Amorites over to Israel, Joshua said to the Lord in the presence of Israel: "Sun, stand still over Gibeon, and you, moon, over the Valley of Aijalon."

verses.textZh: 于是太阳停住，月亮站住，直到以色列人在仇敌的身上报了仇。这事不是写在《雅煞珥书》上吗？太阳在天空中站住，不急速下落，约有一整天。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是太阳停住，月亮站住，直到以色列人在仇敌的身上报了仇。这事不是写在《雅煞珥书》上吗？太阳在天空中站住，不急速下落，约有一整天。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是日头停留，月亮止住， 直等国民向敌人报仇。 这事岂不是写在雅煞珥书上吗？日头在天当中停住，不急速下落，约有一日之久。
verses.textEnNiv: So the sun stood still, and the moon stopped, till the nation avenged itself on its enemies, as it is written in the Book of Jashar. The sun stopped in the middle of the sky and delayed going down about a full day.
verses.textEnEsv: And the sun stood still, and the moon stopped, until the nation took vengeance on their enemies. Is this not written in the Book of Jashar? The sun stopped in the midst of heaven and did not hurry to set for about a whole day.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the sun stood still, And the moon stopped, Till the people had revenge Upon their enemies. Is this not written in the Book of Jasher? So the sun stood still in the midst of heaven, and did not hasten to go down for about a whole day.
verses.textEnNlt: So the sun stood still and the moon stayed in place until the nation of Israel had defeated its enemies. Is this event not recorded in The Book of Jashar ? The sun stayed in the middle of the sky, and it did not set as on a normal day.
verses.textEnNasb: So the sun stood still, and the moon stopped, Until the nation avenged themselves of their enemies. Is it not written in the Book of Jashar? And the sun stopped in the middle of the sky and did not hurry to go down for about a whole day.
verses.textEn: So the sun stood still, and the moon stopped, till the nation avenged itself on its enemies, as it is written in the Book of Jashar. The sun stopped in the middle of the sky and delayed going down about a full day.

verses.textZh: 在这日以前或这日以后，耶和华听人的祷告，没有像这日一样的，因为耶和华为以色列作战。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在这日以前或这日以后，耶和华听人的祷告，没有像这日一样的，因为耶和华为以色列作战。
verses.textZhCuv: 在这日以前，这日以后，耶和华听人的祷告，没有像这日的，是因耶和华为以色列争战。
verses.textEnNiv: There has never been a day like it before or since, a day when the Lord listened to a human being. Surely the Lord was fighting for Israel!
verses.textEnEsv: There has been no day like it before or since, when the Lord heeded the voice of a man, for the Lord fought for Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: And there has been no day like that, before it or after it, that the Lord heeded the voice of a man; for the Lord fought for Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: There has never been a day like this one before or since, when the Lord answered such a prayer. Surely the Lord fought for Israel that day!
verses.textEnNasb: There was no day like that before it or after it, when the Lord listened to the voice of a man; for the Lord fought for Israel.
verses.textEn: There has never been a day like it before or since, a day when the Lord listened to a human being. Surely the Lord was fighting for Israel!

verses.textZh: 后来，约书亚和众以色列人回到吉甲营那里去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 后来，约书亚和众以色列人回到吉甲营那里去。
verses.textZhCuv: 约书亚和以色列众人回到吉甲的营中。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Joshua returned with all Israel to the camp at Gilgal.
verses.textEnEsv: So Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, to the camp at Gilgal.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, to the camp at Gilgal.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Joshua and the Israelite army returned to their camp at Gilgal.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Joshua and all Israel with him returned to the camp at Gilgal.
verses.textEn: Then Joshua returned with all Israel to the camp at Gilgal.

verses.textZh: 那五个王逃跑了，躲藏在玛基大洞里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那五个王逃跑了，躲藏在玛基大洞里。
verses.textZhCuv: 那五王逃跑，藏在玛基大洞里。
verses.textEnNiv: Now the five kings had fled and hidden in the cave at Makkedah.
verses.textEnEsv: These five kings fled and hid themselves in the cave at Makkedah.
verses.textEnNkjv: But these five kings had fled and hidden themselves in a cave at Makkedah.
verses.textEnNlt: During the battle the five kings escaped and hid in a cave at Makkedah.
verses.textEnNasb: Now these five kings had fled and hidden themselves in the cave at Makkedah.
verses.textEn: Now the five kings had fled and hidden in the cave at Makkedah.

verses.textZh: 有人告诉约书亚，说："那五个王已经找到了，都躲藏在玛基大洞里。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 有人告诉约书亚，说："那五个王已经找到了，都躲藏在玛基大洞里。"
verses.textZhCuv: 有人告诉约书亚说：「那五王已经找到了，都藏在玛基大洞里。」
verses.textEnNiv: When Joshua was told that the five kings had been found hiding in the cave at Makkedah,
verses.textEnEsv: And it was told to Joshua, "The five kings have been found, hidden in the cave at Makkedah."
verses.textEnNkjv: And it was told Joshua, saying, "The five kings have been found hidden in the cave at Makkedah."
verses.textEnNlt: When Joshua heard that they had been found,
verses.textEnNasb: And it was told to Joshua, saying, "The five kings have been found hidden in the cave at Makkedah."
verses.textEn: When Joshua was told that the five kings had been found hiding in the cave at Makkedah,

verses.textZh: 约书亚说："你们把几块大石头辊到洞口那里去，并派人到洞口去看守他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约书亚说："你们把几块大石头辊到洞口那里去，并派人到洞口去看守他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 约书亚说：「你们把几块大石头滚到洞口，派人看守，
verses.textEnNiv: he said, "Roll large rocks up to the mouth of the cave, and post some men there to guard it.
verses.textEnEsv: And Joshua said, "Roll large stones against the mouth of the cave and set men by it to guard them,
verses.textEnNkjv: So Joshua said, "Roll large stones against the mouth of the cave, and set men by it to guard them.
verses.textEnNlt: he issued this command: "Cover the opening of the cave with large rocks, and place guards at the entrance to keep the kings inside.
verses.textEnNasb: So Joshua said, "Roll large stones against the mouth of the cave, and post men by it to guard them,
verses.textEn: he said, "Roll large rocks up to the mouth of the cave, and post some men there to guard it.

verses.textZh: 你们却不可站着，要追赶你们的仇敌，从后面击杀他们，不可让他们逃进自己的城中，因为耶和华你们的神已经把他们交在你们的手里了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们却不可站着，要追赶你们的仇敌，从后面击杀他们，不可让他们逃进自己的城中，因为耶和华你们的神已经把他们交在你们的手里了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你们却不可耽延，要追赶你们的仇敌，击杀他们尽后边的人，不容他们进自己的城邑，因为耶和华－你们的神已经把他们交在你们手里。」
verses.textEnNiv: But don’t stop; pursue your enemies! Attack them from the rear and don’t let them reach their cities, for the Lord your God has given them into your hand."
verses.textEnEsv: but do not stay there yourselves. Pursue your enemies; attack their rear guard. Do not let them enter their cities, for the Lord your God has given them into your hand."
verses.textEnNkjv: And do not stay there yourselves, but pursue your enemies, and attack their rear guard. Do not allow them to enter their cities, for the Lord your God has delivered them into your hand."
verses.textEnNlt: The rest of you continue chasing the enemy and cut them down from the rear. Don’t give them a chance to get back to their towns, for the Lord your God has given you victory over them."
verses.textEnNasb: but do not stay there yourselves; pursue your enemies and attack them from behind. Do not allow them to enter their cities, for the Lord your God has handed them over to you."
verses.textEn: But don’t stop; pursue your enemies! Attack them from the rear and don’t let them reach their cities, for the Lord your God has given them into your hand."

verses.textZh: 约书亚和以色列人把他们杀得惨败，直到把他们灭绝为止，那些逃脱的人都逃进设防的城里；
verses.textZhCnvs: 约书亚和以色列人把他们杀得惨败，直到把他们灭绝为止，那些逃脱的人都逃进设防的城里；
verses.textZhCuv: 约书亚和以色列人大大杀败他们，直到将他们灭尽；其中剩下的人都进了坚固的城。
verses.textEnNiv: So Joshua and the Israelites defeated them completely, but a few survivors managed to reach their fortified cities.
verses.textEnEsv: When Joshua and the sons of Israel had finished striking them with a great blow until they were wiped out, and when the remnant that remained of them had entered into the fortified cities,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then it happened, while Joshua and the children of Israel made an end of slaying them with a very great slaughter, till they had finished, that those who escaped entered fortified cities.
verses.textEnNlt: So Joshua and the Israelite army continued the slaughter and completely crushed the enemy. They totally wiped out the five armies except for a tiny remnant that managed to reach their fortified towns.
verses.textEnNasb: It came about when Joshua and the sons of Israel had finished striking them down in a very great defeat, until they were destroyed, and the survivors of them who escaped had entered the fortified cities,
verses.textEn: So Joshua and the Israelites defeated them completely, but a few survivors managed to reach their fortified cities.

verses.textZh: 众以色列人都平平安安回到玛基大营中约书亚那里。没有人敢说话攻击以色列人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 众以色列人都平平安安回到玛基大营中约书亚那里。没有人敢说话攻击以色列人。
verses.textZhCuv: 众百姓就安然回玛基大营中，到约书亚那里。没有一人敢向以色列人饶舌。
verses.textEnNiv: The whole army then returned safely to Joshua in the camp at Makkedah, and no one uttered a word against the Israelites.
verses.textEnEsv: then all the people returned safe to Joshua in the camp at Makkedah. Not a man moved his tongue against any of the people of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: And all the people returned to the camp, to Joshua at Makkedah, in peace. No one moved his tongue against any of the children of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Israelites returned safely to Joshua in the camp at Makkedah. After that, no one dared to speak even a word against Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: that all the people returned to the camp, to Joshua at Makkedah in peace. No one uttered a word against any of the sons of Israel.
verses.textEn: The whole army then returned safely to Joshua in the camp at Makkedah, and no one uttered a word against the Israelites.

verses.textZh: 约书亚说："你们打开洞口，把那五个王从洞里拉出来，带到我这里来。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 约书亚说："你们打开洞口，把那五个王从洞里拉出来，带到我这里来。"
verses.textZhCuv: 约书亚说：「打开洞口，将那五王从洞里带出来，领到我面前。」
verses.textEnNiv: Joshua said, "Open the mouth of the cave and bring those five kings out to me."
verses.textEnEsv: Then Joshua said, "Open the mouth of the cave and bring those five kings out to me from the cave."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Joshua said, "Open the mouth of the cave, and bring out those five kings to me from the cave."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Joshua said, "Remove the rocks covering the opening of the cave, and bring the five kings to me."
verses.textEnNasb: Then Joshua said, "Open the mouth of the cave and bring these five kings out to me from the cave."
verses.textEn: Joshua said, "Open the mouth of the cave and bring those five kings out to me."

verses.textZh: 众人就照着执行，他们把那五个王，就是耶路撒冷王、希伯仑王、耶末王、拉吉王和伊矶伦王，从洞里拉出来，带到约书亚那里去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 众人就照着执行，他们把那五个王，就是耶路撒冷王、希伯仑王、耶末王、拉吉王和伊矶伦王，从洞里拉出来，带到约书亚那里去。
verses.textZhCuv: 众人就这样行，将那五王，就是耶路撒冷王、希伯仑王、耶末王、拉吉王、伊矶伦王，从洞里带出来，领到约书亚面前。
verses.textEnNiv: So they brought the five kings out of the cave—the kings of Jerusalem, Hebron, Jarmuth, Lachish and Eglon.
verses.textEnEsv: And they did so, and brought those five kings out to him from the cave, the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, and the king of Eglon.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they did so, and brought out those five kings to him from the cave: the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, and the king of Eglon.
verses.textEnNlt: So they brought the five kings out of the cave—the kings of Jerusalem, Hebron, Jarmuth, Lachish, and Eglon.
verses.textEnNasb: They did so, and brought these five kings out to him from the cave: the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, and the king of Eglon.
verses.textEn: So they brought the five kings out of the cave—the kings of Jerusalem, Hebron, Jarmuth, Lachish and Eglon.

verses.textZh: 众人把那五个王带到约书亚那里去的时候，约书亚把所有的以色列人都召了来，对那些与他同去作战的军长说："你们走前来，把脚踏在这些王的颈项上。"他们就走前来，把脚踏在那些王的颈项上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 众人把那五个王带到约书亚那里去的时候，约书亚把所有的以色列人都召了来，对那些与他同去作战的军长说："你们走前来，把脚踏在这些王的颈项上。"他们就走前来，把脚踏在那些王的颈项上。
verses.textZhCuv: 带出那五王到约书亚面前的时候，约书亚就召了以色列众人来，对那些和他同去的军长说：「你们近前来，把脚踏在这些王的颈项上。」他们就近前来，把脚踏在这些王的颈项上。
verses.textEnNiv: When they had brought these kings to Joshua, he summoned all the men of Israel and said to the army commanders who had come with him, "Come here and put your feet on the necks of these kings." So they came forward and placed their feet on their necks.
verses.textEnEsv: And when they brought those kings out to Joshua, Joshua summoned all the men of Israel and said to the chiefs of the men of war who had gone with him, "Come near; put your feet on the necks of these kings." Then they came near and put their feet on their necks.
verses.textEnNkjv: So it was, when they brought out those kings to Joshua, that Joshua called for all the men of Israel, and said to the captains of the men of war who went with him, "Come near, put your feet on the necks of these kings." And they drew near and put their feet on their necks.
verses.textEnNlt: When they brought them out, Joshua told the commanders of his army, "Come and put your feet on the kings’ necks." And they did as they were told.
verses.textEnNasb: When they brought these kings out to Joshua, Joshua called for all the men of Israel, and said to the leaders of the men of war who had gone with him, "Come forward, put your feet on the necks of these kings." So they came forward and put their feet on their necks.
verses.textEn: When they had brought these kings to Joshua, he summoned all the men of Israel and said to the army commanders who had come with him, "Come here and put your feet on the necks of these kings." So they came forward and placed their feet on their necks.

verses.textZh: 约书亚对他们说："你们不要惧怕，不要惊慌；总要坚强勇敢，因为耶和华必这样对待你们要攻打的所有仇敌。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 约书亚对他们说："你们不要惧怕，不要惊慌；总要坚强勇敢，因为耶和华必这样对待你们要攻打的所有仇敌。"
verses.textZhCuv: 约书亚对他们说：「你们不要惧怕，也不要惊惶。应当刚强壮胆，因为耶和华必这样待你们所要攻打的一切仇敌。」
verses.textEnNiv: Joshua said to them, "Do not be afraid; do not be discouraged. Be strong and courageous. This is what the Lord will do to all the enemies you are going to fight."
verses.textEnEsv: And Joshua said to them, "Do not be afraid or dismayed; be strong and courageous. For thus the Lord will do to all your enemies against whom you fight."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Joshua said to them, "Do not be afraid, nor be dismayed; be strong and of good courage, for thus the Lord will do to all your enemies against whom you fight."
verses.textEnNlt: "Don’t ever be afraid or discouraged," Joshua told his men. "Be strong and courageous, for the Lord is going to do this to all of your enemies."
verses.textEnNasb: Joshua then said to them, "Do not fear or be dismayed! Be strong and courageous, for the Lord will do this to all your enemies with whom you fight."
verses.textEn: Joshua said to them, "Do not be afraid; do not be discouraged. Be strong and courageous. This is what the Lord will do to all the enemies you are going to fight."

verses.textZh: 随后，约书亚把那五个王杀死，悬在五棵树上；他们就悬在树上，直到晚上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 随后，约书亚把那五个王杀死，悬在五棵树上；他们就悬在树上，直到晚上。
verses.textZhCuv: 随后约书亚将这五王杀死，挂在五棵树上。他们就在树上直挂到晚上。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Joshua put the kings to death and exposed their bodies on five poles, and they were left hanging on the poles until evening.
verses.textEnEsv: And afterward Joshua struck them and put them to death, and he hanged them on five trees. And they hung on the trees until evening.
verses.textEnNkjv: And afterward Joshua struck them and killed them, and hanged them on five trees; and they were hanging on the trees until evening.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Joshua killed each of the five kings and impaled them on five sharpened poles, where they hung until evening.
verses.textEnNasb: So afterward Joshua struck them and put them to death, and he hanged them on five trees; and they were hung on the trees until evening.
verses.textEn: Then Joshua put the kings to death and exposed their bodies on five poles, and they were left hanging on the poles until evening.

verses.textZh: 到了日落的时候，约书亚吩咐人把他们从树上取下来，丢在他们躲藏过的洞里，把几块大石头放在洞口；这些石头一直存到今日。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到了日落的时候，约书亚吩咐人把他们从树上取下来，丢在他们躲藏过的洞里，把几块大石头放在洞口；这些石头一直存到今日。
verses.textZhCuv: 日头要落的时候，约书亚一吩咐，人就把尸首从树上取下来，丢在他们藏过的洞里，把几块大石头放在洞口，直存到今日。
verses.textEnNiv: At sunset Joshua gave the order and they took them down from the poles and threw them into the cave where they had been hiding. At the mouth of the cave they placed large rocks, which are there to this day.
verses.textEnEsv: But at the time of the going down of the sun, Joshua commanded, and they took them down from the trees and threw them into the cave where they had hidden themselves, and they set large stones against the mouth of the cave, which remain to this very day.
verses.textEnNkjv: So it was at the time of the going down of the sun that Joshua commanded, and they took them down from the trees, cast them into the cave where they had been hidden, and laid large stones against the cave’s mouth, whichremain until this very day.
verses.textEnNlt: As the sun was going down, Joshua gave instructions for the bodies of the kings to be taken down from the poles and thrown into the cave where they had been hiding. Then they covered the opening of the cave with a pile of large rocks, which remains to this very day.
verses.textEnNasb: Then it came about at sunset that Joshua gave the command, and they took them down from the trees and threw them into the cave where they had hidden themselves, and put large stones over the mouth of the cave, to this very day.
verses.textEn: At sunset Joshua gave the order and they took them down from the poles and threw them into the cave where they had been hiding. At the mouth of the cave they placed large rocks, which are there to this day.

verses.textZh: 在那天，约书亚占领了玛基大，用刀击杀了那城的人和那城的王，把城中所有的人完全毁灭，不容一人逃脱；他对待玛基大王就像对待耶利哥王一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在那天，约书亚占领了玛基大，用刀击杀了那城的人和那城的王，把城中所有的人完全毁灭，不容一人逃脱；他对待玛基大王就像对待耶利哥王一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 当日，约书亚夺了玛基大，用刀击杀城中的人和王；将其中一切人口尽行杀灭，没有留下一个。他待玛基大王，像从前待耶利哥王一样。
verses.textEnNiv: That day Joshua took Makkedah. He put the city and its king to the sword and totally destroyed everyone in it. He left no survivors. And he did to the king of Makkedah as he had done to the king of Jericho.
verses.textEnEsv: As for Makkedah, Joshua captured it on that day and struck it, and its king, with the edge of the sword. He devoted to destruction every person in it; he left none remaining. And he did to the king of Makkedah just as he had done to the king of Jericho.
verses.textEnNkjv: On that day Joshua took Makkedah, and struck it and its king with the edge of the sword. He utterly destroyed them—all the people who were in it. He let none remain. He also did to the king of Makkedah as he had done to the king of Jericho.
verses.textEnNlt: That same day Joshua captured and destroyed the town of Makkedah. He killed everyone in it, including the king, leaving no survivors. He destroyed them all, and he killed the king of Makkedah as he had killed the king of Jericho.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Joshua captured Makkedah on that day, and struck it and its king with the edge of the sword; he utterly destroyed it and every person who was in it. He left no survivor. So he did to the king of Makkedah just as he had done to the king of Jericho.
verses.textEn: That day Joshua took Makkedah. He put the city and its king to the sword and totally destroyed everyone in it. He left no survivors. And he did to the king of Makkedah as he had done to the king of Jericho.

verses.textZh: 约书亚和跟他在一起的众以色列人从玛基大往立拿去，攻打立拿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约书亚和跟他在一起的众以色列人从玛基大往立拿去，攻打立拿。
verses.textZhCuv: 约书亚和以色列众人从玛基大往立拿去，攻打立拿。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Joshua and all Israel with him moved on from Makkedah to Libnah and attacked it.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Joshua and all Israel with him passed on from Makkedah to Libnah and fought against Libnah.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Joshua passed from Makkedah, and all Israel with him, to Libnah; and they fought against Libnah.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Joshua and the Israelites went to Libnah and attacked it.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Joshua and all Israel with him passed on from Makkedah to Libnah, and fought against Libnah.
verses.textEn: Then Joshua and all Israel with him moved on from Makkedah to Libnah and attacked it.

verses.textZh: 耶和华把立拿和立拿的王也交在以色列人手里，约书亚用刀攻击那城，杀了城里所有的人，不容一人逃脱；他对待立拿王就像对待耶利哥王一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华把立拿和立拿的王也交在以色列人手里，约书亚用刀攻击那城，杀了城里所有的人，不容一人逃脱；他对待立拿王就像对待耶利哥王一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华将立拿和立拿的王也交在以色列人手里。约书亚攻打这城，用刀击杀了城中的一切人口，没有留下一个。他待立拿王，像从前待耶利哥王一样。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord also gave that city and its king into Israel’s hand. The city and everyone in it Joshua put to the sword. He left no survivors there. And he did to its king as he had done to the king of Jericho.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord gave it also and its king into the hand of Israel. And he struck it with the edge of the sword, and every person in it; he left none remaining in it. And he did to its king as he had done to the king of Jericho.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord also delivered it and its king into the hand of Israel; he struck it and all the people who were in it with the edge of the sword. He let none remain in it, but did to its king as he had done to the king of Jericho.
verses.textEnNlt: There, too, the Lord gave them the town and its king. He killed everyone in it, leaving no survivors. Then Joshua killed the king of Libnah as he had killed the king of Jericho.
verses.textEnNasb: And the Lord also handed it over to Israel, with its king, and he struck it and every person who was in it with the edge of the sword. He left no survivor in it. So he did to its king just as he had done to the king of Jericho.
verses.textEn: The Lord also gave that city and its king into Israel’s hand. The city and everyone in it Joshua put to the sword. He left no survivors there. And he did to its king as he had done to the king of Jericho.

verses.textZh: 约书亚和跟他在一起的众以色列人从立拿往拉吉去，对着拉吉安营，攻打这城。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约书亚和跟他在一起的众以色列人从立拿往拉吉去，对着拉吉安营，攻打这城。
verses.textZhCuv: 约书亚和以色列众人从立拿往拉吉去，对着拉吉安营，攻打这城。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Joshua and all Israel with him moved on from Libnah to Lachish; he took up positions against it and attacked it.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Joshua and all Israel with him passed on from Libnah to Lachish and laid siege to it and fought against it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Joshua passed from Libnah, and all Israel with him, to Lachish; and they encamped against it and fought against it.
verses.textEnNlt: From Libnah, Joshua and the Israelites went to Lachish and attacked it.
verses.textEnNasb: And Joshua and all Israel with him passed on from Libnah to Lachish, and they camped by it and fought against it.
verses.textEn: Then Joshua and all Israel with him moved on from Libnah to Lachish; he took up positions against it and attacked it.

verses.textZh: 耶和华把拉吉交在以色列人手里，第二天约书亚就占领了拉吉，用刀攻击那城，杀了城中所有的人，跟他对立拿所行的一切一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华把拉吉交在以色列人手里，第二天约书亚就占领了拉吉，用刀攻击那城，杀了城中所有的人，跟他对立拿所行的一切一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华将拉吉交在以色列人的手里。第二天约书亚就夺了拉吉，用刀击杀了城中的一切人口，是照他向立拿一切所行的。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord gave Lachish into Israel’s hands, and Joshua took it on the second day. The city and everyone in it he put to the sword, just as he had done to Libnah.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord gave Lachish into the hand of Israel, and he captured it on the second day and struck it with the edge of the sword, and every person in it, as he had done to Libnah.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord delivered Lachish into the hand of Israel, who took it on the second day, and struck it and all the people who were in it with the edge of the sword, according to all that he had done to Libnah.
verses.textEnNlt: Here again, the Lord gave them Lachish. Joshua took it on the second day and killed everyone in it, just as he had done at Libnah.
verses.textEnNasb: And the Lord handed Lachish over to Israel; and he captured it on the second day, and struck it and every person who was in it with the edge of the sword, according to all that he had done to Libnah.
verses.textEn: The Lord gave Lachish into Israel’s hands, and Joshua took it on the second day. The city and everyone in it he put to the sword, just as he had done to Libnah.

verses.textZh: 那时，基色王荷兰上来帮助拉吉，约书亚就把他和他的人民都击杀了，没有留下一人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，基色王荷兰上来帮助拉吉，约书亚就把他和他的人民都击杀了，没有留下一人。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时基色王荷兰上来帮助拉吉，约书亚就把他和他的民都击杀了，没有留下一个。
verses.textEnNiv: Meanwhile, Horam king of Gezer had come up to help Lachish, but Joshua defeated him and his army—until no survivors were left.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Horam king of Gezer came up to help Lachish. And Joshua struck him and his people, until he left none remaining.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Horam king of Gezer came up to help Lachish; and Joshua struck him and his people, until he left him none remaining.
verses.textEnNlt: During the attack on Lachish, King Horam of Gezer arrived with his army to help defend the town. But Joshua’s men killed him and his army, leaving no survivors.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Horam king of Gezer came up to help Lachish, and Joshua defeated him and his people until he had left him no survivor.
verses.textEn: Meanwhile, Horam king of Gezer had come up to help Lachish, but Joshua defeated him and his army—until no survivors were left.

verses.textZh: 约书亚和与他在一起的众以色列人从拉吉往伊矶伦去，对着伊矶伦安营，攻打这城。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约书亚和与他在一起的众以色列人从拉吉往伊矶伦去，对着伊矶伦安营，攻打这城。
verses.textZhCuv: 约书亚和以色列众人从拉吉往伊矶伦去，对着伊矶伦安营，攻打这城。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Joshua and all Israel with him moved on from Lachish to Eglon; they took up positions against it and attacked it.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Joshua and all Israel with him passed on from Lachish to Eglon. And they laid siege to it and fought against it.
verses.textEnNkjv: From Lachish Joshua passed to Eglon, and all Israel with him; and they encamped against it and fought against it.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Joshua and the Israelite army went on to Eglon and attacked it.
verses.textEnNasb: And Joshua and all Israel with him passed on from Lachish to Eglon, and they camped by it and fought against it.
verses.textEn: Then Joshua and all Israel with him moved on from Lachish to Eglon; they took up positions against it and attacked it.

verses.textZh: 那一天，他们占领了这城，用刀攻击那城，杀了城中所有的人；那一天约书亚把他们完全毁灭，跟他对拉吉所行的一切一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那一天，他们占领了这城，用刀攻击那城，杀了城中所有的人；那一天约书亚把他们完全毁灭，跟他对拉吉所行的一切一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 当日就夺了城，用刀击杀了城中的人。那日，约书亚将城中的一切人口尽行杀灭，是照他向拉吉一切所行的。
verses.textEnNiv: They captured it that same day and put it to the sword and totally destroyed everyone in it, just as they had done to Lachish.
verses.textEnEsv: And they captured it on that day, and struck it with the edge of the sword. And he devoted every person in it to destruction that day, as he had done to Lachish.
verses.textEnNkjv: They took it on that day and struck it with the edge of the sword; all the people who were in it he utterly destroyed that day, according to all that he had done to Lachish.
verses.textEnNlt: They captured it that day and killed everyone in it. He completely destroyed everyone, just as he had done at Lachish.
verses.textEnNasb: They captured it on that day and struck it with the edge of the sword; and he utterly destroyed on that day every person who was in it, according to all that he had done to Lachish.
verses.textEn: They captured it that same day and put it to the sword and totally destroyed everyone in it, just as they had done to Lachish.

verses.textZh: 约书亚和与他在一起的众以色列人从伊矶伦上希伯仑去，攻打这城。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约书亚和与他在一起的众以色列人从伊矶伦上希伯仑去，攻打这城。
verses.textZhCuv: 约书亚和以色列众人从伊矶伦上希伯仑去，攻打这城，
verses.textEnNiv: Then Joshua and all Israel with him went up from Eglon to Hebron and attacked it.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Joshua and all Israel with him went up from Eglon to Hebron. And they fought against it
verses.textEnNkjv: So Joshua went up from Eglon, and all Israel with him, to Hebron; and they fought against it.
verses.textEnNlt: From Eglon, Joshua and the Israelite army went up to Hebron and attacked it.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Joshua and all Israel with him went up from Eglon to Hebron, and they fought against it.
verses.textEn: Then Joshua and all Israel with him went up from Eglon to Hebron and attacked it.

verses.textZh: 他们占领了这城，用刀攻击这城，杀了这城的王，又攻击属于这城的城镇，杀了城中所有的人，不容一人逃脱，跟他对伊矶伦所行的一切一样，把这城和城中所有的人完全毁灭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们占领了这城，用刀攻击这城，杀了这城的王，又攻击属于这城的城镇，杀了城中所有的人，不容一人逃脱，跟他对伊矶伦所行的一切一样，把这城和城中所有的人完全毁灭。
verses.textZhCuv: 就夺了希伯仑和属希伯仑的诸城邑，用刀将城中的人与王，并那些城邑中的人口，都击杀了，没有留下一个，是照他向伊矶伦所行的，把城中的一切人口尽行杀灭。
verses.textEnNiv: They took the city and put it to the sword, together with its king, its villages and everyone in it. They left no survivors. Just as at Eglon, they totally destroyed it and everyone in it.
verses.textEnEsv: and captured it and struck it with the edge of the sword, and its king and its towns, and every person in it. He left none remaining, as he had done to Eglon, and devoted it to destruction and every person in it.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they took it and struck it with the edge of the sword—its king, all its cities, and all the people who were in it; he left none remaining, according to all that he had done to Eglon, but utterly destroyed it and all the people who were in it.
verses.textEnNlt: They captured the town and killed everyone in it, including its king, leaving no survivors. They did the same thing to all of its surrounding villages. And just as he had done at Eglon, he completely destroyed the entire population.
verses.textEnNasb: And they captured it and struck it and its king and all its cities and all the persons who were in it with the edge of the sword. He left no survivor, according to all that he had done to Eglon. And he utterly destroyed it and every person who was in it.
verses.textEn: They took the city and put it to the sword, together with its king, its villages and everyone in it. They left no survivors. Just as at Eglon, they totally destroyed it and everyone in it.

verses.textZh: 约书亚和与他在一起的众以色列人回到了底璧，攻打这城。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约书亚和与他在一起的众以色列人回到了底璧，攻打这城。
verses.textZhCuv: 约书亚和以色列众人回到底璧，攻打这城，
verses.textEnNiv: Then Joshua and all Israel with him turned around and attacked Debir.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Joshua and all Israel with him turned back to Debir and fought against it
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, to Debir; and they fought against it.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Joshua and the Israelites turned back and attacked Debir.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Joshua and all Israel with him returned to Debir, and they fought against it.
verses.textEn: Then Joshua and all Israel with him turned around and attacked Debir.

verses.textZh: 约书亚占领了这城，抓住这城的王，又占领了属于这城的一切城镇；以色列人用刀击杀他们，把城中所有的人都毁灭了；约书亚不容一人逃脱，他怎样对待希伯仑，也照样对待底璧和底璧的王；也好象他对待立拿和立拿的王一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约书亚占领了这城，抓住这城的王，又占领了属于这城的一切城镇；以色列人用刀击杀他们，把城中所有的人都毁灭了；约书亚不容一人逃脱，他怎样对待希伯仑，也照样对待底璧和底璧的王；也好象他对待立拿和立拿的王一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 就夺了底璧和属底璧的城邑，又擒获底璧的王，用刀将这些城中的人口尽行杀灭，没有留下一个。他待底璧和底璧王，像从前待希伯仑和立拿与立拿王一样。
verses.textEnNiv: They took the city, its king and its villages, and put them to the sword. Everyone in it they totally destroyed. They left no survivors. They did to Debir and its king as they had done to Libnah and its king and to Hebron.
verses.textEnEsv: and he captured it with its king and all its towns. And they struck them with the edge of the sword and devoted to destruction every person in it; he left none remaining. Just as he had done to Hebron and to Libnah and its king, so he did to Debir and to its king.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he took it and its king and all its cities; they struck them with the edge of the sword and utterly destroyed all the people who were in it. He left none remaining; as he had done to Hebron, so he did to Debir and its king, as he had done also to Libnah and its king.
verses.textEnNlt: He captured the town, its king, and all of its surrounding villages. He completely destroyed everyone in it, leaving no survivors. He did to Debir and its king just what he had done to Hebron and to Libnah and its king.
verses.textEnNasb: He captured it and its king and all its cities, and they struck them with the edge of the sword, and utterly destroyed every person who was in it. He left no survivor. Just as he had done to Hebron, so he did to Debir and its king, as he had also done to Libnah and its king.
verses.textEn: They took the city, its king and its villages, and put them to the sword. Everyone in it they totally destroyed. They left no survivors. They did to Debir and its king as they had done to Libnah and its king and to Hebron.

verses.textZh: 这样，约书亚击杀了全地的人，就是山地、南地、高原和山坡的人，以及那些地方所有的王，不容一人逃脱；约书亚照着耶和华以色列的神的吩咐，把有气息的都完全毁灭了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，约书亚击杀了全地的人，就是山地、南地、高原和山坡的人，以及那些地方所有的王，不容一人逃脱；约书亚照着耶和华以色列的神的吩咐，把有气息的都完全毁灭了。
verses.textZhCuv: 这样，约书亚击杀全地的人，就是山地、南地、高原、山坡的人，和那些地的诸王，没有留下一个。将凡有气息的尽行杀灭，正如耶和华－以色列的神所吩咐的。
verses.textEnNiv: So Joshua subdued the whole region, including the hill country, the Negev, the western foothills and the mountain slopes, together with all their kings. He left no survivors. He totally destroyed all who breathed, just as the Lord , the God of Israel, had commanded.
verses.textEnEsv: So Joshua struck the whole land, the hill country and the Negeb and the lowland and the slopes, and all their kings. He left none remaining, but devoted to destruction all that breathed, just as the Lord God of Israel commanded.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Joshua conquered all the land: the mountain country and the South and the lowland and the wilderness slopes, and all their kings; he left none remaining, but utterly destroyed all that breathed, as the Lord God of Israel had commanded.
verses.textEnNlt: So Joshua conquered the whole region—the kings and people of the hill country, the Negev, the western foothills, and the mountain slopes. He completely destroyed everyone in the land, leaving no survivors, just as the Lord , the God of Israel, had commanded.
verses.textEnNasb: So Joshua struck all the land, the hill country and the Negev and the lowland and the slopes, and all their kings. He left no survivor, but he utterly destroyed all who breathed, just as the Lord, the God of Israel, had commanded.
verses.textEn: So Joshua subdued the whole region, including the hill country, the Negev, the western foothills and the mountain slopes, together with all their kings. He left no survivors. He totally destroyed all who breathed, just as the Lord , the God of Israel, had commanded.

verses.textZh: 约书亚从加低斯．巴尼亚击杀他们，直到迦萨，又从歌珊全地击杀他们，直到基遍。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约书亚从加低斯．巴尼亚击杀他们，直到迦萨，又从歌珊全地击杀他们，直到基遍。
verses.textZhCuv: 约书亚从加低斯‧巴尼亚攻击到迦萨，又攻击歌珊全地，直到基遍。
verses.textEnNiv: Joshua subdued them from Kadesh Barnea to Gaza and from the whole region of Goshen to Gibeon.
verses.textEnEsv: And Joshua struck them from Kadesh-barnea as far as Gaza, and all the country of Goshen, as far as Gibeon.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Joshua conquered them from Kadesh Barnea as far as Gaza, and all the country of Goshen, even as far as Gibeon.
verses.textEnNlt: Joshua slaughtered them from Kadesh-barnea to Gaza and from the region around the town of Goshen up to Gibeon.
verses.textEnNasb: Joshua struck them from Kadesh-barnea even as far as Gaza, and all the country of Goshen even as far as Gibeon.
verses.textEn: Joshua subdued them from Kadesh Barnea to Gaza and from the whole region of Goshen to Gibeon.

verses.textZh: 约书亚在这一次战役中击败了这些王和占领了他们的地，是因为耶和华以色列的神为以色列作战。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约书亚在这一次战役中击败了这些王和占领了他们的地，是因为耶和华以色列的神为以色列作战。
verses.textZhCuv: 约书亚一时杀败了这些王，并夺了他们的地，因为耶和华－以色列的神为以色列争战。
verses.textEnNiv: All these kings and their lands Joshua conquered in one campaign, because the Lord , the God of Israel, fought for Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: And Joshua captured all these kings and their land at one time, because the Lord God of Israel fought for Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: All these kings and their land Joshua took at one time, because the Lord God of Israel fought for Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: Joshua conquered all these kings and their land in a single campaign, for the Lord , the God of Israel, was fighting for his people.
verses.textEnNasb: Joshua captured all these kings and their lands at one time, because the Lord, the God of Israel, fought for Israel.
verses.textEn: All these kings and their lands Joshua conquered in one campaign, because the Lord , the God of Israel, fought for Israel.

verses.textZh: 于是约书亚和与他在一起的众以色列人回到吉甲营中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是约书亚和与他在一起的众以色列人回到吉甲营中。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是约书亚和以色列众人回到吉甲的营中。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Joshua returned with all Israel to the camp at Gilgal.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, to the camp at Gilgal.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Joshua returned, and all Israel with him, to the camp at Gilgal.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Joshua and the Israelite army returned to their camp at Gilgal.
verses.textEnNasb: So Joshua and all Israel with him returned to the camp at Gilgal.
verses.textEn: Then Joshua returned with all Israel to the camp at Gilgal.

verses.textZh: 夏琐王耶宾一听见这些事，就派人去见玛顿王约巴、伸仑王、押煞王，
verses.textZhCnvs: 夏琐王耶宾一听见这些事，就派人去见玛顿王约巴、伸仑王、押煞王，
verses.textZhCuv: 夏琐王耶宾听见这事，就打发人去见玛顿王约巴、伸仑王、押煞王，
verses.textEnNiv: When Jabin king of Hazor heard of this, he sent word to Jobab king of Madon, to the kings of Shimron and Akshaph,
verses.textEnEsv: When Jabin, king of Hazor, heard of this, he sent to Jobab king of Madon, and to the king of Shimron, and to the king of Achshaph,
verses.textEnNkjv: And it came to pass, when Jabin king of Hazor heard thesethings, that he sent to Jobab king of Madon, to the king of Shimron, to the king of Achshaph,
verses.textEnNlt: When King Jabin of Hazor heard what had happened, he sent messages to the following kings: King Jobab of Madon; the king of Shimron; the king of Acshaph;
verses.textEnNasb: Then it came about, when Jabin king of Hazor heard about it, that he sent word to Jobab king of Madon, to the king of Shimron, to the king of Achshaph,
verses.textEn: When Jabin king of Hazor heard of this, he sent word to Jobab king of Madon, to the kings of Shimron and Akshaph,

verses.textZh: 以及住在北方山地、基尼烈南边的亚拉巴、高原和西边多珥高地的众王，
verses.textZhCnvs: 以及住在北方山地、基尼烈南边的亚拉巴、高原和西边多珥高地的众王，
verses.textZhCuv: 与北方山地、基尼烈南边的亚拉巴高原，并西边多珥山冈的诸王；
verses.textEnNiv: and to the northern kings who were in the mountains, in the Arabah south of Kinnereth, in the western foothills and in Naphoth Dor on the west;
verses.textEnEsv: and to the kings who were in the northern hill country, and in the Arabah south of Chinneroth, and in the lowland, and in Naphoth-dor on the west,
verses.textEnNkjv: and to the kings who were from the north, in the mountains, in the plain south of Chinneroth, in the lowland, and in the heights of Dor on the west,
verses.textEnNlt: all the kings of the northern hill country; the kings in the Jordan Valley south of Galilee ; the kings in the Galilean foothills ; the kings of Naphoth-dor on the west;
verses.textEnNasb: and to the kings who were of the north in the hill country, and in the Arabah—south of Chinneroth and in the lowland, and on the heights of Dor on the west—
verses.textEn: and to the northern kings who were in the mountains, in the Arabah south of Kinnereth, in the western foothills and in Naphoth Dor on the west;

verses.textZh: 又去见在东方和西方的迦南人，住在山地的亚摩利人、赫人、比利洗人和耶布斯人，以及米斯巴地黑门山下的希未人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又去见在东方和西方的迦南人，住在山地的亚摩利人、赫人、比利洗人和耶布斯人，以及米斯巴地黑门山下的希未人。
verses.textZhCuv: 又去见东方和西方的迦南人，与山地的亚摩利人、赫人、比利洗人、耶布斯人，并黑门山根米斯巴地的希未人。
verses.textEnNiv: to the Canaanites in the east and west; to the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites and Jebusites in the hill country; and to the Hivites below Hermon in the region of Mizpah.
verses.textEnEsv: to the Canaanites in the east and the west, the Amorites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, and the Jebusites in the hill country, and the Hivites under Hermon in the land of Mizpah.
verses.textEnNkjv: to the Canaanites in the east and in the west, the Amorite, the Hittite, the Perizzite, the Jebusite in the mountains, and the Hivite below Hermon in the land of Mizpah.
verses.textEnNlt: the kings of Canaan, both east and west; the kings of the Amorites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Jebusites in the hill country, and the Hivites in the towns on the slopes of Mount Hermon in the land of Mizpah.
verses.textEnNasb: to the Canaanite on the east and on the west, and the Amorite, the Hittite, the Perizzite, and the Jebusite in the hill country, and the Hivite at the foot of Hermon in the land of Mizpeh.
verses.textEn: to the Canaanites in the east and west; to the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites and Jebusites in the hill country; and to the Hivites below Hermon in the region of Mizpah.

verses.textZh: 这些王与他们所有的军队都一同出来，人数众多，好象海边的沙，还有很多马匹和车辆。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些王与他们所有的军队都一同出来，人数众多，好象海边的沙，还有很多马匹和车辆。
verses.textZhCuv: 这些王和他们的众军都出来，人数多如海边的沙，并有许多马匹车辆。
verses.textEnNiv: They came out with all their troops and a large number of horses and chariots—a huge army, as numerous as the sand on the seashore.
verses.textEnEsv: And they came out with all their troops, a great horde, in number like the sand that is on the seashore, with very many horses and chariots.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they went out, they and all their armies with them, as many people as the sand that is on the seashore in multitude, with very many horses and chariots.
verses.textEnNlt: All these kings came out to fight. Their combined armies formed a vast horde. And with all their horses and chariots, they covered the landscape like the sand on the seashore.
verses.textEnNasb: Then they came out, they and all their armies with them, as many people as the sand that is on the seashore, with very many horses and chariots.
verses.textEn: They came out with all their troops and a large number of horses and chariots—a huge army, as numerous as the sand on the seashore.

verses.textZh: 这些王都联合起来，来到米伦水边，在那里一起安营，要与以色列人作战。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些王都联合起来，来到米伦水边，在那里一起安营，要与以色列人作战。
verses.textZhCuv: 这诸王会合，来到米伦水边，一同安营，要与以色列人争战。
verses.textEnNiv: All these kings joined forces and made camp together at the Waters of Merom to fight against Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: And all these kings joined their forces and came and encamped together at the waters of Merom to fight against Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when all these kings had met together, they came and camped together at the waters of Merom to fight against Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: The kings joined forces and established their camp around the water near Merom to fight against Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: So all of these kings gathered together, and came and encamped together at the waters of Merom, to fight against Israel.
verses.textEn: All these kings joined forces and made camp together at the Waters of Merom to fight against Israel.

verses.textZh: 耶和华对约书亚说："你不要因他们惧怕，因为明天这个时候，我必使他们全数在以色列人面前被杀；你要砍断他们的马蹄筋，焚烧他们的车辆。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对约书亚说："你不要因他们惧怕，因为明天这个时候，我必使他们全数在以色列人面前被杀；你要砍断他们的马蹄筋，焚烧他们的车辆。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对约书亚说：「你不要因他们惧怕。明日这时，我必将他们交付以色列人全然杀了。你要砍断他们马的蹄筋，用火焚烧他们的车辆。」
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to Joshua, "Do not be afraid of them, because by this time tomorrow I will hand all of them, slain, over to Israel. You are to hamstring their horses and burn their chariots."
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord said to Joshua, "Do not be afraid of them, for tomorrow at this time I will give over all of them, slain, to Israel. You shall hamstring their horses and burn their chariots with fire."
verses.textEnNkjv: But the Lord said to Joshua, "Do not be afraid because of them, for tomorrow about this time I will deliver all of them slain before Israel. You shall hamstring their horses and burn their chariots with fire."
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to Joshua, "Do not be afraid of them. By this time tomorrow I will hand all of them over to Israel as dead men. Then you must cripple their horses and burn their chariots."
verses.textEnNasb: Yet the Lord said to Joshua, "Do not be afraid because of them, for tomorrow at this time I am going to turn all of them over to Israel as good as dead; you shall hamstring their horses and burn their chariots with fire."
verses.textEn: The Lord said to Joshua, "Do not be afraid of them, because by this time tomorrow I will hand all of them, slain, over to Israel. You are to hamstring their horses and burn their chariots."

verses.textZh: 于是约书亚和所有与他在一起能作战的人，在米伦水边突然迫近，攻打他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是约书亚和所有与他在一起能作战的人，在米伦水边突然迫近，攻打他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是约书亚率领一切兵丁，在米伦水边突然向前攻打他们。
verses.textEnNiv: So Joshua and his whole army came against them suddenly at the Waters of Merom and attacked them,
verses.textEnEsv: So Joshua and all his warriors came suddenly against them by the waters of Merom and fell upon them.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Joshua and all the people of war with him came against them suddenly by the waters of Merom, and they attacked them.
verses.textEnNlt: So Joshua and all his fighting men traveled to the water near Merom and attacked suddenly.
verses.textEnNasb: So Joshua and all the people of war with him came upon them suddenly at the waters of Merom, and attacked them.
verses.textEn: So Joshua and his whole army came against them suddenly at the Waters of Merom and attacked them,

verses.textZh: 耶和华把他们交在以色列人手里，以色列人就击杀他们，追赶他们直到西顿大城、米斯利弗．玛音，以及在东边的米斯巴谷；以色列人击杀他们，没有留下一个。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华把他们交在以色列人手里，以色列人就击杀他们，追赶他们直到西顿大城、米斯利弗．玛音，以及在东边的米斯巴谷；以色列人击杀他们，没有留下一个。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华将他们交在以色列人手里，以色列人就击杀他们，追赶他们到西顿大城，到米斯利弗‧玛音，直到东边米斯巴的平原，将他们击杀，没有留下一个。
verses.textEnNiv: and the Lord gave them into the hand of Israel. They defeated them and pursued them all the way to Greater Sidon, to Misrephoth Maim, and to the Valley of Mizpah on the east, until no survivors were left.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord gave them into the hand of Israel, who struck them and chased them as far as Great Sidon and Misrephoth-maim, and eastward as far as the Valley of Mizpeh. And they struck them until he left none remaining.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord delivered them into the hand of Israel, who defeated them and chased them to Greater Sidon, to the Brook Misrephoth, and to the Valley of Mizpah eastward; they attacked them until they left none of them remaining.
verses.textEnNlt: And the Lord gave them victory over their enemies. The Israelites chased them as far as Greater Sidon and Misrephoth-maim, and eastward into the valley of Mizpah, until not one enemy warrior was left alive.
verses.textEnNasb: And the Lord handed them over to Israel, so that they defeated them, and pursued them as far as Great Sidon, and Misrephoth-maim, and the Valley of Mizpeh to the east; and they struck them until no survivor was left to them.
verses.textEn: and the Lord gave them into the hand of Israel. They defeated them and pursued them all the way to Greater Sidon, to Misrephoth Maim, and to the Valley of Mizpah on the east, until no survivors were left.

verses.textZh: 约书亚照着耶和华吩咐他的对待他们；他砍断了他们的马蹄筋，用火烧了他们的车辆。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约书亚照着耶和华吩咐他的对待他们；他砍断了他们的马蹄筋，用火烧了他们的车辆。
verses.textZhCuv: 约书亚就照耶和华所吩咐他的去行，砍断他们马的蹄筋，用火焚烧他们的车辆。
verses.textEnNiv: Joshua did to them as the Lord had directed: He hamstrung their horses and burned their chariots.
verses.textEnEsv: And Joshua did to them just as the Lord said to him: he hamstrung their horses and burned their chariots with fire.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Joshua did to them as the Lord had told him: he hamstrung their horses and burned their chariots with fire.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Joshua crippled the horses and burned all the chariots, as the Lord had instructed.
verses.textEnNasb: And Joshua did to them just as the Lord had told him; he hamstrung their horses and burned their chariots with fire.
verses.textEn: Joshua did to them as the Lord had directed: He hamstrung their horses and burned their chariots.

verses.textZh: 那时，约书亚转回来，占领了夏琐，用刀击杀了夏琐王，因为夏琐在这些国中素来是为首的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，约书亚转回来，占领了夏琐，用刀击杀了夏琐王，因为夏琐在这些国中素来是为首的。
verses.textZhCuv: 当时，约书亚转回夺了夏琐，用刀击杀夏琐王。（素来夏琐在这诸国中是为首的。）
verses.textEnNiv: At that time Joshua turned back and captured Hazor and put its king to the sword. (Hazor had been the head of all these kingdoms.)
verses.textEnEsv: And Joshua turned back at that time and captured Hazor and struck its king with the sword, for Hazor formerly was the head of all those kingdoms.
verses.textEnNkjv: Joshua turned back at that time and took Hazor, and struck its king with the sword; for Hazor was formerly the head of all those kingdoms.
verses.textEnNlt: Joshua then turned back and captured Hazor and killed its king. (Hazor had at one time been the capital of all these kingdoms.)
verses.textEnNasb: Then Joshua turned back at that time and captured Hazor, and struck its king with the sword; for Hazor previously was the head of all these kingdoms.
verses.textEn: At that time Joshua turned back and captured Hazor and put its king to the sword. (Hazor had been the head of all these kingdoms.)

verses.textZh: 以色列人用刀击杀了城中所有的人，把他们完全毁灭；有气息的一个也没有留下；约书亚又放火烧了夏琐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人用刀击杀了城中所有的人，把他们完全毁灭；有气息的一个也没有留下；约书亚又放火烧了夏琐。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人用刀击杀城中的人口，将他们尽行杀灭；凡有气息的没有留下一个。约书亚又用火焚烧夏琐。
verses.textEnNiv: Everyone in it they put to the sword. They totally destroyed them, not sparing anyone that breathed, and he burned Hazor itself.
verses.textEnEsv: And they struck with the sword all who were in it, devoting them to destruction; there was none left that breathed. And he burned Hazor with fire.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they struck all the people who were in it with the edge of the sword, utterly destroying them. There was none left breathing. Then he burned Hazor with fire.
verses.textEnNlt: The Israelites completely destroyed every living thing in the city, leaving no survivors. Not a single person was spared. And then Joshua burned the city.
verses.textEnNasb: They struck every person who was in it with the edge of the sword, utterly destroying them; there was no one left who breathed. And he burned Hazor with fire.
verses.textEn: Everyone in it they put to the sword. They totally destroyed them, not sparing anyone that breathed, and he burned Hazor itself.

verses.textZh: 约书亚夺取了那些王的一切城镇，又擒获那些城镇所有的王；他用刀击杀了他们，把一切完全毁灭，正如耶和华仆人摩西所吩咐的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约书亚夺取了那些王的一切城镇，又擒获那些城镇所有的王；他用刀击杀了他们，把一切完全毁灭，正如耶和华仆人摩西所吩咐的。
verses.textZhCuv: 约书亚夺了这些王的一切城邑，擒获其中的诸王，用刀击杀他们，将他们尽行杀灭，正如耶和华仆人摩西所吩咐的。
verses.textEnNiv: Joshua took all these royal cities and their kings and put them to the sword. He totally destroyed them, as Moses the servant of the Lord had commanded.
verses.textEnEsv: And all the cities of those kings, and all their kings, Joshua captured, and struck them with the edge of the sword, devoting them to destruction, just as Moses the servant of the Lord had commanded.
verses.textEnNkjv: So all the cities of those kings, and all their kings, Joshua took and struck with the edge of the sword. He utterly destroyed them, as Moses the servant of the Lord had commanded.
verses.textEnNlt: Joshua slaughtered all the other kings and their people, completely destroying them, just as Moses, the servant of the Lord , had commanded.
verses.textEnNasb: Joshua captured all the cities of these kings, and all their kings; and he struck them with the edge of the sword and utterly destroyed them, just as Moses the servant of the Lord had commanded.
verses.textEn: Joshua took all these royal cities and their kings and put them to the sword. He totally destroyed them, as Moses the servant of the Lord had commanded.

verses.textZh: 至于那些立在土丘上的城，除了夏琐以外，以色列人都没有焚烧；约书亚只烧了夏琐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于那些立在土丘上的城，除了夏琐以外，以色列人都没有焚烧；约书亚只烧了夏琐。
verses.textZhCuv: 至于造在山冈上的城，除了夏琐以外，以色列人都没有焚烧。约书亚只将夏琐焚烧了。
verses.textEnNiv: Yet Israel did not burn any of the cities built on their mounds—except Hazor, which Joshua burned.
verses.textEnEsv: But none of the cities that stood on mounds did Israel burn, except Hazor alone; that Joshua burned.
verses.textEnNkjv: But asfor the cities that stood on their mounds, Israel burned none of them, except Hazor only, which Joshua burned.
verses.textEnNlt: But the Israelites did not burn any of the towns built on mounds except Hazor, which Joshua burned.
verses.textEnNasb: However, Israel did not burn any cities that stood on their mounds, except Hazor alone, which Joshua burned.
verses.textEn: Yet Israel did not burn any of the cities built on their mounds—except Hazor, which Joshua burned.

verses.textZh: 那些城所有的战利品和牲畜，以色列人都据为己有；只是把所有的人都用刀击杀了，直到把他们杀尽；有气息的，他们没有留下一个。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那些城所有的战利品和牲畜，以色列人都据为己有；只是把所有的人都用刀击杀了，直到把他们杀尽；有气息的，他们没有留下一个。
verses.textZhCuv: 那些城邑所有的财物和牲畜，以色列人都取为自己的掠物；惟有一切人口都用刀击杀，直到杀尽；凡有气息的没有留下一个。
verses.textEnNiv: The Israelites carried off for themselves all the plunder and livestock of these cities, but all the people they put to the sword until they completely destroyed them, not sparing anyone that breathed.
verses.textEnEsv: And all the spoil of these cities and the livestock, the people of Israel took for their plunder. But every person they struck with the edge of the sword until they had destroyed them, and they did not leave any who breathed.
verses.textEnNkjv: And all the spoil of these cities and the livestock, the children of Israel took as booty for themselves; but they struck every man with the edge of the sword until they had destroyed them, and they left none breathing.
verses.textEnNlt: And the Israelites took all the plunder and livestock of the ravaged towns for themselves. But they killed all the people, leaving no survivors.
verses.textEnNasb: And all the spoils of these cities and the cattle, the sons of Israel took as their plunder; but they struck every person with the edge of the sword, until they had destroyed them. They left no one breathing.
verses.textEn: The Israelites carried off for themselves all the plunder and livestock of these cities, but all the people they put to the sword until they completely destroyed them, not sparing anyone that breathed.

verses.textZh: 耶和华怎样吩咐他的仆人摩西，摩西就怎样吩咐约书亚，约书亚也照样行了；耶和华吩咐摩西的一切，约书亚没有一样不办妥的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华怎样吩咐他的仆人摩西，摩西就怎样吩咐约书亚，约书亚也照样行了；耶和华吩咐摩西的一切，约书亚没有一样不办妥的。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华怎样吩咐他仆人摩西，摩西就照样吩咐约书亚，约书亚也照样行。凡耶和华所吩咐摩西的，约书亚没有一件懈怠不行的。
verses.textEnNiv: As the Lord commanded his servant Moses, so Moses commanded Joshua, and Joshua did it; he left nothing undone of all that the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.textEnEsv: Just as the Lord had commanded Moses his servant, so Moses commanded Joshua, and so Joshua did. He left nothing undone of all that the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textEnNkjv: As the Lord had commanded Moses his servant, so Moses commanded Joshua, and so Joshua did. He left nothing undone of all that the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textEnNlt: As the Lord had commanded his servant Moses, so Moses commanded Joshua. And Joshua did as he was told, carefully obeying all the commands that the Lord had given to Moses.
verses.textEnNasb: Just as the Lord had commanded His servant Moses, so Moses commanded Joshua, and so Joshua did; he left nothing undone of all that the Lord had commanded Moses.
