verses.textEn: As the Lord commanded his servant Moses, so Moses commanded Joshua, and Joshua did it; he left nothing undone of all that the Lord commanded Moses.

verses.textZh: 这样，约书亚夺取了那整个地区，就是山地、整个南地、歌珊全地、高原、亚拉巴、以色列山地和山地的高原；
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，约书亚夺取了那整个地区，就是山地、整个南地、歌珊全地、高原、亚拉巴、以色列山地和山地的高原；
verses.textZhCuv: 约书亚夺了那全地，就是山地、一带南地、歌珊全地、高原、亚拉巴、以色列的山地，和山下的高原。
verses.textEnNiv: So Joshua took this entire land: the hill country, all the Negev, the whole region of Goshen, the western foothills, the Arabah and the mountains of Israel with their foothills,
verses.textEnEsv: So Joshua took all that land, the hill country and all the Negeb and all the land of Goshen and the lowland and the Arabah and the hill country of Israel and its lowland
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus Joshua took all this land: the mountain country, all the South, all the land of Goshen, the lowland, and the Jordan plain—the mountains of Israel and its lowlands,
verses.textEnNlt: So Joshua conquered the entire region—the hill country, the entire Negev, the whole area around the town of Goshen, the western foothills, the Jordan Valley, the mountains of Israel, and the Galilean foothills.
verses.textEnNasb: So Joshua took all that land: the hill country and all the Negev, all the land of Goshen, the lowland, the Arabah, the hill country of Israel and its lowland
verses.textEn: So Joshua took this entire land: the hill country, all the Negev, the whole region of Goshen, the western foothills, the Arabah and the mountains of Israel with their foothills,

verses.textZh: 从延伸至西珥的哈拉山，直到黑门山下黎巴嫩谷的巴力．迦得；约书亚擒获了那些地方所有的王，击打他们，把他们都杀死了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从延伸至西珥的哈拉山，直到黑门山下黎巴嫩谷的巴力．迦得；约书亚擒获了那些地方所有的王，击打他们，把他们都杀死了。
verses.textZhCuv: 从上西珥的哈拉山，直到黑门山下黎巴嫩平原的巴力‧迦得，并且擒获那些地的诸王，将他们杀死。
verses.textEnNiv: from Mount Halak, which rises toward Seir, to Baal Gad in the Valley of Lebanon below Mount Hermon. He captured all their kings and put them to death.
verses.textEnEsv: from Mount Halak, which rises toward Seir, as far as Baal-gad in the Valley of Lebanon below Mount Hermon. And he captured all their kings and struck them and put them to death.
verses.textEnNkjv: from Mount Halak and the ascent to Seir, even as far as Baal Gad in the Valley of Lebanon below Mount Hermon. He captured all their kings, and struck them down and killed them.
verses.textEnNlt: The Israelite territory now extended all the way from Mount Halak, which leads up to Seir in the south, as far north as Baal-gad at the foot of Mount Hermon in the valley of Lebanon. Joshua killed all the kings of those territories,
verses.textEnNasb: from Mount Halak, that rises toward Seir, even as far as Baal-gad in the Valley of Lebanon at the foot of Mount Hermon. And he captured all their kings, and struck them and put them to death.
verses.textEn: from Mount Halak, which rises toward Seir, to Baal Gad in the Valley of Lebanon below Mount Hermon. He captured all their kings and put them to death.

verses.textZh: 约书亚和这些王作战了很多的日子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约书亚和这些王作战了很多的日子。
verses.textZhCuv: 约书亚和这诸王争战了许多年日。
verses.textEnNiv: Joshua waged war against all these kings for a long time.
verses.textEnEsv: Joshua made war a long time with all those kings.
verses.textEnNkjv: Joshua made war a long time with all those kings.
verses.textEnNlt: waging war for a long time to accomplish this.
verses.textEnNasb: Joshua waged war a long time with all these kings.
verses.textEn: Joshua waged war against all these kings for a long time.

verses.textZh: 除了住在基遍的希未人以外，没有一座城与以色列人议和的；所有其他的城都是以色列人作战夺取的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 除了住在基遍的希未人以外，没有一座城与以色列人议和的；所有其他的城都是以色列人作战夺取的。
verses.textZhCuv: 除了基遍的希未人之外，没有一城与以色列人讲和的，都是以色列人争战夺来的。
verses.textEnNiv: Except for the Hivites living in Gibeon, not one city made a treaty of peace with the Israelites, who took them all in battle.
verses.textEnEsv: There was not a city that made peace with the people of Israel except the Hivites, the inhabitants of Gibeon. They took them all in battle.
verses.textEnNkjv: There was not a city that made peace with the children of Israel, except the Hivites, the inhabitants of Gibeon. All theothers they took in battle.
verses.textEnNlt: No one in this region made peace with the Israelites except the Hivites of Gibeon. All the others were defeated.
verses.textEnNasb: There was not a city which made peace with the sons of Israel except the Hivites living in Gibeon; they took them all in battle.
verses.textEn: Except for the Hivites living in Gibeon, not one city made a treaty of peace with the Israelites, who took them all in battle.

verses.textZh: 因为这是出于耶和华的旨意，他使他们心里刚硬，要与以色列人交战，好把他们完全毁灭，使他们不蒙怜悯，却要被消灭，正如耶和华吩咐摩西的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为这是出于耶和华的旨意，他使他们心里刚硬，要与以色列人交战，好把他们完全毁灭，使他们不蒙怜悯，却要被消灭，正如耶和华吩咐摩西的。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为耶和华的意思是要使他们心里刚硬，来与以色列人争战，好叫他们尽被杀灭，不蒙怜悯，正如耶和华所吩咐摩西的。
verses.textEnNiv: For it was the Lord himself who hardened their hearts to wage war against Israel, so that he might destroy them totally, exterminating them without mercy, as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textEnEsv: For it was the Lord ’s doing to harden their hearts that they should come against Israel in battle, in order that they should be devoted to destruction and should receive no mercy but be destroyed, just as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.textEnNkjv: For it was of the Lord to harden their hearts, that they should come against Israel in battle, that He might utterly destroy them, and that they might receive no mercy, but that He might destroy them, as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textEnNlt: For the Lord hardened their hearts and caused them to fight the Israelites. So they were completely destroyed without mercy, as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textEnNasb: For it was of the Lord to harden their hearts, to meet Israel in battle in order that he might utterly destroy them, that they might receive no mercy, but that he might destroy them, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textEn: For it was the Lord himself who hardened their hearts to wage war against Israel, so that he might destroy them totally, exterminating them without mercy, as the Lord had commanded Moses.

verses.textZh: 那时约书亚来了，把在山地、希伯仑、底璧、亚拿伯、整个犹大山地、整个以色列山地所有的亚衲族人都剪除了。约书亚把他们与他们的城镇都完全毁灭了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时约书亚来了，把在山地、希伯仑、底璧、亚拿伯、整个犹大山地、整个以色列山地所有的亚衲族人都剪除了。约书亚把他们与他们的城镇都完全毁灭了。
verses.textZhCuv: 当时约书亚来到，将住山地、希伯仑、底璧、亚拿伯、犹大山地、以色列山地所有的亚衲族人剪除了。约书亚将他们和他们的城邑尽都毁灭。
verses.textEnNiv: At that time Joshua went and destroyed the Anakites from the hill country: from Hebron, Debir and Anab, from all the hill country of Judah, and from all the hill country of Israel. Joshua totally destroyed them and their towns.
verses.textEnEsv: And Joshua came at that time and cut off the Anakim from the hill country, from Hebron, from Debir, from Anab, and from all the hill country of Judah, and from all the hill country of Israel. Joshua devoted them to destruction with their cities.
verses.textEnNkjv: And at that time Joshua came and cut off the Anakim from the mountains: from Hebron, from Debir, from Anab, from all the mountains of Judah, and from all the mountains of Israel; Joshua utterly destroyed them with their cities.
verses.textEnNlt: During this period Joshua destroyed all the descendants of Anak, who lived in the hill country of Hebron, Debir, Anab, and the entire hill country of Judah and Israel. He killed them all and completely destroyed their towns.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Joshua came at that time and eliminated the Anakim from the hill country, from Hebron, Debir, Anab, and from all the hill country of Judah and all the hill country of Israel. Joshua utterly destroyed them with their cities.
verses.textEn: At that time Joshua went and destroyed the Anakites from the hill country: from Hebron, Debir and Anab, from all the hill country of Judah, and from all the hill country of Israel. Joshua totally destroyed them and their towns.

verses.textZh: 在以色列人的境内，没有留下一个亚衲族人，只在迦萨、迦特和亚实突还有余下的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在以色列人的境内，没有留下一个亚衲族人，只在迦萨、迦特和亚实突还有余下的。
verses.textZhCuv: 在以色列人的地没有留下一个亚衲族人，只在迦萨、迦特，和亚实突有留下的。
verses.textEnNiv: No Anakites were left in Israelite territory; only in Gaza, Gath and Ashdod did any survive.
verses.textEnEsv: There was none of the Anakim left in the land of the people of Israel. Only in Gaza, in Gath, and in Ashdod did some remain.
verses.textEnNkjv: None of the Anakim were left in the land of the children of Israel; they remained only in Gaza, in Gath, and in Ashdod.
verses.textEnNlt: None of the descendants of Anak were left in all the land of Israel, though some still remained in Gaza, Gath, and Ashdod.
verses.textEnNasb: There were no Anakim left in the land of the sons of Israel; only in Gaza, Gath, and Ashdod some remained.
verses.textEn: No Anakites were left in Israelite territory; only in Gaza, Gath and Ashdod did any survive.

verses.textZh: 这样，约书亚照着耶和华吩咐摩西的一切话，夺取了那全地；于是，约书亚按着以色列的支派把地分给他们作产业。全地也就止息了战争。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，约书亚照着耶和华吩咐摩西的一切话，夺取了那全地；于是，约书亚按着以色列的支派把地分给他们作产业。全地也就止息了战争。
verses.textZhCuv: 这样，约书亚照着耶和华所吩咐摩西的一切话夺了那全地，就按着以色列支派的宗族将地分给他们为业。于是国中太平，没有争战了。
verses.textEnNiv: So Joshua took the entire land, just as the Lord had directed Moses, and he gave it as an inheritance to Israel according to their tribal divisions. Then the land had rest from war.
verses.textEnEsv: So Joshua took the whole land, according to all that the Lord had spoken to Moses. And Joshua gave it for an inheritance to Israel according to their tribal allotments. And the land had rest from war.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Joshua took the whole land, according to all that the Lord had said to Moses; and Joshua gave it as an inheritance to Israel according to their divisions by their tribes. Then the land rested from war.
verses.textEnNlt: So Joshua took control of the entire land, just as the Lord had instructed Moses. He gave it to the people of Israel as their special possession, dividing the land among the tribes. So the land finally had rest from war.
verses.textEnNasb: So Joshua took the whole land, in accordance with everything that the Lord had spoken to Moses; and Joshua gave it as an inheritance to Israel according to their divisions by their tribes. So the land was at rest from war.
verses.textEn: So Joshua took the entire land, just as the Lord had directed Moses, and he gave it as an inheritance to Israel according to their tribal divisions. Then the land had rest from war.

verses.textZh: 以色列人在约旦河东向日出之地击杀了那地的两个王，占领了他们的地，就是从亚嫩谷直到黑门山，和东边的亚拉巴全境。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人在约旦河东向日出之地击杀了那地的两个王，占领了他们的地，就是从亚嫩谷直到黑门山，和东边的亚拉巴全境。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人在约旦河外向日出之地击杀二王，得他们的地，就是从亚嫩谷直到黑门山，并东边的全亚拉巴之地。
verses.textEnNiv: These are the kings of the land whom the Israelites had defeated and whose territory they took over east of the Jordan, from the Arnon Gorge to Mount Hermon, including all the eastern side of the Arabah:
verses.textEnEsv: Now these are the kings of the land whom the people of Israel defeated and took possession of their land beyond the Jordan toward the sunrise, from the Valley of the Arnon to Mount Hermon, with all the Arabah eastward:
verses.textEnNkjv: These are the kings of the land whom the children of Israel defeated, and whose land they possessed on the other side of the Jordan toward the rising of the sun, from the River Arnon to Mount Hermon, and all the eastern Jordan plain:
verses.textEnNlt: These are the kings east of the Jordan River who had been killed by the Israelites and whose land was taken. Their territory extended from the Arnon Gorge to Mount Hermon and included all the land east of the Jordan Valley.
verses.textEnNasb: Now these are the kings of the land whom the sons of Israel defeated, and they took possession of their land beyond the Jordan toward the sunrise, from the Valley of the Arnon as far as Mount Hermon, and all the Arabah to the east:
verses.textEn: These are the kings of the land whom the Israelites had defeated and whose territory they took over east of the Jordan, from the Arnon Gorge to Mount Hermon, including all the eastern side of the Arabah:

verses.textZh: 这两个王，一个是住在希实本的亚摩利人的王西宏；他管辖的地区，是从亚嫩谷旁的亚罗珥起，包括山谷中部和基列的一半，直到雅博河，就是亚扪人的境界；
verses.textZhCnvs: 这两个王，一个是住在希实本的亚摩利人的王西宏；他管辖的地区，是从亚嫩谷旁的亚罗珥起，包括山谷中部和基列的一半，直到雅博河，就是亚扪人的境界；
verses.textZhCuv: 这二王，有住希实本、亚摩利人的王西宏。他所管之地是从亚嫩谷边的亚罗珥和谷中的城，并基列一半，直到亚扪人的境界，雅博河
verses.textEnNiv: Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon. He ruled from Aroer on the rim of the Arnon Gorge—from the middle of the gorge—to the Jabbok River, which is the border of the Ammonites. This included half of Gilead.
verses.textEnEsv: Sihon king of the Amorites who lived at Heshbon and ruled from Aroer, which is on the edge of the Valley of the Arnon, and from the middle of the valley as far as the river Jabbok, the boundary of the Ammonites, that is, half of Gilead,
verses.textEnNkjv: Onekingwas Sihon king of the Amorites, who dwelt in Heshbon and ruled half of Gilead, from Aroer, which is on the bank of the River Arnon, from the middle of that river, even as far as the River Jabbok, whichis the border of the Ammonites,
verses.textEnNlt: King Sihon of the Amorites, who lived in Heshbon, was defeated. His kingdom included Aroer, on the edge of the Arnon Gorge, and extended from the middle of the Arnon Gorge to the Jabbok River, which serves as a border for the Ammonites. This territory included the southern half of the territory of Gilead.
verses.textEnNasb: Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived in Heshbon and ruled from Aroer, which is on the edge of the Valley of the Arnon, both the middle of the valley and half of Gilead, even as far as the brook Jabbok, the border of the sons of Ammon;
verses.textEn: Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon. He ruled from Aroer on the rim of the Arnon Gorge—from the middle of the gorge—to the Jabbok River, which is the border of the Ammonites. This included half of Gilead.

verses.textZh: 东边有亚拉巴，上至基尼烈海，下至亚拉巴海，就是盐海，东边是往伯．耶西末的路；南边直到毘斯迦的山麓。
verses.textZhCnvs: 东边有亚拉巴，上至基尼烈海，下至亚拉巴海，就是盐海，东边是往伯．耶西末的路；南边直到毘斯迦的山麓。
verses.textZhCuv: 与约旦河东边的亚拉巴，直到基尼烈海，又到亚拉巴的海，就是盐海，通伯‧耶西末的路，以及南方，直到毗斯迦的山根。
verses.textEnNiv: He also ruled over the eastern Arabah from the Sea of Galilee to the Sea of the Arabah (that is, the Dead Sea), to Beth Jeshimoth, and then southward below the slopes of Pisgah.
verses.textEnEsv: and the Arabah to the Sea of Chinneroth eastward, and in the direction of Beth-jeshimoth, to the Sea of the Arabah, the Salt Sea, southward to the foot of the slopes of Pisgah;
verses.textEnNkjv: and the eastern Jordan plain from the Sea of Chinneroth as far as the Sea of the Arabah (the Salt Sea), the road to Beth Jeshimoth, and southward below the slopes of Pisgah.
verses.textEnNlt: Sihon also controlled the Jordan Valley and regions to the east—from as far north as the Sea of Galilee to as far south as the Dead Sea, including the road to Beth-jeshimoth and southward to the slopes of Pisgah.
verses.textEnNasb: and the Arabah as far as the Sea of Chinneroth toward the east, and as far as the Sea of the Arabah, that is, the Salt Sea, eastward toward Beth-jeshimoth, and on the south, at the foot of the slopes of Pisgah;
verses.textEn: He also ruled over the eastern Arabah from the Sea of Galilee to the Sea of the Arabah (that is, the Dead Sea), to Beth Jeshimoth, and then southward below the slopes of Pisgah.

verses.textZh: 另一个是巴珊王噩 ，他是利乏音人的余民，住在亚斯他录和以得来；
verses.textZhCnvs: 另一个是巴珊王噩 ，他是利乏音人的余民，住在亚斯他录和以得来；
verses.textZhCuv: 又有巴珊王噩。他是利乏音人所剩下的，住在亚斯他录和以得来。
verses.textEnNiv: And the territory of Og king of Bashan, one of the last of the Rephaites, who reigned in Ashtaroth and Edrei.
verses.textEnEsv: and Og king of Bashan, one of the remnant of the Rephaim, who lived at Ashtaroth and at Edrei
verses.textEnNkjv: Theotherkingwas Og king of Bashan and his territory, whowas of the remnant of the giants, who dwelt at Ashtaroth and at Edrei,
verses.textEnNlt: King Og of Bashan, the last of the Rephaites, lived at Ashtaroth and Edrei.
verses.textEnNasb: and the territory of Og king of Bashan, one of the remnant of Rephaim, who lived at Ashtaroth and at Edrei,
verses.textEn: And the territory of Og king of Bashan, one of the last of the Rephaites, who reigned in Ashtaroth and Edrei.

verses.textZh: 他管辖的地区，是黑门山、撒迦、巴珊全地，直到基述人和玛迦人的境界，还有基列的一半，直到希实本王西宏的境界。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他管辖的地区，是黑门山、撒迦、巴珊全地，直到基述人和玛迦人的境界，还有基列的一半，直到希实本王西宏的境界。
verses.textZhCuv: 他所管之地是黑门山、撒迦、巴珊全地，直到基述人和玛迦人的境界，并基列一半，直到希实本王西宏的境界。
verses.textEnNiv: He ruled over Mount Hermon, Salekah, all of Bashan to the border of the people of Geshur and Maakah, and half of Gilead to the border of Sihon king of Heshbon.
verses.textEnEsv: and ruled over Mount Hermon and Salecah and all Bashan to the boundary of the Geshurites and the Maacathites, and over half of Gilead to the boundary of Sihon king of Heshbon.
verses.textEnNkjv: and reigned over Mount Hermon, over Salcah, over all Bashan, as far as the border of the Geshurites and the Maachathites, and over half of Gilead to the border of Sihon king of Heshbon.
verses.textEnNlt: He ruled a territory stretching from Mount Hermon to Salecah in the north and to all of Bashan in the east, and westward to the borders of the kingdoms of Geshur and Maacah. This territory included the northern half of Gilead, as far as the boundary of King Sihon of Heshbon.
verses.textEnNasb: and ruled over Mount Hermon, Salecah, and all Bashan, as far as the border of the Geshurites and the Maacathites, and half of Gilead, as far as the border of Sihon king of Heshbon.
verses.textEn: He ruled over Mount Hermon, Salekah, all of Bashan to the border of the people of Geshur and Maakah, and half of Gilead to the border of Sihon king of Heshbon.

verses.textZh: 耶和华的仆人摩西和以色列人把这两个王击杀了。耶和华的仆人摩西把地分给流本人、迦得人和玛拿西半个支派的人作产业。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的仆人摩西和以色列人把这两个王击杀了。耶和华的仆人摩西把地分给流本人、迦得人和玛拿西半个支派的人作产业。
verses.textZhCuv: 这二王是耶和华仆人摩西和以色列人所击杀的；耶和华仆人摩西将他们的地赐给吕便人、迦得人，和玛拿西半支派的人为业。
verses.textEnNiv: Moses, the servant of the Lord , and the Israelites conquered them. And Moses the servant of the Lord gave their land to the Reubenites, the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh to be their possession.
verses.textEnEsv: Moses, the servant of the Lord , and the people of Israel defeated them. And Moses the servant of the Lord gave their land for a possession to the Reubenites and the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh.
verses.textEnNkjv: These Moses the servant of the Lord and the children of Israel had conquered; and Moses the servant of the Lord had given it as a possession to the Reubenites, the Gadites, and half the tribe of Manasseh.
verses.textEnNlt: Moses, the servant of the Lord , and the Israelites had destroyed the people of King Sihon and King Og. And Moses gave their land as a possession to the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and the half-tribe of Manasseh.
verses.textEnNasb: Moses the servant of the Lord and the sons of Israel defeated them; and Moses the servant of the Lord gave it to the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh as a possession.
verses.textEn: Moses, the servant of the Lord , and the Israelites conquered them. And Moses the servant of the Lord gave their land to the Reubenites, the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh to be their possession.

verses.textZh: 以下是约书亚和以色列人在约旦河西，从黎巴嫩谷的巴力．迦得，直到延伸至西珥的哈拉山等地，所击杀的众王；约书亚按着分配办法把那地分给以色列各支派作产业；
verses.textZhCnvs: 以下是约书亚和以色列人在约旦河西，从黎巴嫩谷的巴力．迦得，直到延伸至西珥的哈拉山等地，所击杀的众王；约书亚按着分配办法把那地分给以色列各支派作产业；
verses.textZhCuv: 约书亚和以色列人在约旦河西击杀了诸王。他们的地是从黎巴嫩平原的巴力‧迦得，直到上西珥的哈拉山。约书亚就将那地按着以色列支派的宗族分给他们为业，
verses.textEnNiv: Here is a list of the kings of the land that Joshua and the Israelites conquered on the west side of the Jordan, from Baal Gad in the Valley of Lebanon to Mount Halak, which rises toward Seir. Joshua gave their lands as an inheritance to the tribes of Israel according to their tribal divisions.
verses.textEnEsv: And these are the kings of the land whom Joshua and the people of Israel defeated on the west side of the Jordan, from Baal-gad in the Valley of Lebanon to Mount Halak, that rises toward Seir (and Joshua gave their land to the tribes of Israel as a possession according to their allotments,
verses.textEnNkjv: And these are the kings of the country which Joshua and the children of Israel conquered on this side of the Jordan, on the west, from Baal Gad in the Valley of Lebanon as far as Mount Halak and the ascent to Seir, which Joshua gave to the tribes of Israel as a possession according to their divisions,
verses.textEnNlt: The following is a list of the kings that Joshua and the Israelite armies defeated on the west side of the Jordan, from Baal-gad in the valley of Lebanon to Mount Halak, which leads up to Seir. (Joshua gave this land to the tribes of Israel as their possession,
verses.textEnNasb: Now these are the kings of the land whom Joshua and the sons of Israel defeated beyond the Jordan toward the west, from Baal-gad in the Valley of Lebanon even as far as Mount Halak, which rises toward Seir; and Joshua gave it to the tribes of Israel as a possession according to their divisions,
verses.textEn: Here is a list of the kings of the land that Joshua and the Israelites conquered on the west side of the Jordan, from Baal Gad in the Valley of Lebanon to Mount Halak, which rises toward Seir. Joshua gave their lands as an inheritance to the tribes of Israel according to their tribal divisions.

verses.textZh: 就是赫人、亚摩利人、迦南人、比利洗人、希未人、耶布斯人所住的山地、高原、亚拉巴、山坡、旷野和南地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就是赫人、亚摩利人、迦南人、比利洗人、希未人、耶布斯人所住的山地、高原、亚拉巴、山坡、旷野和南地。
verses.textZhCuv: 就是赫人、亚摩利人，迦南人、比利洗人、希未人、耶布斯人的山地、高原亚拉巴、山坡、旷野，和南地。
verses.textEnNiv: The lands included the hill country, the western foothills, the Arabah, the mountain slopes, the wilderness and the Negev. These were the lands of the Hittites, Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites. These were the kings:
verses.textEnEsv: in the hill country, in the lowland, in the Arabah, in the slopes, in the wilderness, and in the Negeb, the land of the Hittites, the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites):
verses.textEnNkjv: in the mountain country, in the lowlands, in the Jordan plain, in the slopes, in the wilderness, and in the South— the Hittites, the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites:
verses.textEnNlt: including the hill country, the western foothills, the Jordan Valley, the mountain slopes, the Judean wilderness, and the Negev. The people who lived in this region were the Hittites, the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites.) These are the kings Israel defeated:
verses.textEnNasb: in the hill country, in the lowland, in the Arabah, on the slopes, in the wilderness, and in the Negev; the Hittite, the Amorite and the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite:
verses.textEn: The lands included the hill country, the western foothills, the Arabah, the mountain slopes, the wilderness and the Negev. These were the lands of the Hittites, Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites. These were the kings:

verses.textZh: 约书亚老了，年纪不小；耶和华对他说："你已经老了，年纪不小；还有很多的地有待征服。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约书亚老了，年纪不小；耶和华对他说："你已经老了，年纪不小；还有很多的地有待征服。
verses.textZhCuv: 约书亚年纪老迈，耶和华对他说：「你年纪老迈了，还有许多未得之地，
verses.textEnNiv: When Joshua had grown old, the Lord said to him, "You are now very old, and there are still very large areas of land to be taken over.
verses.textEnEsv: Now Joshua was old and advanced in years, and the Lord said to him, "You are old and advanced in years, and there remains yet very much land to possess.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Joshua was old, advanced in years. And the Lord said to him: "You are old, advanced in years, and there remains very much land yet to be possessed.
verses.textEnNlt: When Joshua was an old man, the Lord said to him, "You are growing old, and much land remains to be conquered.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Joshua was old and advanced in years when the Lord said to him, "You are old and advanced in years, and a very large amount of the land remains to be possessed.
verses.textEn: When Joshua had grown old, the Lord said to him, "You are now very old, and there are still very large areas of land to be taken over.

verses.textZh: 还剩下来的地，就是非利士人的全境和基述人的全地，

verses.textEnNiv: "This is the land that remains: All the regions of the Philistines and Geshurites,

verses.textEnNlt: This is the territory that remains: all the regions of the Philistines and the Geshurites,
verses.textEnNasb: This is the land that remains: all the regions of the Philistines and all those of the Geshurites;
verses.textEn: "This is the land that remains: All the regions of the Philistines and Geshurites,

verses.textZh: 从埃及东面的西曷河，向北直到以革伦的境界 ，由五个非利士人的首领管辖的迦萨人、亚实突人、亚实基伦人、迦特人、以革伦人的地方；并且有亚卫人，
verses.textZhCnvs: 从埃及东面的西曷河，向北直到以革伦的境界 ，由五个非利士人的首领管辖的迦萨人、亚实突人、亚实基伦人、迦特人、以革伦人的地方；并且有亚卫人，
verses.textZhCuv: 从埃及前的西曷河往北，直到以革伦的境界，就算属迦南人之地。有非利士人五个首领所管的迦萨人、亚实突人、亚实基伦人、迦特人、以革伦人之地，并有南方亚卫人之地。
verses.textEnNiv: from the Shihor River on the east of Egypt to the territory of Ekron on the north, all of it counted as Canaanite though held by the five Philistine rulers in Gaza, Ashdod, Ashkelon, Gath and Ekron; the territory of the Avvites
verses.textEnEsv: (from the Shihor, which is east of Egypt, northward to the boundary of Ekron, it is counted as Canaanite; there are five rulers of the Philistines, those of Gaza, Ashdod, Ashkelon, Gath, and Ekron), and those of the Avvim,
verses.textEnNkjv: from Sihor, which is east of Egypt, as far as the border of Ekron northward (which is counted as Canaanite); the five lords of the Philistines—the Gazites, the Ashdodites, the Ashkelonites, the Gittites, and the Ekronites; also the Avites;
verses.textEnNlt: and the larger territory of the Canaanites, extending from the stream of Shihor on the border of Egypt, northward to the boundary of Ekron. It includes the territory of the five Philistine rulers of Gaza, Ashdod, Ashkelon, Gath, and Ekron. The land of the Avvites
verses.textEnNasb: from the Shihor which is east of Egypt, even as far as the border of Ekron to the north (it is counted as Canaanite); the five governors of the Philistines: the Gazite, the Ashdodite, the Ashkelonite, the Gittite, the Ekronite; and the Avvite
verses.textEn: from the Shihor River on the east of Egypt to the territory of Ekron on the north, all of it counted as Canaanite though held by the five Philistine rulers in Gaza, Ashdod, Ashkelon, Gath and Ekron; the territory of the Avvites

verses.textZh: 他们是在南方，以及迦南人全境和属西顿人的米亚拉，直到亚弗和亚摩利人的境界；
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们是在南方，以及迦南人全境和属西顿人的米亚拉，直到亚弗和亚摩利人的境界；
verses.textZhCuv: 又有迦南人的全地，并属西顿人的米亚拉到亚弗，直到亚摩利人的境界。
verses.textEnNiv: on the south; all the land of the Canaanites, from Arah of the Sidonians as far as Aphek and the border of the Amorites;
verses.textEnEsv: in the south, all the land of the Canaanites, and Mearah that belongs to the Sidonians, to Aphek, to the boundary of the Amorites,
verses.textEnNkjv: from the south, all the land of the Canaanites, and Mearah that belongs to the Sidonians as far as Aphek, to the border of the Amorites;
verses.textEnNlt: in the south also remains to be conquered. In the north, the following area has not yet been conquered: all the land of the Canaanites, including Mearah (which belongs to the Sidonians), stretching northward to Aphek on the border of the Amorites;
verses.textEnNasb: to the south, all the land of the Canaanite, and Mearah that belongs to the Sidonians, as far as Aphek, to the border of the Amorite;
verses.textEn: on the south; all the land of the Canaanites, from Arah of the Sidonians as far as Aphek and the border of the Amorites;

verses.textZh: 还有迦巴勒人的地和东面的黎巴嫩全境，从黑门山下的巴力．迦得，直到哈马口；
verses.textZhCnvs: 还有迦巴勒人的地和东面的黎巴嫩全境，从黑门山下的巴力．迦得，直到哈马口；
verses.textZhCuv: 还有迦巴勒人之地，并向日出的全黎巴嫩，就是从黑门山根的巴力‧迦得，直到哈马口。
verses.textEnNiv: the area of Byblos; and all Lebanon to the east, from Baal Gad below Mount Hermon to Lebo Hamath.
verses.textEnEsv: and the land of the Gebalites, and all Lebanon, toward the sunrise, from Baal-gad below Mount Hermon to Lebo-hamath,
