verses.textEnNasb: and the land of the Gebalite, and all of Lebanon, toward the east, from Baal-gad below Mount Hermon as far as Lebo-hamath.
verses.textEn: the area of Byblos; and all Lebanon to the east, from Baal Gad below Mount Hermon to Lebo Hamath.

verses.textZh: 从黎巴嫩直到米斯利弗．玛音，所有住在山地的居民，就是所有的西顿人，我必在以色列人面前把他们赶出去。你只要照着我吩咐你的，把这地抽签分给以色列人作产业。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从黎巴嫩直到米斯利弗．玛音，所有住在山地的居民，就是所有的西顿人，我必在以色列人面前把他们赶出去。你只要照着我吩咐你的，把这地抽签分给以色列人作产业。
verses.textZhCuv: 山地的一切居民，从黎巴嫩直到米斯利弗‧玛音，就是所有的西顿人，我必在以色列人面前赶出他们去。你只管照我所吩咐的，将这地拈阄分给以色列人为业。
verses.textEnNiv: "As for all the inhabitants of the mountain regions from Lebanon to Misrephoth Maim, that is, all the Sidonians, I myself will drive them out before the Israelites. Be sure to allocate this land to Israel for an inheritance, as I have instructed you,
verses.textEnEsv: all the inhabitants of the hill country from Lebanon to Misrephoth-maim, even all the Sidonians. I myself will drive them out from before the people of Israel. Only allot the land to Israel for an inheritance, as I have commanded you.
verses.textEnNkjv: all the inhabitants of the mountains from Lebanon as far as the Brook Misrephoth, and all the Sidonians—them I will drive out from before the children of Israel; only divide it by lot to Israel as an inheritance, as I have commanded you.
verses.textEnNlt: and all the hill country from Lebanon to Misrephoth-maim, including all the land of the Sidonians. "I myself will drive these people out of the land ahead of the Israelites. So be sure to give this land to Israel as a special possession, just as I have commanded you.
verses.textEnNasb: All the inhabitants of the hill country from Lebanon as far as Misrephoth-maim, all the Sidonians, I will drive out from the sons of Israel; only allot it to Israel as an inheritance as I have commanded you.
verses.textEn: "As for all the inhabitants of the mountain regions from Lebanon to Misrephoth Maim, that is, all the Sidonians, I myself will drive them out before the Israelites. Be sure to allocate this land to Israel for an inheritance, as I have instructed you,

verses.textZh: 现在你要把这地分给九个支派和玛拿西半个支派作产业。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在你要把这地分给九个支派和玛拿西半个支派作产业。"
verses.textZhCuv: 现在你要把这地分给九个支派和玛拿西半个支派为业。」
verses.textEnNiv: and divide it as an inheritance among the nine tribes and half of the tribe of Manasseh."
verses.textEnEsv: Now therefore divide this land for an inheritance to the nine tribes and half the tribe of Manasseh."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now therefore, divide this land as an inheritance to the nine tribes and half the tribe of Manasseh."
verses.textEnNlt: Include all this territory as Israel’s possession when you divide this land among the nine tribes and the half-tribe of Manasseh."
verses.textEnNasb: Now therefore, apportion this land as an inheritance to the nine tribes and the half-tribe of Manasseh."
verses.textEn: and divide it as an inheritance among the nine tribes and half of the tribe of Manasseh."

verses.textZh: 玛拿西另半个支派 ，跟流本人和迦得人，已经得了摩西在约旦河东赐给他们的产业，是照着耶和华的仆人摩西赐给他们的，
verses.textZhCnvs: 玛拿西另半个支派 ，跟流本人和迦得人，已经得了摩西在约旦河东赐给他们的产业，是照着耶和华的仆人摩西赐给他们的，
verses.textZhCuv: 玛拿西那半支派和吕便、迦得二支派已经受了产业，就是耶和华的仆人摩西在约旦河东所赐给他们的：
verses.textEnNiv: The other half of Manasseh, the Reubenites and the Gadites had received the inheritance that Moses had given them east of the Jordan, as he, the servant of the Lord , had assigned it to them.
verses.textEnEsv: With the other half of the tribe of Manasseh the Reubenites and the Gadites received their inheritance, which Moses gave them, beyond the Jordan eastward, as Moses the servant of the Lord gave them:
verses.textEnNkjv: With the other half-tribe the Reubenites and the Gadites received their inheritance, which Moses had given them, beyond the Jordan eastward, as Moses the servant of the Lord had given them:
verses.textEnNlt: Half the tribe of Manasseh and the tribes of Reuben and Gad had already received their grants of land on the east side of the Jordan, for Moses, the servant of the Lord , had previously assigned this land to them.
verses.textEnNasb: With the other half-tribe, the Reubenites and the Gadites received their inheritance which Moses gave them beyond the Jordan to the east, just as Moses the servant of the Lord gave to them;
verses.textEn: The other half of Manasseh, the Reubenites and the Gadites had received the inheritance that Moses had given them east of the Jordan, as he, the servant of the Lord , had assigned it to them.

verses.textZh: 就是从亚嫩谷边的亚罗珥和谷中间的城，以及米底巴的整片平原，直到底本；
verses.textZhCnvs: 就是从亚嫩谷边的亚罗珥和谷中间的城，以及米底巴的整片平原，直到底本；
verses.textZhCuv: 是从亚嫩谷边的亚罗珥和谷中的城，并米底巴的全平原，直到底本，
verses.textEnNiv: It extended from Aroer on the rim of the Arnon Gorge, and from the town in the middle of the gorge, and included the whole plateau of Medeba as far as Dibon,
verses.textEnEsv: from Aroer, which is on the edge of the Valley of the Arnon, and the city that is in the middle of the valley, and all the tableland of Medeba as far as Dibon;
verses.textEnNkjv: from Aroer which is on the bank of the River Arnon, and the town that is in the midst of the ravine, and all the plain of Medeba as far as Dibon;
verses.textEnNlt: Their territory extended from Aroer on the edge of the Arnon Gorge (including the town in the middle of the gorge) to the plain beyond Medeba, as far as Dibon.
verses.textEnNasb: from Aroer, which is on the edge of the Valley of the Arnon, with the city which is in the middle of the valley, and all the plain of Medeba, as far as Dibon;
verses.textEn: It extended from Aroer on the rim of the Arnon Gorge, and from the town in the middle of the gorge, and included the whole plateau of Medeba as far as Dibon,

verses.textZh: 还有在希实本作王的亚摩利人的王西宏所有的城镇，直到亚扪人的境界；
verses.textZhCnvs: 还有在希实本作王的亚摩利人的王西宏所有的城镇，直到亚扪人的境界；
verses.textZhCuv: 和在希实本作王亚摩利王西宏的诸城，直到亚扪人的境界；
verses.textEnNiv: and all the towns of Sihon king of the Amorites, who ruled in Heshbon, out to the border of the Ammonites.
verses.textEnEsv: and all the cities of Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon, as far as the boundary of the Ammonites;
verses.textEnNkjv: all the cities of Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon, as far as the border of the children of Ammon;
verses.textEnNlt: It also included all the towns of King Sihon of the Amorites, who had reigned in Heshbon, and extended as far as the borders of Ammon.
verses.textEnNasb: and all the cities of Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon, as far as the border of the sons of Ammon;
verses.textEn: and all the towns of Sihon king of the Amorites, who ruled in Heshbon, out to the border of the Ammonites.

verses.textZh: 又有基列地、基述人和玛迦人的境界，以及整个黑门山、巴珊全地，直到撒迦；
verses.textZhCnvs: 又有基列地、基述人和玛迦人的境界，以及整个黑门山、巴珊全地，直到撒迦；
verses.textZhCuv: 又有基列地、基述人、玛迦人的地界，并黑门全山、巴珊全地，直到撒迦；
verses.textEnNiv: It also included Gilead, the territory of the people of Geshur and Maakah, all of Mount Hermon and all Bashan as far as Salekah—
verses.textEnEsv: and Gilead, and the region of the Geshurites and Maacathites, and all Mount Hermon, and all Bashan to Salecah;
verses.textEnNkjv: Gilead, and the border of the Geshurites and Maachathites, all Mount Hermon, and all Bashan as far as Salcah;
verses.textEnNlt: It included Gilead, the territory of the kingdoms of Geshur and Maacah, all of Mount Hermon, all of Bashan as far as Salecah,
verses.textEnNasb: and Gilead, and the territory of the Geshurites and Maacathites, and all Mount Hermon, and all Bashan as far as Salecah;
verses.textEn: It also included Gilead, the territory of the people of Geshur and Maakah, all of Mount Hermon and all Bashan as far as Salekah—

verses.textZh: 另有巴珊王噩的全国，他在亚斯他录和以得来作王；他是利乏音人留下的唯一余民。这些地方的人，摩西都把他们击杀了，赶走了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 另有巴珊王噩的全国，他在亚斯他录和以得来作王；他是利乏音人留下的唯一余民。这些地方的人，摩西都把他们击杀了，赶走了。
verses.textZhCuv: 又有巴珊王噩的全国－他在亚斯他录和以得来作王（利乏音人所存留的只剩下他）。这些地的人都是摩西所击杀、所赶逐的。
verses.textEnNiv: that is, the whole kingdom of Og in Bashan, who had reigned in Ashtaroth and Edrei. (He was the last of the Rephaites.) Moses had defeated them and taken over their land.
verses.textEnEsv: all the kingdom of Og in Bashan, who reigned in Ashtaroth and in Edrei (he alone was left of the remnant of the Rephaim); these Moses had struck and driven out.
verses.textEnNkjv: all the kingdom of Og in Bashan, who reigned in Ashtaroth and Edrei, who remained of the remnant of the giants; for Moses had defeated and cast out these.
verses.textEnNlt: and all the territory of King Og of Bashan, who had reigned in Ashtaroth and Edrei. King Og was the last of the Rephaites, for Moses had attacked them and driven them out.
verses.textEnNasb: all the kingdom of Og in Bashan, who reigned in Ashtaroth and in Edrei (he alone was left of the remnant of the Rephaim); for Moses struck them and drove them out.
verses.textEn: that is, the whole kingdom of Og in Bashan, who had reigned in Ashtaroth and Edrei. (He was the last of the Rephaites.) Moses had defeated them and taken over their land.

verses.textZh: 以色列人却没有赶走基述人和玛迦人；因此，基述人和玛迦人住在以色列人中间，直到今日。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人却没有赶走基述人和玛迦人；因此，基述人和玛迦人住在以色列人中间，直到今日。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人却没有赶逐基述人、玛迦人；这些人仍住在以色列中，直到今日。
verses.textEnNiv: But the Israelites did not drive out the people of Geshur and Maakah, so they continue to live among the Israelites to this day.
verses.textEnEsv: Yet the people of Israel did not drive out the Geshurites or the Maacathites, but Geshur and Maacath dwell in the midst of Israel to this day.
verses.textEnNkjv: Nevertheless the children of Israel did not drive out the Geshurites or the Maachathites, but the Geshurites and the Maachathites dwell among the Israelites until this day.
verses.textEnNlt: But the Israelites failed to drive out the people of Geshur and Maacah, so they continue to live among the Israelites to this day.
verses.textEnNasb: But the sons of Israel did not drive out the Geshurites or the Maacathites; instead, Geshur and Maacath live among Israel to this day.
verses.textEn: But the Israelites did not drive out the people of Geshur and Maakah, so they continue to live among the Israelites to this day.

verses.textZh: 只有利未支派，摩西没有把产业给他们；他们的产业就是献给耶和华以色列的神的火祭，正如耶和华对他们所说的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 只有利未支派，摩西没有把产业给他们；他们的产业就是献给耶和华以色列的神的火祭，正如耶和华对他们所说的。
verses.textZhCuv: 只是利未支派，摩西 没有把产业分给他们。他们的产业乃是献与耶和华－以色列神的火祭，正如耶和华所应许他们的。
verses.textEnNiv: But to the tribe of Levi he gave no inheritance, since the food offerings presented to the Lord , the God of Israel, are their inheritance, as he promised them.
verses.textEnEsv: To the tribe of Levi alone Moses gave no inheritance. The offerings by fire to the Lord God of Israel are their inheritance, as he said to him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Only to the tribe of Levi he had given no inheritance; the sacrifices of the Lord God of Israel made by fire are their inheritance, as He said to them.
verses.textEnNlt: Moses did not assign any allotment of land to the tribe of Levi. Instead, as the Lord had promised them, their allotment came from the offerings burned on the altar to the Lord , the God of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: Only to the tribe of Levi he did not give an inheritance; the offerings by fire to the Lord, the God of Israel, are their inheritance, as He spoke to him.
verses.textEn: But to the tribe of Levi he gave no inheritance, since the food offerings presented to the Lord , the God of Israel, are their inheritance, as he promised them.

verses.textZh: 摩西按着流本支派的家族，把产业给了他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西按着流本支派的家族，把产业给了他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西按着吕便支派的宗族分给他们产业。
verses.textEnNiv: This is what Moses had given to the tribe of Reuben, according to its clans:
verses.textEnEsv: And Moses gave an inheritance to the tribe of the people of Reuben according to their clans.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Moses had given to the tribe of the children of Reuben aninheritance according to their families.
verses.textEnNlt: Moses had assigned the following area to the clans of the tribe of Reuben.
verses.textEnNasb: So Moses gave an inheritance to the tribe of the sons of Reuben according to their families.
verses.textEn: This is what Moses had given to the tribe of Reuben, according to its clans:

verses.textZh: 他们的境界是从亚嫩谷边的亚罗珥起，包括谷中间的城、靠近米底巴的整片平原、
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们的境界是从亚嫩谷边的亚罗珥起，包括谷中间的城、靠近米底巴的整片平原、
verses.textZhCuv: 他们的境界是亚嫩谷边的亚罗珥和谷中的城，靠近米底巴的全平原；
verses.textEnNiv: The territory from Aroer on the rim of the Arnon Gorge, and from the town in the middle of the gorge, and the whole plateau past Medeba
verses.textEnEsv: So their territory was from Aroer, which is on the edge of the Valley of the Arnon, and the city that is in the middle of the valley, and all the tableland by Medeba;
verses.textEnNkjv: Their territory was from Aroer, which is on the bank of the River Arnon, and the city that is in the midst of the ravine, and all the plain by Medeba;
verses.textEnNlt: Their territory extended from Aroer on the edge of the Arnon Gorge (including the town in the middle of the gorge) to the plain beyond Medeba.
verses.textEnNasb: Their territory was from Aroer, which is on the edge of the Valley of the Arnon, with the city which is in the middle of the valley and all the plain by Medeba;
verses.textEn: The territory from Aroer on the rim of the Arnon Gorge, and from the town in the middle of the gorge, and the whole plateau past Medeba

verses.textZh: 希实本和平原上属希实本所有的城、底本、巴末．巴力、伯．巴力．勉、
verses.textZhCnvs: 希实本和平原上属希实本所有的城、底本、巴末．巴力、伯．巴力．勉、
verses.textZhCuv: 希实本并属希实本平原的各城，底本、巴末‧巴力、伯‧巴力‧勉、
verses.textEnNiv: to Heshbon and all its towns on the plateau, including Dibon, Bamoth Baal, Beth Baal Meon,
verses.textEnEsv: with Heshbon, and all its cities that are in the tableland; Dibon, and Bamoth-baal, and Beth-baal-meon,
verses.textEnNkjv: Heshbon and all its cities that are in the plain: Dibon, Bamoth Baal, Beth Baal Meon,
verses.textEnNlt: It included Heshbon and the other towns on the plain—Dibon, Bamoth-baal, Beth-baal-meon,
verses.textEnNasb: Heshbon and all its cities which are on the plain: Dibon, Bamoth-baal, Beth-baal-meon,
verses.textEn: to Heshbon and all its towns on the plateau, including Dibon, Bamoth Baal, Beth Baal Meon,

verses.textZh: 雅杂、基底莫、米法押、
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅杂、基底莫、米法押、
verses.textZhCuv: 雅杂、基底莫、米法押、
verses.textEnNiv: Jahaz, Kedemoth, Mephaath,
verses.textEnEsv: and Jahaz, and Kedemoth, and Mephaath,
verses.textEnNkjv: Jahaza, Kedemoth, Mephaath,
verses.textEnNlt: Jahaz, Kedemoth, Mephaath,
verses.textEnNasb: Jahaz, Kedemoth, Mephaath,
verses.textEn: Jahaz, Kedemoth, Mephaath,

verses.textZh: 基列亭、西比玛、谷中山地上的细列哈．沙辖、
verses.textZhCnvs: 基列亭、西比玛、谷中山地上的细列哈．沙辖、
verses.textZhCuv: 基列亭、西比玛、谷中山的细列‧哈沙辖、
verses.textEnNiv: Kiriathaim, Sibmah, Zereth Shahar on the hill in the valley,
verses.textEnEsv: and Kiriathaim, and Sibmah, and Zereth-shahar on the hill of the valley,
verses.textEnNkjv: Kirjathaim, Sibmah, Zereth Shahar on the mountain of the valley,
verses.textEnNlt: Kiriathaim, Sibmah, Zereth-shahar on the hill above the valley,
verses.textEnNasb: Kiriathaim, Sibmah, Zereth-shahar on the hill of the valley,
verses.textEn: Kiriathaim, Sibmah, Zereth Shahar on the hill in the valley,

verses.textZh: 伯．毘珥、毘斯迦山坡、伯．耶西末、
verses.textZhCnvs: 伯．毘珥、毘斯迦山坡、伯．耶西末、
verses.textZhCuv: 伯‧毗珥、毗斯迦山坡、伯‧耶西末；
verses.textEnNiv: Beth Peor, the slopes of Pisgah, and Beth Jeshimoth—
verses.textEnEsv: and Beth-peor, and the slopes of Pisgah, and Beth-jeshimoth,
verses.textEnNkjv: Beth Peor, the slopes of Pisgah, and Beth Jeshimoth—
verses.textEnNlt: Beth-peor, the slopes of Pisgah, and Beth-jeshimoth.
verses.textEnNasb: Beth-peor, the slopes of Pisgah, Beth-jeshimoth,
verses.textEn: Beth Peor, the slopes of Pisgah, and Beth Jeshimoth—

verses.textZh: 平原上所有的城和亚摩利人的王西宏的全国。这西宏曾经在希实本作王，摩西把他和米甸的首领以未、利金、苏珥、户珥和利巴都击杀了。这些都是西宏的王侯，住在那地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 平原上所有的城和亚摩利人的王西宏的全国。这西宏曾经在希实本作王，摩西把他和米甸的首领以未、利金、苏珥、户珥和利巴都击杀了。这些都是西宏的王侯，住在那地。
verses.textZhCuv: 平原的各城，并亚摩利王西宏的全国。这西宏曾在希实本作王，摩西把他和米甸的族长以未、利金、苏珥、户珥、利巴击杀了；这都是住那地属西宏为首领的。
verses.textEnNiv: all the towns on the plateau and the entire realm of Sihon king of the Amorites, who ruled at Heshbon. Moses had defeated him and the Midianite chiefs, Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur and Reba—princes allied with Sihon—who lived in that country.
verses.textEnEsv: that is, all the cities of the tableland, and all the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon, whom Moses defeated with the leaders of Midian, Evi and Rekem and Zur and Hur and Reba, the princes of Sihon, who lived in the land.
verses.textEnNkjv: all the cities of the plain and all the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon, whom Moses had struck with the princes of Midian: Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba, who were princes of Sihon dwelling in the country.
verses.textEnNlt: The land of Reuben also included all the towns of the plain and the entire kingdom of Sihon. Sihon was the Amorite king who had reigned in Heshbon and was killed by Moses along with the leaders of Midian—Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba—princes living in the region who were allied with Sihon.
verses.textEnNasb: even all the cities of the plain, and all the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon, whom Moses struck with the leaders of Midian, Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba, the leaders of Sihon, who lived in the land.
verses.textEn: all the towns on the plateau and the entire realm of Sihon king of the Amorites, who ruled at Heshbon. Moses had defeated him and the Midianite chiefs, Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur and Reba—princes allied with Sihon—who lived in that country.

verses.textZh: 在以色列人所杀的人中，比珥的儿子占卜者巴兰也被他们用刀所杀。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在以色列人所杀的人中，比珥的儿子占卜者巴兰也被他们用刀所杀。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时以色列人在所杀的人中，也用刀杀了比珥的儿子术士巴兰。
verses.textEnNiv: In addition to those slain in battle, the Israelites had put to the sword Balaam son of Beor, who practiced divination.
verses.textEnEsv: Balaam also, the son of Beor, the one who practiced divination, was killed with the sword by the people of Israel among the rest of their slain.
verses.textEnNkjv: The children of Israel also killed with the sword Balaam the son of Beor, the soothsayer, among those who were killed by them.
verses.textEnNlt: The Israelites had also killed Balaam son of Beor, who used magic to tell the future.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Israel also killed Balaam the son of Beor, the diviner, with the sword among the rest of their dead.
verses.textEn: In addition to those slain in battle, the Israelites had put to the sword Balaam son of Beor, who practiced divination.

verses.textZh: 流本人领土的疆界是约旦河，这就是流本人按着家族得着的产业所包括的众城，和属于这些城的村庄。
verses.textZhCnvs: 流本人领土的疆界是约旦河，这就是流本人按着家族得着的产业所包括的众城，和属于这些城的村庄。
verses.textZhCuv: 吕便人的境界就是约旦河与靠近约旦河的地。以上是吕便人按着宗族所得为业的诸城，并属城的村庄。
verses.textEnNiv: The boundary of the Reubenites was the bank of the Jordan. These towns and their villages were the inheritance of the Reubenites, according to their clans.
verses.textEnEsv: And the border of the people of Reuben was the Jordan as a boundary. This was the inheritance of the people of Reuben, according to their clans with their cities and villages.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the border of the children of Reuben was the bank of the Jordan. This was the inheritance of the children of Reuben according to their families, the cities and their villages.
verses.textEnNlt: The Jordan River marked the western boundary for the tribe of Reuben. The towns and their surrounding villages in this area were given as a homeland to the clans of the tribe of Reuben.
verses.textEnNasb: The border of the sons of Reuben was the Jordan. This was the inheritance of the sons of Reuben according to their families, the cities and their villages.
verses.textEn: The boundary of the Reubenites was the bank of the Jordan. These towns and their villages were the inheritance of the Reubenites, according to their clans.

verses.textZh: 摩西按着迦得支派的家族把产业分给迦得支派。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西按着迦得支派的家族把产业分给迦得支派。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西按着迦得支派的宗族分给他们产业。
verses.textEnNiv: This is what Moses had given to the tribe of Gad, according to its clans:
verses.textEnEsv: Moses gave an inheritance also to the tribe of Gad, to the people of Gad, according to their clans.
verses.textEnNkjv: Moses also had given aninheritance to the tribe of Gad, to the children of Gad according to their families.
verses.textEnNlt: Moses had assigned the following area to the clans of the tribe of Gad.
verses.textEnNasb: Moses also gave an inheritance to the tribe of Gad, to the sons of Gad according to their families.
verses.textEn: This is what Moses had given to the tribe of Gad, according to its clans:

verses.textZh: 他们的境界包括雅谢和基列所有的城，以及亚扪人的一半土地，直到拉巴前面的亚罗珥；
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们的境界包括雅谢和基列所有的城，以及亚扪人的一半土地，直到拉巴前面的亚罗珥；
verses.textZhCuv: 他们的境界是雅谢和基列的各城，并亚扪人的一半地，直到拉巴前的亚罗珥；
verses.textEnNiv: The territory of Jazer, all the towns of Gilead and half the Ammonite country as far as Aroer, near Rabbah;
verses.textEnEsv: Their territory was Jazer, and all the cities of Gilead, and half the land of the Ammonites, to Aroer, which is east of Rabbah,
verses.textEnNkjv: Their territory was Jazer, and all the cities of Gilead, and half the land of the Ammonites as far as Aroer, which is before Rabbah,
verses.textEnNlt: Their territory included Jazer, all the towns of Gilead, and half of the land of Ammon, as far as the town of Aroer just west of Rabbah.
verses.textEnNasb: Their territory was Jazer and all the cities of Gilead, and half the land of the sons of Ammon, as far as Aroer which is opposite Rabbah;
verses.textEn: The territory of Jazer, all the towns of Gilead and half the Ammonite country as far as Aroer, near Rabbah;

verses.textZh: 从希实本直到拉抹．米斯巴和比多宁，又从玛哈念直到底璧的境界；
verses.textZhCnvs: 从希实本直到拉抹．米斯巴和比多宁，又从玛哈念直到底璧的境界；
verses.textZhCuv: 从希实本到拉抹‧米斯巴和比多宁，又从玛哈念到底璧的境界，
verses.textEnNiv: and from Heshbon to Ramath Mizpah and Betonim, and from Mahanaim to the territory of Debir;
verses.textEnEsv: and from Heshbon to Ramath-mizpeh and Betonim, and from Mahanaim to the territory of Debir,
verses.textEnNkjv: and from Heshbon to Ramath Mizpah and Betonim, and from Mahanaim to the border of Debir,
verses.textEnNlt: It extended from Heshbon to Ramath-mizpeh and Betonim, and from Mahanaim to the territory of Lo-debar.
verses.textEnNasb: and from Heshbon as far as Ramath-mizpeh and Betonim, and from Mahanaim as far as the border of Debir;
verses.textEn: and from Heshbon to Ramath Mizpah and Betonim, and from Mahanaim to the territory of Debir;

verses.textZh: 还有在谷中的伯．亚兰、伯．宁拉、疏割、撒分，就是希实本王西宏国中的余地，以约旦河作疆界，直到基尼烈海的底端，都在约旦河东。
verses.textZhCnvs: 还有在谷中的伯．亚兰、伯．宁拉、疏割、撒分，就是希实本王西宏国中的余地，以约旦河作疆界，直到基尼烈海的底端，都在约旦河东。
verses.textZhCuv: 并谷中的伯‧亚兰、伯‧宁拉、疏割、撒分，就是希实本王西宏国中的余地，以及约旦河与靠近约旦河的地，直到基尼烈海的极边，都在约旦河东。
verses.textEnNiv: and in the valley, Beth Haram, Beth Nimrah, Sukkoth and Zaphon with the rest of the realm of Sihon king of Heshbon (the east side of the Jordan, the territory up to the end of the Sea of Galilee ).
verses.textEnEsv: and in the valley Beth-haram, Beth-nimrah, Succoth, and Zaphon, the rest of the kingdom of Sihon king of Heshbon, having the Jordan as a boundary, to the lower end of the Sea of Chinnereth, eastward beyond the Jordan.
verses.textEnNkjv: and in the valley Beth Haram, Beth Nimrah, Succoth, and Zaphon, the rest of the kingdom of Sihon king of Heshbon, with the Jordan as its border, as far as the edge of the Sea of Chinnereth, on the other side of the Jordan eastward.
verses.textEnNlt: In the valley were Beth-haram, Beth-nimrah, Succoth, Zaphon, and the rest of the kingdom of King Sihon of Heshbon. The western boundary ran along the Jordan River, extended as far north as the tip of the Sea of Galilee, and then turned eastward.
verses.textEnNasb: and in the valley, Beth-haram, Beth-nimrah, Succoth, and Zaphon, the rest of the kingdom of Sihon king of Heshbon, with the Jordan as a border, as far as the lower end of the Sea of Chinnereth beyond the Jordan to the east.
verses.textEn: and in the valley, Beth Haram, Beth Nimrah, Sukkoth and Zaphon with the rest of the realm of Sihon king of Heshbon (the east side of the Jordan, the territory up to the end of the Sea of Galilee ).

verses.textZh: 这就是迦得人按着家族得着的产业所包括的城镇，和属于这些城的村庄。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这就是迦得人按着家族得着的产业所包括的城镇，和属于这些城的村庄。
verses.textZhCuv: 以上是迦得人按着宗族所得为业的诸城，并属城的村庄。
verses.textEnNiv: These towns and their villages were the inheritance of the Gadites, according to their clans.
verses.textEnEsv: This is the inheritance of the people of Gad according to their clans, with their cities and villages.
verses.textEnNkjv: This is the inheritance of the children of Gad according to their families, the cities and their villages.
verses.textEnNlt: The towns and their surrounding villages in this area were given as a homeland to the clans of the tribe of Gad.
verses.textEnNasb: This is the inheritance of the sons of Gad according to their families, the cities and their villages.
verses.textEn: These towns and their villages were the inheritance of the Gadites, according to their clans.

verses.textZh: 摩西把产业分给玛拿西半个支派，是按着玛拿西半个支派的家族分给他们的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 摩西把产业分给玛拿西半个支派，是按着玛拿西半个支派的家族分给他们的。
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西把产业分给玛拿西半支派，是按着玛拿西半支派的宗族所分的。
verses.textEnNiv: This is what Moses had given to the half-tribe of Manasseh, that is, to half the family of the descendants of Manasseh, according to its clans:
verses.textEnEsv: And Moses gave an inheritance to the half-tribe of Manasseh. It was allotted to the half-tribe of the people of Manasseh according to their clans.
verses.textEnNkjv: Moses also had given aninheritance to half the tribe of Manasseh; it was for half the tribe of the children of Manasseh according to their families:
verses.textEnNlt: Moses had assigned the following area to the clans of the half-tribe of Manasseh.
verses.textEnNasb: Moses also gave an inheritance to the half-tribe of Manasseh; and it was for the half-tribe of the sons of Manasseh according to their families.
verses.textEn: This is what Moses had given to the half-tribe of Manasseh, that is, to half the family of the descendants of Manasseh, according to its clans:

verses.textZh: 他们的境界是从玛哈念起，包括巴珊全地、巴珊王噩的全国，并且在巴珊的睚珥的所有村落，共六十座城，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们的境界是从玛哈念起，包括巴珊全地、巴珊王噩的全国，并且在巴珊的睚珥的所有村落，共六十座城，
verses.textZhCuv: 他们的境界是从玛哈念起，包括巴珊全地，就是巴珊王噩的全国，并在巴珊、睚珥的一切城邑，共六十个。
verses.textEnNiv: The territory extending from Mahanaim and including all of Bashan, the entire realm of Og king of Bashan—all the settlements of Jair in Bashan, sixty towns,
verses.textEnEsv: Their region extended from Mahanaim, through all Bashan, the whole kingdom of Og king of Bashan, and all the towns of Jair, which are in Bashan, sixty cities,
verses.textEnNkjv: Their territory was from Mahanaim, all Bashan, all the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, and all the towns of Jair which are in Bashan, sixty cities;
verses.textEnNlt: Their territory extended from Mahanaim, including all of Bashan, all the former kingdom of King Og, and the sixty towns of Jair in Bashan.
verses.textEnNasb: Their territory was from Mahanaim, all Bashan, all the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, and all the towns of Jair, which are in Bashan, sixty cities;
verses.textEn: The territory extending from Mahanaim and including all of Bashan, the entire realm of Og king of Bashan—all the settlements of Jair in Bashan, sixty towns,

verses.textZh: 还有基列的一半和亚斯他录、以得来，就是在巴珊，噩的王国的两座城，都是按着家族分给玛拿西的儿子玛吉的孙子，就是分给玛吉的一半孙子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 还有基列的一半和亚斯他录、以得来，就是在巴珊，噩的王国的两座城，都是按着家族分给玛拿西的儿子玛吉的孙子，就是分给玛吉的一半孙子。
verses.textZhCuv: 基列的一半，并亚斯他录、以得来，就是属巴珊王噩国的二城，是按着宗族给玛拿西的儿子玛吉的一半子孙。
verses.textEnNiv: half of Gilead, and Ashtaroth and Edrei (the royal cities of Og in Bashan). This was for the descendants of Makir son of Manasseh—for half of the sons of Makir, according to their clans.
verses.textEnEsv: and half Gilead, and Ashtaroth, and Edrei, the cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan. These were allotted to the people of Machir the son of Manasseh for the half of the people of Machir according to their clans.
verses.textEnNkjv: half of Gilead, and Ashtaroth and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan, were for the children of Machir the son of Manasseh, for half of the children of Machir according to their families.
verses.textEnNlt: It also included half of Gilead and King Og’s royal cities of Ashtaroth and Edrei. All this was given to the clans of the descendants of Makir, who was Manasseh’s son.
verses.textEnNasb: also half of Gilead, with Ashtaroth and Edrei, the cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan, were for the sons of Machir the son of Manasseh, for half of the sons of Machir according to their families.
verses.textEn: half of Gilead, and Ashtaroth and Edrei (the royal cities of Og in Bashan). This was for the descendants of Makir son of Manasseh—for half of the sons of Makir, according to their clans.

verses.textZh: 以上这些地方是摩西在约旦河东，耶利哥对面的摩押平原所分配的产业。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以上这些地方是摩西在约旦河东，耶利哥对面的摩押平原所分配的产业。
verses.textZhCuv: 以上是摩西在约旦河东对着耶利哥的摩押平原所分给他们的产业。
verses.textEnNiv: This is the inheritance Moses had given when he was in the plains of Moab across the Jordan east of Jericho.
verses.textEnEsv: These are the inheritances that Moses distributed in the plains of Moab, beyond the Jordan east of Jericho.
verses.textEnNkjv: These aretheareas which Moses had distributed as an inheritance in the plains of Moab on the other side of the Jordan, by Jericho eastward.
verses.textEnNlt: These are the allotments Moses had made while he was on the plains of Moab, across the Jordan River, east of Jericho.
verses.textEnNasb: These are the territories which Moses apportioned as an inheritance in the plains of Moab, beyond the Jordan at Jericho to the east.
verses.textEn: This is the inheritance Moses had given when he was in the plains of Moab across the Jordan east of Jericho.

verses.textZh: 可是利未支派，摩西却没有把产业分给他们，因为耶和华以色列的神就是他们的产业，正如耶和华对他们所说的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 可是利未支派，摩西却没有把产业分给他们，因为耶和华以色列的神就是他们的产业，正如耶和华对他们所说的。
verses.textZhCuv: 只是利未支派，摩西没有把产业分给他们。耶和华－以色列的神是他们的产业，正如耶和华所应许他们的。
verses.textEnNiv: But to the tribe of Levi, Moses had given no inheritance; the Lord , the God of Israel, is their inheritance, as he promised them.
verses.textEnEsv: But to the tribe of Levi Moses gave no inheritance; the Lord God of Israel is their inheritance, just as he said to them.
verses.textEnNkjv: But to the tribe of Levi Moses had given no inheritance; the Lord God of Israel was their inheritance, as He had said to them.
verses.textEnNlt: But Moses gave no allotment of land to the tribe of Levi, for the Lord , the God of Israel, had promised that he himself would be their allotment.
verses.textEnNasb: But to the tribe of Levi, Moses did not give an inheritance; the Lord, the God of Israel, is their inheritance, as He had promised to them.
verses.textEn: But to the tribe of Levi, Moses had given no inheritance; the Lord , the God of Israel, is their inheritance, as he promised them.

verses.textZh: 以下这些地方是以色列人在迦南地分得的产业，就是以利亚撒祭司和嫩的儿子约书亚，以及以色列人各支派的族长分给他们的，
verses.textZhCnvs: 以下这些地方是以色列人在迦南地分得的产业，就是以利亚撒祭司和嫩的儿子约书亚，以及以色列人各支派的族长分给他们的，
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人在迦南地所得的产业，就是祭司以利亚撒和嫩的儿子约书亚，并以色列各支派的族长所分给他们的，都记在下面，
verses.textEnNiv: Now these are the areas the Israelites received as an inheritance in the land of Canaan, which Eleazar the priest, Joshua son of Nun and the heads of the tribal clans of Israel allotted to them.
verses.textEnEsv: These are the inheritances that the people of Israel received in the land of Canaan, which Eleazar the priest and Joshua the son of Nun and the heads of the fathers’ houses of the tribes of the people of Israel gave them to inherit.
verses.textEnNkjv: These aretheareas which the children of Israel inherited in the land of Canaan, which Eleazar the priest, Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel distributed as an inheritance to them.
verses.textEnNlt: The remaining tribes of Israel received land in Canaan as allotted by Eleazar the priest, Joshua son of Nun, and the tribal leaders.
verses.textEnNasb: Now these are the territories which the sons of Israel inherited in the land of Canaan, which Eleazar the priest, Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers’ households of the tribes of the sons of Israel apportioned to them as inheritances,
verses.textEn: Now these are the areas the Israelites received as an inheritance in the land of Canaan, which Eleazar the priest, Joshua son of Nun and the heads of the tribal clans of Israel allotted to them.

verses.textZh: 是照着耶和华借着摩西所吩咐的，以抽签的方法把产业分给九个半支派。
verses.textZhCnvs: 是照着耶和华借着摩西所吩咐的，以抽签的方法把产业分给九个半支派。
verses.textZhCuv: 是照耶和华藉摩西所吩咐的，把产业拈阄分给九个半支派。
verses.textEnNiv: Their inheritances were assigned by lot to the nine-and-a-half tribes, as the Lord had commanded through Moses.
verses.textEnEsv: Their inheritance was by lot, just as the Lord had commanded by the hand of Moses for the nine and one-half tribes.
verses.textEnNkjv: Their inheritance was by lot, as the Lord had commanded by the hand of Moses, for the nine tribes and the half-tribe.
verses.textEnNlt: These nine and a half tribes received their grants of land by means of sacred lots, in accordance with the Lord ’s command through Moses.
verses.textEnNasb: by the lot of their inheritance, just as the Lord commanded through Moses, for the nine tribes and the half-tribe.
verses.textEn: Their inheritances were assigned by lot to the nine-and-a-half tribes, as the Lord had commanded through Moses.

verses.textZh: 因为摩西在约旦河东已经把产业分给了那两个半支派；却没有把产业分给他们中间的利未人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为摩西在约旦河东已经把产业分给了那两个半支派；却没有把产业分给他们中间的利未人。
verses.textZhCuv: 原来，摩西在约旦河东已经把产业分给那两个半支派，只是在他们中间没有把产业分给利未人。
verses.textEnNiv: Moses had granted the two-and-a-half tribes their inheritance east of the Jordan but had not granted the Levites an inheritance among the rest,
verses.textEnEsv: For Moses had given an inheritance to the two and one-half tribes beyond the Jordan, but to the Levites he gave no inheritance among them.
verses.textEnNkjv: For Moses had given the inheritance of the two tribes and the half-tribe on the other side of the Jordan; but to the Levites he had given no inheritance among them.
verses.textEnNlt: Moses had already given a grant of land to the two and a half tribes on the east side of the Jordan River, but he had given the Levites no such allotment.
verses.textEnNasb: For Moses had given the inheritance of the two tribes and the half-tribe beyond the Jordan; but he did not give an inheritance to the Levites among them.
verses.textEn: Moses had granted the two-and-a-half tribes their inheritance east of the Jordan but had not granted the Levites an inheritance among the rest,

verses.textZh: 因为约瑟的子孙成了两个支派，就是玛拿西和以法莲，因此以色列人没有把地业分给在那地的利未人，只给他们一些城市居住，还有城市的郊野，可以牧放他们的牲畜，安置他们的财产。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为约瑟的子孙成了两个支派，就是玛拿西和以法莲，因此以色列人没有把地业分给在那地的利未人，只给他们一些城市居住，还有城市的郊野，可以牧放他们的牲畜，安置他们的财产。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为约瑟的子孙是两个支派，就是玛拿西和以法莲，所以没有把地分给利未人，但给他们城邑居住，并城邑的郊野，可以牧养他们的牲畜，安置他们的财物。
verses.textEnNiv: for Joseph’s descendants had become two tribes—Manasseh and Ephraim. The Levites received no share of the land but only towns to live in, with pasturelands for their flocks and herds.
verses.textEnEsv: For the people of Joseph were two tribes, Manasseh and Ephraim. And no portion was given to the Levites in the land, but only cities to dwell in, with their pasturelands for their livestock and their substance.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the children of Joseph were two tribes: Manasseh and Ephraim. And they gave no part to the Levites in the land, except cities to dwell in, with their common-lands for their livestock and their property.
verses.textEnNlt: The descendants of Joseph had become two separate tribes—Manasseh and Ephraim. And the Levites were given no land at all, only towns to live in with surrounding pasturelands for their livestock and all their possessions.
verses.textEnNasb: For the sons of Joseph were two tribes, Manasseh and Ephraim, and they did not give a portion to the Levites in the land, except cities to live in, with their pasture lands for their livestock and for their property.
verses.textEn: for Joseph’s descendants had become two tribes—Manasseh and Ephraim. The Levites received no share of the land but only towns to live in, with pasturelands for their flocks and herds.

verses.textZh: 耶和华怎样吩咐摩西，以色列人就照样行，把地分配了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华怎样吩咐摩西，以色列人就照样行，把地分配了。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华怎样吩咐摩西，以色列人就照样行，把地分了。
verses.textEnNiv: So the Israelites divided the land, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.
verses.textEnEsv: The people of Israel did as the Lord commanded Moses; they allotted the land.
verses.textEnNkjv: As the Lord had commanded Moses, so the children of Israel did; and they divided the land.
verses.textEnNlt: So the land was distributed in strict accordance with the Lord ’s commands to Moses.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Israel did exactly as the Lord had commanded Moses, and they divided the land.
verses.textEn: So the Israelites divided the land, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.

verses.textZh: 犹大人来到吉甲约书亚那里，基尼洗人耶孚尼的儿子迦勒对约书亚说："耶和华在加低斯．巴尼亚对神人摩西所说关于你和我的话，你是知道的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大人来到吉甲约书亚那里，基尼洗人耶孚尼的儿子迦勒对约书亚说："耶和华在加低斯．巴尼亚对神人摩西所说关于你和我的话，你是知道的。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，犹大人来到吉甲见约书亚，有基尼洗族耶孚尼的儿子迦勒对约书亚说：「耶和华在加低斯‧巴尼亚指着我与你对神人摩西所说的话，你都知道了。
verses.textEnNiv: Now the people of Judah approached Joshua at Gilgal, and Caleb son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite said to him, "You know what the Lord said to Moses the man of God at Kadesh Barnea about you and me.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the people of Judah came to Joshua at Gilgal. And Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite said to him, "You know what the Lord said to Moses the man of God in Kadesh-barnea concerning you and me.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the children of Judah came to Joshua in Gilgal. And Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite said to him: "You know the word which the Lord said to Moses the man of God concerning you and me in Kadesh Barnea.
verses.textEnNlt: A delegation from the tribe of Judah, led by Caleb son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite, came to Joshua at Gilgal. Caleb said to Joshua, "Remember what the Lord said to Moses, the man of God, about you and me when we were at Kadesh-barnea.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the sons of Judah approached Joshua in Gilgal, and Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite said to him, "You know the word which the Lord spoke to Moses the man of God on account of you and me in Kadesh-barnea.
verses.textEn: Now the people of Judah approached Joshua at Gilgal, and Caleb son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite said to him, "You know what the Lord said to Moses the man of God at Kadesh Barnea about you and me.

verses.textZh: 耶和华的仆人摩西从加低斯．巴尼亚派我去窥探这地的时候，我正四十岁；我照着我心里所想的向他报告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的仆人摩西从加低斯．巴尼亚派我去窥探这地的时候，我正四十岁；我照着我心里所想的向他报告。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的仆人摩西从加低斯‧巴尼亚打发我窥探这地，那时我正四十岁；我按着心意回报他。
verses.textEnNiv: I was forty years old when Moses the servant of the Lord sent me from Kadesh Barnea to explore the land. And I brought him back a report according to my convictions,
verses.textEnEsv: I was forty years old when Moses the servant of the Lord sent me from Kadesh-barnea to spy out the land, and I brought him word again as it was in my heart.
verses.textEnNkjv: I was forty years old when Moses the servant of the Lord sent me from Kadesh Barnea to spy out the land, and I brought back word to him as itwas in my heart.
verses.textEnNlt: I was forty years old when Moses, the servant of the Lord , sent me from Kadesh-barnea to explore the land of Canaan. I returned and gave an honest report,
verses.textEnNasb: I was forty years old when Moses the servant of the Lord sent me from Kadesh-barnea to spy out the land, and I brought word back to him as it was in my heart.
verses.textEn: I was forty years old when Moses the servant of the Lord sent me from Kadesh Barnea to explore the land. And I brought him back a report according to my convictions,

verses.textZh: 可是，与我一同上去的众兄弟却使人民的心惊惧，我却完全顺从耶和华我的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 可是，与我一同上去的众兄弟却使人民的心惊惧，我却完全顺从耶和华我的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 然而，同我上去的众弟兄使百姓的心消化；但我专心跟从耶和华－我的神。
verses.textEnNiv: but my fellow Israelites who went up with me made the hearts of the people melt in fear. I, however, followed the Lord my God wholeheartedly.
verses.textEnEsv: But my brothers who went up with me made the heart of the people melt; yet I wholly followed the Lord my God.
verses.textEnNkjv: Nevertheless my brethren who went up with me made the heart of the people melt, but I wholly followed the Lord my God.
verses.textEnNlt: but my brothers who went with me frightened the people from entering the Promised Land. For my part, I wholeheartedly followed the Lord my God.
verses.textEnNasb: Nevertheless my brothers who went up with me made the heart of the people melt with fear; but I followed the Lord my God fully.
verses.textEn: but my fellow Israelites who went up with me made the hearts of the people melt in fear. I, however, followed the Lord my God wholeheartedly.

verses.textZh: 那天摩西起誓说：‘你的脚踏过的地都必归你和你的子孙作产业，直到永远，因为你完全顺从耶和华我的神。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 那天摩西起誓说：‘你的脚踏过的地都必归你和你的子孙作产业，直到永远，因为你完全顺从耶和华我的神。’
verses.textZhCuv: 当日摩西起誓说：『你脚所踏之地定要归你和你的子孙永远为业，因为你专心跟从耶和华－我的神。』
verses.textEnNiv: So on that day Moses swore to me, ‘The land on which your feet have walked will be your inheritance and that of your children forever, because you have followed the Lord my God wholeheartedly.’
verses.textEnEsv: And Moses swore on that day, saying, ‘Surely the land on which your foot has trodden shall be an inheritance for you and your children forever, because you have wholly followed the Lord my God.’
verses.textEnNkjv: So Moses swore on that day, saying, ‘Surely the land where your foot has trodden shall be your inheritance and your children’s forever, because you have wholly followed the Lord my God.’
verses.textEnNlt: So that day Moses solemnly promised me, ‘The land of Canaan on which you were just walking will be your grant of land and that of your descendants forever, because you wholeheartedly followed the Lord my God.’
verses.textEnNasb: So Moses swore on that day, saying, ‘The land on which your foot has walked shall certainly be an inheritance to you and to your children forever, because you have followed the Lord my God fully.’
verses.textEn: So on that day Moses swore to me, ‘The land on which your feet have walked will be your inheritance and that of your children forever, because you have followed the Lord my God wholeheartedly.’

verses.textZh: 现在你看，自从耶和华对摩西说了这话以后，耶和华照着所应许的，使我活了这四十五年，就是以色列人在旷野行走的时期；现在你看，我今日已经是八十五岁了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在你看，自从耶和华对摩西说了这话以后，耶和华照着所应许的，使我活了这四十五年，就是以色列人在旷野行走的时期；现在你看，我今日已经是八十五岁了。
verses.textZhCuv: 自从耶和华对摩西说这话的时候，耶和华照他所应许的使我存活这四十五年；其间以色列人在旷野行走。看哪，现今我八十五岁了，
verses.textEnNiv: "Now then, just as the Lord promised, he has kept me alive for forty-five years since the time he said this to Moses, while Israel moved about in the wilderness. So here I am today, eighty-five years old!
verses.textEnEsv: And now, behold, the Lord has kept me alive, just as he said, these forty-five years since the time that the Lord spoke this word to Moses, while Israel walked in the wilderness. And now, behold, I am this day eighty-five years old.
verses.textEnNkjv: And now, behold, the Lord has kept me alive, as He said, these forty-five years, ever since the Lord spoke this word to Moses while Israel wandered in the wilderness; and now, here I am this day, eighty-five years old.
verses.textEnNlt: "Now, as you can see, the Lord has kept me alive and well as he promised for all these forty-five years since Moses made this promise—even while Israel wandered in the wilderness. Today I am eighty-five years old.
verses.textEnNasb: And now behold, the Lord has let me live, just as He spoke, these forty-five years, from the time that the Lord spoke this word to Moses, when Israel walked in the wilderness; and now behold, I am eighty-five years old today.
verses.textEn: "Now then, just as the Lord promised, he has kept me alive for forty-five years since the time he said this to Moses, while Israel moved about in the wilderness. So here I am today, eighty-five years old!

verses.textZh: 今日我还是强壮，像摩西派我去的那天一样；无论是作战，或是出入，那时我的力量怎样，现在我的力量还是怎样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 今日我还是强壮，像摩西派我去的那天一样；无论是作战，或是出入，那时我的力量怎样，现在我的力量还是怎样。
verses.textZhCuv: 我还是强壮，像摩西打发我去的那天一样；无论是争战，是出入，我的力量那时如何，现在还是如何。
verses.textEnNiv: I am still as strong today as the day Moses sent me out; I’m just as vigorous to go out to battle now as I was then.
verses.textEnEsv: I am still as strong today as I was in the day that Moses sent me; my strength now is as my strength was then, for war and for going and coming.
verses.textEnNkjv: As yet I amas strong this day as on the day that Moses sent me; just as my strength was then, so now is my strength for war, both for going out and for coming in.
verses.textEnNlt: I am as strong now as I was when Moses sent me on that journey, and I can still travel and fight as well as I could then.
verses.textEnNasb: I am still as strong today as I was on the day Moses sent me; as my strength was then, so my strength is now, for war and for going out and coming in.
verses.textEn: I am still as strong today as the day Moses sent me out; I’m just as vigorous to go out to battle now as I was then.

verses.textZh: 现在求你把耶和华那日所应许的这山地赐给我；因为那天你也曾听见那里有亚衲人，又有宽大坚固的城；也许耶和华与我同在，我就可以把他们赶出去，正如耶和华所应许的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在求你把耶和华那日所应许的这山地赐给我；因为那天你也曾听见那里有亚衲人，又有宽大坚固的城；也许耶和华与我同在，我就可以把他们赶出去，正如耶和华所应许的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 求你将耶和华那日应许我的这山地给我；那里有亚衲族人，并宽大坚固的城，你也曾听见了。或者耶和华照他所应许的与我同在，我就把他们赶出去。」
verses.textEnNiv: Now give me this hill country that the Lord promised me that day. You yourself heard then that the Anakites were there and their cities were large and fortified, but, the Lord helping me, I will drive them out just as he said."
verses.textEnEsv: So now give me this hill country of which the Lord spoke on that day, for you heard on that day how the Anakim were there, with great fortified cities. It may be that the Lord will be with me, and I shall drive them out just as the Lord said."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now therefore, give me this mountain of which the Lord spoke in that day; for you heard in that day how the Anakim were there, and that the cities were great and fortified. It may be that the Lordwillbe with me, and I shall be able to drive them out as the Lord said."
verses.textEnNlt: So give me the hill country that the Lord promised me. You will remember that as scouts we found the descendants of Anak living there in great, walled towns. But if the Lord is with me, I will drive them out of the land, just as the Lord said."
verses.textEnNasb: Now then, give me this hill country about which the Lord spoke on that day, for you heard on that day that Anakim were there, with great fortified cities; perhaps the Lord will be with me, and I will drive them out just as the Lord has spoken."
verses.textEn: Now give me this hill country that the Lord promised me that day. You yourself heard then that the Anakites were there and their cities were large and fortified, but, the Lord helping me, I will drive them out just as he said."

verses.textZh: 于是约书亚给迦勒祝福，把希伯仑赐给了耶孚尼的儿子迦勒作产业。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是约书亚给迦勒祝福，把希伯仑赐给了耶孚尼的儿子迦勒作产业。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是约书亚为耶孚尼的儿子迦勒祝福，将希伯仑给他为业。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Joshua blessed Caleb son of Jephunneh and gave him Hebron as his inheritance.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Joshua blessed him, and he gave Hebron to Caleb the son of Jephunneh for an inheritance.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Joshua blessed him, and gave Hebron to Caleb the son of Jephunneh as an inheritance.
verses.textEnNlt: So Joshua blessed Caleb son of Jephunneh and gave Hebron to him as his portion of land.
verses.textEnNasb: So Joshua blessed him and gave Hebron to Caleb the son of Jephunneh as an inheritance.
verses.textEn: Then Joshua blessed Caleb son of Jephunneh and gave him Hebron as his inheritance.

verses.textZh: 因此，希伯仑成了基尼洗人耶孚尼的儿子迦勒的产业，直到今日；因为他完全顺从耶和华以色列的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，希伯仑成了基尼洗人耶孚尼的儿子迦勒的产业，直到今日；因为他完全顺从耶和华以色列的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以希伯仑作了基尼洗族耶孚尼的儿子迦勒的产业，直到今日，因为他专心跟从耶和华－以色列的神。
verses.textEnNiv: So Hebron has belonged to Caleb son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite ever since, because he followed the Lord , the God of Israel, wholeheartedly.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore Hebron became the inheritance of Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite to this day, because he wholly followed the Lord , the God of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Hebron therefore became the inheritance of Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite to this day, because he wholly followed the Lord God of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: Hebron still belongs to the descendants of Caleb son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite because he wholeheartedly followed the Lord , the God of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, Hebron became the inheritance of Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite to this day, because he followed the Lord God of Israel fully.
verses.textEn: So Hebron has belonged to Caleb son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite ever since, because he followed the Lord , the God of Israel, wholeheartedly.

verses.textZh: 希伯仑从前名叫基列．亚巴；亚巴是亚衲人中最伟大的人。全地也就止息了战争。
verses.textZhCnvs: 希伯仑从前名叫基列．亚巴；亚巴是亚衲人中最伟大的人。全地也就止息了战争。
verses.textZhCuv: 希伯仑从前名叫基列‧亚巴；亚巴是亚衲族中最尊大的人。于是国中太平，没有争战了。
verses.textEnNiv: (Hebron used to be called Kiriath Arba after Arba, who was the greatest man among the Anakites.) Then the land had rest from war.
verses.textEnEsv: Now the name of Hebron formerly was Kiriath-arba. (Arba was the greatest man among the Anakim.) And the land had rest from war.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the name of Hebron formerly was Kirjath Arba (Arbawas the greatest man among the Anakim). Then the land had rest from war.
verses.textEnNlt: (Previously Hebron had been called Kiriath-arba. It had been named after Arba, a great hero of the descendants of Anak.) And the land had rest from war.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the name of Hebron was previously Kiriath-arba; for Arba was the greatest man among the Anakim. Then the land was at rest from war.
verses.textEn: (Hebron used to be called Kiriath Arba after Arba, who was the greatest man among the Anakites.) Then the land had rest from war.

verses.textZh: 犹大支派按着家族抽签所得的地业，是极南的部分，达到以东的边境，去到南边寻的旷野。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大支派按着家族抽签所得的地业，是极南的部分，达到以东的边境，去到南边寻的旷野。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大支派按着宗族拈阄所得之地是在尽南边，到以东的交界，向南直到寻的旷野。
verses.textEnNiv: The allotment for the tribe of Judah, according to its clans, extended down to the territory of Edom, to the Desert of Zin in the extreme south.
verses.textEnEsv: The allotment for the tribe of the people of Judah according to their clans reached southward to the boundary of Edom, to the wilderness of Zin at the farthest south.
verses.textEnNkjv: So this was the lot of the tribe of the children of Judah according to their families: The border of Edom at the Wilderness of Zin southward was the extreme southern boundary.
verses.textEnNlt: The allotment for the clans of the tribe of Judah reached southward to the border of Edom, as far south as the wilderness of Zin.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the lot for the tribe of the sons of Judah according to their families reached the border of Edom, southward to the wilderness of Zin at the extreme south.
verses.textEn: The allotment for the tribe of Judah, according to its clans, extended down to the territory of Edom, to the Desert of Zin in the extreme south.

verses.textZh: 他们南方的疆界是从盐海的极南部分起，就是从南边的海湾起；
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们南方的疆界是从盐海的极南部分起，就是从南边的海湾起；
verses.textZhCuv: 他们的南界是从盐海的尽边，就是从朝南的海汊起，
verses.textEnNiv: Their southern boundary started from the bay at the southern end of the Dead Sea,
verses.textEnEsv: And their south boundary ran from the end of the Salt Sea, from the bay that faces southward.
verses.textEnNkjv: And their southern border began at the shore of the Salt Sea, from the bay that faces southward.
verses.textEnNlt: The southern boundary began at the south bay of the Dead Sea,
verses.textEnNasb: Their southern border was from the lower end of the Salt Sea, from the bay that turns to the south.
verses.textEn: Their southern boundary started from the bay at the southern end of the Dead Sea,

verses.textZh: 伸到亚克拉滨山坡的南边，经过寻，上到加低斯．巴尼亚的南边，又经过希斯仑，再上到亚达珥，绕过甲加，
verses.textZhCnvs: 伸到亚克拉滨山坡的南边，经过寻，上到加低斯．巴尼亚的南边，又经过希斯仑，再上到亚达珥，绕过甲加，
verses.textZhCuv: 通到亚克拉滨坡的南边，接连到寻，上到加低斯‧巴尼亚的南边，又过希斯仑，上到亚达珥，绕到甲加，
verses.textEnNiv: crossed south of Scorpion Pass, continued on to Zin and went over to the south of Kadesh Barnea. Then it ran past Hezron up to Addar and curved around to Karka.
verses.textEnEsv: It goes out southward of the ascent of Akrabbim, passes along to Zin, and goes up south of Kadesh-barnea, along by Hezron, up to Addar, turns about to Karka,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then it went out to the southern side of the Ascent of Akrabbim, passed along to Zin, ascended on the south side of Kadesh Barnea, passed along to Hezron, went up to Adar, and went around to Karkaa.
verses.textEnNlt: ran south of Scorpion Pass into the wilderness of Zin, and then went south of Kadesh-barnea to Hezron. Then it went up to Addar, where it turned toward Karka.
verses.textEnNasb: Then it proceeded southward to the ascent of Akrabbim and continued to Zin, then went up by the south of Kadesh-barnea and continued to Hezron, and went up to Addar and turned to Karka.
verses.textEn: crossed south of Scorpion Pass, continued on to Zin and went over to the south of Kadesh Barnea. Then it ran past Hezron up to Addar and curved around to Karka.

verses.textZh: 经过押们，伸展到埃及河，疆界直通到海；这就是他们 南方的疆界。
verses.textZhCnvs: 经过押们，伸展到埃及河，疆界直通到海；这就是他们 南方的疆界。
verses.textZhCuv: 接连到押们，通到埃及小河，直通到海为止。这就是他们的南界。
verses.textEnNiv: It then passed along to Azmon and joined the Wadi of Egypt, ending at the Mediterranean Sea. This is their southern boundary.
verses.textEnEsv: passes along to Azmon, goes out by the Brook of Egypt, and comes to its end at the sea. This shall be your south boundary.
verses.textEnNkjv: Fromthere it passed toward Azmon and went out to the Brook of Egypt; and the border ended at the sea. This shall be your southern border.
verses.textEnNlt: From there it passed to Azmon until it finally reached the Brook of Egypt, which it followed to the Mediterranean Sea. This was their southern boundary.
verses.textEnNasb: It continued to Azmon and proceeded to the brook of Egypt, and the border ended at the sea. This shall be your southern border.
verses.textEn: It then passed along to Azmon and joined the Wadi of Egypt, ending at the Mediterranean Sea. This is their southern boundary.

verses.textZh: 东方的疆界是从盐海直到约旦河口。北方的疆界是从约旦河口的海湾起，
verses.textZhCnvs: 东方的疆界是从盐海直到约旦河口。北方的疆界是从约旦河口的海湾起，
verses.textZhCuv: 东界是从盐海南边到约旦河口。北界是从约旦河口的海汊起，
verses.textEnNiv: The eastern boundary is the Dead Sea as far as the mouth of the Jordan. The northern boundary started from the bay of the sea at the mouth of the Jordan,
verses.textEnEsv: And the east boundary is the Salt Sea, to the mouth of the Jordan. And the boundary on the north side runs from the bay of the sea at the mouth of the Jordan.
verses.textEnNkjv: The east border was the Salt Sea as far as the mouth of the Jordan. And the border on the northern quarter began at the bay of the sea at the mouth of the Jordan.
verses.textEnNlt: The eastern boundary extended along the Dead Sea to the mouth of the Jordan River. The northern boundary began at the bay where the Jordan River empties into the Dead Sea,
verses.textEnNasb: The eastern border was the Salt Sea, as far as the mouth of the Jordan. And the border of the north side was from the bay of the sea at the mouth of the Jordan.
verses.textEn: The eastern boundary is the Dead Sea as far as the mouth of the Jordan. The northern boundary started from the bay of the sea at the mouth of the Jordan,

verses.textZh: 上到伯．曷拉，经过伯．亚拉巴的北边，再上到流本的儿子波罕的盘石那里；
verses.textZhCnvs: 上到伯．曷拉，经过伯．亚拉巴的北边，再上到流本的儿子波罕的盘石那里；
verses.textZhCuv: 上到伯‧曷拉，过伯‧亚拉巴的北边，上到吕便之子波罕的磐石；
verses.textEnNiv: went up to Beth Hoglah and continued north of Beth Arabah to the Stone of Bohan son of Reuben.
verses.textEnEsv: And the boundary goes up to Beth-hoglah and passes along north of Beth-arabah. And the boundary goes up to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben.
verses.textEnNkjv: The border went up to Beth Hoglah and passed north of Beth Arabah; and the border went up to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben.
verses.textEnNlt: went up from there to Beth-hoglah, then proceeded north of Beth-arabah to the Stone of Bohan. (Bohan was Reuben’s son.)
verses.textEnNasb: Then the border went up to Beth-hoglah, and continued on the north of Beth-arabah, and the border went up to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben.
verses.textEn: went up to Beth Hoglah and continued north of Beth Arabah to the Stone of Bohan son of Reuben.

verses.textZh: 又从亚割谷上到底璧，再北转到河的南边亚都冥山坡对面的吉甲去；又经过隐．示麦水泉，直通到隐．罗结；
verses.textZhCnvs: 又从亚割谷上到底璧，再北转到河的南边亚都冥山坡对面的吉甲去；又经过隐．示麦水泉，直通到隐．罗结；
verses.textZhCuv: 从亚割谷往北，上到底璧，直向河南亚都冥坡对面的吉甲；又接连到隐‧示麦泉，直通到隐‧罗结，
verses.textEnNiv: The boundary then went up to Debir from the Valley of Achor and turned north to Gilgal, which faces the Pass of Adummim south of the gorge. It continued along to the waters of En Shemesh and came out at En Rogel.
verses.textEnEsv: And the boundary goes up to Debir from the Valley of Achor, and so northward, turning toward Gilgal, which is opposite the ascent of Adummim, which is on the south side of the valley. And the boundary passes along to the waters of En-shemesh and ends at En-rogel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the border went up toward Debir from the Valley of Achor, and it turned northward toward Gilgal, which is before the Ascent of Adummim, which is on the south side of the valley. The border continued toward the waters of En Shemesh and ended at En Rogel.
verses.textEnNlt: From that point it went through the valley of Achor to Debir, turning north toward Gilgal, which is across from the slopes of Adummim on the south side of the valley. From there the boundary extended to the springs at En-shemesh and on to En-rogel.
verses.textEnNasb: And the border went up to Debir from the Valley of Achor, and turned northward toward Gilgal which is opposite the ascent of Adummim, which is on the south of the valley; and the border continued to the waters of En-shemesh and it ended at En-rogel.
verses.textEn: The boundary then went up to Debir from the Valley of Achor and turned north to Gilgal, which faces the Pass of Adummim south of the gorge. It continued along to the waters of En Shemesh and came out at En Rogel.

verses.textZh: 再上到欣嫩子谷，到达耶布斯南面的山坡，耶布斯就是耶路撒冷；又上到欣嫩子谷西边的山顶，就是在利乏音的北端；
verses.textZhCnvs: 再上到欣嫩子谷，到达耶布斯南面的山坡，耶布斯就是耶路撒冷；又上到欣嫩子谷西边的山顶，就是在利乏音的北端；
verses.textZhCuv: 上到欣嫩子谷，贴近耶布斯的南界（耶布斯就是耶路撒冷）；又上到欣嫩谷西边的山顶，就是在利乏音谷极北的边界；
verses.textEnNiv: Then it ran up the Valley of Ben Hinnom along the southern slope of the Jebusite city (that is, Jerusalem). From there it climbed to the top of the hill west of the Hinnom Valley at the northern end of the Valley of Rephaim.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the boundary goes up by the Valley of the Son of Hinnom at the southern shoulder of the Jebusite ( that is, Jerusalem). And the boundary goes up to the top of the mountain that lies over against the Valley of Hinnom, on the west, at the northern end of the Valley of Rephaim.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the border went up by the Valley of the Son of Hinnom to the southern slope of the Jebusite city (which is Jerusalem). The border went up to the top of the mountain that lies before the Valley of Hinnom westward, which is at the end of the Valley of Rephaim northward.
verses.textEnNlt: The boundary then passed through the valley of Ben-Hinnom, along the southern slopes of the Jebusites, where the city of Jerusalem is located. Then it went west to the top of the mountain above the valley of Hinnom, and on up to the northern end of the valley of Rephaim.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the border went up the Valley of Ben-hinnom to the slope of the Jebusite on the south (that is, Jerusalem); and the border went up to the top of the mountain which is opposite the Valley of Hinnom to the west, which is at the end of the Valley of Rephaim toward the north.
verses.textEn: Then it ran up the Valley of Ben Hinnom along the southern slope of the Jebusite city (that is, Jerusalem). From there it climbed to the top of the hill west of the Hinnom Valley at the northern end of the Valley of Rephaim.

verses.textZh: 又从山顶转到尼弗多亚的水泉，伸展到以弗仑山的众城；又转到巴拉，巴拉就是基列．耶琳；
verses.textZhCnvs: 又从山顶转到尼弗多亚的水泉，伸展到以弗仑山的众城；又转到巴拉，巴拉就是基列．耶琳；
verses.textZhCuv: 又从山顶延到尼弗多亚的水源，通到以弗仑山的城邑，又延到巴拉（巴拉就是基列‧耶琳）；
verses.textEnNiv: From the hilltop the boundary headed toward the spring of the waters of Nephtoah, came out at the towns of Mount Ephron and went down toward Baalah (that is, Kiriath Jearim).
verses.textEnEsv: Then the boundary extends from the top of the mountain to the spring of the waters of Nephtoah, and from there to the cities of Mount Ephron. Then the boundary bends around to Baalah ( that is, Kiriath-jearim).
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the border went around from the top of the hill to the fountain of the water of Nephtoah, and extended to the cities of Mount Ephron. And the border went around to Baalah (which is Kirjath Jearim).
verses.textEnNlt: From there the boundary extended from the top of the mountain to the spring at the waters of Nephtoah, and from there to the towns on Mount Ephron. Then it turned toward Baalah (that is, Kiriath-jearim).
verses.textEnNasb: And from the top of the mountain the border turned to the spring of the waters of Nephtoah and proceeded to the cities of Mount Ephron, then the border turned to Baalah (that is, Kiriath-jearim).
verses.textEn: From the hilltop the boundary headed toward the spring of the waters of Nephtoah, came out at the towns of Mount Ephron and went down toward Baalah (that is, Kiriath Jearim).

verses.textZh: 又从巴拉向西绕到西珥山，经过耶琳山坡的北边，耶琳就是基撒仑；又下到伯．示麦，经过亭纳；
verses.textZhCnvs: 又从巴拉向西绕到西珥山，经过耶琳山坡的北边，耶琳就是基撒仑；又下到伯．示麦，经过亭纳；
verses.textZhCuv: 又从巴拉往西绕到西珥山，接连到耶琳山的北边（耶琳就是基撒仑）；又下到伯‧示麦过亭纳，
verses.textEnNiv: Then it curved westward from Baalah to Mount Seir, ran along the northern slope of Mount Jearim (that is, Kesalon), continued down to Beth Shemesh and crossed to Timnah.
verses.textEnEsv: And the boundary circles west of Baalah to Mount Seir, passes along to the northern shoulder of Mount Jearim (that is, Chesalon), and goes down to Beth-shemesh and passes along by Timnah.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the border turned westward from Baalah to Mount Seir, passed along to the side of Mount Jearim on the north (which is Chesalon), went down to Beth Shemesh, and passed on to Timnah.
verses.textEnNlt: The boundary circled west of Baalah to Mount Seir, passed along to the town of Kesalon on the northern slope of Mount Jearim, and went down to Beth-shemesh and on to Timnah.
verses.textEnNasb: The border turned from Baalah westward to Mount Seir, and continued to the slope of Mount Jearim on the north (that is, Chesalon), and went down to Beth-shemesh and continued through Timnah.
verses.textEn: Then it curved westward from Baalah to Mount Seir, ran along the northern slope of Mount Jearim (that is, Kesalon), continued down to Beth Shemesh and crossed to Timnah.

verses.textZh: 伸展到以革伦北面的山坡，转到施基仑，经过巴拉山，伸展到雅比聂，直通到海为止。
verses.textZhCnvs: 伸展到以革伦北面的山坡，转到施基仑，经过巴拉山，伸展到雅比聂，直通到海为止。
verses.textZhCuv: 通到以革伦北边，延到施基仑，接连到巴拉山；又通到雅比聂，直通到海为止。
verses.textEnNiv: It went to the northern slope of Ekron, turned toward Shikkeron, passed along to Mount Baalah and reached Jabneel. The boundary ended at the sea.
verses.textEnEsv: The boundary goes out to the shoulder of the hill north of Ekron, then the boundary bends around to Shikkeron and passes along to Mount Baalah and goes out to Jabneel. Then the boundary comes to an end at the sea.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the border went out to the side of Ekron northward. Then the border went around to Shicron, passed along to Mount Baalah, and extended to Jabneel; and the border ended at the sea.
verses.textEnNlt: The boundary then proceeded to the slope of the hill north of Ekron, where it turned toward Shikkeron and Mount Baalah. It passed Jabneel and ended at the Mediterranean Sea.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the border proceeded to the side of Ekron northward. And the border turned to Shikkeron and continued to Mount Baalah and proceeded to Jabneel, and the border ended at the sea.
verses.textEn: It went to the northern slope of Ekron, turned toward Shikkeron, passed along to Mount Baalah and reached Jabneel. The boundary ended at the sea.

verses.textZh: 西方的疆界就是大海和海岸。这是犹大人按着家族所得四围的境界。
verses.textZhCnvs: 西方的疆界就是大海和海岸。这是犹大人按着家族所得四围的境界。
verses.textZhCuv: 西界就是大海和靠近大海之地。这是犹大人按着宗族所得之地四围的交界。
verses.textEnNiv: The western boundary is the coastline of the Mediterranean Sea. These are the boundaries around the people of Judah by their clans.
verses.textEnEsv: And the west boundary was the Great Sea with its coastline. This is the boundary around the people of Judah according to their clans.
verses.textEnNkjv: The west border was the coastline of the Great Sea. This is the boundary of the children of Judah all around according to their families.
verses.textEnNlt: The western boundary was the shoreline of the Mediterranean Sea. These are the boundaries for the clans of the tribe of Judah.
verses.textEnNasb: The western border was at the Great Sea, even its coastline. This is the border around the sons of Judah according to their families.
verses.textEn: The western boundary is the coastline of the Mediterranean Sea. These are the boundaries around the people of Judah by their clans.

verses.textZh: 约书亚照着耶和华所吩咐的，把犹大人的一份地业，就是基列．亚巴，分给了耶孚尼的儿子迦勒；亚巴是亚衲人的祖先。基列．亚巴就是希伯仑。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约书亚照着耶和华所吩咐的，把犹大人的一份地业，就是基列．亚巴，分给了耶孚尼的儿子迦勒；亚巴是亚衲人的祖先。基列．亚巴就是希伯仑。
verses.textZhCuv: 约书亚照耶和华所吩咐的，将犹大人中的一段地，就是基列‧亚巴，分给耶孚尼的儿子迦勒。亚巴是亚衲族的始祖（基列‧亚巴就是希伯仑）。
verses.textEnNiv: In accordance with the Lord ’s command to him, Joshua gave to Caleb son of Jephunneh a portion in Judah—Kiriath Arba, that is, Hebron. (Arba was the forefather of Anak.)
verses.textEnEsv: According to the commandment of the Lord to Joshua, he gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh a portion among the people of Judah, Kiriath-arba, that is, Hebron (Arba was the father of Anak).
verses.textEnNkjv: Now to Caleb the son of Jephunneh he gave a share among the children of Judah, according to the commandment of the Lord to Joshua, namely, Kirjath Arba, which is Hebron (Arbawas the father of Anak).
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord commanded Joshua to assign some of Judah’s territory to Caleb son of Jephunneh. So Caleb was given the town of Kiriath-arba (that is, Hebron), which had been named after Anak’s ancestor.
verses.textEnNasb: Now he gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh a portion among the sons of Judah, in accordance with the command of the Lord to Joshua, namely, Kiriath-arba, Arba being the father of Anak (that is, Hebron).
verses.textEn: In accordance with the Lord ’s command to him, Joshua gave to Caleb son of Jephunneh a portion in Judah—Kiriath Arba, that is, Hebron. (Arba was the forefather of Anak.)

verses.textZh: 迦勒把亚衲人的三个子孙，就是示筛、亚希幔、挞买，从那里赶出去；他们是亚衲人的后代。
verses.textZhCnvs: 迦勒把亚衲人的三个子孙，就是示筛、亚希幔、挞买，从那里赶出去；他们是亚衲人的后代。
verses.textZhCuv: 迦勒就从那里赶出亚衲族的三个族长，就是示筛、亚希幔、挞买；
verses.textEnNiv: From Hebron Caleb drove out the three Anakites—Sheshai, Ahiman and Talmai, the sons of Anak.
verses.textEnEsv: And Caleb drove out from there the three sons of Anak, Sheshai and Ahiman and Talmai, the descendants of Anak.
verses.textEnNkjv: Caleb drove out the three sons of Anak from there: Sheshai, Ahiman, and Talmai, the children of Anak.
verses.textEnNlt: Caleb drove out the three groups of Anakites—the descendants of Sheshai, Ahiman, and Talmai, the sons of Anak.
verses.textEnNasb: And Caleb drove out from there the three sons of Anak: Sheshai, Ahiman, and Talmai, the children of Anak.
verses.textEn: From Hebron Caleb drove out the three Anakites—Sheshai, Ahiman and Talmai, the sons of Anak.

verses.textZh: 他又从那里上去攻击底璧的居民；底璧从前名叫基列．西弗。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又从那里上去攻击底璧的居民；底璧从前名叫基列．西弗。
verses.textZhCuv: 又从那里上去，攻击底璧的居民。（这底璧从前名叫基列‧西弗。）
verses.textEnNiv: From there he marched against the people living in Debir (formerly called Kiriath Sepher).
verses.textEnEsv: And he went up from there against the inhabitants of Debir. Now the name of Debir formerly was Kiriath-sepher.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he went up from there to the inhabitants of Debir (formerly the name of Debir was Kirjath Sepher).
verses.textEnNlt: From there he went to fight against the people living in the town of Debir (formerly called Kiriath-sepher).
verses.textEnNasb: Then he went up from there against the inhabitants of Debir; now the name of Debir previously was Kiriath-sepher.
verses.textEn: From there he marched against the people living in Debir (formerly called Kiriath Sepher).

verses.textZh: 迦勒说："谁能攻打基列．西弗，把基列．西弗夺取，我就把我的女儿押撒给他作妻子。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 迦勒说："谁能攻打基列．西弗，把基列．西弗夺取，我就把我的女儿押撒给他作妻子。"
verses.textZhCuv: 迦勒说：「谁能攻打基列‧西弗将城夺取，我就把我女儿押撒给他为妻。」
verses.textEnNiv: And Caleb said, "I will give my daughter Aksah in marriage to the man who attacks and captures Kiriath Sepher."
verses.textEnEsv: And Caleb said, "He who attacks Kiriath-sepher and captures it, I will give him Achsah my daughter as wife."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Caleb said, "He who attacks Kirjath Sepher and takes it, to him I will give Achsah my daughter as wife."
verses.textEnNlt: Caleb said, "I will give my daughter Acsah in marriage to the one who attacks and captures Kiriath-sepher."
verses.textEnNasb: And Caleb said, "The one who attacks Kiriath-sepher and captures it, I will give him Achsah my daughter as a wife."
verses.textEn: And Caleb said, "I will give my daughter Aksah in marriage to the man who attacks and captures Kiriath Sepher."

verses.textZh: 迦勒的兄弟基纳斯的儿子俄陀聂夺取了那城，迦勒就把女儿押撒给他作妻子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 迦勒的兄弟基纳斯的儿子俄陀聂夺取了那城，迦勒就把女儿押撒给他作妻子。
verses.textZhCuv: 迦勒兄弟基纳斯的儿子俄陀聂夺取了那城，迦勒就把女儿押撒给他为妻。
verses.textEnNiv: Othniel son of Kenaz, Caleb’s brother, took it; so Caleb gave his daughter Aksah to him in marriage.
verses.textEnEsv: And Othniel the son of Kenaz, the brother of Caleb, captured it. And he gave him Achsah his daughter as wife.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Othniel the son of Kenaz, the brother of Caleb, took it; and he gave him Achsah his daughter as wife.
verses.textEnNlt: Othniel, the son of Caleb’s brother Kenaz, was the one who conquered it, so Acsah became Othniel’s wife.
verses.textEnNasb: Othniel the son of Kenaz, the brother of Caleb, captured it; so he gave him Achsah his daughter as a wife.
verses.textEn: Othniel son of Kenaz, Caleb’s brother, took it; so Caleb gave his daughter Aksah to him in marriage.

verses.textZh: 押撒出嫁的时候，怂恿丈夫向她父亲求一块田地；押撒一下驴，迦勒问她："你要甚么？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 押撒出嫁的时候，怂恿丈夫向她父亲求一块田地；押撒一下驴，迦勒问她："你要甚么？"
verses.textZhCuv: 押撒过门的时候，劝丈夫向她父亲求一块田，押撒一下驴，迦勒问她说：「你要什么？」
verses.textEnNiv: One day when she came to Othniel, she urged him to ask her father for a field. When she got off her donkey, Caleb asked her, "What can I do for you?"
verses.textEnEsv: When she came to him, she urged him to ask her father for a field. And she dismounted from her donkey, and Caleb said to her, "What do you want?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it was so, when she came tohim, that she persuaded him to ask her father for a field. So she dismounted from her donkey, and Caleb said to her, "What do you wish?"
verses.textEnNlt: When Acsah married Othniel, she urged him to ask her father for a field. As she got down off her donkey, Caleb asked her, "What’s the matter?"
verses.textEnNasb: And it happened that when she came to him, she incited him to ask her father for a field. So she dismounted from the donkey, and Caleb said to her, "What do you want?"
verses.textEn: One day when she came to Othniel, she urged him to ask her father for a field. When she got off her donkey, Caleb asked her, "What can I do for you?"

verses.textZh: 她回答："求你给我祝福；你既然把南地给了我，求你也把水泉给我。"她父亲就把上泉和下泉都给了她。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她回答："求你给我祝福；你既然把南地给了我，求你也把水泉给我。"她父亲就把上泉和下泉都给了她。
verses.textZhCuv: 她说：「求你赐福给我，你既将我安置在南地，求你也给我水泉。」她父亲就把上泉下泉赐给她。
verses.textEnNiv: She replied, "Do me a special favor. Since you have given me land in the Negev, give me also springs of water." So Caleb gave her the upper and lower springs.
verses.textEnEsv: She said to him, "Give me a blessing. Since you have given me the land of the Negeb, give me also springs of water." And he gave her the upper springs and the lower springs.
verses.textEnNkjv: She answered, "Give me a blessing; since you have given me land in the South, give me also springs of water." So he gave her the upper springs and the lower springs.
verses.textEnNlt: She said, "Give me another gift. You have already given me land in the Negev; now please give me springs of water, too." So Caleb gave her the upper and lower springs.
verses.textEnNasb: Then she said, "Give me a blessing; since you have given me the land of the Negev, give me springs of water also." So he gave her the upper springs and the lower springs.
verses.textEn: She replied, "Do me a special favor. Since you have given me land in the Negev, give me also springs of water." So Caleb gave her the upper and lower springs.

verses.textZh: 以下是犹大支派按着家族所得的产业。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以下是犹大支派按着家族所得的产业。
verses.textZhCuv: 以下是犹大支派按着宗族所得的产业。
verses.textEnNiv: This is the inheritance of the tribe of Judah, according to its clans:
verses.textEnEsv: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the people of Judah according to their clans.
verses.textEnNkjv: This was the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Judah according to their families:
verses.textEnNlt: This was the homeland allocated to the clans of the tribe of Judah.
verses.textEnNasb: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Judah according to their families.
verses.textEn: This is the inheritance of the tribe of Judah, according to its clans:

verses.textZh: 犹大支派极南边的众城，接近以东边界的，有：甲薛、以得、雅姑珥、
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大支派极南边的众城，接近以东边界的，有：甲薛、以得、雅姑珥、
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大支派尽南边的城邑，与以东交界相近的，就是甲薛、以得、雅姑珥、
verses.textEnNiv: The southernmost towns of the tribe of Judah in the Negev toward the boundary of Edom were: Kabzeel, Eder, Jagur,
verses.textEnEsv: The cities belonging to the tribe of the people of Judah in the extreme south, toward the boundary of Edom, were Kabzeel, Eder, Jagur,
verses.textEnNkjv: The cities at the limits of the tribe of the children of Judah, toward the border of Edom in the South, were Kabzeel, Eder, Jagur,
verses.textEnNlt: The towns of Judah situated along the borders of Edom in the extreme south were Kabzeel, Eder, Jagur,
verses.textEnNasb: Now the cities at the extremity of the tribe of the sons of Judah toward the border of Edom in the south were Kabzeel, Eder, and Jagur,
verses.textEn: The southernmost towns of the tribe of Judah in the Negev toward the boundary of Edom were: Kabzeel, Eder, Jagur,
