verses.textZh: 又有哈忽、伯．夙、基突、
verses.textZhCnvs: 又有哈忽、伯．夙、基突、
verses.textZhCuv: 又有哈忽、伯‧夙、基突、
verses.textEnNiv: Halhul, Beth Zur, Gedor,
verses.textEnEsv: Halhul, Beth-zur, Gedor,
verses.textEnNkjv: Halhul, Beth Zur, Gedor,
verses.textEnNlt: In addition, there were Halhul, Beth-zur, Gedor,
verses.textEnNasb: Halhul, Beth-zur, and Gedor,
verses.textEn: Halhul, Beth Zur, Gedor,

verses.textZh: 玛腊、伯．亚诺、伊勒提君，共六座城，还有属于这些城的村庄。
verses.textZhCnvs: 玛腊、伯．亚诺、伊勒提君，共六座城，还有属于这些城的村庄。
verses.textZhCuv: 玛腊、伯‧亚诺、伊勒提君，共六座城，还有属城的村庄。
verses.textEnNiv: Maarath, Beth Anoth and Eltekon—six towns and their villages.
verses.textEnEsv: Maarath, Beth-anoth, and Eltekon: six cities with their villages.
verses.textEnNkjv: Maarath, Beth Anoth, and Eltekon: six cities with their villages;
verses.textEnNlt: Maarath, Beth-anoth, and Eltekon—six towns with their surrounding villages.
verses.textEnNasb: Maarath, Beth-anoth, and Eltekon; six cities with their villages.
verses.textEn: Maarath, Beth Anoth and Eltekon—six towns and their villages.

verses.textZh: 又有基列．巴力 、拉巴，共两座城，还有属于这些城的村庄。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又有基列．巴力 、拉巴，共两座城，还有属于这些城的村庄。
verses.textZhCuv: 又有基列‧巴力（基列‧巴力就是基列‧耶琳）、拉巴，共两座城，还有属城的村庄。
verses.textEnNiv: Kiriath Baal (that is, Kiriath Jearim) and Rabbah—two towns and their villages.
verses.textEnEsv: Kiriath-baal (that is, Kiriath-jearim), and Rabbah: two cities with their villages.
verses.textEnNkjv: Kirjath Baal (which is Kirjath Jearim) and Rabbah: two cities with their villages.
verses.textEnNlt: There were also Kiriath-baal (that is, Kiriath-jearim) and Rabbah—two towns with their surrounding villages.
verses.textEnNasb: Kiriath-baal (that is, Kiriath-jearim), and Rabbah; two cities with their villages.
verses.textEn: Kiriath Baal (that is, Kiriath Jearim) and Rabbah—two towns and their villages.

verses.textZh: 在旷野有伯．亚拉巴、密丁、西迦迦、
verses.textZhCnvs: 在旷野有伯．亚拉巴、密丁、西迦迦、
verses.textZhCuv: 在旷野有伯‧亚拉巴、密丁、西迦迦、
verses.textEnNiv: In the wilderness: Beth Arabah, Middin, Sekakah,
verses.textEnEsv: In the wilderness, Beth-arabah, Middin, Secacah,
verses.textEnNkjv: In the wilderness: Beth Arabah, Middin, Secacah,
verses.textEnNlt: In the wilderness there were the towns of Beth-arabah, Middin, Secacah,
verses.textEnNasb: In the wilderness: Beth-arabah, Middin, and Secacah,
verses.textEn: In the wilderness: Beth Arabah, Middin, Sekakah,

verses.textZh: 匿珊、盐城、隐．基底，共六座城，还有属于这些城的村庄。
verses.textZhCnvs: 匿珊、盐城、隐．基底，共六座城，还有属于这些城的村庄。
verses.textZhCuv: 匿珊、盐城、隐‧基底，共六座城，还有属城的村庄。
verses.textEnNiv: Nibshan, the City of Salt and En Gedi—six towns and their villages.
verses.textEnEsv: Nibshan, the City of Salt, and Engedi: six cities with their villages.
verses.textEnNkjv: Nibshan, the City of Salt, and En Gedi: six cities with their villages.
verses.textEnNlt: Nibshan, the City of Salt, and En-gedi—six towns with their surrounding villages.
verses.textEnNasb: Nibshan, the City of Salt, and Engedi; six cities with their villages.
verses.textEn: Nibshan, the City of Salt and En Gedi—six towns and their villages.

verses.textZh: 至于住在耶路撒冷的耶布斯人，犹大人不能把他们赶走；所以耶布斯人在耶路撒冷与犹大人同住，直到今日。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于住在耶路撒冷的耶布斯人，犹大人不能把他们赶走；所以耶布斯人在耶路撒冷与犹大人同住，直到今日。
verses.textZhCuv: 至于住耶路撒冷的耶布斯人，犹大人不能把他们赶出去，耶布斯人却在耶路撒冷与犹大人同住，直到今日。
verses.textEnNiv: Judah could not dislodge the Jebusites, who were living in Jerusalem; to this day the Jebusites live there with the people of Judah.
verses.textEnEsv: But the Jebusites, the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the people of Judah could not drive out, so the Jebusites dwell with the people of Judah at Jerusalem to this day.
verses.textEnNkjv: As for the Jebusites, the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the children of Judah could not drive them out; but the Jebusites dwell with the children of Judah at Jerusalem to this day.
verses.textEnNlt: But the tribe of Judah could not drive out the Jebusites, who lived in the city of Jerusalem, so the Jebusites live there among the people of Judah to this day.
verses.textEnNasb: Now as for the Jebusites, the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the sons of Judah could not drive them out; so the Jebusites live with the sons of Judah in Jerusalem to this day.
verses.textEn: Judah could not dislodge the Jebusites, who were living in Jerusalem; to this day the Jebusites live there with the people of Judah.

verses.textZh: 约瑟的子孙抽签所得的地业，是从靠近耶利哥的约旦河起，到耶利哥东边的水泉，经过从耶利哥上去的旷野，进到在山地的伯特利；
verses.textZhCnvs: 约瑟的子孙抽签所得的地业，是从靠近耶利哥的约旦河起，到耶利哥东边的水泉，经过从耶利哥上去的旷野，进到在山地的伯特利；
verses.textZhCuv: 约瑟的子孙拈阄所得之地是从靠近耶利哥的约旦河起，以耶利哥东边的水为界：从耶利哥上去，通过山地的旷野，到伯特利；
verses.textEnNiv: The allotment for Joseph began at the Jordan, east of the springs of Jericho, and went up from there through the desert into the hill country of Bethel.
verses.textEnEsv: The allotment of the people of Joseph went from the Jordan by Jericho, east of the waters of Jericho, into the wilderness, going up from Jericho into the hill country to Bethel.
verses.textEnNkjv: The lot fell to the children of Joseph from the Jordan, by Jericho, to the waters of Jericho on the east, to the wilderness that goes up from Jericho through the mountains to Bethel,
verses.textEnNlt: The allotment for the descendants of Joseph extended from the Jordan River near Jericho, east of the springs of Jericho, through the wilderness and into the hill country of Bethel.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the lot for the sons of Joseph went from the Jordan at Jericho to the waters of Jericho on the east into the wilderness, going up from Jericho through the hill country to Bethel.
verses.textEn: The allotment for Joseph began at the Jordan, east of the springs of Jericho, and went up from there through the desert into the hill country of Bethel.

verses.textZh: 又从伯特利到路斯，经过亚基人的境界亚他绿，
verses.textZhCnvs: 又从伯特利到路斯，经过亚基人的境界亚他绿，
verses.textZhCuv: 又从伯特利到路斯，接连到亚基人的境界，至亚他绿；
verses.textEnNiv: It went on from Bethel (that is, Luz), crossed over to the territory of the Arkites in Ataroth,
verses.textEnEsv: Then going from Bethel to Luz, it passes along to Ataroth, the territory of the Archites.
verses.textEnNkjv: then went out from Bethel to Luz, passed along to the border of the Archites at Ataroth,
verses.textEnNlt: From Bethel (that is, Luz) it ran over to Ataroth in the territory of the Arkites.
verses.textEnNasb: It went from Bethel to Luz, and continued to the border of the Archites at Ataroth.
verses.textEn: It went on from Bethel (that is, Luz), crossed over to the territory of the Arkites in Ataroth,

verses.textZh: 又向西下到押利提人的境界，去到下伯．和仑和基色的境界，直通到海。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又向西下到押利提人的境界，去到下伯．和仑和基色的境界，直通到海。
verses.textZhCuv: 又往西下到押利提人的境界，到下伯‧和仑的境界，直到基色，通到海为止。
verses.textEnNiv: descended westward to the territory of the Japhletites as far as the region of Lower Beth Horon and on to Gezer, ending at the Mediterranean Sea.
verses.textEnEsv: Then it goes down westward to the territory of the Japhletites, as far as the territory of Lower Beth-horon, then to Gezer, and it ends at the sea.
verses.textEnNkjv: and went down westward to the boundary of the Japhletites, as far as the boundary of Lower Beth Horon to Gezer; and it ended at the sea.
verses.textEnNlt: Then it descended westward to the territory of the Japhletites as far as Lower Beth-horon, then to Gezer and over to the Mediterranean Sea.
verses.textEnNasb: Then it went down westward to the territory of the Japhletites, as far as the territory of lower Beth-horon even to Gezer, and it ended at the sea.
verses.textEn: descended westward to the territory of the Japhletites as far as the region of Lower Beth Horon and on to Gezer, ending at the Mediterranean Sea.

verses.textZh: 约瑟的儿子玛拿西和以法莲，也得了他们的产业。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约瑟的儿子玛拿西和以法莲，也得了他们的产业。
verses.textZhCuv: 约瑟的儿子玛拿西、以法莲就得了他们的地业。
verses.textEnNiv: So Manasseh and Ephraim, the descendants of Joseph, received their inheritance.
verses.textEnEsv: The people of Joseph, Manasseh and Ephraim, received their inheritance.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the children of Joseph, Manasseh and Ephraim, took their inheritance.
verses.textEnNlt: This was the homeland allocated to the families of Joseph’s sons, Manasseh and Ephraim.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Joseph, Manasseh and Ephraim, received their inheritance.
verses.textEn: So Manasseh and Ephraim, the descendants of Joseph, received their inheritance.

verses.textZh: 以下是以法莲人按着家族所得的境界：他们的产业在东方的疆界，是亚他绿．亚达，直到上伯．和仑。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以下是以法莲人按着家族所得的境界：他们的产业在东方的疆界，是亚他绿．亚达，直到上伯．和仑。
verses.textZhCuv: 以法莲子孙的境界，按着宗族所得的，记在下面：他们地业的东界是亚他绿‧亚达到上伯‧和仑；
verses.textEnNiv: This was the territory of Ephraim, according to its clans: The boundary of their inheritance went from Ataroth Addar in the east to Upper Beth Horon
verses.textEnEsv: The territory of the people of Ephraim by their clans was as follows: the boundary of their inheritance on the east was Ataroth-addar as far as Upper Beth-horon,
verses.textEnNkjv: The border of the children of Ephraim, according to their families, was thus: The border of their inheritance on the east side was Ataroth Addar as far as Upper Beth Horon.
verses.textEnNlt: The following territory was given to the clans of the tribe of Ephraim. The boundary of their homeland began at Ataroth-addar in the east. From there it ran to Upper Beth-horon,
verses.textEnNasb: Now this was the territory of the sons of Ephraim according to their families: the border of their inheritance eastward was Ataroth-addar, as far as upper Beth-horon.
verses.textEn: This was the territory of Ephraim, according to its clans: The boundary of their inheritance went from Ataroth Addar in the east to Upper Beth Horon

verses.textZh: 向西伸展到北面的密米他，又向东绕到他纳．示罗，经过雅挪哈的东边；
verses.textZhCnvs: 向西伸展到北面的密米他，又向东绕到他纳．示罗，经过雅挪哈的东边；
verses.textZhCuv: 往西通到北边的密米他，又向东绕到他纳‧示罗，又接连到雅挪哈的东边；
verses.textEnNiv: and continued to the Mediterranean Sea. From Mikmethath on the north it curved eastward to Taanath Shiloh, passing by it to Janoah on the east.
verses.textEnEsv: and the boundary goes from there to the sea. On the north is Michmethath. Then on the east the boundary turns around toward Taanath-shiloh and passes along beyond it on the east to Janoah,
verses.textEnNkjv: And the border went out toward the sea on the north side of Michmethath; then the border went around eastward to Taanath Shiloh, and passed by it on the east of Janohah.
verses.textEnNlt: then on to the Mediterranean Sea. From Micmethath on the north, the boundary curved eastward past Taanath-shiloh to the east of Janoah.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the border went westward at Michmethath on the north, and the border turned eastward to Taanath-shiloh and continued beyond it to the east of Janoah.
verses.textEn: and continued to the Mediterranean Sea. From Mikmethath on the north it curved eastward to Taanath Shiloh, passing by it to Janoah on the east.

verses.textZh: 从雅挪哈下到亚他绿，又到拿拉，和耶利哥接壤，伸展到约旦河；
verses.textZhCnvs: 从雅挪哈下到亚他绿，又到拿拉，和耶利哥接壤，伸展到约旦河；
verses.textZhCuv: 从雅挪哈下到亚他绿，又到拿拉，达到耶利哥，通到约旦河为止；
verses.textEnNiv: Then it went down from Janoah to Ataroth and Naarah, touched Jericho and came out at the Jordan.
verses.textEnEsv: then it goes down from Janoah to Ataroth and to Naarah, and touches Jericho, ending at the Jordan.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then it went down from Janohah to Ataroth and Naarah, reached to Jericho, and came out at the Jordan.
verses.textEnNlt: From Janoah it turned southward to Ataroth and Naarah, touched Jericho, and ended at the Jordan River.
verses.textEnNasb: Then it went down from Janoah to Ataroth and to Naarah, then reached Jericho and came out at the Jordan.
verses.textEn: Then it went down from Janoah to Ataroth and Naarah, touched Jericho and came out at the Jordan.

verses.textZh: 又从他普亚向西行，到加拿河，直通到海；这就是以法莲支派按着家族所得的产业。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又从他普亚向西行，到加拿河，直通到海；这就是以法莲支派按着家族所得的产业。
verses.textZhCuv: 从他普亚往西，到加拿河，直通到海为止。这就是以法莲支派按着宗族所得的地业。
verses.textEnNiv: From Tappuah the border went west to the Kanah Ravine and ended at the Mediterranean Sea. This was the inheritance of the tribe of the Ephraimites, according to its clans.
verses.textEnEsv: From Tappuah the boundary goes westward to the brook Kanah and ends at the sea. Such is the inheritance of the tribe of the people of Ephraim by their clans,
verses.textEnNkjv: The border went out from Tappuah westward to the Brook Kanah, and it ended at the sea. This was the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Ephraim according to their families.
verses.textEnNlt: From Tappuah the boundary extended westward, following the Kanah Ravine to the Mediterranean Sea. This is the homeland allocated to the clans of the tribe of Ephraim.
verses.textEnNasb: From Tappuah the border continued westward to the brook of Kanah, and it ended at the sea. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Ephraim according to their families,
verses.textEn: From Tappuah the border went west to the Kanah Ravine and ended at the Mediterranean Sea. This was the inheritance of the tribe of the Ephraimites, according to its clans.

verses.textZh: 此外在玛拿西人的产业中，还有些城镇分给以法莲人的，这些城镇都包括属于它们的村庄在内。
verses.textZhCnvs: 此外在玛拿西人的产业中，还有些城镇分给以法莲人的，这些城镇都包括属于它们的村庄在内。
verses.textZhCuv: 另外在玛拿西人地业中得了些城邑和属城的村庄。这都是分给以法莲子孙的。
verses.textEnNiv: It also included all the towns and their villages that were set aside for the Ephraimites within the inheritance of the Manassites.
verses.textEnEsv: together with the towns that were set apart for the people of Ephraim within the inheritance of the Manassites, all those towns with their villages.
verses.textEnNkjv: The separate cities for the children of Ephraim were among the inheritance of the children of Manasseh, all the cities with their villages.
verses.textEnNlt: In addition, some towns with their surrounding villages in the territory allocated to the half-tribe of Manasseh were set aside for the tribe of Ephraim.
verses.textEnNasb: together with the cities which were set apart for the sons of Ephraim in the midst of the inheritance of the sons of Manasseh, all the cities with their villages.
verses.textEn: It also included all the towns and their villages that were set aside for the Ephraimites within the inheritance of the Manassites.

verses.textZh: 可是他们没有把住在基色的迦南人赶走，于是迦南人住在以法莲中间，直到今日，成了作苦工的奴仆。
verses.textZhCnvs: 可是他们没有把住在基色的迦南人赶走，于是迦南人住在以法莲中间，直到今日，成了作苦工的奴仆。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们没有赶出住基色的迦南人；迦南人却住在以法莲人中间，成为做苦工的仆人，直到今日。
verses.textEnNiv: They did not dislodge the Canaanites living in Gezer; to this day the Canaanites live among the people of Ephraim but are required to do forced labor.
verses.textEnEsv: However, they did not drive out the Canaanites who lived in Gezer, so the Canaanites have lived in the midst of Ephraim to this day but have been made to do forced labor.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they did not drive out the Canaanites who dwelt in Gezer; but the Canaanites dwell among the Ephraimites to this day and have become forced laborers.
verses.textEnNlt: They did not drive the Canaanites out of Gezer, however, so the people of Gezer live as slaves among the people of Ephraim to this day.
verses.textEnNasb: But they did not drive out the Canaanites who lived in Gezer, so the Canaanites live in the midst of Ephraim to this day, and they became forced laborers.
verses.textEn: They did not dislodge the Canaanites living in Gezer; to this day the Canaanites live among the people of Ephraim but are required to do forced labor.

verses.textZh: 玛拿西是约瑟的长子，他的支派抽签所得的地业记在下面；至于玛拿西的长子，基列的父亲玛吉，因为是个战士，所以得到基列和巴珊。
verses.textZhCnvs: 玛拿西是约瑟的长子，他的支派抽签所得的地业记在下面；至于玛拿西的长子，基列的父亲玛吉，因为是个战士，所以得到基列和巴珊。
verses.textZhCuv: 玛拿西是约瑟的长子，他的支派拈阄所得之地记在下面。至于玛拿西的长子基列之父 玛吉，因为是勇士就得了基列和巴珊。
verses.textEnNiv: This was the allotment for the tribe of Manasseh as Joseph’s firstborn, that is, for Makir, Manasseh’s firstborn. Makir was the ancestor of the Gileadites, who had received Gilead and Bashan because the Makirites were great soldiers.
verses.textEnEsv: Then allotment was made to the people of Manasseh, for he was the firstborn of Joseph. To Machir the firstborn of Manasseh, the father of Gilead, were allotted Gilead and Bashan, because he was a man of war.
verses.textEnNkjv: There was also a lot for the tribe of Manasseh, for he was the firstborn of Joseph: namely for Machir the firstborn of Manasseh, the father of Gilead, because he was a man of war; therefore he was given Gilead and Bashan.
verses.textEnNlt: The next allotment of land was given to the half-tribe of Manasseh, the descendants of Joseph’s older son. Makir, the firstborn son of Manasseh, was the father of Gilead. Because his descendants were experienced soldiers, the regions of Gilead and Bashan on the east side of the Jordan had already been given to them.
verses.textEnNasb: Now this was the lot for the tribe of Manasseh, for he was the firstborn of Joseph. To Machir the firstborn of Manasseh, the father of Gilead, were allotted Gilead and Bashan, because he was a man of war.
verses.textEn: This was the allotment for the tribe of Manasseh as Joseph’s firstborn, that is, for Makir, Manasseh’s firstborn. Makir was the ancestor of the Gileadites, who had received Gilead and Bashan because the Makirites were great soldiers.

verses.textZh: 玛拿西其余的子孙按着家族抽签分地，包括亚比以谢的子孙、希勒的子孙、亚斯列的子孙、示剑的子孙、希弗的子孙、示米大的子孙；这些都是约瑟的儿子玛拿西子孙中男丁的各家族。
verses.textZhCnvs: 玛拿西其余的子孙按着家族抽签分地，包括亚比以谢的子孙、希勒的子孙、亚斯列的子孙、示剑的子孙、希弗的子孙、示米大的子孙；这些都是约瑟的儿子玛拿西子孙中男丁的各家族。
verses.textZhCuv: 玛拿西其余的子孙，按着宗族拈阄分地，就是亚比以谢子孙，希勒子孙，亚斯列子孙，示剑子孙，希弗子孙，示米大子孙；这些按着宗族，都是约瑟儿子玛拿西子孙的男丁。
verses.textEnNiv: So this allotment was for the rest of the people of Manasseh—the clans of Abiezer, Helek, Asriel, Shechem, Hepher and Shemida. These are the other male descendants of Manasseh son of Joseph by their clans.
verses.textEnEsv: And allotments were made to the rest of the people of Manasseh by their clans, Abiezer, Helek, Asriel, Shechem, Hepher, and Shemida. These were the male descendants of Manasseh the son of Joseph, by their clans.
verses.textEnNkjv: And there was alot for the rest of the children of Manasseh according to their families: for the children of Abiezer, the children of Helek, the children of Asriel, the children of Shechem, the children of Hepher, and the children of Shemida; these were the male children of Manasseh the son of Joseph according to their families.
verses.textEnNlt: So the allotment on the west side of the Jordan was for the remaining families within the clans of the tribe of Manasseh: Abiezer, Helek, Asriel, Shechem, Hepher, and Shemida. These clans represent the male descendants of Manasseh son of Joseph.
verses.textEnNasb: So the lot was made for the rest of the sons of Manasseh according to their families: for the sons of Abiezer, the sons of Helek, the sons of Asriel, the sons of Shechem, the sons of Hepher, and the sons of Shemida; these were the male descendants of Manasseh the son of Joseph according to their families.
verses.textEn: So this allotment was for the rest of the people of Manasseh—the clans of Abiezer, Helek, Asriel, Shechem, Hepher and Shemida. These are the other male descendants of Manasseh son of Joseph by their clans.

verses.textZh: 玛拿西的玄孙、玛吉的曾孙、基列的孙子、希弗的儿子西罗非哈没有儿子，只有女儿；他女儿们的名字是玛拉、挪阿、曷拉、密迦、得撒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 玛拿西的玄孙、玛吉的曾孙、基列的孙子、希弗的儿子西罗非哈没有儿子，只有女儿；他女儿们的名字是玛拉、挪阿、曷拉、密迦、得撒。
verses.textZhCuv: 玛拿西的玄孙，玛吉的曾孙，基列的孙子，希弗的儿子西罗非哈没有儿子，只有女儿。他的女儿名叫玛拉、挪阿、曷拉、密迦、得撒；
verses.textEnNiv: Now Zelophehad son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Makir, the son of Manasseh, had no sons but only daughters, whose names were Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milkah and Tirzah.
verses.textEnEsv: Now Zelophehad the son of Hepher, son of Gilead, son of Machir, son of Manasseh, had no sons, but only daughters, and these are the names of his daughters: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
verses.textEnNkjv: But Zelophehad the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, had no sons, but only daughters. And these are the names of his daughters: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
verses.textEnNlt: However, Zelophehad, a descendant of Hepher son of Gilead, son of Makir, son of Manasseh, had no sons. He had only daughters, whose names were Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
verses.textEnNasb: However, Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, had no sons, only daughters; and these are the names of his daughters: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
verses.textEn: Now Zelophehad son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Makir, the son of Manasseh, had no sons but only daughters, whose names were Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milkah and Tirzah.

verses.textZh: 她们来到以利亚撒祭司和嫩的儿子约书亚，以及众首领的面前，说："耶和华曾经吩咐摩西，在我们的兄弟中把产业分给我们。"于是约书亚照着耶和华所吩咐的，在她们的叔伯中间，把产业分给她们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她们来到以利亚撒祭司和嫩的儿子约书亚，以及众首领的面前，说："耶和华曾经吩咐摩西，在我们的兄弟中把产业分给我们。"于是约书亚照着耶和华所吩咐的，在她们的叔伯中间，把产业分给她们。
verses.textZhCuv: 她们来到祭司以利亚撒和嫩的儿子约书亚并众首领面前，说：「耶和华曾吩咐摩西在我们弟兄中分给我们产业。」于是约书亚照耶和华所吩咐的，在她们伯叔中，把产业分给她们。
verses.textEnNiv: They went to Eleazar the priest, Joshua son of Nun, and the leaders and said, "The Lord commanded Moses to give us an inheritance among our relatives." So Joshua gave them an inheritance along with the brothers of their father, according to the Lord ’s command.
verses.textEnEsv: They approached Eleazar the priest and Joshua the son of Nun and the leaders and said, "The Lord commanded Moses to give us an inheritance along with our brothers." So according to the mouth of the Lord he gave them an inheritance among the brothers of their father.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they came near before Eleazar the priest, before Joshua the son of Nun, and before the rulers, saying, "The Lord commanded Moses to give us an inheritance among our brothers." Therefore, according to the commandment of the Lord, he gave them an inheritance among their father’s brothers.
verses.textEnNlt: These women came to Eleazar the priest, Joshua son of Nun, and the Israelite leaders and said, "The Lord commanded Moses to give us a grant of land along with the men of our tribe." So Joshua gave them a grant of land along with their uncles, as the Lord had commanded.
verses.textEnNasb: They approached Eleazar the priest, Joshua the son of Nun, and the leaders, saying, "The Lord commanded Moses to give us an inheritance among our brothers." So in accordance with the command of the Lord he gave them an inheritance among their father’s brothers.
verses.textEn: They went to Eleazar the priest, Joshua son of Nun, and the leaders and said, "The Lord commanded Moses to give us an inheritance among our relatives." So Joshua gave them an inheritance along with the brothers of their father, according to the Lord ’s command.

verses.textZh: 这样，除了约旦河东的基列和巴珊地之外，还有十份地业归属玛拿西。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，除了约旦河东的基列和巴珊地之外，还有十份地业归属玛拿西。
verses.textZhCuv: 除了约旦河东的基列和巴珊地之外，还有十分地归玛拿西，
verses.textEnNiv: Manasseh’s share consisted of ten tracts of land besides Gilead and Bashan east of the Jordan,
verses.textEnEsv: Thus there fell to Manasseh ten portions, besides the land of Gilead and Bashan, which is on the other side of the Jordan,
verses.textEnNkjv: Ten shares fell to Manasseh, besides the land of Gilead and Bashan, which were on the other side of the Jordan,
verses.textEnNlt: As a result, Manasseh’s total allocation came to ten parcels of land, in addition to the land of Gilead and Bashan across the Jordan River,
verses.textEnNasb: So ten portions fell to Manasseh, besides the land of Gilead and Bashan, which is beyond the Jordan,
verses.textEn: Manasseh’s share consisted of ten tracts of land besides Gilead and Bashan east of the Jordan,

verses.textZh: 因为玛拿西的孙女，在玛拿西的孩子中，也得了产业；基列地是属于玛拿西其余的子孙的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为玛拿西的孙女，在玛拿西的孩子中，也得了产业；基列地是属于玛拿西其余的子孙的。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为玛拿西的孙女们在玛拿西的孙子中得了产业。基列地是属玛拿西其余的子孙。
verses.textEnNiv: because the daughters of the tribe of Manasseh received an inheritance among the sons. The land of Gilead belonged to the rest of the descendants of Manasseh.
verses.textEnEsv: because the daughters of Manasseh received an inheritance along with his sons. The land of Gilead was allotted to the rest of the people of Manasseh.
verses.textEnNkjv: because the daughters of Manasseh received an inheritance among his sons; and the rest of Manasseh’s sons had the land of Gilead.
verses.textEnNlt: because the female descendants of Manasseh received a grant of land along with the male descendants. (The land of Gilead was given to the rest of the male descendants of Manasseh.)
verses.textEnNasb: because the daughters of Manasseh received an inheritance among his sons. And the land of Gilead belonged to the rest of the sons of Manasseh.
verses.textEn: because the daughters of the tribe of Manasseh received an inheritance among the sons. The land of Gilead belonged to the rest of the descendants of Manasseh.

verses.textZh: 玛拿西的疆界，是从亚设起，到示剑东面的密米他；又向南走，到隐．他普亚的居民那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 玛拿西的疆界，是从亚设起，到示剑东面的密米他；又向南走，到隐．他普亚的居民那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 玛拿西的境界：从亚设起，到示剑前的密米他，往北到隐‧他普亚居民之地。
verses.textEnNiv: The territory of Manasseh extended from Asher to Mikmethath east of Shechem. The boundary ran southward from there to include the people living at En Tappuah.
verses.textEnEsv: The territory of Manasseh reached from Asher to Michmethath, which is east of Shechem. Then the boundary goes along southward to the inhabitants of En-tappuah.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the territory of Manasseh was from Asher to Michmethath, that lies east of Shechem; and the border went along south to the inhabitants of En Tappuah.
verses.textEnNlt: The boundary of the tribe of Manasseh extended from the border of Asher to Micmethath, near Shechem. Then the boundary went south from Micmethath to the settlement near the spring of Tappuah.
verses.textEnNasb: The border of Manasseh ran from Asher to Michmethath which was east of Shechem; then the border went southward to the inhabitants of En-tappuah.
verses.textEn: The territory of Manasseh extended from Asher to Mikmethath east of Shechem. The boundary ran southward from there to include the people living at En Tappuah.

verses.textZh: 玛拿西的疆界又下到加拿河，在加拿河的南边，玛拿西的众城镇中，有这些城镇是属于以法莲的。玛拿西的疆界，从河的北面起，直通到海。
verses.textZhCnvs: 玛拿西的疆界又下到加拿河，在加拿河的南边，玛拿西的众城镇中，有这些城镇是属于以法莲的。玛拿西的疆界，从河的北面起，直通到海。
verses.textZhCuv: 他普亚地归玛拿西，只是玛拿西境界上的他普亚城归以法莲子孙。
verses.textEnNiv: (Manasseh had the land of Tappuah, but Tappuah itself, on the boundary of Manasseh, belonged to the Ephraimites.)
verses.textEnEsv: The land of Tappuah belonged to Manasseh, but the town of Tappuah on the boundary of Manasseh belonged to the people of Ephraim.
verses.textEnNkjv: Manasseh had the land of Tappuah, but Tappuah on the border of Manasseh belonged to the children of Ephraim.
verses.textEnNlt: The land surrounding Tappuah belonged to Manasseh, but the town of Tappuah itself, on the border of Manasseh’s territory, belonged to the tribe of Ephraim.
verses.textEnNasb: The land of Tappuah belonged to Manasseh, but Tappuah on the border of Manasseh belonged to the sons of Ephraim.
verses.textEn: (Manasseh had the land of Tappuah, but Tappuah itself, on the boundary of Manasseh, belonged to the Ephraimites.)

verses.textZh: 南面是属于以法莲的，北面是属于玛拿西的；玛拿西在西边的疆界就是海，北面与亚设相接，东面和以萨迦相连；
verses.textZhCnvs: 南面是属于以法莲的，北面是属于玛拿西的；玛拿西在西边的疆界就是海，北面与亚设相接，东面和以萨迦相连；
verses.textZhCuv: 其界下到加拿河的南边。在玛拿西城邑中的这些城邑都归以法莲。玛拿西的地界是在河北直通到海为止；
verses.textEnNiv: Then the boundary continued south to the Kanah Ravine. There were towns belonging to Ephraim lying among the towns of Manasseh, but the boundary of Manasseh was the northern side of the ravine and ended at the Mediterranean Sea.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the boundary went down to the brook Kanah. These cities, to the south of the brook, among the cities of Manasseh, belong to Ephraim. Then the boundary of Manasseh goes on the north side of the brook and ends at the sea,
verses.textEnNkjv: And the border descended to the Brook Kanah, southward to the brook. These cities of Ephraim are among the cities of Manasseh. The border of Manasseh was on the north side of the brook; and it ended at the sea.
verses.textEnNlt: From the spring of Tappuah, the boundary of Manasseh followed the Kanah Ravine to the Mediterranean Sea. Several towns south of the ravine were inside Manasseh’s territory, but they actually belonged to the tribe of Ephraim.
verses.textEnNasb: And the border went down to the brook of Kanah, southward of the brook (these cities belonged to Ephraim among the cities of Manasseh), and the border of Manasseh was on the north side of the brook, and it ended at the sea.
verses.textEn: Then the boundary continued south to the Kanah Ravine. There were towns belonging to Ephraim lying among the towns of Manasseh, but the boundary of Manasseh was the northern side of the ravine and ended at the Mediterranean Sea.

verses.textZh: 在以萨迦和亚设的境内，伯．善和属于伯．善的市镇，以伯莲和属于以伯莲的市镇，多珥的居民和属于多珥的市镇，都属于玛拿西；还有三处山区，就是：隐．多珥的居民和属于隐．多珥的市镇，他衲的居民和属于他衲的市镇，米吉多的居民和属于米吉多的市镇。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在以萨迦和亚设的境内，伯．善和属于伯．善的市镇，以伯莲和属于以伯莲的市镇，多珥的居民和属于多珥的市镇，都属于玛拿西；还有三处山区，就是：隐．多珥的居民和属于隐．多珥的市镇，他衲的居民和属于他衲的市镇，米吉多的居民和属于米吉多的市镇。
verses.textZhCuv: 南归以法莲，北归玛拿西，以海为界；北边到亚设，东边到以萨迦。
verses.textEnNiv: On the south the land belonged to Ephraim, on the north to Manasseh. The territory of Manasseh reached the Mediterranean Sea and bordered Asher on the north and Issachar on the east.
verses.textEnEsv: the land to the south being Ephraim’s and that to the north being Manasseh’s, with the sea forming its boundary. On the north Asher is reached, and on the east Issachar.
verses.textEnNkjv: Southward itwas Ephraim’s, northward itwas Manasseh’s, and the sea was its border. Manasseh’s territory was adjoining Asher on the north and Issachar on the east.
verses.textEnNlt: In general, however, the land south of the ravine belonged to Ephraim, and the land north of the ravine belonged to Manasseh. Manasseh’s boundary ran along the northern side of the ravine and ended at the Mediterranean Sea. North of Manasseh was the territory of Asher, and to the east was the territory of Issachar.
verses.textEnNasb: The south side belonged to Ephraim and the north side to Manasseh, and the sea was their border; and they reached to Asher on the north and to Issachar on the east.
verses.textEn: On the south the land belonged to Ephraim, on the north to Manasseh. The territory of Manasseh reached the Mediterranean Sea and bordered Asher on the north and Issachar on the east.

verses.textZh: 可是玛拿西的子孙却不能把这些城的居民赶走，迦南人决意住在那地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 可是玛拿西的子孙却不能把这些城的居民赶走，迦南人决意住在那地。
verses.textZhCuv: 玛拿西在以萨迦和亚设境内，有伯‧善和属伯‧善的镇市，以伯莲和属以伯莲的镇市，多珥的居民和属多珥的镇市；又有三处山冈，就是隐‧多珥和属隐‧多珥的镇市；他纳的居民和属他纳的镇市，米吉多的居民和属米吉多的镇市。
verses.textEnNiv: Within Issachar and Asher, Manasseh also had Beth Shan, Ibleam and the people of Dor, Endor, Taanach and Megiddo, together with their surrounding settlements (the third in the list is Naphoth ).
verses.textEnEsv: Also in Issachar and in Asher Manasseh had Beth-shean and its villages, and Ibleam and its villages, and the inhabitants of Dor and its villages, and the inhabitants of En-dor and its villages, and the inhabitants of Taanach and its villages, and the inhabitants of Megiddo and its villages; the third is Naphath.
verses.textEnNkjv: And in Issachar and in Asher, Manasseh had Beth Shean and its towns, Ibleam and its towns, the inhabitants of Dor and its towns, the inhabitants of En Dor and its towns, the inhabitants of Taanach and its towns, and the inhabitants of Megiddo and its towns—three hilly regions.
verses.textEnNlt: The following towns within the territory of Issachar and Asher, however, were given to Manasseh: Beth-shan, Ibleam, Dor (that is, Naphoth-dor), Endor, Taanach, and Megiddo, each with their surrounding settlements.
verses.textEnNasb: In Issachar and in Asher, Manasseh had Beth-shean and its towns and Ibleam and its towns, and the inhabitants of Dor and its towns, and the inhabitants of En-dor and its towns, and the inhabitants of Taanach and its towns, and the inhabitants of Megiddo and its towns; the third is Napheth.
verses.textEn: Within Issachar and Asher, Manasseh also had Beth Shan, Ibleam and the people of Dor, Endor, Taanach and Megiddo, together with their surrounding settlements (the third in the list is Naphoth ).

verses.textZh: 以色列人强盛以后，就迫使迦南人作苦工，却没有把他们完全赶出去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人强盛以后，就迫使迦南人作苦工，却没有把他们完全赶出去。
verses.textZhCuv: 只是玛拿西子孙不能赶出这些城的居民，迦南人偏要住在那地。
verses.textEnNiv: Yet the Manassites were not able to occupy these towns, for the Canaanites were determined to live in that region.
verses.textEnEsv: Yet the people of Manasseh could not take possession of those cities, but the Canaanites persisted in dwelling in that land.
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet the children of Manasseh could not drive out theinhabitantsof those cities, but the Canaanites were determined to dwell in that land.
verses.textEnNlt: But the descendants of Manasseh were unable to occupy these towns because the Canaanites were determined to stay in that region.
verses.textEnNasb: But the sons of Manasseh could not take possession of these cities, because the Canaanites persisted in living in this land.
verses.textEn: Yet the Manassites were not able to occupy these towns, for the Canaanites were determined to live in that region.

verses.textZh: 约瑟的子孙对约书亚说："耶和华这样赐福我们，我们族大人多，你为甚么只给我们抽一份签，分一份地作产业呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 约瑟的子孙对约书亚说："耶和华这样赐福我们，我们族大人多，你为甚么只给我们抽一份签，分一份地作产业呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 及至以色列人强盛了，就使迦南人做苦工，没有把他们全然赶出。
verses.textEnNiv: However, when the Israelites grew stronger, they subjected the Canaanites to forced labor but did not drive them out completely.
verses.textEnEsv: Now when the people of Israel grew strong, they put the Canaanites to forced labor, but did not utterly drive them out.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it happened, when the children of Israel grew strong, that they put the Canaanites to forced labor, but did not utterly drive them out.
verses.textEnNlt: Later, however, when the Israelites became strong enough, they forced the Canaanites to work as slaves. But they did not drive them out of the land.
verses.textEnNasb: And it came about when the sons of Israel became strong, they put the Canaanites to forced labor, but they did not drive them out completely.
verses.textEn: However, when the Israelites grew stronger, they subjected the Canaanites to forced labor but did not drive them out completely.

verses.textZh: 约书亚对他们说："如果你们族大人多，又嫌以法莲山地过于窄小，就可以上森林区去，在比利洗人和利乏音人之地那里自己砍伐树木。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 约书亚对他们说："如果你们族大人多，又嫌以法莲山地过于窄小，就可以上森林区去，在比利洗人和利乏音人之地那里自己砍伐树木。"
verses.textZhCuv: 约瑟的子孙对约书亚说：「耶和华到如今既然赐福与我们，我们也族大人多，你为什么仅将一阄一段之地分给我们为业呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: The people of Joseph said to Joshua, "Why have you given us only one allotment and one portion for an inheritance? We are a numerous people, and the Lord has blessed us abundantly."
verses.textEnEsv: Then the people of Joseph spoke to Joshua, saying, "Why have you given me but one lot and one portion as an inheritance, although I am a numerous people, since all along the Lord has blessed me?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the children of Joseph spoke to Joshua, saying, "Why have you given us only one lot and one share to inherit, since we are a great people, inasmuch as the Lord has blessed us until now?"
verses.textEnNlt: The descendants of Joseph came to Joshua and asked, "Why have you given us only one portion of land as our homeland when the Lord has blessed us with so many people?"
verses.textEnNasb: Then the sons of Joseph spoke to Joshua, saying, "Why have you given me only one lot and one portion as an inheritance, though I am a numerous people whom the Lord has blessed up to this point?"
verses.textEn: The people of Joseph said to Joshua, "Why have you given us only one allotment and one portion for an inheritance? We are a numerous people, and the Lord has blessed us abundantly."

verses.textZh: 约瑟的子孙回答："那山地容不下我们，并且住在谷地的所有迦南人，就是住在伯．善和属于伯．善的市镇的人，以及住在耶斯列谷的人，都有铁车。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 约瑟的子孙回答："那山地容不下我们，并且住在谷地的所有迦南人，就是住在伯．善和属于伯．善的市镇的人，以及住在耶斯列谷的人，都有铁车。"
verses.textZhCuv: 约书亚说：「你们如果族大人多，嫌以法莲山地窄小，就可以上比利洗人、利乏音人之地，在树林中砍伐树木。」
verses.textEnNiv: "If you are so numerous," Joshua answered, "and if the hill country of Ephraim is too small for you, go up into the forest and clear land for yourselves there in the land of the Perizzites and Rephaites."
verses.textEnEsv: And Joshua said to them, "If you are a numerous people, go up by yourselves to the forest, and there clear ground for yourselves in the land of the Perizzites and the Rephaim, since the hill country of Ephraim is too narrow for you."
verses.textEnNkjv: So Joshua answered them, "If you are a great people, then go up to the forest country and clear a place for yourself there in the land of the Perizzites and the giants, since the mountains of Ephraim are too confined for you."
verses.textEnNlt: Joshua replied, "If there are so many of you, and if the hill country of Ephraim is not large enough for you, clear out land for yourselves in the forest where the Perizzites and Rephaites live."
verses.textEnNasb: And Joshua said to them, "If you are a numerous people, go up to the forest and clear a place for yourself there in the land of the Perizzites and of the Rephaim, since the hill country of Ephraim is too narrow for you."
verses.textEn: "If you are so numerous," Joshua answered, "and if the hill country of Ephraim is too small for you, go up into the forest and clear land for yourselves there in the land of the Perizzites and Rephaites."

verses.textZh: 约书亚对约瑟家，就是对以法莲人和玛拿西人说："你们族大人多，势力强大，不可以只抽一份地业；
verses.textZhCnvs: 约书亚对约瑟家，就是对以法莲人和玛拿西人说："你们族大人多，势力强大，不可以只抽一份地业；
verses.textZhCuv: 约瑟的子孙说：「那山地容不下我们，并且住平原的迦南人，就是住伯‧善和属伯‧善的镇市，并住耶斯列平原的人，都有铁车。」
verses.textEnNiv: The people of Joseph replied, "The hill country is not enough for us, and all the Canaanites who live in the plain have chariots fitted with iron, both those in Beth Shan and its settlements and those in the Valley of Jezreel."
verses.textEnEsv: The people of Joseph said, "The hill country is not enough for us. Yet all the Canaanites who dwell in the plain have chariots of iron, both those in Beth-shean and its villages and those in the Valley of Jezreel."
verses.textEnNkjv: But the children of Joseph said, "The mountain country is not enough for us; and all the Canaanites who dwell in the land of the valley have chariots of iron, boththose who are of Beth Shean and its towns and those who are of the Valley of Jezreel."
verses.textEnNlt: The descendants of Joseph responded, "It’s true that the hill country is not large enough for us. But all the Canaanites in the lowlands have iron chariots, both those in Beth-shan and its surrounding settlements and those in the valley of Jezreel. They are too strong for us."
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Joseph then said, "The hill country is not enough for us, but all the Canaanites who live in the valley land have iron chariots, both those who are in Beth-shean and its towns and those who are in the Valley of Jezreel."
verses.textEn: The people of Joseph replied, "The hill country is not enough for us, and all the Canaanites who live in the plain have chariots fitted with iron, both those in Beth Shan and its settlements and those in the Valley of Jezreel."

verses.textZh: 山地也要归给你们，那里虽然是森林，你们可以砍伐，开辟的土地都归给你们，直到它最远的边界；迦南人虽然拥有铁车，势力强大，你们也能把他们赶出去。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 山地也要归给你们，那里虽然是森林，你们可以砍伐，开辟的土地都归给你们，直到它最远的边界；迦南人虽然拥有铁车，势力强大，你们也能把他们赶出去。"
verses.textZhCuv: 约书亚对约瑟家，就是以法莲和玛拿西人，说：「你是族大人多，并且强盛，不可仅有一阄之地，
verses.textEnNiv: But Joshua said to the tribes of Joseph—to Ephraim and Manasseh—"You are numerous and very powerful. You will have not only one allotment
verses.textEnEsv: Then Joshua said to the house of Joseph, to Ephraim and Manasseh, "You are a numerous people and have great power. You shall not have one allotment only,
verses.textEnNkjv: And Joshua spoke to the house of Joseph—to Ephraim and Manasseh—saying, "You are a great people and have great power; you shall not have only one lot,
verses.textEnNlt: Then Joshua said to the tribes of Ephraim and Manasseh, the descendants of Joseph, "Since you are so large and strong, you will be given more than one portion.
verses.textEnNasb: But Joshua spoke to the house of Joseph, to Ephraim and Manasseh, saying, "You are a numerous people and have great power; you shall not have one lot only,
verses.textEn: But Joshua said to the tribes of Joseph—to Ephraim and Manasseh—"You are numerous and very powerful. You will have not only one allotment

verses.textZh: 山地也要归你，虽是树林，你也可以砍伐；靠近之地必归你。迦南人虽有铁车，虽是强盛，你也能把他们赶出去。」
verses.textZhCnvs: 山地也要归你，虽是树林，你也可以砍伐；靠近之地必归你。迦南人虽有铁车，虽是强盛，你也能把他们赶出去。」
verses.textZhCuv: 山地也要归你，虽是树林，你也可以砍伐；靠近之地必归你。迦南人虽有铁车，虽是强盛，你也能把他们赶出去。」
verses.textEnNiv: but the forested hill country as well. Clear it, and its farthest limits will be yours; though the Canaanites have chariots fitted with iron and though they are strong, you can drive them out."
verses.textEnEsv: but the hill country shall be yours, for though it is a forest, you shall clear it and possess it to its farthest borders. For you shall drive out the Canaanites, though they have chariots of iron, and though they are strong."
verses.textEnNkjv: but the mountain country shall be yours. Although it is wooded, you shall cut it down, and its farthest extent shall be yours; for you shall drive out the Canaanites, though they have iron chariots and are strong."
verses.textEnNlt: The forests of the hill country will be yours as well. Clear as much of the land as you wish, and take possession of its farthest corners. And you will drive out the Canaanites from the valleys, too, even though they are strong and have iron chariots."
verses.textEnNasb: but the hill country shall be yours. For though it is a forest, you shall clear it, and to its farthest borders it shall be yours; for you shall drive out the Canaanites, even though they have iron chariots and though they are strong."
verses.textEn: but the forested hill country as well. Clear it, and its farthest limits will be yours; though the Canaanites have chariots fitted with iron and though they are strong, you can drive them out."

verses.textZh: 以色列全体会众聚集在示罗，把会幕竖立在那里，因为那地在他们面前被征服了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列全体会众聚集在示罗，把会幕竖立在那里，因为那地在他们面前被征服了。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列的全会众都聚集在示罗，把会幕设立在那里，那地已经被他们制伏了。
verses.textEnNiv: The whole assembly of the Israelites gathered at Shiloh and set up the tent of meeting there. The country was brought under their control,
verses.textEnEsv: Then the whole congregation of the people of Israel assembled at Shiloh and set up the tent of meeting there. The land lay subdued before them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the whole congregation of the children of Israel assembled together at Shiloh, and set up the tabernacle of meeting there. And the land was subdued before them.
verses.textEnNlt: Now that the land was under Israelite control, the entire community of Israel gathered at Shiloh and set up the Tabernacle.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the whole congregation of the sons of Israel assembled at Shiloh, and set up the tent of meeting there; and the land was subdued before them.
verses.textEn: The whole assembly of the Israelites gathered at Shiloh and set up the tent of meeting there. The country was brought under their control,

verses.textZh: 以色列人其余的七个支派还没有得着产业。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人其余的七个支派还没有得着产业。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人中其余的七个支派还没有分给他们地业。
verses.textEnNiv: but there were still seven Israelite tribes who had not yet received their inheritance.
verses.textEnEsv: There remained among the people of Israel seven tribes whose inheritance had not yet been apportioned.
verses.textEnNkjv: But there remained among the children of Israel seven tribes which had not yet received their inheritance.
verses.textEnNlt: But there remained seven tribes who had not yet been allotted their grants of land.
verses.textEnNasb: But there remained among the sons of Israel seven tribes who had not divided their inheritance.
verses.textEn: but there were still seven Israelite tribes who had not yet received their inheritance.

verses.textZh: 约书亚对以色列人说："耶和华你们列祖的神赐给你们的地，你们迟迟不去占领，要到几时呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 约书亚对以色列人说："耶和华你们列祖的神赐给你们的地，你们迟迟不去占领，要到几时呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 约书亚对以色列人说：「耶和华－你们列祖的神所赐给你们的地，你们耽延不去得，要到几时呢？
verses.textEnNiv: So Joshua said to the Israelites: "How long will you wait before you begin to take possession of the land that the Lord , the God of your ancestors, has given you?
verses.textEnEsv: So Joshua said to the people of Israel, "How long will you put off going in to take possession of the land, which the Lord , the God of your fathers, has given you?
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Joshua said to the children of Israel: "How long will you neglect to go and possess the land which the Lord God of your fathers has given you?
verses.textEnNlt: Then Joshua asked them, "How long are you going to wait before taking possession of the remaining land the Lord , the God of your ancestors, has given to you?
verses.textEnNasb: So Joshua said to the sons of Israel, "How long will you put off entering to take possession of the land which the Lord, the God of your fathers, has given you?
verses.textEn: So Joshua said to the Israelites: "How long will you wait before you begin to take possession of the land that the Lord , the God of your ancestors, has given you?

verses.textZh: 你们每支派要选出三个人，我要派他们去；他们要起程走遍那地，把各支派的产业描绘下来，然后回到我这里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们每支派要选出三个人，我要派他们去；他们要起程走遍那地，把各支派的产业描绘下来，然后回到我这里。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们每支派当选举三个人，我要打发他们去，他们就要起身走遍那地，按着各支派应得的地业写明 ，就回到我这里来。
verses.textEnNiv: Appoint three men from each tribe. I will send them out to make a survey of the land and to write a description of it, according to the inheritance of each. Then they will return to me.
verses.textEnEsv: Provide three men from each tribe, and I will send them out that they may set out and go up and down the land. They shall write a description of it with a view to their inheritances, and then come to me.
verses.textEnNkjv: Pick out from among you three men for each tribe, and I will send them; they shall rise and go through the land, survey it according to their inheritance, and come back to me.
verses.textEnNlt: Select three men from each tribe, and I will send them out to explore the land and map it out. They will then return to me with a written report of their proposed divisions of their new homeland.
verses.textEnNasb: Provide for yourselves three men from each tribe so that I may send them, and that they may arise and walk through the land and write a description of it according to their inheritance; then they shall return to me.
verses.textEn: Appoint three men from each tribe. I will send them out to make a survey of the land and to write a description of it, according to the inheritance of each. Then they will return to me.

verses.textZh: 他们要把地业分作七份，犹大留在南方他们的境界内；约瑟家留在北方他们的境界内。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们要把地业分作七份，犹大留在南方他们的境界内；约瑟家留在北方他们的境界内。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们要将地分做七分；犹大仍在南方，住在他的境内。约瑟家仍在北方，住在他的境内。
verses.textEnNiv: You are to divide the land into seven parts. Judah is to remain in its territory on the south and the tribes of Joseph in their territory on the north.
verses.textEnEsv: They shall divide it into seven portions. Judah shall continue in his territory on the south, and the house of Joseph shall continue in their territory on the north.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they shall divide it into seven parts. Judah shall remain in their territory on the south, and the house of Joseph shall remain in their territory on the north.
verses.textEnNlt: Let them divide the land into seven sections, excluding Judah’s territory in the south and Joseph’s territory in the north.
verses.textEnNasb: And they shall divide it into seven portions; Judah shall stay in its territory on the south, and the house of Joseph shall stay in their territory on the north.
verses.textEn: You are to divide the land into seven parts. Judah is to remain in its territory on the south and the tribes of Joseph in their territory on the north.

verses.textZh: 你们要把地划分七份，然后把图样拿给我；我要在这里，在耶和华我们的神面前，为你们抽签。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要把地划分七份，然后把图样拿给我；我要在这里，在耶和华我们的神面前，为你们抽签。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要将地分做七分，写明了拿到我这里来。我要在耶和华－我们神面前，为你们拈阄。
verses.textEnNiv: After you have written descriptions of the seven parts of the land, bring them here to me and I will cast lots for you in the presence of the Lord our God.
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall describe the land in seven divisions and bring the description here to me. And I will cast lots for you here before the Lord our God.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall therefore survey the land in seven parts and bring thesurvey here to me, that I may cast lots for you here before the Lord our God.
verses.textEnNlt: And when you record the seven divisions of the land and bring them to me, I will cast sacred lots in the presence of the Lord our God to assign land to each tribe.
verses.textEnNasb: And you shall write a description of the land in seven divisions, and bring the description here to me. Then I will cast lots for you here before the Lord our God.
verses.textEn: After you have written descriptions of the seven parts of the land, bring them here to me and I will cast lots for you in the presence of the Lord our God.

verses.textZh: 利未人在你们中间没有业分，因为耶和华祭司的职分就是他们的产业。迦得支派、流本支派和玛拿西半个支派，已经在约旦河东得了产业，就是耶和华的仆人摩西分给他们的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 利未人在你们中间没有业分，因为耶和华祭司的职分就是他们的产业。迦得支派、流本支派和玛拿西半个支派，已经在约旦河东得了产业，就是耶和华的仆人摩西分给他们的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 利未人在你们中间没有分，因为供耶和华祭司的职任就是他们的产业。迦得支派、吕便支派，和玛拿西半支派已经在约旦河东得了地业，就是耶和华仆人摩西所给他们的。」
verses.textEnNiv: The Levites, however, do not get a portion among you, because the priestly service of the Lord is their inheritance. And Gad, Reuben and the half-tribe of Manasseh have already received their inheritance on the east side of the Jordan. Moses the servant of the Lord gave it to them."
verses.textEnEsv: The Levites have no portion among you, for the priesthood of the Lord is their heritage. And Gad and Reuben and half the tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance beyond the Jordan eastward, which Moses the servant of the Lord gave them."
verses.textEnNkjv: But the Levites have no part among you, for the priesthood of the Lordis their inheritance. And Gad, Reuben, and half the tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance beyond the Jordan on the east, which Moses the servant of the Lord gave them."
verses.textEnNlt: "The Levites, however, will not receive any allotment of land. Their role as priests of the Lord is their allotment. And the tribes of Gad, Reuben, and the half-tribe of Manasseh won’t receive any more land, for they have already received their grant of land, which Moses, the servant of the Lord , gave them on the east side of the Jordan River."
verses.textEnNasb: For the Levites have no portion among you, because the priesthood of the Lord is their inheritance. Gad, Reuben, and the half-tribe of Manasseh also have received their inheritance eastward beyond the Jordan, which Moses the servant of the Lord gave them."
verses.textEn: The Levites, however, do not get a portion among you, because the priestly service of the Lord is their inheritance. And Gad, Reuben and the half-tribe of Manasseh have already received their inheritance on the east side of the Jordan. Moses the servant of the Lord gave it to them."

verses.textZh: 那些人起程前去的时候，约书亚吩咐那些前去绘画那地的人说："你们要去，走遍那地，绘画地形，然后回到我这里来，我要在示罗这里，在耶和华面前，为你们抽签。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那些人起程前去的时候，约书亚吩咐那些前去绘画那地的人说："你们要去，走遍那地，绘画地形，然后回到我这里来，我要在示罗这里，在耶和华面前，为你们抽签。"
verses.textZhCuv: 划地势的人起身去的时候，约书亚嘱咐他们说：「你们去走遍那地，划明地势，就回到我这里来。我要在示罗这里，耶和华面前，为你们拈阄。」
verses.textEnNiv: As the men started on their way to map out the land, Joshua instructed them, "Go and make a survey of the land and write a description of it. Then return to me, and I will cast lots for you here at Shiloh in the presence of the Lord ."
verses.textEnEsv: So the men arose and went, and Joshua charged those who went to write the description of the land, saying, "Go up and down in the land and write a description and return to me. And I will cast lots for you here before the Lord in Shiloh."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the men arose to go away; and Joshua charged those who went to survey the land, saying, "Go, walk through the land, survey it, and come back to me, that I may cast lots for you here before the Lord in Shiloh."
verses.textEnNlt: As the men started on their way to map out the land, Joshua commanded them, "Go and explore the land and write a description of it. Then return to me, and I will assign the land to the tribes by casting sacred lots here in the presence of the Lord at Shiloh."
verses.textEnNasb: Then the men arose and went, and Joshua commanded those who went to write a description of the land, saying, "Go and walk through the land and write a description of it, and return to me; then I will cast lots for you here before the Lord in Shiloh."
verses.textEn: As the men started on their way to map out the land, Joshua instructed them, "Go and make a survey of the land and write a description of it. Then return to me, and I will cast lots for you here at Shiloh in the presence of the Lord ."

verses.textZh: 那些人就去了，走遍那地，并绘画下来，把众城分作七份记在册子上，然后回到示罗营中约书亚那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那些人就去了，走遍那地，并绘画下来，把众城分作七份记在册子上，然后回到示罗营中约书亚那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们就去了，走遍那地，按着城邑分做七分，写在册子上，回到示罗营中见约书亚。
verses.textEnNiv: So the men left and went through the land. They wrote its description on a scroll, town by town, in seven parts, and returned to Joshua in the camp at Shiloh.
verses.textEnEsv: So the men went and passed up and down in the land and wrote in a book a description of it by towns in seven divisions. Then they came to Joshua to the camp at Shiloh,
verses.textEnNkjv: So the men went, passed through the land, and wrote the survey in a book in seven parts by cities; and they came to Joshua at the camp in Shiloh.
verses.textEnNlt: The men did as they were told and mapped the entire territory into seven sections, listing the towns in each section. They made a written record and then returned to Joshua in the camp at Shiloh.
verses.textEnNasb: So the men went and passed through the land, and wrote a description of it by cities in seven divisions in a book; and they came to Joshua at the camp at Shiloh.
verses.textEn: So the men left and went through the land. They wrote its description on a scroll, town by town, in seven parts, and returned to Joshua in the camp at Shiloh.

verses.textZh: 约书亚就在示罗，在耶和华面前为他们抽签；约书亚在那里按着他们的支派把地分给以色列人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约书亚就在示罗，在耶和华面前为他们抽签；约书亚在那里按着他们的支派把地分给以色列人。
verses.textZhCuv: 约书亚就在示罗，耶和华面前，为他们拈阄。约书亚在那里，按着以色列人的支派，将地分给他们。
verses.textEnNiv: Joshua then cast lots for them in Shiloh in the presence of the Lord , and there he distributed the land to the Israelites according to their tribal divisions.
verses.textEnEsv: and Joshua cast lots for them in Shiloh before the Lord . And there Joshua apportioned the land to the people of Israel, to each his portion.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Joshua cast lots for them in Shiloh before the Lord, and there Joshua divided the land to the children of Israel according to their divisions.
verses.textEnNlt: And there at Shiloh, Joshua cast sacred lots in the presence of the Lord to determine which tribe should have each section.
verses.textEnNasb: Joshua then cast lots for them in Shiloh before the Lord, and there Joshua divided the land for the sons of Israel according to their divisions.
verses.textEn: Joshua then cast lots for them in Shiloh in the presence of the Lord , and there he distributed the land to the Israelites according to their tribal divisions.

verses.textZh: 便雅悯支派按着家族抽了签；他们抽签所得的境界，是在犹大子孙和约瑟子孙中间。
verses.textZhCnvs: 便雅悯支派按着家族抽了签；他们抽签所得的境界，是在犹大子孙和约瑟子孙中间。
verses.textZhCuv: 便雅悯支派，按着宗族拈阄所得之地，是在犹大、约瑟子孙中间。
verses.textEnNiv: The first lot came up for the tribe of Benjamin according to its clans. Their allotted territory lay between the tribes of Judah and Joseph:
verses.textEnEsv: The lot of the tribe of the people of Benjamin according to its clans came up, and the territory allotted to it fell between the people of Judah and the people of Joseph.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the lot of the tribe of the children of Benjamin came up according to their families, and the territory of their lot came out between the children of Judah and the children of Joseph.
verses.textEnNlt: The first allotment of land went to the clans of the tribe of Benjamin. It lay between the territory assigned to the tribes of Judah and Joseph.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the lot of the tribe of the sons of Benjamin came up according to their families, and the territory of their lot lay between the sons of Judah and the sons of Joseph.
verses.textEn: The first lot came up for the tribe of Benjamin according to its clans. Their allotted territory lay between the tribes of Judah and Joseph:

verses.textZh: 他们的疆界，北边是从约旦河起，向上到耶利哥的北边，又向西上到山地，直到伯．亚文的旷野。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们的疆界，北边是从约旦河起，向上到耶利哥的北边，又向西上到山地，直到伯．亚文的旷野。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们的北界是从约旦河起，往上贴近耶利哥的北边；又往西通过山地，直到伯‧亚文的旷野；
verses.textEnNiv: On the north side their boundary began at the Jordan, passed the northern slope of Jericho and headed west into the hill country, coming out at the wilderness of Beth Aven.
verses.textEnEsv: On the north side their boundary began at the Jordan. Then the boundary goes up to the shoulder north of Jericho, then up through the hill country westward, and it ends at the wilderness of Beth-aven.
verses.textEnNkjv: Their border on the north side began at the Jordan, and the border went up to the side of Jericho on the north, and went up through the mountains westward; it ended at the Wilderness of Beth Aven.
verses.textEnNlt: The northern boundary of Benjamin’s land began at the Jordan River, went north of the slope of Jericho, then west through the hill country and the wilderness of Beth-aven.
verses.textEnNasb: Their border on the north side was from the Jordan, then the border went up to the side of Jericho on the north, and went up through the hill country westward, and it ended at the wilderness of Beth-aven.
verses.textEn: On the north side their boundary began at the Jordan, passed the northern slope of Jericho and headed west into the hill country, coming out at the wilderness of Beth Aven.

verses.textZh: 又从那里向南经过路斯，路斯就是伯特利，再下到亚他绿．亚达，靠近下伯．和仑南边的山地；
verses.textZhCnvs: 又从那里向南经过路斯，路斯就是伯特利，再下到亚他绿．亚达，靠近下伯．和仑南边的山地；
verses.textZhCuv: 从那里往南接连到路斯，贴近路斯（路斯就是伯特利），又下到亚他绿‧亚达，靠近下伯‧和仑南边的山；
verses.textEnNiv: From there it crossed to the south slope of Luz (that is, Bethel) and went down to Ataroth Addar on the hill south of Lower Beth Horon.
verses.textEnEsv: From there the boundary passes along southward in the direction of Luz, to the shoulder of Luz (that is, Bethel), then the boundary goes down to Ataroth-addar, on the mountain that lies south of Lower Beth-horon.
verses.textEnNkjv: The border went over from there toward Luz, to the side of Luz (which is Bethel) southward; and the border descended to Ataroth Addar, near the hill that lies on the south side of Lower Beth Horon.
verses.textEnNlt: From there the boundary went south to Luz (that is, Bethel) and proceeded down to Ataroth-addar on the hill that lies south of Lower Beth-horon.
verses.textEnNasb: Then from there the border continued to Luz, to the side of Luz (that is, Bethel) southward; and the border went down to Ataroth-addar, near the hill which lies on the south of lower Beth-horon.
verses.textEn: From there it crossed to the south slope of Luz (that is, Bethel) and went down to Ataroth Addar on the hill south of Lower Beth Horon.

verses.textZh: 又从那里伸延，绕到西边再向南，从伯．和仑南边对面的山起，直到犹大人的城基列．巴力，基列．巴力就是基列．耶琳；这是西方的疆界。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又从那里伸延，绕到西边再向南，从伯．和仑南边对面的山起，直到犹大人的城基列．巴力，基列．巴力就是基列．耶琳；这是西方的疆界。
verses.textZhCuv: 从那里往西，又转向南，从伯‧和仑南对面的山，直达到犹大人的城基列‧巴力（基列‧巴力就是基列‧耶琳）；这是西界。
verses.textEnNiv: From the hill facing Beth Horon on the south the boundary turned south along the western side and came out at Kiriath Baal (that is, Kiriath Jearim), a town of the people of Judah. This was the western side.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the boundary goes in another direction, turning on the western side southward from the mountain that lies to the south, opposite Beth-horon, and it ends at Kiriath-baal ( that is, Kiriath-jearim), a city belonging to the people of Judah. This forms the western side.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the border extended around the west side to the south, from the hill that lies before Beth Horon southward; and it ended at Kirjath Baal (which is Kirjath Jearim), a city of the children of Judah. This was the west side.
verses.textEnNlt: The boundary then made a turn and swung south along the western edge of the hill facing Beth-horon, ending at the village of Kiriath-baal (that is, Kiriath-jearim), a town belonging to the tribe of Judah. This was the western boundary.
verses.textEnNasb: And the border changed direction from there and turned around on the west side southward, from the hill which lies opposite Beth-horon southward; and it ended at Kiriath-baal (that is, Kiriath-jearim), a city of the sons of Judah. This was the west side.
verses.textEn: From the hill facing Beth Horon on the south the boundary turned south along the western side and came out at Kiriath Baal (that is, Kiriath Jearim), a town of the people of Judah. This was the western side.

verses.textZh: 南方的疆界是从基列．耶琳的边缘起，向西伸展，去到尼弗多亚的水泉；
verses.textZhCnvs: 南方的疆界是从基列．耶琳的边缘起，向西伸展，去到尼弗多亚的水泉；
verses.textZhCuv: 南界是从基列‧耶琳的尽边起，往西达到尼弗多亚的水源；
verses.textEnNiv: The southern side began at the outskirts of Kiriath Jearim on the west, and the boundary came out at the spring of the waters of Nephtoah.
verses.textEnEsv: And the southern side begins at the outskirts of Kiriath-jearim. And the boundary goes from there to Ephron, to the spring of the waters of Nephtoah.
verses.textEnNkjv: The south side began at the end of Kirjath Jearim, and the border extended on the west and went out to the spring of the waters of Nephtoah.
verses.textEnNlt: The southern boundary began at the outskirts of Kiriath-jearim. From that western point it ran to the spring at the waters of Nephtoah,
verses.textEnNasb: Then the south side was from the edge of Kiriath-jearim, and the border went westward and went to the fountain of the waters of Nephtoah.
verses.textEn: The southern side began at the outskirts of Kiriath Jearim on the west, and the boundary came out at the spring of the waters of Nephtoah.

verses.textZh: 又下到欣嫩子谷前面的山边，就是利乏音谷北面的山；再下到欣嫩谷，去到耶布斯人的南边，又下去隐．罗结；
verses.textZhCnvs: 又下到欣嫩子谷前面的山边，就是利乏音谷北面的山；再下到欣嫩谷，去到耶布斯人的南边，又下去隐．罗结；
verses.textZhCuv: 又下到欣嫩子谷对面山的尽边，就是利乏音谷北边的山；又下到欣嫩谷，贴近耶布斯的南边；又下到隐‧罗结；
verses.textEnNiv: The boundary went down to the foot of the hill facing the Valley of Ben Hinnom, north of the Valley of Rephaim. It continued down the Hinnom Valley along the southern slope of the Jebusite city and so to En Rogel.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the boundary goes down to the border of the mountain that overlooks the Valley of the Son of Hinnom, which is at the north end of the Valley of Rephaim. And it then goes down the Valley of Hinnom, south of the shoulder of the Jebusites, and downward to En-rogel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the border came down to the end of the mountain that lies before the Valley of the Son of Hinnom, which is in the Valley of the Rephaim on the north, descended to the Valley of Hinnom, to the side of the Jebusite city on the south, and descended to En Rogel.
verses.textEnNlt: and down to the base of the mountain beside the valley of Ben-Hinnom, at the northern end of the valley of Rephaim. From there it went down the valley of Hinnom, crossing south of the slope where the Jebusites lived, and continued down to En-rogel.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the border went down to the edge of the hill which is in the Valley of Ben-hinnom, which is in the Valley of Rephaim northward; and it went down to the Valley of Hinnom, to the slope of the Jebusite southward, and went down to En-rogel.
verses.textEn: The boundary went down to the foot of the hill facing the Valley of Ben Hinnom, north of the Valley of Rephaim. It continued down the Hinnom Valley along the southern slope of the Jebusite city and so to En Rogel.

verses.textZh: 再转向北，伸展至隐．示麦，去到亚都冥斜坡对面的基利录，又下到流本的儿子波罕的盘石那里；
verses.textZhCnvs: 再转向北，伸展至隐．示麦，去到亚都冥斜坡对面的基利录，又下到流本的儿子波罕的盘石那里；
verses.textZhCuv: 又往北通到隐‧示麦，达到亚都冥坡对面的基利绿；又下到吕便之子波罕的磐石；
verses.textEnNiv: It then curved north, went to En Shemesh, continued to Geliloth, which faces the Pass of Adummim, and ran down to the Stone of Bohan son of Reuben.
verses.textEnEsv: Then it bends in a northerly direction going on to En-shemesh, and from there goes to Geliloth, which is opposite the ascent of Adummim. Then it goes down to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben,
verses.textEnNkjv: And it went around from the north, went out to En Shemesh, and extended toward Geliloth, which is before the Ascent of Adummim, and descended to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben.
verses.textEnNlt: From En-rogel the boundary proceeded in a northerly direction and came to En-shemesh and on to Geliloth (which is across from the slopes of Adummim). Then it went down to the Stone of Bohan. (Bohan was Reuben’s son.)
verses.textEnNasb: Then it turned northward and went to En-shemesh, and went to Geliloth, which is opposite the ascent of Adummim, and it went down to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben.
verses.textEn: It then curved north, went to En Shemesh, continued to Geliloth, which faces the Pass of Adummim, and ran down to the Stone of Bohan son of Reuben.

verses.textZh: 又经过亚拉巴对面山坡的北边，直下到亚拉巴；
verses.textZhCnvs: 又经过亚拉巴对面山坡的北边，直下到亚拉巴；
verses.textZhCuv: 又接连到亚拉巴对面，往北下到亚拉巴；
verses.textEnNiv: It continued to the northern slope of Beth Arabah and on down into the Arabah.
verses.textEnEsv: and passing on to the north of the shoulder of Beth-arabah it goes down to the Arabah.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then it passed along toward the north side of Arabah, and went down to Arabah.
verses.textEnNlt: From there it passed along the north side of the slope overlooking the Jordan Valley. The border then went down into the valley,
verses.textEnNasb: And it continued to the side in front of the Arabah northward, and went down to the Arabah.
verses.textEn: It continued to the northern slope of Beth Arabah and on down into the Arabah.

verses.textZh: 又经过伯．曷拉的北边，直通到盐海的北湾，约旦河的南端；这是南方的疆界。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又经过伯．曷拉的北边，直通到盐海的北湾，约旦河的南端；这是南方的疆界。
verses.textZhCuv: 又接连到伯‧曷拉的北边，直通到盐海的北汊，就是约旦河的南头；这是南界。
verses.textEnNiv: It then went to the northern slope of Beth Hoglah and came out at the northern bay of the Dead Sea, at the mouth of the Jordan in the south. This was the southern boundary.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the boundary passes on to the north of the shoulder of Beth-hoglah. And the boundary ends at the northern bay of the Salt Sea, at the south end of the Jordan: this is the southern border.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the border passed along to the north side of Beth Hoglah; then the border ended at the north bay at the Salt Sea, at the south end of the Jordan. This was the southern boundary.
verses.textEnNlt: ran past the north slope of Beth-hoglah, and ended at the north bay of the Dead Sea, which is the southern end of the Jordan River. This was the southern boundary.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the border continued to the side of Beth-hoglah northward; and the border ended at the north bay of the Salt Sea, at the south end of the Jordan. This was the southern border.
verses.textEn: It then went to the northern slope of Beth Hoglah and came out at the northern bay of the Dead Sea, at the mouth of the Jordan in the south. This was the southern boundary.

verses.textZh: 东方的疆界是约旦河。这就是便雅悯各家族所得的产业四围的疆界。
verses.textZhCnvs: 东方的疆界是约旦河。这就是便雅悯各家族所得的产业四围的疆界。
verses.textZhCuv: 东界是约旦河。这是便雅悯人按着宗族，照他们四围的交界所得的地业。
verses.textEnNiv: The Jordan formed the boundary on the eastern side. These were the boundaries that marked out the inheritance of the clans of Benjamin on all sides.
verses.textEnEsv: The Jordan forms its boundary on the eastern side. This is the inheritance of the people of Benjamin, according to their clans, boundary by boundary all around.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Jordan was its border on the east side. This was the inheritance of the children of Benjamin, according to its boundaries all around, according to their families.
verses.textEnNlt: The eastern boundary was the Jordan River. These were the boundaries of the homeland allocated to the clans of the tribe of Benjamin.
verses.textEnNasb: Moreover, the Jordan was its border on the east side. This was the inheritance of the sons of Benjamin according to their families, and according to its borders all around.
verses.textEn: The Jordan formed the boundary on the eastern side. These were the boundaries that marked out the inheritance of the clans of Benjamin on all sides.

verses.textZh: 便雅悯支派按着家族所得的城就是：耶利哥、伯．曷拉、伊麦．基悉、
verses.textZhCnvs: 便雅悯支派按着家族所得的城就是：耶利哥、伯．曷拉、伊麦．基悉、
verses.textZhCuv: 便雅悯支派按着宗族所得的城邑就是：耶利哥、伯‧曷拉、伊麦‧基悉、
verses.textEnNiv: The tribe of Benjamin, according to its clans, had the following towns: Jericho, Beth Hoglah, Emek Keziz,
verses.textEnEsv: Now the cities of the tribe of the people of Benjamin according to their clans were Jericho, Beth-hoglah, Emek-keziz,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the cities of the tribe of the children of Benjamin, according to their families, were Jericho, Beth Hoglah, Emek Keziz,
verses.textEnNlt: These were the towns given to the clans of the tribe of Benjamin. Jericho, Beth-hoglah, Emek-keziz,
verses.textEnNasb: Now the cities of the tribe of the sons of Benjamin according to their families were Jericho, Beth-hoglah, and Emek-keziz,
verses.textEn: The tribe of Benjamin, according to its clans, had the following towns: Jericho, Beth Hoglah, Emek Keziz,

verses.textZh: 洗拉、以利弗、耶布斯 、基比亚、基列，共十四座城，还有属于这些城的村庄。这就是便雅悯人按着家族所得的产业。
verses.textZhCnvs: 洗拉、以利弗、耶布斯 、基比亚、基列，共十四座城，还有属于这些城的村庄。这就是便雅悯人按着家族所得的产业。
verses.textZhCuv: 洗拉、以利弗、耶布斯（耶布斯就是耶路撒冷）、基比亚、基列，共十四座城，还有属城的村庄。这是便雅悯人按着宗族所得的地业。
verses.textEnNiv: Zelah, Haeleph, the Jebusite city (that is, Jerusalem), Gibeah and Kiriath—fourteen towns and their villages. This was the inheritance of Benjamin for its clans.
verses.textEnEsv: Zela, Haeleph, Jebus (that is, Jerusalem), Gibeah and Kiriath-jearim —fourteen cities with their villages. This is the inheritance of the people of Benjamin according to its clans.
verses.textEnNkjv: Zelah, Eleph, Jebus (which is Jerusalem), Gibeath, and Kirjath: fourteen cities with their villages. This was the inheritance of the children of Benjamin according to their families.
verses.textEnNlt: Zela, Haeleph, the Jebusite town (that is, Jerusalem), Gibeah, and Kiriath-jearim —fourteen towns with their surrounding villages. This was the homeland allocated to the clans of the tribe of Benjamin.
verses.textEnNasb: Zelah, Haeleph, the Jebusite city (that is, Jerusalem), Gibeah, Kiriath; fourteen cities with their villages. This is the inheritance of the sons of Benjamin according to their families.
verses.textEn: Zelah, Haeleph, the Jebusite city (that is, Jerusalem), Gibeah and Kiriath—fourteen towns and their villages. This was the inheritance of Benjamin for its clans.

verses.textZh: 为西缅，就是为西缅支派，按着家族抽出第二签；他们的产业是在犹大人的产业中间。
verses.textZhCnvs: 为西缅，就是为西缅支派，按着家族抽出第二签；他们的产业是在犹大人的产业中间。
verses.textZhCuv: 为西缅支派的人，按着宗族，拈出第二阄。他们所得的地业是在犹大人地业中间。
verses.textEnNiv: The second lot came out for the tribe of Simeon according to its clans. Their inheritance lay within the territory of Judah.
verses.textEnEsv: The second lot came out for Simeon, for the tribe of the people of Simeon, according to their clans, and their inheritance was in the midst of the inheritance of the people of Judah.
verses.textEnNkjv: The second lot came out for Simeon, for the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families. And their inheritance was within the inheritance of the children of Judah.
verses.textEnNlt: The second allotment of land went to the clans of the tribe of Simeon. Their homeland was surrounded by Judah’s territory.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the second lot went to Simeon, to the tribe of the sons of Simeon according to their families; and their inheritance was in the midst of the inheritance of the sons of Judah.
verses.textEn: The second lot came out for the tribe of Simeon according to its clans. Their inheritance lay within the territory of Judah.

verses.textZh: 他们所得的产业有别是巴、示巴、摩拉大、
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们所得的产业有别是巴、示巴、摩拉大、
verses.textZhCuv: 他们所得为业之地就是：别是巴（或名示巴）、摩拉大、
verses.textEnNiv: It included: Beersheba (or Sheba), Moladah,
verses.textEnEsv: And they had for their inheritance Beersheba, Sheba, Moladah,
verses.textEnNkjv: They had in their inheritance Beersheba (Sheba), Moladah,
verses.textEnNlt: Simeon’s homeland included Beersheba, Sheba, Moladah,
verses.textEnNasb: So they had in their inheritance Beersheba or Sheba and Moladah,
verses.textEn: It included: Beersheba (or Sheba), Moladah,
