verses.textEnNasb: Ziklag, Beth-marcaboth, and Hazar-susah,
verses.textEn: Ziklag, Beth Markaboth, Hazar Susah,

verses.textZh: 伯．利巴勿、沙鲁险，共十三座城，还有属于这些城的村庄；
verses.textZhCnvs: 伯．利巴勿、沙鲁险，共十三座城，还有属于这些城的村庄；
verses.textZhCuv: 伯‧利巴勿、沙鲁险，共十三座城，还有属城的村庄；
verses.textEnNiv: Beth Lebaoth and Sharuhen—thirteen towns and their villages;
verses.textEnEsv: Beth-lebaoth, and Sharuhen—thirteen cities with their villages;
verses.textEnNkjv: Beth Lebaoth, and Sharuhen: thirteen cities and their villages;
verses.textEnNlt: Beth-lebaoth, and Sharuhen—thirteen towns with their surrounding villages.
verses.textEnNasb: Beth-lebaoth, and Sharuhen; thirteen cities with their villages;
verses.textEn: Beth Lebaoth and Sharuhen—thirteen towns and their villages;

verses.textZh: 又有亚因、利门、以帖、亚珊，共四座城，还有属于这些城的村庄；
verses.textZhCnvs: 又有亚因、利门、以帖、亚珊，共四座城，还有属于这些城的村庄；
verses.textZhCuv: 又有亚因、利门、以帖、亚珊，共四座城，还有属城的村庄；
verses.textEnNiv: Ain, Rimmon, Ether and Ashan—four towns and their villages—
verses.textEnEsv: Ain, Rimmon, Ether, and Ashan—four cities with their villages,
verses.textEnNkjv: Ain, Rimmon, Ether, and Ashan: four cities and their villages;
verses.textEnNlt: It also included Ain, Rimmon, Ether, and Ashan—four towns with their villages,
verses.textEnNasb: Ain, Rimmon, Ether, and Ashan; four cities with their villages;
verses.textEn: Ain, Rimmon, Ether and Ashan—four towns and their villages—

verses.textZh: 以及这些城周围所有的村庄，直到巴拉．比珥，就是南地的拉玛。这就是西缅支派按着家族所得的产业。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以及这些城周围所有的村庄，直到巴拉．比珥，就是南地的拉玛。这就是西缅支派按着家族所得的产业。
verses.textZhCuv: 并有这些城邑四围一切的村庄，直到巴拉‧比珥，就是南地的拉玛。这是西缅支派按着宗族所得的地业。
verses.textEnNiv: and all the villages around these towns as far as Baalath Beer (Ramah in the Negev). This was the inheritance of the tribe of the Simeonites, according to its clans.
verses.textEnEsv: together with all the villages around these cities as far as Baalath-beer, Ramah of the Negeb. This was the inheritance of the tribe of the people of Simeon according to their clans.
verses.textEnNkjv: and all the villages that were all around these cities as far as Baalath Beer, Ramah of the South. This was the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families.
verses.textEnNlt: including all the surrounding villages as far south as Baalath-beer (also known as Ramah of the Negev). This was the homeland allocated to the clans of the tribe of Simeon.
verses.textEnNasb: and all the villages which were around these cities as far as Baalath-beer, Ramah of the Negev. This was the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Simeon according to their families.
verses.textEn: and all the villages around these towns as far as Baalath Beer (Ramah in the Negev). This was the inheritance of the tribe of the Simeonites, according to its clans.

verses.textZh: 西缅人的产业是从犹大人的地业中得来的；因为犹大人的分过大，所以西缅人在犹大人的产业中得了他们的产业。
verses.textZhCnvs: 西缅人的产业是从犹大人的地业中得来的；因为犹大人的分过大，所以西缅人在犹大人的产业中得了他们的产业。
verses.textZhCuv: 西缅人的地业是从犹大人地业中得来的；因为犹大人的分过多，所以西缅人在他们的地业中得了地业。
verses.textEnNiv: The inheritance of the Simeonites was taken from the share of Judah, because Judah’s portion was more than they needed. So the Simeonites received their inheritance within the territory of Judah.
verses.textEnEsv: The inheritance of the people of Simeon formed part of the territory of the people of Judah. Because the portion of the people of Judah was too large for them, the people of Simeon obtained an inheritance in the midst of their inheritance.
verses.textEnNkjv: The inheritance of the children of Simeon wasincluded in the share of the children of Judah, for the share of the children of Judah was too much for them. Therefore the children of Simeon had their inheritance within the inheritance of that people.
verses.textEnNlt: Their allocation of land came from part of what had been given to Judah because Judah’s territory was too large for them. So the tribe of Simeon received an allocation within the territory of Judah.
verses.textEnNasb: The inheritance of the sons of Simeon was taken from the portion of the sons of Judah, because the share of the sons of Judah was too large for them; so the sons of Simeon received an inheritance in the midst of Judah’s inheritance.
verses.textEn: The inheritance of the Simeonites was taken from the share of Judah, because Judah’s portion was more than they needed. So the Simeonites received their inheritance within the territory of Judah.

verses.textZh: 为西布伦人，按着家族抽出第三签；他们产业的境界去到撒立；
verses.textZhCnvs: 为西布伦人，按着家族抽出第三签；他们产业的境界去到撒立；
verses.textZhCuv: 为西布伦人，按着宗族，拈出第三阄。他们地业的境界是到撒立；
verses.textEnNiv: The third lot came up for Zebulun according to its clans: The boundary of their inheritance went as far as Sarid.
verses.textEnEsv: The third lot came up for the people of Zebulun, according to their clans. And the territory of their inheritance reached as far as Sarid.
verses.textEnNkjv: The third lot came out for the children of Zebulun according to their families, and the border of their inheritance was as far as Sarid.
verses.textEnNlt: The third allotment of land went to the clans of the tribe of Zebulun. The boundary of Zebulun’s homeland started at Sarid.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the third lot came up for the sons of Zebulun according to their families. And the territory of their inheritance was as far as Sarid.
verses.textEn: The third lot came up for Zebulun according to its clans: The boundary of their inheritance went as far as Sarid.

verses.textZh: 他们的疆界再向西上到玛拉拉，直达大巴设，再去到约念前面的河；
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们的疆界再向西上到玛拉拉，直达大巴设，再去到约念前面的河；
verses.textZhCuv: 往西上到玛拉拉，达到大巴设，又达到约念前的河；
verses.textEnNiv: Going west it ran to Maralah, touched Dabbesheth, and extended to the ravine near Jokneam.
verses.textEnEsv: Then their boundary goes up westward and on to Mareal and touches Dabbesheth, then the brook that is east of Jokneam.
verses.textEnNkjv: Their border went toward the west and to Maralah, went to Dabbasheth, and extended along the brook that is east of Jokneam.
verses.textEnNlt: From there it went west, going past Maralah, touching Dabbesheth, and proceeding to the brook east of Jokneam.
verses.textEnNasb: Then their border went up to the west and to Maralah, and it reached Dabbesheth and reached to the brook that is opposite Jokneam.
verses.textEn: Going west it ran to Maralah, touched Dabbesheth, and extended to the ravine near Jokneam.

verses.textZh: 又从撒立向东转到日出的方向，去到吉斯绿．他泊的境界，又伸展到大比拉，上到雅非亚；
verses.textZhCnvs: 又从撒立向东转到日出的方向，去到吉斯绿．他泊的境界，又伸展到大比拉，上到雅非亚；
verses.textZhCuv: 又从撒立往东转向日出之地，到吉斯绿‧他泊的境界，又通到大比拉，上到雅非亚；
verses.textEnNiv: It turned east from Sarid toward the sunrise to the territory of Kisloth Tabor and went on to Daberath and up to Japhia.
verses.textEnEsv: From Sarid it goes in the other direction eastward toward the sunrise to the boundary of Chisloth-tabor. From there it goes to Daberath, then up to Japhia.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then from Sarid it went eastward toward the sunrise along the border of Chisloth Tabor, and went out toward Daberath, bypassing Japhia.
verses.textEnNlt: In the other direction, the boundary went east from Sarid to the border of Kisloth-tabor, and from there to Daberath and up to Japhia.
verses.textEnNasb: Then it turned from Sarid to the east toward the sunrise as far as the border of Chisloth-tabor, and it proceeded to Daberath and up to Japhia.
verses.textEn: It turned east from Sarid toward the sunrise to the territory of Kisloth Tabor and went on to Daberath and up to Japhia.

verses.textZh: 又从那里往东面日出的方向，经过迦特．希弗，到以特．加汛、临门，再伸展到尼亚；
verses.textZhCnvs: 又从那里往东面日出的方向，经过迦特．希弗，到以特．加汛、临门，再伸展到尼亚；
verses.textZhCuv: 从那里往东，接连到迦特‧希弗，至以特‧加汛，通到临门，临门延到尼亚；
verses.textEnNiv: Then it continued eastward to Gath Hepher and Eth Kazin; it came out at Rimmon and turned toward Neah.
verses.textEnEsv: From there it passes along on the east toward the sunrise to Gath-hepher, to Eth-kazin, and going on to Rimmon it bends toward Neah,
verses.textEnNkjv: And from there it passed along on the east of Gath Hepher, toward Eth Kazin, and extended to Rimmon, which borders on Neah.
verses.textEnNlt: Then it continued east to Gath-hepher, Eth-kazin, and Rimmon and turned toward Neah.
verses.textEnNasb: From there it continued eastward toward the sunrise to Gath-hepher, to Eth-kazin, and it proceeded to Rimmon which stretches to Neah.
verses.textEn: Then it continued eastward to Gath Hepher and Eth Kazin; it came out at Rimmon and turned toward Neah.

verses.textZh: 又绕过尼亚的北面，到哈拿顿，直通到伊弗他．伊勒谷；
verses.textZhCnvs: 又绕过尼亚的北面，到哈拿顿，直通到伊弗他．伊勒谷；
verses.textZhCuv: 又绕过尼亚的北边，转到哈拿顿，通到伊弗他‧伊勒谷。
verses.textEnNiv: There the boundary went around on the north to Hannathon and ended at the Valley of Iphtah El.
verses.textEnEsv: then on the north the boundary turns about to Hannathon, and it ends at the Valley of Iphtahel;
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the border went around it on the north side of Hannathon, and it ended in the Valley of Jiphthah El.
verses.textEnNlt: The northern boundary of Zebulun passed Hannathon and ended at the valley of Iphtah-el.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the border circled around it on the north to Hannathon, and it ended at the Valley of Iphtahel.
verses.textEn: There the boundary went around on the north to Hannathon and ended at the Valley of Iphtah El.

verses.textZh: 还有加他、拿哈拉、伸仑、以大拉、伯利恒，共有十二座城，还有属于这些城的村庄。
verses.textZhCnvs: 还有加他、拿哈拉、伸仑、以大拉、伯利恒，共有十二座城，还有属于这些城的村庄。
verses.textZhCuv: 还有加他、拿哈拉、伸仑、以大拉、伯利恒，共十二座城，还有属城的村庄。
verses.textEnNiv: Included were Kattath, Nahalal, Shimron, Idalah and Bethlehem. There were twelve towns and their villages.
verses.textEnEsv: and Kattath, Nahalal, Shimron, Idalah, and Bethlehem—twelve cities with their villages.
verses.textEnNkjv: Included were Kattath, Nahallal, Shimron, Idalah, and Bethlehem: twelve cities with their villages.
verses.textEnNlt: The towns in these areas included Kattath, Nahalal, Shimron, Idalah, and Bethlehem—twelve towns with their surrounding villages.
verses.textEnNasb: Included also were Kattah, Nahalal, Shimron, Idalah, and Bethlehem; twelve cities with their villages.
verses.textEn: Included were Kattath, Nahalal, Shimron, Idalah and Bethlehem. There were twelve towns and their villages.

verses.textZh: 这些城和属于这些城的村庄，就是西布伦人按着家族所得的产业。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些城和属于这些城的村庄，就是西布伦人按着家族所得的产业。
verses.textZhCuv: 这些城并属城的村庄就是西布伦人按着宗族所得的地业。
verses.textEnNiv: These towns and their villages were the inheritance of Zebulun, according to its clans.
verses.textEnEsv: This is the inheritance of the people of Zebulun, according to their clans—these cities with their villages.
verses.textEnNkjv: This was the inheritance of the children of Zebulun according to their families, these cities with their villages.
verses.textEnNlt: The homeland allocated to the clans of the tribe of Zebulun included these towns and their surrounding villages.
verses.textEnNasb: This was the inheritance of the sons of Zebulun according to their families, these cities with their villages.
verses.textEn: These towns and their villages were the inheritance of Zebulun, according to its clans.

verses.textZh: 为以萨迦，就是为以萨迦人，按着家族抽出第四签。
verses.textZhCnvs: 为以萨迦，就是为以萨迦人，按着家族抽出第四签。
verses.textZhCuv: 为以萨迦人，按着宗族，拈出第四阄。
verses.textEnNiv: The fourth lot came out for Issachar according to its clans.
verses.textEnEsv: The fourth lot came out for Issachar, for the people of Issachar, according to their clans.
verses.textEnNkjv: The fourth lot came out to Issachar, for the children of Issachar according to their families.
verses.textEnNlt: The fourth allotment of land went to the clans of the tribe of Issachar.
verses.textEnNasb: The fourth lot went to Issachar, to the sons of Issachar according to their families.
verses.textEn: The fourth lot came out for Issachar according to its clans.

verses.textZh: 他们的境界包括耶斯列、基苏律、书念、
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们的境界包括耶斯列、基苏律、书念、
verses.textZhCuv: 他们的境界是到耶斯列、基苏律、书念、
verses.textEnNiv: Their territory included: Jezreel, Kesulloth, Shunem,
verses.textEnEsv: Their territory included Jezreel, Chesulloth, Shunem,
verses.textEnNkjv: And their territory went to Jezreel, and included Chesulloth, Shunem,
verses.textEnNlt: Its boundaries included the following towns: Jezreel, Kesulloth, Shunem,
verses.textEnNasb: Their territory was to Jezreel and included Chesulloth, Shunem,
verses.textEn: Their territory included: Jezreel, Kesulloth, Shunem,

verses.textZh: 哈弗连、示按、亚拿哈拉、

verses.textZhCuv: 哈弗连、示按、亚拿哈拉、

verses.textEnEsv: Hapharaim, Shion, Anaharath,
verses.textEnNkjv: Haphraim, Shion, Anaharath,
verses.textEnNlt: Hapharaim, Shion, Anaharath,
verses.textEnNasb: Hapharaim, Shion, and Anaharath,
verses.textEn: Hapharaim, Shion, Anaharath,

verses.textZh: 拉璧、基善、亚别、
verses.textZhCnvs: 拉璧、基善、亚别、
verses.textZhCuv: 拉璧、基善、亚别、

verses.textEnNasb: Rabbith, Kishion, and Ebez,
verses.textEn: Rabbith, Kishion, Ebez,

verses.textZh: 利蔑、隐．干宁、隐．哈大、伯．帕薛，
verses.textZhCnvs: 利蔑、隐．干宁、隐．哈大、伯．帕薛，
verses.textZhCuv: 利篾、隐‧干宁、隐‧哈大、伯‧帕薛；
verses.textEnNiv: Remeth, En Gannim, En Haddah and Beth Pazzez.
verses.textEnEsv: Remeth, En-gannim, En-haddah, Beth-pazzez.
verses.textEnNkjv: Remeth, En Gannim, En Haddah, and Beth Pazzez.
verses.textEnNlt: Remeth, En-gannim, En-haddah, and Beth-pazzez.
verses.textEnNasb: Remeth, En-gannim, En-haddah, and Beth-pazzez.
verses.textEn: Remeth, En Gannim, En Haddah and Beth Pazzez.

verses.textZh: 又达到他泊、沙哈洗玛、伯．示麦，直通到约旦河，共十六座城，还有属于这些城的村庄。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又达到他泊、沙哈洗玛、伯．示麦，直通到约旦河，共十六座城，还有属于这些城的村庄。
verses.textZhCuv: 又达到他泊、沙哈洗玛、伯‧示麦，直通到约旦河为止，共十六座城，还有属城的村庄。
verses.textEnNiv: The boundary touched Tabor, Shahazumah and Beth Shemesh, and ended at the Jordan. There were sixteen towns and their villages.
verses.textEnEsv: The boundary also touches Tabor, Shahazumah, and Beth-shemesh, and its boundary ends at the Jordan—sixteen cities with their villages.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the border reached to Tabor, Shahazimah, and Beth Shemesh; their border ended at the Jordan: sixteen cities with their villages.
verses.textEnNlt: The boundary also touched Tabor, Shahazumah, and Beth-shemesh, ending at the Jordan River—sixteen towns with their surrounding villages.
verses.textEnNasb: The border reached to Tabor, Shahazumah, and Beth-shemesh, and their border ended at the Jordan; sixteen cities with their villages.
verses.textEn: The boundary touched Tabor, Shahazumah and Beth Shemesh, and ended at the Jordan. There were sixteen towns and their villages.

verses.textZh: 这些城和属于这些城的村庄，就是以萨迦支派按着家族所得的产业。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些城和属于这些城的村庄，就是以萨迦支派按着家族所得的产业。
verses.textZhCuv: 这些城并属城的村庄就是以萨迦支派按着宗族所得的地业。
verses.textEnNiv: These towns and their villages were the inheritance of the tribe of Issachar, according to its clans.
verses.textEnEsv: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the people of Issachar, according to their clans—the cities with their villages.
verses.textEnNkjv: This was the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Issachar according to their families, the cities and their villages.
verses.textEnNlt: The homeland allocated to the clans of the tribe of Issachar included these towns and their surrounding villages.
verses.textEnNasb: This was the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Issachar according to their families, the cities with their villages.
verses.textEn: These towns and their villages were the inheritance of the tribe of Issachar, according to its clans.

verses.textZh: 为亚设支派，按着家族抽出第五签。
verses.textZhCnvs: 为亚设支派，按着家族抽出第五签。
verses.textZhCuv: 为亚设支派，按着宗族，拈出第五阄。
verses.textEnNiv: The fifth lot came out for the tribe of Asher according to its clans.
verses.textEnEsv: The fifth lot came out for the tribe of the people of Asher according to their clans.
verses.textEnNkjv: The fifth lot came out for the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families.
verses.textEnNlt: The fifth allotment of land went to the clans of the tribe of Asher.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the fifth lot went to the tribe of the sons of Asher according to their families.
verses.textEn: The fifth lot came out for the tribe of Asher according to its clans.

verses.textZh: 他们的境界包括黑甲、哈利、比田、押煞、
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们的境界包括黑甲、哈利、比田、押煞、
verses.textZhCuv: 他们的境界是黑甲、哈利、比田、押煞、
verses.textEnNiv: Their territory included: Helkath, Hali, Beten, Akshaph,
verses.textEnEsv: Their territory included Helkath, Hali, Beten, Achshaph,
verses.textEnNkjv: And their territory included Helkath, Hali, Beten, Achshaph,
verses.textEnNlt: Its boundaries included these towns: Helkath, Hali, Beten, Acshaph,
verses.textEnNasb: Their territory was Helkath, Hali, Beten, and Achshaph,
verses.textEn: Their territory included: Helkath, Hali, Beten, Akshaph,

verses.textZh: 亚拉米勒、亚末、米沙勒，向西直达迦密和希曷．立纳；
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚拉米勒、亚末、米沙勒，向西直达迦密和希曷．立纳；
verses.textZhCuv: 亚拉米勒、亚末、米沙勒；往西达到迦密，又到希曷‧立纳，
verses.textEnNiv: Allammelek, Amad and Mishal. On the west the boundary touched Carmel and Shihor Libnath.
verses.textEnEsv: Allammelech, Amad, and Mishal. On the west it touches Carmel and Shihor-libnath,
verses.textEnNkjv: Alammelech, Amad, and Mishal; it reached to Mount Carmel westward, along theBrook Shihor Libnath.
verses.textEnNlt: Allammelech, Amad, and Mishal. The boundary on the west touched Carmel and Shihor-libnath,
verses.textEnNasb: Allammelech, Amad, and Mishal; and it reached to Carmel on the west and Shihor-libnath.
verses.textEn: Allammelek, Amad and Mishal. On the west the boundary touched Carmel and Shihor Libnath.

verses.textZh: 又转往日出的方向，到伯．大衮，延伸到细步纶，向北去到伊弗他．伊勒谷、伯．以墨和尼业，又伸展到迦布勒的左边，
verses.textZhCnvs: 又转往日出的方向，到伯．大衮，延伸到细步纶，向北去到伊弗他．伊勒谷、伯．以墨和尼业，又伸展到迦布勒的左边，
verses.textZhCuv: 转向日出之地，到伯‧大衮，达到西布伦；往北到伊弗他‧伊勒谷，到伯‧以墨和尼业，也通到迦步勒的左边；
verses.textEnNiv: It then turned east toward Beth Dagon, touched Zebulun and the Valley of Iphtah El, and went north to Beth Emek and Neiel, passing Kabul on the left.
verses.textEnEsv: then it turns eastward, it goes to Beth-dagon, and touches Zebulun and the Valley of Iphtahel northward to Beth-emek and Neiel. Then it continues in the north to Cabul,
verses.textEnNkjv: It turned toward the sunrise to Beth Dagon; and it reached to Zebulun and to the Valley of Jiphthah El, then northward beyond Beth Emek and Neiel, bypassing Cabul whichwas on the left,
verses.textEnNlt: then it turned east toward Beth-dagon, and ran as far as Zebulun in the valley of Iphtah-el, going north to Beth-emek and Neiel. It then continued north to Cabul,
verses.textEnNasb: It turned toward the east to Beth-dagon and reached Zebulun, and to the Valley of Iphtahel northward to Beth-emek and Neiel; then it proceeded on north to Cabul,
verses.textEn: It then turned east toward Beth Dagon, touched Zebulun and the Valley of Iphtah El, and went north to Beth Emek and Neiel, passing Kabul on the left.

verses.textZh: 到义伯仑、利合、哈们、加拿，直到西顿大城；

verses.textZhCuv: 又到义伯仑、利合、哈们、加拿，直到西顿大城；

verses.textEnEsv: Ebron, Rehob, Hammon, Kanah, as far as Sidon the Great.
verses.textEnNkjv: including Ebron, Rehob, Hammon, and Kanah, as far as Greater Sidon.
verses.textEnNlt: Abdon, Rehob, Hammon, Kanah, and as far as Greater Sidon.
verses.textEnNasb: Ebron, Rehob, Hammon, and Kanah, as far as Great Sidon.
verses.textEn: It went to Abdon, Rehob, Hammon and Kanah, as far as Greater Sidon.

verses.textZh: 又转到拉玛，直到设防的城推罗；再转到何萨，直通到海岸靠近亚革悉的地区；
verses.textZhCnvs: 又转到拉玛，直到设防的城推罗；再转到何萨，直通到海岸靠近亚革悉的地区；
verses.textZhCuv: 转到拉玛和坚固城泰尔；又转到何萨，靠近亚革悉一带地方，直通到海；
verses.textEnNiv: The boundary then turned back toward Ramah and went to the fortified city of Tyre, turned toward Hosah and came out at the Mediterranean Sea in the region of Akzib,
verses.textEnEsv: Then the boundary turns to Ramah, reaching to the fortified city of Tyre. Then the boundary turns to Hosah, and it ends at the sea; Mahalab, Achzib,
verses.textEnNkjv: And the border turned to Ramah and to the fortified city of Tyre; then the border turned to Hosah, and ended at the sea by the region of Achzib.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the boundary turned toward Ramah and the fortress of Tyre, where it turned toward Hosah and came to the Mediterranean Sea. The territory also included Mehebel, Aczib,
verses.textEnNasb: The border turned to Ramah and to the fortified city of Tyre; then the border turned to Hosah, and it ended at the sea by the region of Achzib.
verses.textEn: The boundary then turned back toward Ramah and went to the fortified city of Tyre, turned toward Hosah and came out at the Mediterranean Sea in the region of Akzib,

verses.textZh: 又有乌玛、亚弗、利合，共二十二座城，还有属于这些城的村庄。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又有乌玛、亚弗、利合，共二十二座城，还有属于这些城的村庄。

verses.textEnNiv: Ummah, Aphek and Rehob. There were twenty-two towns and their villages.

verses.textEnNlt: Ummah, Aphek, and Rehob—twenty-two towns with their surrounding villages.

verses.textEn: Ummah, Aphek and Rehob. There were twenty-two towns and their villages.

verses.textEnNkjv: This was the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families, these cities with their villages.
verses.textEnNlt: The homeland allocated to the clans of the tribe of Asher included these towns and their surrounding villages.

verses.textEn: These towns and their villages were the inheritance of the tribe of Asher, according to its clans.

verses.textEnNlt: The sixth allotment of land went to the clans of the tribe of Naphtali.
verses.textEnNasb: The sixth lot went to the sons of Naphtali; to the sons of Naphtali according to their families.
verses.textEn: The sixth lot came out for Naphtali according to its clans:

verses.textZh: 他们的疆界，是从希利弗，从撒拿音的橡树林，从亚大米．尼吉和雅比聂起，去到拉共，直通到约旦河；
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们的疆界，是从希利弗，从撒拿音的橡树林，从亚大米．尼吉和雅比聂起，去到拉共，直通到约旦河；
verses.textZhCuv: 他们的境界是从希利弗从撒拿音的橡树，从亚大米‧尼吉和雅比聂，直到拉共，通到约旦河；
verses.textEnNiv: Their boundary went from Heleph and the large tree in Zaanannim, passing Adami Nekeb and Jabneel to Lakkum and ending at the Jordan.
verses.textEnEsv: And their boundary ran from Heleph, from the oak in Zaanannim, and Adami-nekeb, and Jabneel, as far as Lakkum, and it ended at the Jordan.
verses.textEnNkjv: And their border began at Heleph, enclosing the territory from the terebinth tree in Zaanannim, Adami Nekeb, and Jabneel, as far as Lakkum; it ended at the Jordan.
verses.textEnNlt: Its boundary ran from Heleph, from the oak at Zaanannim, and extended across to Adami-nekeb, Jabneel, and as far as Lakkum, ending at the Jordan River.
verses.textEnNasb: Their border was from Heleph, from the oak in Zaanannim, and Adami-nekeb and Jabneel, as far as Lakkum, and it ended at the Jordan.
verses.textEn: Their boundary went from Heleph and the large tree in Zaanannim, passing Adami Nekeb and Jabneel to Lakkum and ending at the Jordan.

verses.textZh: 又向西转到亚斯纳．他泊，从那里伸展到户割，南边达到西布伦，西边达到亚设，东边达到约旦河那里的犹大。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又向西转到亚斯纳．他泊，从那里伸展到户割，南边达到西布伦，西边达到亚设，东边达到约旦河那里的犹大。
verses.textZhCuv: 又转向西到亚斯纳‧他泊，从那里通到户割，南边到西布伦，西边到亚设，又向日出之地，达到约旦河那里的犹大。
verses.textEnNiv: The boundary ran west through Aznoth Tabor and came out at Hukkok. It touched Zebulun on the south, Asher on the west and the Jordan on the east.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the boundary turns westward to Aznoth-tabor and goes from there to Hukkok, touching Zebulun at the south and Asher on the west and Judah on the east at the Jordan.
verses.textEnNkjv: From Heleph the border extended westward to Aznoth Tabor, and went out from there toward Hukkok; it adjoined Zebulun on the south side and Asher on the west side, and ended at Judah by the Jordan toward the sunrise.
verses.textEnNlt: The western boundary ran past Aznoth-tabor, then to Hukkok, and touched the border of Zebulun in the south, the border of Asher on the west, and the Jordan River on the east.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the border turned westward to Aznoth-tabor and proceeded from there to Hukkok; and it reached Zebulun on the south and reached Asher on the west, and Judah at the Jordan toward the east.
verses.textEn: The boundary ran west through Aznoth Tabor and came out at Hukkok. It touched Zebulun on the south, Asher on the west and the Jordan on the east.

verses.textZh: 但人未能控制他们的境界，因此他们就上去攻打利善，夺取那城，用刀击杀了城中的人；他们占领利善，就住在城中，以他们祖先但的名字，把利善改名为但。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但人未能控制他们的境界，因此他们就上去攻打利善，夺取那城，用刀击杀了城中的人；他们占领利善，就住在城中，以他们祖先但的名字，把利善改名为但。
verses.textZhCuv: 但人的地界越过原得的地界；因为但人上去攻取利善，用刀击杀城中的人，得了那城，住在其中，以他们先祖但的名将利善改名为但。
verses.textEnNiv: (When the territory of the Danites was lost to them, they went up and attacked Leshem, took it, put it to the sword and occupied it. They settled in Leshem and named it Dan after their ancestor.)
verses.textEnEsv: When the territory of the people of Dan was lost to them, the people of Dan went up and fought against Leshem, and after capturing it and striking it with the sword they took possession of it and settled in it, calling Leshem, Dan, after the name of Dan their ancestor.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the border of the children of Dan went beyond these, because the children of Dan went up to fight against Leshem and took it; and they struck it with the edge of the sword, took possession of it, and dwelt in it. They called Leshem, Dan, after the name of Dan their father.
verses.textEnNlt: But the tribe of Dan had trouble taking possession of their land, so they attacked the town of Laish. They captured it, slaughtered its people, and settled there. They renamed the town Dan after their ancestor.
verses.textEnNasb: The territory of the sons of Dan proceeded beyond them; for the sons of Dan went up and fought with Leshem and captured it. Then they struck it with the edge of the sword and took possession of it and settled in it; and they named Leshem Dan after the name of their father Dan.
verses.textEn: (When the territory of the Danites was lost to them, they went up and attacked Leshem, took it, put it to the sword and occupied it. They settled in Leshem and named it Dan after their ancestor.)

verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人按着疆界把地分完了之后，就在他们中间把产业分给嫩的儿子约书亚。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人按着境界分完了地业，就在他们中间将地给嫩的儿子约书亚为业，
verses.textEnNiv: When they had finished dividing the land into its allotted portions, the Israelites gave Joshua son of Nun an inheritance among them,
verses.textEnEsv: When they had finished distributing the several territories of the land as inheritances, the people of Israel gave an inheritance among them to Joshua the son of Nun.
verses.textEnNkjv: When they had made an end of dividing the land as an inheritance according to their borders, the children of Israel gave an inheritance among them to Joshua the son of Nun.
verses.textEnNlt: After all the land was divided among the tribes, the Israelites gave a piece of land to Joshua as his allocation.
verses.textEnNasb: When they finished apportioning the land for inheritance by its borders, the sons of Israel gave an inheritance among them to Joshua the son of Nun.
verses.textEn: When they had finished dividing the land into its allotted portions, the Israelites gave Joshua son of Nun an inheritance among them,

verses.textZh: 他们照着耶和华所吩咐的，把约书亚所要的城，就是以法莲山地的亭拿．西拉，给了他；约书亚就修建那城，住在城中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们照着耶和华所吩咐的，把约书亚所要的城，就是以法莲山地的亭拿．西拉，给了他；约书亚就修建那城，住在城中。
verses.textZhCuv: 是照耶和华的吩咐，将约书亚所求的城，就是以法莲山地的亭拿‧西拉城，给了他。他就修那城，住在其中。
verses.textEnNiv: as the Lord had commanded. They gave him the town he asked for—Timnath Serah in the hill country of Ephraim. And he built up the town and settled there.
verses.textEnEsv: By command of the Lord they gave him the city that he asked, Timnath-serah in the hill country of Ephraim. And he rebuilt the city and settled in it.
verses.textEnNkjv: According to the word of the Lord they gave him the city which he asked for, Timnath Serah in the mountains of Ephraim; and he built the city and dwelt in it.
verses.textEnNlt: For the Lord had said he could have any town he wanted. He chose Timnath-serah in the hill country of Ephraim. He rebuilt the town and lived there.
verses.textEnNasb: In accordance with the command of the Lord, they gave him the city for which he asked, Timnath-serah in the hill country of Ephraim. So he built the city and settled in it.
verses.textEn: as the Lord had commanded. They gave him the town he asked for—Timnath Serah in the hill country of Ephraim. And he built up the town and settled there.

verses.textZh: 以上就是以利亚撒祭司和嫩的儿子约书亚，以及以色列人各支派的族长，在示罗会幕的门口，在耶和华面前，借着抽签所分的产业。这样，他们就完成了分地的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以上就是以利亚撒祭司和嫩的儿子约书亚，以及以色列人各支派的族长，在示罗会幕的门口，在耶和华面前，借着抽签所分的产业。这样，他们就完成了分地的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 这就是祭司以利亚撒和嫩的儿子约书亚，并以色列各支派的族长，在示罗会幕门口，耶和华面前，拈阄所分的地业。这样，他们把地分完了。
verses.textEnNiv: These are the territories that Eleazar the priest, Joshua son of Nun and the heads of the tribal clans of Israel assigned by lot at Shiloh in the presence of the Lord at the entrance to the tent of meeting. And so they finished dividing the land.
verses.textEnEsv: These are the inheritances that Eleazar the priest and Joshua the son of Nun and the heads of the fathers’ houses of the tribes of the people of Israel distributed by lot at Shiloh before the Lord , at the entrance of the tent of meeting. So they finished dividing the land.
verses.textEnNkjv: These were the inheritances which Eleazar the priest, Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel divided as an inheritance by lot in Shiloh before the Lord, at the door of the tabernacle of meeting. So they made an end of dividing the country.
verses.textEnNlt: These are the territories that Eleazar the priest, Joshua son of Nun, and the tribal leaders allocated as grants of land to the tribes of Israel by casting sacred lots in the presence of the Lord at the entrance of the Tabernacle at Shiloh. So the division of the land was completed.
verses.textEnNasb: These are the inheritances which Eleazar the priest, Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers’ households of the tribes of the sons of Israel apportioned by lot in Shiloh before the Lord at the doorway of the tent of meeting. So they finished dividing the land.
verses.textEn: These are the territories that Eleazar the priest, Joshua son of Nun and the heads of the tribal clans of Israel assigned by lot at Shiloh in the presence of the Lord at the entrance to the tent of meeting. And so they finished dividing the land.

verses.textZh: 耶和华对约书亚说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对约书亚说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华晓谕约书亚说：
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord said to Joshua:
verses.textEnEsv: Then the Lord said to Joshua,
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord also spoke to Joshua, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord said to Joshua,
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord spoke to Joshua, saying,
verses.textEn: Then the Lord said to Joshua:

verses.textZh: "你要告诉以色列人：‘你们要照着我借着摩西命令你们的，为自己设立避难城，
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要告诉以色列人：‘你们要照着我借着摩西命令你们的，为自己设立避难城，
verses.textZhCuv: 「你吩咐以色列人说：你们要照着我藉摩西所晓谕你们的，为自己设立逃城，
verses.textEnNiv: "Tell the Israelites to designate the cities of refuge, as I instructed you through Moses,
verses.textEnEsv: "Say to the people of Israel, ‘Appoint the cities of refuge, of which I spoke to you through Moses,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Speak to the children of Israel, saying: ‘Appoint for yourselves cities of refuge, of which I spoke to you through Moses,
verses.textEnNlt: "Now tell the Israelites to designate the cities of refuge, as I instructed Moses.
verses.textEnNasb: "Speak to the sons of Israel, saying, ‘ Designate the cities of refuge, of which I spoke to you through Moses,
verses.textEn: "Tell the Israelites to designate the cities of refuge, as I instructed you through Moses,

verses.textZh: 好使那出于错误、并非蓄意杀人的，可以逃到那里去；这些城要成为你们逃避报血仇的人的避难所。
verses.textZhCnvs: 好使那出于错误、并非蓄意杀人的，可以逃到那里去；这些城要成为你们逃避报血仇的人的避难所。
verses.textZhCuv: 使那无心而误杀人的，可以逃到那里。这些城可以作你们逃避报血仇人的地方。
verses.textEnNiv: so that anyone who kills a person accidentally and unintentionally may flee there and find protection from the avenger of blood.
verses.textEnEsv: that the manslayer who strikes any person without intent or unknowingly may flee there. They shall be for you a refuge from the avenger of blood.
verses.textEnNkjv: that the slayer who kills a person accidentally or unintentionally may flee there; and they shall be your refuge from the avenger of blood.
verses.textEnNlt: Anyone who kills another person accidentally and unintentionally can run to one of these cities; they will be places of refuge from relatives seeking revenge for the person who was killed.
verses.textEnNasb: so that one who commits manslaughter by killing a person unintentionally, without premeditation, may flee there, and they shall become your refuge from the avenger of blood.
verses.textEn: so that anyone who kills a person accidentally and unintentionally may flee there and find protection from the avenger of blood.

verses.textZh: 那杀人的要逃到这些城中的一座，站在城门口，把自己的事情向城中的众长老述说，长老就要把他接入城中，到他们那里，并要给他地方，使他可以住在他们中间。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那杀人的要逃到这些城中的一座，站在城门口，把自己的事情向城中的众长老述说，长老就要把他接入城中，到他们那里，并要给他地方，使他可以住在他们中间。
verses.textZhCuv: 那杀人的要逃到这些城中的一座城，站在城门口，将他的事情说给城内的长老们听。他们就把他收进城里，给他地方，使他住在他们中间。
verses.textEnNiv: When they flee to one of these cities, they are to stand in the entrance of the city gate and state their case before the elders of that city. Then the elders are to admit the fugitive into their city and provide a place to live among them.
verses.textEnEsv: He shall flee to one of these cities and shall stand at the entrance of the gate of the city and explain his case to the elders of that city. Then they shall take him into the city and give him a place, and he shall remain with them.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when he flees to one of those cities, and stands at the entrance of the gate of the city, and declares his case in the hearing of the elders of that city, they shall take him into the city as one of them, and give him a place, that he may dwell among them.
verses.textEnNlt: "Upon reaching one of these cities, the one who caused the death will appear before the elders at the city gate and present his case. They must allow him to enter the city and give him a place to live among them.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he shall flee to one of these cities, and shall stand at the entrance of the gate of the city, and state his case in the presence of the elders of that city; and they shall receive him into the city to them and give him a place, so that he may remain among them.
verses.textEn: When they flee to one of these cities, they are to stand in the entrance of the city gate and state their case before the elders of that city. Then the elders are to admit the fugitive into their city and provide a place to live among them.

verses.textZh: 如果报血仇的人追赶他，长老不可把他交在报血仇的人手里，因为他并非蓄意杀人，他以前与他并没有仇恨。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果报血仇的人追赶他，长老不可把他交在报血仇的人手里，因为他并非蓄意杀人，他以前与他并没有仇恨。
verses.textZhCuv: 若是报血仇的追了他来，长老不可将他交在报血仇的手里；因为他是素无仇恨，无心杀了人的。
verses.textEnNiv: If the avenger of blood comes in pursuit, the elders must not surrender the fugitive, because the fugitive killed their neighbor unintentionally and without malice aforethought.
verses.textEnEsv: And if the avenger of blood pursues him, they shall not give up the manslayer into his hand, because he struck his neighbor unknowingly, and did not hate him in the past.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then if the avenger of blood pursues him, they shall not deliver the slayer into his hand, because he struck his neighbor unintentionally, but did not hate him beforehand.
verses.textEnNlt: If the relatives of the victim come to avenge the killing, the leaders must not release the slayer to them, for he killed the other person unintentionally and without previous hostility.
verses.textEnNasb: Now if the avenger of blood pursues him, then they are not to hand the one who committed manslaughter over to him, since he struck his neighbor without premeditation and did not hate him previously.
verses.textEn: If the avenger of blood comes in pursuit, the elders must not surrender the fugitive, because the fugitive killed their neighbor unintentionally and without malice aforethought.

verses.textZh: 那杀人的要住在那城里，直到他站在会众面前受审；等到当时的大祭司死了，才可以回到本城本家，回到他逃出来的城那里。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那杀人的要住在那城里，直到他站在会众面前受审；等到当时的大祭司死了，才可以回到本城本家，回到他逃出来的城那里。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 他要住在那城里，站在会众面前听审判，等到那时的大祭司死了，杀人的才可以回到本城本家，就是他所逃出来的那城。」
verses.textEnNiv: They are to stay in that city until they have stood trial before the assembly and until the death of the high priest who is serving at that time. Then they may go back to their own home in the town from which they fled."
verses.textEnEsv: And he shall remain in that city until he has stood before the congregation for judgment, until the death of him who is high priest at the time. Then the manslayer may return to his own town and his own home, to the town from which he fled.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: And he shall dwell in that city until he stands before the congregation for judgment, and until the death of the one who is high priest in those days. Then the slayer may return and come to his own city and his own house, to the city from which he fled.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: But the slayer must stay in that city and be tried by the local assembly, which will render a judgment. And he must continue to live in that city until the death of the high priest who was in office at the time of the accident. After that, he is free to return to his own home in the town from which he fled."
verses.textEnNasb: And he shall remain in that city until he stands before the congregation for judgment, until the death of the one who is high priest in those days. Then he shall return to his own city and to his own house, to the city from which he fled.’ "
verses.textEn: They are to stay in that city until they have stood trial before the assembly and until the death of the high priest who is serving at that time. Then they may go back to their own home in the town from which they fled."

verses.textZh: 于是以色列人在拿弗他利山地，把加利利的基低斯分别出来；在以法莲山地，把示剑分别出来；在犹大山地，把基列．亚巴分别出来，基列．亚巴就是希伯仑；
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是以色列人在拿弗他利山地，把加利利的基低斯分别出来；在以法莲山地，把示剑分别出来；在犹大山地，把基列．亚巴分别出来，基列．亚巴就是希伯仑；
verses.textZhCuv: 于是，以色列人在拿弗他利山地分定加利利的基低斯；在以法莲山地分定示剑；在犹大山地分定基列‧亚巴（基列‧亚巴就是希伯仑）；
verses.textEnNiv: So they set apart Kedesh in Galilee in the hill country of Naphtali, Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim, and Kiriath Arba (that is, Hebron) in the hill country of Judah.
verses.textEnEsv: So they set apart Kedesh in Galilee in the hill country of Naphtali, and Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim, and Kiriath-arba (that is, Hebron) in the hill country of Judah.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they appointed Kedesh in Galilee, in the mountains of Naphtali, Shechem in the mountains of Ephraim, and Kirjath Arba (which is Hebron) in the mountains of Judah.
verses.textEnNlt: The following cities were designated as cities of refuge: Kedesh of Galilee, in the hill country of Naphtali; Shechem, in the hill country of Ephraim; and Kiriath-arba (that is, Hebron), in the hill country of Judah.
verses.textEnNasb: So they set apart Kedesh in Galilee in the hill country of Naphtali, and Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim, and Kiriath-arba (that is, Hebron) in the hill country of Judah.
verses.textEn: So they set apart Kedesh in Galilee in the hill country of Naphtali, Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim, and Kiriath Arba (that is, Hebron) in the hill country of Judah.

verses.textZh: 又在约旦河东，耶利哥的东面，从流本支派中，指定在旷野平原上的比悉；从迦得支派中，指定在基列的拉末；从玛拿西支派中，指定在巴珊的哥兰。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又在约旦河东，耶利哥的东面，从流本支派中，指定在旷野平原上的比悉；从迦得支派中，指定在基列的拉末；从玛拿西支派中，指定在巴珊的哥兰。
verses.textZhCuv: 又在约旦河外耶利哥东，从吕便支派中，在旷野的平原，设立比悉；从迦得支派中设立基列的拉末；从玛拿西支派中设立巴珊的哥兰。
verses.textEnNiv: East of the Jordan (on the other side from Jericho) they designated Bezer in the wilderness on the plateau in the tribe of Reuben, Ramoth in Gilead in the tribe of Gad, and Golan in Bashan in the tribe of Manasseh.
verses.textEnEsv: And beyond the Jordan east of Jericho, they appointed Bezer in the wilderness on the tableland, from the tribe of Reuben, and Ramoth in Gilead, from the tribe of Gad, and Golan in Bashan, from the tribe of Manasseh.
verses.textEnNkjv: And on the other side of the Jordan, by Jericho eastward, they assigned Bezer in the wilderness on the plain, from the tribe of Reuben, Ramoth in Gilead, from the tribe of Gad, and Golan in Bashan, from the tribe of Manasseh.
verses.textEnNlt: On the east side of the Jordan River, across from Jericho, the following cities were designated: Bezer, in the wilderness plain of the tribe of Reuben; Ramoth in Gilead, in the territory of the tribe of Gad; and Golan in Bashan, in the land of the tribe of Manasseh.
verses.textEnNasb: And beyond the Jordan east of Jericho, they designated Bezer in the wilderness on the plain from the tribe of Reuben, and Ramoth in Gilead from the tribe of Gad, and Golan in Bashan from the tribe of Manasseh.
verses.textEn: East of the Jordan (on the other side from Jericho) they designated Bezer in the wilderness on the plateau in the tribe of Reuben, Ramoth in Gilead in the tribe of Gad, and Golan in Bashan in the tribe of Manasseh.

verses.textZh: 这些都是为所有的以色列人，和在他们中间寄居的外族人所指定的城，让误杀人的可以逃到那里，不致死在报血仇的人手里，直到他站在会众面前受审为止。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些都是为所有的以色列人，和在他们中间寄居的外族人所指定的城，让误杀人的可以逃到那里，不致死在报血仇的人手里，直到他站在会众面前受审为止。
verses.textZhCuv: 这都是为以色列众人和在他们中间寄居的外人所分定的城邑，使误杀人的都可以逃到那里，不死在报血仇人的手中，等他站在会众面前听审判。
verses.textEnNiv: Any of the Israelites or any foreigner residing among them who killed someone accidentally could flee to these designated cities and not be killed by the avenger of blood prior to standing trial before the assembly.
verses.textEnEsv: These were the cities designated for all the people of Israel and for the stranger sojourning among them, that anyone who killed a person without intent could flee there, so that he might not die by the hand of the avenger of blood, till he stood before the congregation.
verses.textEnNkjv: These were the cities appointed for all the children of Israel and for the stranger who dwelt among them, that whoever killed a person accidentally might flee there, and not die by the hand of the avenger of blood until he stood before the congregation.
verses.textEnNlt: These cities were set apart for all the Israelites as well as the foreigners living among them. Anyone who accidentally killed another person could take refuge in one of these cities. In this way, they could escape being killed in revenge prior to standing trial before the local assembly.
verses.textEnNasb: These were the designated cities for all the sons of Israel and for the stranger who resides among them, so that whoever kills a person unintentionally may flee there, and not die by the hand of the avenger of blood until he stands before the congregation.
verses.textEn: Any of the Israelites or any foreigner residing among them who killed someone accidentally could flee to these designated cities and not be killed by the avenger of blood prior to standing trial before the assembly.

verses.textZh: 那时，利未人的众族长来到以利亚撒祭司和嫩的儿子约书亚，以及以色列众支派的族长那里，
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，利未人的众族长来到以利亚撒祭司和嫩的儿子约书亚，以及以色列众支派的族长那里，
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，利未人的众族长来到祭司以利亚撒和嫩的儿子约书亚，并以色列各支派的族长面前，
verses.textEnNiv: Now the family heads of the Levites approached Eleazar the priest, Joshua son of Nun, and the heads of the other tribal families of Israel
verses.textEnEsv: Then the heads of the fathers’ houses of the Levites came to Eleazar the priest and to Joshua the son of Nun and to the heads of the fathers’ houses of the tribes of the people of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the heads of the fathers’ houses of the Levites came near to Eleazar the priest, to Joshua the son of Nun, and to the heads of the fathers’ houses of the tribes of the children of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the leaders of the tribe of Levi came to consult with Eleazar the priest, Joshua son of Nun, and the leaders of the other tribes of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the heads of fathers’ households of the Levites approached Eleazar the priest, Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of fathers’ households of the tribes of the sons of Israel.
verses.textEn: Now the family heads of the Levites approached Eleazar the priest, Joshua son of Nun, and the heads of the other tribal families of Israel

verses.textZh: 在迦南地的示罗对他们说："耶和华曾经借着摩西吩咐要给我们城市居住，和城的郊野可以牧放我们的牲畜。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 在迦南地的示罗对他们说："耶和华曾经借着摩西吩咐要给我们城市居住，和城的郊野可以牧放我们的牲畜。"
verses.textZhCuv: 在迦南地的示罗对他们说：「从前耶和华藉着摩西吩咐给我们城邑居住，并城邑的郊野可以牧养我们的牲畜。」
verses.textEnNiv: at Shiloh in Canaan and said to them, "The Lord commanded through Moses that you give us towns to live in, with pasturelands for our livestock."
verses.textEnEsv: And they said to them at Shiloh in the land of Canaan, "The Lord commanded through Moses that we be given cities to dwell in, along with their pasturelands for our livestock."
verses.textEnNkjv: And they spoke to them at Shiloh in the land of Canaan, saying, "The Lord commanded through Moses to give us cities to dwell in, with their common-lands for our livestock."
verses.textEnNlt: They came to them at Shiloh in the land of Canaan and said, "The Lord commanded Moses to give us towns to live in and pasturelands for our livestock."
verses.textEnNasb: And they spoke to them at Shiloh in the land of Canaan, saying, "The Lord commanded through Moses to give us cities to live in, with their pasture lands for our cattle."
verses.textEn: at Shiloh in Canaan and said to them, "The Lord commanded through Moses that you give us towns to live in, with pasturelands for our livestock."

verses.textZh: 于是以色列人照着耶和华所吩咐的，从自己的产业中，把以下这些城市和城的郊野，给了利未人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是以色列人照着耶和华所吩咐的，从自己的产业中，把以下这些城市和城的郊野，给了利未人。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是以色列人照耶和华所吩咐的，从自己的地业中，将以下所记的城邑和城邑的郊野给了利未人。
verses.textEnNiv: So, as the Lord had commanded, the Israelites gave the Levites the following towns and pasturelands out of their own inheritance:
verses.textEnEsv: So by command of the Lord the people of Israel gave to the Levites the following cities and pasturelands out of their inheritance.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the children of Israel gave to the Levites from their inheritance, at the commandment of the Lord, these cities and their common-lands:
verses.textEnNlt: So by the command of the Lord the people of Israel gave the Levites the following towns and pasturelands out of their own grants of land.
verses.textEnNasb: So the sons of Israel gave the Levites from their inheritance these cities with their pasture lands, in accordance with the command of the Lord.
verses.textEn: So, as the Lord had commanded, the Israelites gave the Levites the following towns and pasturelands out of their own inheritance:

verses.textZh: 首先为哥辖家族抽出签来：利未支派亚伦祭司的子孙，从犹大支派、西缅支派和便雅悯支派，抽签得了十三座城。
verses.textZhCnvs: 首先为哥辖家族抽出签来：利未支派亚伦祭司的子孙，从犹大支派、西缅支派和便雅悯支派，抽签得了十三座城。
verses.textZhCuv: 为哥辖族拈阄：利未人的祭司、亚伦的子孙，从犹大支派、西缅支派、便雅悯支派的地业中，按阄得了十三座城。
verses.textEnNiv: The first lot came out for the Kohathites, according to their clans. The Levites who were descendants of Aaron the priest were allotted thirteen towns from the tribes of Judah, Simeon and Benjamin.
verses.textEnEsv: The lot came out for the clans of the Kohathites. So those Levites who were descendants of Aaron the priest received by lot from the tribes of Judah, Simeon, and Benjamin, thirteen cities.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the lot came out for the families of the Kohathites. And the children of Aaron the priest, whowere of the Levites, had thirteen cities by lot from the tribe of Judah, from the tribe of Simeon, and from the tribe of Benjamin.
verses.textEnNlt: The descendants of Aaron, who were members of the Kohathite clan within the tribe of Levi, were allotted thirteen towns that were originally assigned to the tribes of Judah, Simeon, and Benjamin.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the lot came out for the families of the Kohathites. And to the sons of Aaron the priest, who were of the Levites, thirteen cities were given by lot from the tribe of Judah, from the tribe of the Simeonites, and from the tribe of Benjamin.
verses.textEn: The first lot came out for the Kohathites, according to their clans. The Levites who were descendants of Aaron the priest were allotted thirteen towns from the tribes of Judah, Simeon and Benjamin.

verses.textZh: 哥辖其余的子孙，从以法莲支派的家族、但支派和玛拿西半个支派，抽签得了十座城。
verses.textZhCnvs: 哥辖其余的子孙，从以法莲支派的家族、但支派和玛拿西半个支派，抽签得了十座城。
verses.textZhCuv: 哥辖其余的子孙，从以法莲支派、但支派、玛拿西半支派的地业中，按阄得了十座城。
verses.textEnNiv: The rest of Kohath’s descendants were allotted ten towns from the clans of the tribes of Ephraim, Dan and half of Manasseh.
verses.textEnEsv: And the rest of the Kohathites received by lot from the clans of the tribe of Ephraim, from the tribe of Dan and the half-tribe of Manasseh, ten cities.
verses.textEnNkjv: The rest of the children of Kohath had ten cities by lot from the families of the tribe of Ephraim, from the tribe of Dan, and from the half-tribe of Manasseh.
verses.textEnNlt: The other families of the Kohathite clan were allotted ten towns from the tribes of Ephraim, Dan, and the half-tribe of Manasseh.
verses.textEnNasb: And to the rest of the sons of Kohath ten cities were given by lot from the families of the tribe of Ephraim, from the tribe of Dan, and from the half-tribe of Manasseh.
verses.textEn: The rest of Kohath’s descendants were allotted ten towns from the clans of the tribes of Ephraim, Dan and half of Manasseh.

verses.textZh: 革顺的子孙，从以萨迦支派的家族、亚设支派、拿弗他利支派和在巴珊的玛拿西半个支派，抽签得了十三座城。
verses.textZhCnvs: 革顺的子孙，从以萨迦支派的家族、亚设支派、拿弗他利支派和在巴珊的玛拿西半个支派，抽签得了十三座城。
verses.textZhCuv: 革顺的子孙，从以萨迦支派、亚设支派、拿弗他利支派、住巴珊的玛拿西半支派的地业中，按阄得了十三座城。
verses.textEnNiv: The descendants of Gershon were allotted thirteen towns from the clans of the tribes of Issachar, Asher, Naphtali and the half-tribe of Manasseh in Bashan.
verses.textEnEsv: The Gershonites received by lot from the clans of the tribe of Issachar, from the tribe of Asher, from the tribe of Naphtali, and from the half-tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the children of Gershon had thirteen cities by lot from the families of the tribe of Issachar, from the tribe of Asher, from the tribe of Naphtali, and from the half-tribe of Manasseh in Bashan.
verses.textEnNlt: The clan of Gershon was allotted thirteen towns from the tribes of Issachar, Asher, Naphtali, and the half-tribe of Manasseh in Bashan.
verses.textEnNasb: And to the sons of Gershon thirteen cities were given by lot from the families of the tribe of Issachar, from the tribe of Asher, from the tribe of Naphtali, and from the half-tribe of Manasseh in Bashan.
verses.textEn: The descendants of Gershon were allotted thirteen towns from the clans of the tribes of Issachar, Asher, Naphtali and the half-tribe of Manasseh in Bashan.

verses.textZh: 米拉利的子孙，按着家族，从流本支派、迦得支派和西布伦支派，得了十二座城。
verses.textZhCnvs: 米拉利的子孙，按着家族，从流本支派、迦得支派和西布伦支派，得了十二座城。
verses.textZhCuv: 米拉利的子孙，按着宗族，从吕便支派、迦得支派、西布伦支派的地业中，按阄得了十二座城。
verses.textEnNiv: The descendants of Merari, according to their clans, received twelve towns from the tribes of Reuben, Gad and Zebulun.
verses.textEnEsv: The Merarites according to their clans received from the tribe of Reuben, the tribe of Gad, and the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities.
verses.textEnNkjv: The children of Merari according to their families had twelve cities from the tribe of Reuben, from the tribe of Gad, and from the tribe of Zebulun.
verses.textEnNlt: The clan of Merari was allotted twelve towns from the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and Zebulun.
verses.textEnNasb: To the sons of Merari according to their families twelve cities were given from the tribe of Reuben, from the tribe of Gad, and from the tribe of Zebulun.
verses.textEn: The descendants of Merari, according to their clans, received twelve towns from the tribes of Reuben, Gad and Zebulun.

verses.textZh: 以色列人照着耶和华吩咐摩西的，借着抽签，把这些城市和城的郊野分给利未人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人照着耶和华吩咐摩西的，借着抽签，把这些城市和城的郊野分给利未人。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人照着耶和华藉摩西所吩咐的，将这些城邑和城邑的郊野，按阄分给利未人。
verses.textEnNiv: So the Israelites allotted to the Levites these towns and their pasturelands, as the Lord had commanded through Moses.
verses.textEnEsv: These cities and their pasturelands the people of Israel gave by lot to the Levites, as the Lord had commanded through Moses.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the children of Israel gave these cities with their common-lands by lot to the Levites, as the Lord had commanded by the hand of Moses.
verses.textEnNlt: So the Israelites obeyed the Lord ’s command to Moses and assigned these towns and pasturelands to the Levites by casting sacred lots.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the sons of Israel gave by lot to the Levites these cities with their pasture lands, as the Lord had commanded through Moses.
verses.textEn: So the Israelites allotted to the Levites these towns and their pasturelands, as the Lord had commanded through Moses.

verses.textZh: 他们从犹大支派和西缅支派中，把以下这些有提名的城分了
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们从犹大支派和西缅支派中，把以下这些有提名的城分了
verses.textZhCuv: 将犹大山地的基列‧亚巴和四围的郊野给了他们。亚巴是亚衲族的始祖。（基列‧亚巴就是希伯仑）。
verses.textEnNiv: From the tribes of Judah and Simeon they allotted the following towns by name
verses.textEnEsv: Out of the tribe of the people of Judah and the tribe of the people of Simeon they gave the following cities mentioned by name,
verses.textEnNkjv: So they gave from the tribe of the children of Judah and from the tribe of the children of Simeon these cities which are designated by name,
verses.textEnNlt: The Israelites gave the following towns from the tribes of Judah and Simeon
verses.textEnNasb: They gave these cities which are mentioned here by name from the tribe of the sons of Judah and from the tribe of the sons of Simeon;
verses.textEn: From the tribes of Judah and Simeon they allotted the following towns by name

verses.textZh: 给利未支派、哥辖家族中亚伦的子孙，因为第一签是他们的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 给利未支派、哥辖家族中亚伦的子孙，因为第一签是他们的。
verses.textZhCuv: 惟将属城的田地和村庄给了耶孚尼的儿子迦勒为业。
verses.textEnNiv: (these towns were assigned to the descendants of Aaron who were from the Kohathite clans of the Levites, because the first lot fell to them):
verses.textEnEsv: which went to the descendants of Aaron, one of the clans of the Kohathites who belonged to the people of Levi; since the lot fell to them first.
verses.textEnNkjv: which were for the children of Aaron, one of the families of the Kohathites, whowere of the children of Levi; for the lot was theirs first.
verses.textEnNlt: to the descendants of Aaron, who were members of the Kohathite clan within the tribe of Levi, since the sacred lot fell to them first:
verses.textEnNasb: and they were for the sons of Aaron, one of the families of the Kohathites, of the sons of Levi, because the lot was theirs first.
verses.textEn: (these towns were assigned to the descendants of Aaron who were from the Kohathite clans of the Levites, because the first lot fell to them):

verses.textZh: 以色列人把犹大山地的基列．亚巴，和它四围的郊野，给了他们；亚巴是亚衲族的祖宗，基列．亚巴就是希伯仑。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人把犹大山地的基列．亚巴，和它四围的郊野，给了他们；亚巴是亚衲族的祖宗，基列．亚巴就是希伯仑。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人将希伯仑，就是误杀人的逃城和属城的郊野，给了祭司亚伦的子孙；又给他们立拿和属城的郊野，
verses.textEnNiv: They gave them Kiriath Arba (that is, Hebron), with its surrounding pastureland, in the hill country of Judah. (Arba was the forefather of Anak.)
verses.textEnEsv: They gave them Kiriath-arba (Arba being the father of Anak), that is Hebron, in the hill country of Judah, along with the pasturelands around it.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they gave them Kirjath Arba (Arbawas the father of Anak), which is Hebron, in the mountains of Judah, with the common-land surrounding it.
verses.textEnNlt: Kiriath-arba (that is, Hebron), in the hill country of Judah, along with its surrounding pasturelands. (Arba was an ancestor of Anak.)
verses.textEnNasb: So they gave them Kiriath-arba (Arba being the father of Anak), that is, Hebron, in the hill country of Judah, with its surrounding pasture lands.
verses.textEn: They gave them Kiriath Arba (that is, Hebron), with its surrounding pastureland, in the hill country of Judah. (Arba was the forefather of Anak.)

verses.textZh: 属于那城的田地和村庄，他们却给了耶孚尼的儿子迦勒作产业。
verses.textZhCnvs: 属于那城的田地和村庄，他们却给了耶孚尼的儿子迦勒作产业。
verses.textZhCuv: 雅提珥和属城的郊野，以实提莫和属城的郊野，
verses.textEnNiv: But the fields and villages around the city they had given to Caleb son of Jephunneh as his possession.
verses.textEnEsv: But the fields of the city and its villages had been given to Caleb the son of Jephunneh as his possession.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the fields of the city and its villages they gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh as his possession.
verses.textEnNlt: But the open fields beyond the town and the surrounding villages were given to Caleb son of Jephunneh as his possession.
verses.textEnNasb: But the fields of the city and its villages they gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh as his possession.
verses.textEn: But the fields and villages around the city they had given to Caleb son of Jephunneh as his possession.

verses.textZh: 以色列人把误杀人者的避难城希伯仑，和希伯仑的郊野，又把立拿和立拿的郊野给了亚伦祭司的子孙，
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人把误杀人者的避难城希伯仑，和希伯仑的郊野，又把立拿和立拿的郊野给了亚伦祭司的子孙，
verses.textZhCuv: 何仑和属城的郊野，底璧和属城的郊野，
verses.textEnNiv: So to the descendants of Aaron the priest they gave Hebron (a city of refuge for one accused of murder), Libnah,
verses.textEnEsv: And to the descendants of Aaron the priest they gave Hebron, the city of refuge for the manslayer, with its pasturelands, Libnah with its pasturelands,
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus to the children of Aaron the priest they gave Hebron with its common-land (a city of refuge for the slayer), Libnah with its common-land,
verses.textEnNlt: The following towns with their pasturelands were given to the descendants of Aaron the priest: Hebron (a city of refuge for those who accidentally killed someone), Libnah,
verses.textEnNasb: So to the sons of Aaron the priest they gave Hebron, the city of refuge for the one who commits manslaughter, with its pasture lands, Libnah with its pasture lands,
verses.textEn: So to the descendants of Aaron the priest they gave Hebron (a city of refuge for one accused of murder), Libnah,

verses.textZh: 还有雅提珥和雅提珥的郊野，以实提莫和以实提莫的郊野，
verses.textZhCnvs: 还有雅提珥和雅提珥的郊野，以实提莫和以实提莫的郊野，
verses.textZhCuv: 亚因和属城的郊野，淤他和属城的郊野，伯‧示麦和属城的郊野，共九座城，都是从这二支派中分出来的。
verses.textEnNiv: Jattir, Eshtemoa,
verses.textEnEsv: Jattir with its pasturelands, Eshtemoa with its pasturelands,
verses.textEnNkjv: Jattir with its common-land, Eshtemoa with its common-land,
verses.textEnNlt: Jattir, Eshtemoa,
verses.textEnNasb: Jattir with its pasture lands, Eshtemoa with its pasture lands,
verses.textEn: Jattir, Eshtemoa,

verses.textZh: 何仑和何仑的郊野，底璧和底璧的郊野，
verses.textZhCnvs: 何仑和何仑的郊野，底璧和底璧的郊野，
verses.textZhCuv: 又从便雅悯支派的地业中给了他们基遍和属城的郊野，迦巴和属城的郊野，
verses.textEnNiv: Holon, Debir,
verses.textEnEsv: Holon with its pasturelands, Debir with its pasturelands,
verses.textEnNkjv: Holon with its common-land, Debir with its common-land,
verses.textEnNlt: Holon, Debir,
verses.textEnNasb: Holon with its pasture lands, Debir with its pasture lands,
verses.textEn: Holon, Debir,

verses.textZh: 亚因和亚因的郊野，淤他和淤他的郊野，伯．示麦和伯．示麦的郊野，共九座城，都是从这两个支派分出来的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚因和亚因的郊野，淤他和淤他的郊野，伯．示麦和伯．示麦的郊野，共九座城，都是从这两个支派分出来的。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚拿突和属城的郊野，亚勒们和属城的郊野，共四座城。
verses.textEnNiv: Ain, Juttah and Beth Shemesh, together with their pasturelands—nine towns from these two tribes.
verses.textEnEsv: Ain with its pasturelands, Juttah with its pasturelands, Beth-shemesh with its pasturelands—nine cities out of these two tribes;
verses.textEnNkjv: Ain with its common-land, Juttah with its common-land, and Beth Shemesh with its common-land: nine cities from those two tribes;
verses.textEnNlt: Ain, Juttah, and Beth-shemesh—nine towns from these two tribes.
verses.textEnNasb: Ain with its pasture lands, Juttah with its pasture lands, and Beth-shemesh with its pasture lands; nine cities from these two tribes.
verses.textEn: Ain, Juttah and Beth Shemesh, together with their pasturelands—nine towns from these two tribes.

verses.textZh: 又从便雅悯支派中，分给他们基遍和基遍的郊野，迦巴和迦巴的郊野，
verses.textZhCnvs: 又从便雅悯支派中，分给他们基遍和基遍的郊野，迦巴和迦巴的郊野，
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伦子孙作祭司的共有十三座城，还有属城的郊野。
verses.textEnNiv: And from the tribe of Benjamin they gave them: Gibeon, Geba,
verses.textEnEsv: then out of the tribe of Benjamin, Gibeon with its pasturelands, Geba with its pasturelands,
verses.textEnNkjv: and from the tribe of Benjamin, Gibeon with its common-land, Geba with its common-land,
verses.textEnNlt: From the tribe of Benjamin the priests were given the following towns with their pasturelands: Gibeon, Geba,
verses.textEnNasb: From the tribe of Benjamin, Gibeon with its pasture lands, Geba with its pasture lands,
verses.textEn: And from the tribe of Benjamin they gave them: Gibeon, Geba,

verses.textZh: 亚拿突和亚拿突的郊野，亚勒们和亚勒们的郊野，共四座城。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚拿突和亚拿突的郊野，亚勒们和亚勒们的郊野，共四座城。
verses.textZhCuv: 利未支派中哥辖的宗族，就是哥辖其余的子孙，拈阄所得的城有从以法莲支派中分出来的。
verses.textEnNiv: Anathoth and Almon, together with their pasturelands—four towns.
verses.textEnEsv: Anathoth with its pasturelands, and Almon with its pasturelands—four cities.
verses.textEnNkjv: Anathoth with its common-land, and Almon with its common-land: four cities.
verses.textEnNlt: Anathoth, and Almon—four towns.
verses.textEnNasb: Anathoth with its pasture lands, and Almon with its pasture lands; four cities.
verses.textEn: Anathoth and Almon, together with their pasturelands—four towns.

verses.textZh: 亚伦子孙众祭司所有的城，共十三座，还有这些城的郊野。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伦子孙众祭司所有的城，共十三座，还有这些城的郊野。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人将以法莲山地的示剑，就是误杀人的逃城和属城的郊野，给了他们；又给他们基色和属城的郊野，
verses.textEnNiv: The total number of towns for the priests, the descendants of Aaron, came to thirteen, together with their pasturelands.
verses.textEnEsv: The cities of the descendants of Aaron, the priests, were in all thirteen cities with their pasturelands.
verses.textEnNkjv: All the cities of the children of Aaron, the priests, were thirteen cities with their common-lands.
verses.textEnNlt: So in all, thirteen towns with their pasturelands were given to the priests, the descendants of Aaron.
verses.textEnNasb: All the cities of the sons of Aaron, the priests, were thirteen cities with their pasture lands.
verses.textEn: The total number of towns for the priests, the descendants of Aaron, came to thirteen, together with their pasturelands.

verses.textZh: 利未支派哥辖子孙的家族，就是哥辖其余的子孙，抽签所得的城是从以法莲支派中分出来的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 利未支派哥辖子孙的家族，就是哥辖其余的子孙，抽签所得的城是从以法莲支派中分出来的。
verses.textZhCuv: 基伯先和属城的郊野，伯‧和仑和属城的郊野，共四座城；
verses.textEnNiv: The rest of the Kohathite clans of the Levites were allotted towns from the tribe of Ephraim:
verses.textEnEsv: As to the rest of the Kohathites belonging to the Kohathite clans of the Levites, the cities allotted to them were out of the tribe of Ephraim.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the families of the children of Kohath, the Levites, the rest of the children of Kohath, even they had the cities of their lot from the tribe of Ephraim.
verses.textEnNlt: The rest of the Kohathite clan from the tribe of Levi was allotted the following towns and pasturelands from the tribe of Ephraim:
verses.textEnNasb: Then the cities from the tribe of Ephraim were allotted to the families of the sons of Kohath, the Levites, that is, to the rest of the sons of Kohath.
verses.textEn: The rest of the Kohathite clans of the Levites were allotted towns from the tribe of Ephraim:

verses.textZh: 以色列人把误杀人者的避难城，就是在以法莲山地的示剑和示剑的郊野，给了他们；又把基色和基色的郊野，给了他们；
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人把误杀人者的避难城，就是在以法莲山地的示剑和示剑的郊野，给了他们；又把基色和基色的郊野，给了他们；
verses.textZhCuv: 又从但支派的地业中给了他们伊利提基和属城的郊野，基比顿和属城的郊野，
verses.textEnNiv: In the hill country of Ephraim they were given Shechem (a city of refuge for one accused of murder) and Gezer,
verses.textEnEsv: To them were given Shechem, the city of refuge for the manslayer, with its pasturelands in the hill country of Ephraim, Gezer with its pasturelands,
verses.textEnNkjv: For they gave them Shechem with its common-land in the mountains of Ephraim (a city of refuge for the slayer), Gezer with its common-land,
verses.textEnNlt: Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim (a city of refuge for those who accidentally killed someone), Gezer,
verses.textEnNasb: They gave them Shechem, the city of refuge for the one who commits manslaughter, with its pasture lands, in the hill country of Ephraim, and Gezer with its pasture lands,
verses.textEn: In the hill country of Ephraim they were given Shechem (a city of refuge for one accused of murder) and Gezer,

verses.textZh: 又有基伯先和基伯先的郊野，伯．和仑和伯．和仑的郊野，共四座城。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又有基伯先和基伯先的郊野，伯．和仑和伯．和仑的郊野，共四座城。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚雅仑和属城的郊野，迦特‧临门和属城的郊野，共四座城；
verses.textEnNiv: Kibzaim and Beth Horon, together with their pasturelands—four towns.
verses.textEnEsv: Kibzaim with its pasturelands, Beth-horon with its pasturelands—four cities;
verses.textEnNkjv: Kibzaim with its common-land, and Beth Horon with its common-land: four cities;
verses.textEnNlt: Kibzaim, and Beth-horon—four towns.
verses.textEnNasb: and Kibzaim with its pasture lands, and Beth-horon with its pasture lands; four cities.
verses.textEn: Kibzaim and Beth Horon, together with their pasturelands—four towns.

verses.textEn: Also from the tribe of Dan they received: Eltekeh, Gibbethon,

verses.textEnEsv: Aijalon with its pasturelands, Gath-rimmon with its pasturelands—four cities;
verses.textEnNkjv: Aijalon with its common-land, and Gath Rimmon with its common-land: four cities;
verses.textEnNlt: Aijalon, and Gath-rimmon—four towns.
verses.textEnNasb: Aijalon with its pasture lands, Gath-rimmon with its pasture lands; four cities.

verses.textEnEsv: and out of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Taanach with its pasturelands, and Gath-rimmon with its pasturelands—two cities.
verses.textEnNkjv: and from the half-tribe of Manasseh, Tanach with its common-land and Gath Rimmon with its common-land: two cities.
verses.textEnNlt: The half-tribe of Manasseh allotted the following towns with their pasturelands to the priests: Taanach and Gath-rimmon—two towns.
verses.textEnNasb: From the half-tribe of Manasseh, they allotted Taanach with its pasture lands and Gath-rimmon with its pasture lands; two cities.
verses.textEn: From half the tribe of Manasseh they received: Taanach and Gath Rimmon, together with their pasturelands—two towns.

verses.textZhCuv: 又从以萨迦支派的地业中给了他们基善和属城的郊野，大比拉和属城的郊野，

verses.textEnEsv: The cities of the clans of the rest of the Kohathites were ten in all with their pasturelands.
verses.textEnNkjv: All the ten cities with their common-lands were for the rest of the families of the children of Kohath.
verses.textEnNlt: So in all, ten towns with their pasturelands were given to the rest of the Kohathite clan.
verses.textEnNasb: All the cities with their pasture lands for the families of the rest of the sons of Kohath were ten.
verses.textEn: All these ten towns and their pasturelands were given to the rest of the Kohathite clans.

verses.textZh: 以色列人又从玛拿西半个支派中，把误杀人者的避难城，就是在巴珊的哥兰，和哥兰的郊野，给了利未人的家族中革顺的子孙；又给了他们比．施提拉和比．施提拉的郊野，共两座城。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人又从玛拿西半个支派中，把误杀人者的避难城，就是在巴珊的哥兰，和哥兰的郊野，给了利未人的家族中革顺的子孙；又给了他们比．施提拉和比．施提拉的郊野，共两座城。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶末和属城的郊野，隐‧干宁和属城的郊野，共四座城；
verses.textEnNiv: The Levite clans of the Gershonites were given: from the half-tribe of Manasseh, Golan in Bashan (a city of refuge for one accused of murder) and Be Eshterah, together with their pasturelands—two towns;
verses.textEnEsv: And to the Gershonites, one of the clans of the Levites, were given out of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Golan in Bashan with its pasturelands, the city of refuge for the manslayer, and Beeshterah with its pasturelands—two cities;
verses.textEnNkjv: Also to the children of Gershon, of the families of the Levites, from the other half-tribe of Manasseh, theygave Golan in Bashan with its common-land (a city of refuge for the slayer), and Be Eshterah with its common-land: two cities;
verses.textEnNlt: The descendants of Gershon, another clan within the tribe of Levi, received the following towns with their pasturelands from the half-tribe of Manasseh: Golan in Bashan (a city of refuge for those who accidentally killed someone) and Be-eshterah—two towns.
verses.textEnNasb: And to the sons of Gershon, one of the families of the Levites, from the half-tribe of Manasseh, they gave Golan in Bashan, the city of refuge for the one who commits manslaughter, with its pasture lands, and Be-eshterah with its pasture lands; two cities.
verses.textEn: The Levite clans of the Gershonites were given: from the half-tribe of Manasseh, Golan in Bashan (a city of refuge for one accused of murder) and Be Eshterah, together with their pasturelands—two towns;

verses.textEnEsv: and out of the tribe of Naphtali, Kedesh in Galilee with its pasturelands, the city of refuge for the manslayer, Hammoth-dor with its pasturelands, and Kartan with its pasturelands—three cities.
verses.textEnNkjv: and from the tribe of Naphtali, Kedesh in Galilee with its common-land (a city of refuge for the slayer), Hammoth Dor with its common-land, and Kartan with its common-land: three cities.

verses.textEn: The total number of towns of the Gershonite clans came to thirteen, together with their pasturelands.

verses.textEnNiv: The total number of towns allotted to the Merarite clans, who were the rest of the Levites, came to twelve.
verses.textEnEsv: As for the cities of the several Merarite clans, that is, the remainder of the clans of the Levites, those allotted to them were in all twelve cities.
verses.textEnNkjv: So all the cities for the children of Merari according to their families, the rest of the families of the Levites, were by their lot twelve cities.
verses.textEnNlt: So in all, twelve towns were allotted to the clan of Merari.

verses.textEn: The total number of towns allotted to the Merarite clans, who were the rest of the Levites, came to twelve.

verses.textEnNlt: The total number of towns and pasturelands within Israelite territory given to the Levites came to forty-eight.
verses.textEnNasb: All the cities of the Levites in the midst of the possession of the sons of Israel were forty-eight cities with their pasture lands.
verses.textEn: The towns of the Levites in the territory held by the Israelites were forty-eight in all, together with their pasturelands.

verses.textZh: 这些城周围都有自己的郊野，每一座都是这样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些城周围都有自己的郊野，每一座都是这样。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华照着向他们列祖起誓所应许的一切话，使他们四境平安；他们一切仇敌中，没有一人在他们面前站立得住。耶和华把一切仇敌都交在他们手中。
verses.textEnNiv: Each of these towns had pasturelands surrounding it; this was true for all these towns.
verses.textEnEsv: These cities each had its pasturelands around it. So it was with all these cities.
verses.textEnNkjv: Every one of these cities had its common-land surrounding it; thus were all these cities.
verses.textEnNlt: Every one of these towns had pasturelands surrounding it.
verses.textEnNasb: These cities individually had their surrounding pasture lands; this is how it was with all these cities.
verses.textEn: Each of these towns had pasturelands surrounding it; this was true for all these towns.

verses.textZh: 这样，耶和华就把他从前起誓要赐给他们列祖的全地给了以色列人；以色列人占领了那地，就定居下来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，耶和华就把他从前起誓要赐给他们列祖的全地给了以色列人；以色列人占领了那地，就定居下来。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华应许赐福给以色列家的话一句也没有落空，都应验了。
verses.textEnNiv: So the Lord gave Israel all the land he had sworn to give their ancestors, and they took possession of it and settled there.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus the Lord gave to Israel all the land that he swore to give to their fathers. And they took possession of it, and they settled there.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the Lord gave to Israel all the land of which He had sworn to give to their fathers, and they took possession of it and dwelt in it.
verses.textEnNlt: So the Lord gave to Israel all the land he had sworn to give their ancestors, and they took possession of it and settled there.
verses.textEnNasb: So the Lord gave Israel all the land which He had sworn to give to their fathers, and they took possession of it and lived in it.
verses.textEn: So the Lord gave Israel all the land he had sworn to give their ancestors, and they took possession of it and settled there.

verses.textZh: 耶和华照着他向他们列祖起誓所说的一切话，使他们四境平静；他们所有的仇敌，没有一人能在他们面前站立得住；耶和华把他们所有的仇敌都交在他们手里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华照着他向他们列祖起誓所说的一切话，使他们四境平静；他们所有的仇敌，没有一人能在他们面前站立得住；耶和华把他们所有的仇敌都交在他们手里。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华照着他向他们列祖起誓所说的一切话，使他们四境平静；他们所有的仇敌，没有一人能在他们面前站立得住；耶和华把他们所有的仇敌都交在他们手里。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord gave them rest on every side, just as he had sworn to their ancestors. Not one of their enemies withstood them; the Lord gave all their enemies into their hands.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord gave them rest on every side just as he had sworn to their fathers. Not one of all their enemies had withstood them, for the Lord had given all their enemies into their hands.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord gave them rest all around, according to all that He had sworn to their fathers. And not a man of all their enemies stood against them; the Lord delivered all their enemies into their hand.
verses.textEnNlt: And the Lord gave them rest on every side, just as he had solemnly promised their ancestors. None of their enemies could stand against them, for the Lord helped them conquer all their enemies.
verses.textEnNasb: And the Lord gave them rest on every side, in accordance with everything that He had sworn to their fathers, and no one of all their enemies stood before them; the Lord handed all their enemies over to them.
verses.textEn: The Lord gave them rest on every side, just as he had sworn to their ancestors. Not one of their enemies withstood them; the Lord gave all their enemies into their hands.

verses.textZh: 耶和华向以色列家应许赐福的话，没有一句落空，都应验了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华向以色列家应许赐福的话，没有一句落空，都应验了。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华向以色列家应许赐福的话，没有一句落空，都应验了。
verses.textEnNiv: Not one of all the Lord ’s good promises to Israel failed; every one was fulfilled.
verses.textEnEsv: Not one word of all the good promises that the Lord had made to the house of Israel had failed; all came to pass.
verses.textEnNkjv: Not a word failed of any good thing which the Lord had spoken to the house of Israel. All came to pass.
verses.textEnNlt: Not a single one of all the good promises the Lord had given to the family of Israel was left unfulfilled; everything he had spoken came true.
verses.textEnNasb: Not one of the good promises which the Lord had made to the house of Israel failed; everything came to pass.
verses.textEn: Not one of all the Lord ’s good promises to Israel failed; every one was fulfilled.

verses.textZh: 那时，约书亚把流本人、迦得人和玛拿西半个支派的人召了来，
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，约书亚把流本人、迦得人和玛拿西半个支派的人召了来，
verses.textZhCuv: 当时，约书亚召了吕便人、迦得人，和玛拿西半支派的人来，
verses.textEnNiv: Then Joshua summoned the Reubenites, the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh
verses.textEnEsv: At that time Joshua summoned the Reubenites and the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Joshua called the Reubenites, the Gadites, and half the tribe of Manasseh,
verses.textEnNlt: Then Joshua called together the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and the half-tribe of Manasseh.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Joshua summoned the Reubenites and the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh,
verses.textEn: Then Joshua summoned the Reubenites, the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh

verses.textZh: 对他们说："耶和华的仆人摩西吩咐你们的一切，你们都遵守了；我吩咐你们的一切，你们也都听从了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 对他们说："耶和华的仆人摩西吩咐你们的一切，你们都遵守了；我吩咐你们的一切，你们也都听从了。
verses.textZhCuv: 对他们说：「耶和华仆人摩西所吩咐你们的，你们都遵守了；我所吩咐你们的，你们也都听从了。
verses.textEnNiv: and said to them, "You have done all that Moses the servant of the Lord commanded, and you have obeyed me in everything I commanded.
verses.textEnEsv: and said to them, "You have kept all that Moses the servant of the Lord commanded you and have obeyed my voice in all that I have commanded you.
verses.textEnNkjv: and said to them: "You have kept all that Moses the servant of the Lord commanded you, and have obeyed my voice in all that I commanded you.
verses.textEnNlt: He told them, "You have done as Moses, the servant of the Lord , commanded you, and you have obeyed every order I have given you.
verses.textEnNasb: and said to them, "You have kept all that Moses the servant of the Lord commanded you, and have listened to my voice in all that I commanded you.
verses.textEn: and said to them, "You have done all that Moses the servant of the Lord commanded, and you have obeyed me in everything I commanded.

verses.textZh: 这许多日子以来，你们一直没有撇弃你们的兄弟，直到今日；耶和华你们的神吩咐你们的命令，你们也遵守了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这许多日子以来，你们一直没有撇弃你们的兄弟，直到今日；耶和华你们的神吩咐你们的命令，你们也遵守了。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们这许多日子，总没有撇离你们的弟兄，直到今日，并守了耶和华－你们神所吩咐你们当守的。
verses.textEnNiv: For a long time now—to this very day—you have not deserted your fellow Israelites but have carried out the mission the Lord your God gave you.
verses.textEnEsv: You have not forsaken your brothers these many days, down to this day, but have been careful to keep the charge of the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNkjv: You have not left your brethren these many days, up to this day, but have kept the charge of the commandment of the Lord your God.
verses.textEnNlt: During all this time you have not deserted the other tribes. You have been careful to obey the commands of the Lord your God right up to the present day.
verses.textEnNasb: You have not abandoned your brothers these many days to this day, but have fulfilled the obligation of the commandment of the Lord your God.
verses.textEn: For a long time now—to this very day—you have not deserted your fellow Israelites but have carried out the mission the Lord your God gave you.

verses.textZh: 现在耶和华你们的神，照着他应许的，已经使你们兄弟得享平安；现在你们可以返回自己家里，回到耶和华的仆人摩西在约旦河东赐给你们作产业的地方去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在耶和华你们的神，照着他应许的，已经使你们兄弟得享平安；现在你们可以返回自己家里，回到耶和华的仆人摩西在约旦河东赐给你们作产业的地方去。
verses.textZhCuv: 如今耶和华－你们神照着他所应许的，使你们弟兄得享平安，现在可以转回你们的帐棚，到耶和华的仆人摩西在约旦河东所赐你们为业之地。
verses.textEnNiv: Now that the Lord your God has given them rest as he promised, return to your homes in the land that Moses the servant of the Lord gave you on the other side of the Jordan.
verses.textEnEsv: And now the Lord your God has given rest to your brothers, as he promised them. Therefore turn and go to your tents in the land where your possession lies, which Moses the servant of the Lord gave you on the other side of the Jordan.
verses.textEnNkjv: And now the Lord your God has given rest to your brethren, as He promised them; now therefore, return and go to your tents and to the land of your possession, which Moses the servant of the Lord gave you on the other side of the Jordan.
verses.textEnNlt: And now the Lord your God has given the other tribes rest, as he promised them. So go back home to the land that Moses, the servant of the Lord , gave you as your possession on the east side of the Jordan River.
verses.textEnNasb: And now the Lord your God has given rest to your brothers, as He spoke to them; therefore turn now and go to your tents, to the land of your possession, which Moses the servant of the Lord gave you beyond the Jordan.
verses.textEn: Now that the Lord your God has given them rest as he promised, return to your homes in the land that Moses the servant of the Lord gave you on the other side of the Jordan.

verses.textZh: 只是你们要谨慎遵守耶和华的仆人摩西吩咐你们的诫命和律法，爱耶和华你们的神，遵行他的一切道路，谨守他的诫命，紧紧倚靠他，一心一意事奉他。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 只是你们要谨慎遵守耶和华的仆人摩西吩咐你们的诫命和律法，爱耶和华你们的神，遵行他的一切道路，谨守他的诫命，紧紧倚靠他，一心一意事奉他。"
verses.textZhCuv: 只要切切地谨慎遵行耶和华仆人摩西所吩咐你们的诫命律法，爱耶和华－你们的神，行他一切的道，守他的诫命，专靠他，尽心尽性事奉他。」
verses.textEnNiv: But be very careful to keep the commandment and the law that Moses the servant of the Lord gave you: to love the Lord your God, to walk in obedience to him, to keep his commands, to hold fast to him and to serve him with all your heart and with all your soul."
verses.textEnEsv: Only be very careful to observe the commandment and the law that Moses the servant of the Lord commanded you, to love the Lord your God, and to walk in all his ways and to keep his commandments and to cling to him and to serve him with all your heart and with all your soul."
verses.textEnNkjv: But take careful heed to do the commandment and the law which Moses the servant of the Lord commanded you, to love the Lord your God, to walk in all His ways, to keep His commandments, to hold fast to Him, and to serve Him with all your heart and with all your soul."
verses.textEnNlt: But be very careful to obey all the commands and the instructions that Moses gave to you. Love the Lord your God, walk in all his ways, obey his commands, hold firmly to him, and serve him with all your heart and all your soul."
verses.textEnNasb: Only be very careful to follow the commandment and the Law which Moses the servant of the Lord commanded you, to love the Lord your God and walk in all His ways, and keep His commandments and cling to Him, and serve Him with all your heart and with all your soul."
