verses.textEn: So I gave you a land on which you did not toil and cities you did not build; and you live in them and eat from vineyards and olive groves that you did not plant.’

verses.textZh: "现在你们要敬畏耶和华，真诚地按着真理事奉他，把你们列祖在大河那边和在埃及事奉的神除掉，去事奉耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: "现在你们要敬畏耶和华，真诚地按着真理事奉他，把你们列祖在大河那边和在埃及事奉的神除掉，去事奉耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 「现在你们要敬畏耶和华，诚心实意地事奉他，将你们列祖在大河那边和在埃及所事奉的神除掉，去事奉耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: "Now fear the Lord and serve him with all faithfulness. Throw away the gods your ancestors worshiped beyond the Euphrates River and in Egypt, and serve the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: "Now therefore fear the Lord and serve him in sincerity and in faithfulness. Put away the gods that your fathers served beyond the River and in Egypt, and serve the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: "Now therefore, fear the Lord, serve Him in sincerity and in truth, and put away the gods which your fathers served on the other side of the River and in Egypt. Serve the Lord!
verses.textEnNlt: "So fear the Lord and serve him wholeheartedly. Put away forever the idols your ancestors worshiped when they lived beyond the Euphrates River and in Egypt. Serve the Lord alone.
verses.textEnNasb: "Now, therefore, fear the Lord and serve Him in sincerity and truth; and do away with the gods which your fathers served beyond the Euphrates River and in Egypt, and serve the Lord.
verses.textEn: "Now fear the Lord and serve him with all faithfulness. Throw away the gods your ancestors worshiped beyond the Euphrates River and in Egypt, and serve the Lord .

verses.textZh: 如果你们认为事奉耶和华不好，那么今日你们就可以选择你们所要事奉的：是你们列祖在大河那边事奉的神呢，还是你们现在所住亚摩利人之地的神呢？至于我和我家，我们必事奉耶和华。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果你们认为事奉耶和华不好，那么今日你们就可以选择你们所要事奉的：是你们列祖在大河那边事奉的神呢，还是你们现在所住亚摩利人之地的神呢？至于我和我家，我们必事奉耶和华。"
verses.textZhCuv: 若是你们以事奉耶和华为不好，今日就可以选择所要事奉的：是你们列祖在大河那边所事奉的神呢？是你们所住这地的亚摩利人的神呢？至于我和我家，我们必定事奉耶和华。」
verses.textEnNiv: But if serving the Lord seems undesirable to you, then choose for yourselves this day whom you will serve, whether the gods your ancestors served beyond the Euphrates, or the gods of the Amorites, in whose land you are living. But as for me and my household, we will serve the Lord ."
verses.textEnEsv: And if it is evil in your eyes to serve the Lord , choose this day whom you will serve, whether the gods your fathers served in the region beyond the River, or the gods of the Amorites in whose land you dwell. But as for me and my house, we will serve the Lord ."
verses.textEnNkjv: And if it seems evil to you to serve the Lord, choose for yourselves this day whom you will serve, whether the gods which your fathers served that were on the other side of the River, or the gods of the Amorites, in whose land you dwell. But as for me and my house, we will serve the Lord."
verses.textEnNlt: But if you refuse to serve the Lord , then choose today whom you will serve. Would you prefer the gods your ancestors served beyond the Euphrates? Or will it be the gods of the Amorites in whose land you now live? But as for me and my family, we will serve the Lord ."
verses.textEnNasb: But if it is disagreeable in your sight to serve the Lord, choose for yourselves today whom you will serve: whether the gods which your fathers served, which were beyond the Euphrates River, or the gods of the Amorites in whose land you are living; but as for me and my house, we will serve the Lord."
verses.textEn: But if serving the Lord seems undesirable to you, then choose for yourselves this day whom you will serve, whether the gods your ancestors served beyond the Euphrates, or the gods of the Amorites, in whose land you are living. But as for me and my household, we will serve the Lord ."

verses.textZh: 众民回答："我们绝对不会离弃耶和华，去事奉别的神；
verses.textZhCnvs: 众民回答："我们绝对不会离弃耶和华，去事奉别的神；
verses.textZhCuv: 百姓回答说：「我们断不敢离弃耶和华去事奉别神；
verses.textEnNiv: Then the people answered, "Far be it from us to forsake the Lord to serve other gods!
verses.textEnEsv: Then the people answered, "Far be it from us that we should forsake the Lord to serve other gods,
verses.textEnNkjv: So the people answered and said: "Far be it from us that we should forsake the Lord to serve other gods;
verses.textEnNlt: The people replied, "We would never abandon the Lord and serve other gods.
verses.textEnNasb: The people answered and said, "Far be it from us that we would abandon the Lord to serve other gods;
verses.textEn: Then the people answered, "Far be it from us to forsake the Lord to serve other gods!

verses.textZh: 因为耶和华我们的神把我们和我们的列祖，从埃及地为奴的家领出来，并且在我们眼前行了那些伟大的神迹；又在我们所行的一切路上，和我们经过的一切民族中间，他都保护了我们；
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为耶和华我们的神把我们和我们的列祖，从埃及地为奴的家领出来，并且在我们眼前行了那些伟大的神迹；又在我们所行的一切路上，和我们经过的一切民族中间，他都保护了我们；
verses.textZhCuv: 因耶和华－我们的神曾将我们和我们列祖从埃及地的为奴之家领出来，在我们眼前行了那些大神迹，在我们所行的道上，所经过的诸国，都保护了我们。
verses.textEnNiv: It was the Lord our God himself who brought us and our parents up out of Egypt, from that land of slavery, and performed those great signs before our eyes. He protected us on our entire journey and among all the nations through which we traveled.
verses.textEnEsv: for it is the Lord our God who brought us and our fathers up from the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery, and who did those great signs in our sight and preserved us in all the way that we went, and among all the peoples through whom we passed.
verses.textEnNkjv: for the Lord our God is He who brought us and our fathers up out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage, who did those great signs in our sight, and preserved us in all the way that we went and among all the people through whom we passed.
verses.textEnNlt: For the Lord our God is the one who rescued us and our ancestors from slavery in the land of Egypt. He performed mighty miracles before our very eyes. As we traveled through the wilderness among our enemies, he preserved us.
verses.textEnNasb: for the Lord our God is He who brought us and our fathers up out of the land of Egypt, from the house of slaves, and did these great signs in our sight and watched over us through all the way in which we went and among all the peoples through whose midst we passed.
verses.textEn: It was the Lord our God himself who brought us and our parents up out of Egypt, from that land of slavery, and performed those great signs before our eyes. He protected us on our entire journey and among all the nations through which we traveled.

verses.textZh: 耶和华又把所有的民族和住在这地的亚摩利人，都从我们面前赶走；所以我们必事奉耶和华，因为他是我们的神。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华又把所有的民族和住在这地的亚摩利人，都从我们面前赶走；所以我们必事奉耶和华，因为他是我们的神。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华又把住此地的亚摩利人都从我们面前赶出去。所以，我们必事奉耶和华，因为他是我们的神。」
verses.textEnNiv: And the Lord drove out before us all the nations, including the Amorites, who lived in the land. We too will serve the Lord , because he is our God."
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord drove out before us all the peoples, the Amorites who lived in the land. Therefore we also will serve the Lord , for he is our God."
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord drove out from before us all the people, including the Amorites who dwelt in the land. We also will serve the Lord, for He is our God."
verses.textEnNlt: It was the Lord who drove out the Amorites and the other nations living here in the land. So we, too, will serve the Lord , for he alone is our God."
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord drove out from before us all the peoples, even the Amorites who lived in the land. We also will serve the Lord, for He is our God."
verses.textEn: And the Lord drove out before us all the nations, including the Amorites, who lived in the land. We too will serve the Lord , because he is our God."

verses.textZh: 约书亚对众民说："你们不能事奉耶和华，因为他是圣洁的神；他是嫉妒的神，他必不赦免你们的过犯和罪恶。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约书亚对众民说："你们不能事奉耶和华，因为他是圣洁的神；他是嫉妒的神，他必不赦免你们的过犯和罪恶。
verses.textZhCuv: 约书亚对百姓说：「你们不能事奉耶和华；因为他是圣洁的神，是忌邪的神，必不赦免你们的过犯罪恶。
verses.textEnNiv: Joshua said to the people, "You are not able to serve the Lord . He is a holy God; he is a jealous God. He will not forgive your rebellion and your sins.
verses.textEnEsv: But Joshua said to the people, "You are not able to serve the Lord , for he is a holy God. He is a jealous God; he will not forgive your transgressions or your sins.
verses.textEnNkjv: But Joshua said to the people, "You cannot serve the Lord, for He is a holy God. He is a jealous God; He will not forgive your transgressions nor your sins.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Joshua warned the people, "You are not able to serve the Lord , for he is a holy and jealous God. He will not forgive your rebellion and your sins.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Joshua said to the people, "You will not be able to serve the Lord, for He is a holy God. He is a jealous God; He will not forgive your wrongdoing or your sins.
verses.textEn: Joshua said to the people, "You are not able to serve the Lord . He is a holy God; he is a jealous God. He will not forgive your rebellion and your sins.

verses.textZh: 如果你们离弃耶和华，去事奉外族人的神，那么在耶和华赐福给你们之后，他必转而降祸与你们，把你们消灭。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果你们离弃耶和华，去事奉外族人的神，那么在耶和华赐福给你们之后，他必转而降祸与你们，把你们消灭。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你们若离弃耶和华去事奉外邦神，耶和华在降福之后，必转而降祸与你们，把你们灭绝。」
verses.textEnNiv: If you forsake the Lord and serve foreign gods, he will turn and bring disaster on you and make an end of you, after he has been good to you."
verses.textEnEsv: If you forsake the Lord and serve foreign gods, then he will turn and do you harm and consume you, after having done you good."
verses.textEnNkjv: If you forsake the Lord and serve foreign gods, then He will turn and do you harm and consume you, after He has done you good."
verses.textEnNlt: If you abandon the Lord and serve other gods, he will turn against you and destroy you, even though he has been so good to you."
verses.textEnNasb: If you abandon the Lord and serve foreign gods, then He will turn and do you harm and destroy you after He has done good to you."
verses.textEn: If you forsake the Lord and serve foreign gods, he will turn and bring disaster on you and make an end of you, after he has been good to you."

verses.textZh: 众民对约书亚说："不，我们必定事奉耶和华。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 众民对约书亚说："不，我们必定事奉耶和华。"
verses.textZhCuv: 百姓回答约书亚说：「不然，我们定要事奉耶和华。」
verses.textEnNiv: But the people said to Joshua, "No! We will serve the Lord ."
verses.textEnEsv: And the people said to Joshua, "No, but we will serve the Lord ."
verses.textEnNkjv: And the people said to Joshua, "No, but we will serve the Lord!"
verses.textEnNlt: But the people answered Joshua, "No, we will serve the Lord !"
verses.textEnNasb: And the people said to Joshua, "No, but we will serve the Lord."
verses.textEn: But the people said to Joshua, "No! We will serve the Lord ."

verses.textZh: 约书亚对众民说："你们选择了耶和华，要事奉他，你们为自己作证吧。"他们说："我们愿意作证。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 约书亚对众民说："你们选择了耶和华，要事奉他，你们为自己作证吧。"他们说："我们愿意作证。"
verses.textZhCuv: 约书亚对百姓说：「你们选定耶和华，要事奉他，你们自己作见证吧！」他们说：「我们愿意作见证。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Joshua said, "You are witnesses against yourselves that you have chosen to serve the Lord ." "Yes, we are witnesses," they replied.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Joshua said to the people, "You are witnesses against yourselves that you have chosen the Lord , to serve him." And they said, "We are witnesses."
verses.textEnNkjv: So Joshua said to the people, "You are witnesses against yourselves that you have chosen the Lord for yourselves, to serve Him." And they said, "Weare witnesses!"
verses.textEnNlt: "You are a witness to your own decision," Joshua said. "You have chosen to serve the Lord ." "Yes," they replied, "we are witnesses to what we have said."
verses.textEnNasb: So Joshua said to the people, "You are witnesses against yourselves that you have chosen for yourselves the Lord, to serve Him." And they said, "We are witnesses."
verses.textEn: Then Joshua said, "You are witnesses against yourselves that you have chosen to serve the Lord ." "Yes, we are witnesses," they replied.

verses.textZh: 约书亚说："现在你们要除掉在你们中间外族人的神，一心归向耶和华以色列的神。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 约书亚说："现在你们要除掉在你们中间外族人的神，一心归向耶和华以色列的神。"
verses.textZhCuv: 约书亚说：「你们现在要除掉你们中间的外邦神，专心归向耶和华－以色列的神。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Now then," said Joshua, "throw away the foreign gods that are among you and yield your hearts to the Lord , the God of Israel."
verses.textEnEsv: He said, "Then put away the foreign gods that are among you, and incline your heart to the Lord , the God of Israel."
verses.textEnNkjv: "Now therefore," hesaid, "put away the foreign gods which are among you, and incline your heart to the Lord God of Israel."
verses.textEnNlt: "All right then," Joshua said, "destroy the idols among you, and turn your hearts to the Lord , the God of Israel."
verses.textEnNasb: "Now then, do away with the foreign gods which are in your midst, and incline your hearts to the Lord, the God of Israel."
verses.textEn: "Now then," said Joshua, "throw away the foreign gods that are among you and yield your hearts to the Lord , the God of Israel."

verses.textZh: 众民对约书亚说："我们必事奉耶和华我们的神，必听从他的话。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 众民对约书亚说："我们必事奉耶和华我们的神，必听从他的话。"
verses.textZhCuv: 百姓回答约书亚说：「我们必事奉耶和华－我们的神，听从他的话。」
verses.textEnNiv: And the people said to Joshua, "We will serve the Lord our God and obey him."
verses.textEnEsv: And the people said to Joshua, "The Lord our God we will serve, and his voice we will obey."
verses.textEnNkjv: And the people said to Joshua, "The Lord our God we will serve, and His voice we will obey!"
verses.textEnNlt: The people said to Joshua, "We will serve the Lord our God. We will obey him alone."
verses.textEnNasb: And the people said to Joshua, "We will serve the Lord our God and obey His voice."
verses.textEn: And the people said to Joshua, "We will serve the Lord our God and obey him."

verses.textZh: 那一天，约书亚就与众民立约，在示剑为他们订立律例和典章。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那一天，约书亚就与众民立约，在示剑为他们订立律例和典章。
verses.textZhCuv: 当日，约书亚就与百姓立约，在示剑为他们立定律例典章。
verses.textEnNiv: On that day Joshua made a covenant for the people, and there at Shechem he reaffirmed for them decrees and laws.
verses.textEnEsv: So Joshua made a covenant with the people that day, and put in place statutes and rules for them at Shechem.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Joshua made a covenant with the people that day, and made for them a statute and an ordinance in Shechem.
verses.textEnNlt: So Joshua made a covenant with the people that day at Shechem, committing them to follow the decrees and regulations of the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: So Joshua made a covenant with the people that day, and made for them a statute and an ordinance in Shechem.
verses.textEn: On that day Joshua made a covenant for the people, and there at Shechem he reaffirmed for them decrees and laws.

verses.textZh: 约书亚把这些话都写在神的律法书上；又拿一块大石头，立在耶和华圣所旁边的橡树下。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约书亚把这些话都写在神的律法书上；又拿一块大石头，立在耶和华圣所旁边的橡树下。
verses.textZhCuv: 约书亚将这些话都写在神的律法书上，又将一块大石头立在橡树下耶和华的圣所旁边。
verses.textEnNiv: And Joshua recorded these things in the Book of the Law of God. Then he took a large stone and set it up there under the oak near the holy place of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: And Joshua wrote these words in the Book of the Law of God. And he took a large stone and set it up there under the terebinth that was by the sanctuary of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Joshua wrote these words in the Book of the Law of God. And he took a large stone, and set it up there under the oak that was by the sanctuary of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Joshua recorded these things in the Book of God’s Instructions. As a reminder of their agreement, he took a huge stone and rolled it beneath the terebinth tree beside the Tabernacle of the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: And Joshua wrote these words in the Book of the Law of God; and he took a large stone and set it up there under the oak that was by the sanctuary of the Lord.
verses.textEn: And Joshua recorded these things in the Book of the Law of God. Then he took a large stone and set it up there under the oak near the holy place of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 约书亚对全体人民说："看哪，这块石头可以向我们作证，因为它听见了耶和华对我们所说的一切话；所以这块石头要向你们作证，免得你们否认你们的神。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 约书亚对全体人民说："看哪，这块石头可以向我们作证，因为它听见了耶和华对我们所说的一切话；所以这块石头要向你们作证，免得你们否认你们的神。"
verses.textZhCuv: 约书亚对百姓说：「看哪，这石头可以向我们作见证；因为是听见了耶和华所吩咐我们的一切话，倘或你们背弃你们的神，这石头就可以向你们作见证 。」
verses.textEnNiv: "See!" he said to all the people. "This stone will be a witness against us. It has heard all the words the Lord has said to us. It will be a witness against you if you are untrue to your God."
verses.textEnEsv: And Joshua said to all the people, "Behold, this stone shall be a witness against us, for it has heard all the words of the Lord that he spoke to us. Therefore it shall be a witness against you, lest you deal falsely with your God."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Joshua said to all the people, "Behold, this stone shall be a witness to us, for it has heard all the words of the Lord which He spoke to us. It shall therefore be a witness to you, lest you deny your God."
verses.textEnNlt: Joshua said to all the people, "This stone has heard everything the Lord said to us. It will be a witness to testify against you if you go back on your word to God."
verses.textEnNasb: Then Joshua said to all the people, "Behold, this stone shall be a witness against us, because it has heard all the words of the Lord which He spoke to us; so it shall be a witness against you, so that you do not deny your God."
verses.textEn: "See!" he said to all the people. "This stone will be a witness against us. It has heard all the words the Lord has said to us. It will be a witness against you if you are untrue to your God."

verses.textZh: 于是约书亚打发众民各自回到自己的地业去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是约书亚打发众民各自回到自己的地业去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是约书亚打发百姓各归自己的地业去了。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Joshua dismissed the people, each to their own inheritance.
verses.textEnEsv: So Joshua sent the people away, every man to his inheritance.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Joshua let the people depart, each to his own inheritance.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Joshua sent all the people away to their own homelands.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Joshua dismissed the people, each to his inheritance.
verses.textEn: Then Joshua dismissed the people, each to their own inheritance.

verses.textZh: 这些事以后，耶和华的仆人、嫩的儿子约书亚死了，那时他是一百一十岁。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些事以后，耶和华的仆人、嫩的儿子约书亚死了，那时他是一百一十岁。
verses.textZhCuv: 这些事以后，耶和华的仆人嫩的儿子约书亚，正一百一十岁，就死了。
verses.textEnNiv: After these things, Joshua son of Nun, the servant of the Lord , died at the age of a hundred and ten.
verses.textEnEsv: After these things Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of the Lord , died, being 110 years old.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it came to pass after these things that Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of the Lord, died, being one hundred and ten years old.
verses.textEnNlt: After this, Joshua son of Nun, the servant of the Lord , died at the age of 110.
verses.textEnNasb: Now it came about after these things that Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of the Lord, died, being 110 years old.
verses.textEn: After these things, Joshua son of Nun, the servant of the Lord , died at the age of a hundred and ten.

verses.textZh: 以色列人把他埋葬在他自己地业的境内，就是在以法莲山地上的亭拿．西拉，在迦实山的北边。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人把他埋葬在他自己地业的境内，就是在以法莲山地上的亭拿．西拉，在迦实山的北边。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人将他葬在他地业的境内，就是在以法莲山地的亭拿‧西拉，在迦实山的北边。
verses.textEnNiv: And they buried him in the land of his inheritance, at Timnath Serah in the hill country of Ephraim, north of Mount Gaash.
verses.textEnEsv: And they buried him in his own inheritance at Timnath-serah, which is in the hill country of Ephraim, north of the mountain of Gaash.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they buried him within the border of his inheritance at Timnath Serah, which is in the mountains of Ephraim, on the north side of Mount Gaash.
verses.textEnNlt: They buried him in the land he had been allocated, at Timnath-serah in the hill country of Ephraim, north of Mount Gaash.
verses.textEnNasb: And they buried him in the territory of his inheritance, in Timnath-serah, which is in the hill country of Ephraim, on the north of Mount Gaash.
verses.textEn: And they buried him in the land of his inheritance, at Timnath Serah in the hill country of Ephraim, north of Mount Gaash.

verses.textZh: 约书亚在世的日子，和约书亚死后，那些知道耶和华为以色列人所行的一切事的长老还在世的日子，以色列人都事奉耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约书亚在世的日子，和约书亚死后，那些知道耶和华为以色列人所行的一切事的长老还在世的日子，以色列人都事奉耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 约书亚在世和约书亚死后，那些知道耶和华为以色列人所行诸事的长老还在的时候，以色列人事奉耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: Israel served the Lord throughout the lifetime of Joshua and of the elders who outlived him and who had experienced everything the Lord had done for Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: Israel served the Lord all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders who outlived Joshua and had known all the work that the Lord did for Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Israel served the Lord all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders who outlived Joshua, who had known all the works of the Lord which He had done for Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: The people of Israel served the Lord throughout the lifetime of Joshua and of the elders who outlived him—those who had personally experienced all that the Lord had done for Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: Israel served the Lord all the days of Joshua and all the days of the elders who survived Joshua, and had known every deed of the Lord which He had done for Israel.
verses.textEn: Israel served the Lord throughout the lifetime of Joshua and of the elders who outlived him and who had experienced everything the Lord had done for Israel.

verses.textZh: 以色列人从埃及带出来的约瑟骸骨，葬在示剑的一块田里；这块田是雅各从前用一百块银子向示剑的父亲哈抹的子孙那里买来的；这块田就成了约瑟子孙的产业。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人从埃及带出来的约瑟骸骨，葬在示剑的一块田里；这块田是雅各从前用一百块银子向示剑的父亲哈抹的子孙那里买来的；这块田就成了约瑟子孙的产业。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人从埃及所带来约瑟的骸骨，葬埋在示剑，就是在雅各从前用一百块银子向示剑的父亲、哈抹的子孙所买的那块地里；这就作了约瑟子孙的产业。
verses.textEnNiv: And Joseph’s bones, which the Israelites had brought up from Egypt, were buried at Shechem in the tract of land that Jacob bought for a hundred pieces of silver from the sons of Hamor, the father of Shechem. This became the inheritance of Joseph’s descendants.
verses.textEnEsv: As for the bones of Joseph, which the people of Israel brought up from Egypt, they buried them at Shechem, in the piece of land that Jacob bought from the sons of Hamor the father of Shechem for a hundred pieces of money. It became an inheritance of the descendants of Joseph.
verses.textEnNkjv: The bones of Joseph, which the children of Israel had brought up out of Egypt, they buried at Shechem, in the plot of ground which Jacob had bought from the sons of Hamor the father of Shechem for one hundred pieces of silver, and which had become an inheritance of the children of Joseph.
verses.textEnNlt: The bones of Joseph, which the Israelites had brought along with them when they left Egypt, were buried at Shechem, in the plot of land Jacob had bought from the sons of Hamor for 100 pieces of silver. This land was located in the territory allotted to the descendants of Joseph.
verses.textEnNasb: Now they buried the bones of Joseph, which the sons of Israel brought up from Egypt, at Shechem, in the plot of land which Jacob had bought from the sons of Hamor the father of Shechem for a hundred pieces of money; and they became the inheritance of Joseph’s sons.
verses.textEn: And Joseph’s bones, which the Israelites had brought up from Egypt, were buried at Shechem in the tract of land that Jacob bought for a hundred pieces of silver from the sons of Hamor, the father of Shechem. This became the inheritance of Joseph’s descendants.

verses.textZh: 亚伦的儿子以利亚撒也死了；以色列人就把他埋葬在基比亚，就是他儿子非尼哈在以法莲山地所得的产业。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伦的儿子以利亚撒也死了；以色列人就把他埋葬在基比亚，就是他儿子非尼哈在以法莲山地所得的产业。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伦的儿子以利亚撒也死了，就把他葬在他儿子非尼哈所得以法莲山地的小山上。
verses.textEnNiv: And Eleazar son of Aaron died and was buried at Gibeah, which had been allotted to his son Phinehas in the hill country of Ephraim.
verses.textEnEsv: And Eleazar the son of Aaron died, and they buried him at Gibeah, the town of Phinehas his son, which had been given him in the hill country of Ephraim.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Eleazar the son of Aaron died. They buried him in a hill belongingto Phinehas his son, which was given to him in the mountains of Ephraim.
verses.textEnNlt: Eleazar son of Aaron also died. He was buried in the hill country of Ephraim, in the town of Gibeah, which had been given to his son Phinehas.
verses.textEnNasb: And Eleazar the son of Aaron died; and they buried him at Gibeah, the town of his son Phinehas, which was given to him in the hill country of Ephraim.
verses.textEn: And Eleazar son of Aaron died and was buried at Gibeah, which had been allotted to his son Phinehas in the hill country of Ephraim.
